verses.textZh: 太初有道，道与神同在，道就是神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 太初有道，道与神同在，道就是神。
verses.textZhCuv: 太初有道，道与神同在，道就是神。
verses.textEnNiv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.textEnEsv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.textEnNlt: In the beginning the Word already existed. The Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.textEnNasb: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.textEn: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

verses.textZh: 这道太初与神同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这道太初与神同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 这道太初与神同在。
verses.textEnNiv: He was with God in the beginning.
verses.textEnEsv: He was in the beginning with God.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was in the beginning with God.
verses.textEnNlt: He existed in the beginning with God.
verses.textEnNasb: He was in the beginning with God.
verses.textEn: He was with God in the beginning.

verses.textZh: 万有是借着他造的；凡被造的，没有一样不是借着他造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万有是借着他造的；凡被造的，没有一样不是借着他造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 万物是藉着他造的；凡被造的，没有一样不是藉着他造的。
verses.textEnNiv: Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.
verses.textEnEsv: All things were made through him, and without him was not any thing made that was made.
verses.textEnNkjv: All things were made through Him, and without Him nothing was made that was made.
verses.textEnNlt: God created everything through him, and nothing was created except through him.
verses.textEnNasb: All things came into being through Him, and apart from Him not even one thing came into being that has come into being.
verses.textEn: Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.

verses.textZh: 在他里面有生命， 这生命就是人的光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他里面有生命， 这生命就是人的光。
verses.textZhCuv: 生命在他里头，这生命就是人的光。
verses.textEnNiv: In him was life, and that life was the light of all mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
verses.textEnNkjv: In Him was life, and the life was the light of men.
verses.textEnNlt: The Word gave life to everything that was created, and his life brought light to everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: In Him was life, and the life was the Light of mankind.
verses.textEn: In him was life, and that life was the light of all mankind.

verses.textZh: 光照在黑暗中，黑暗不能胜过光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 光照在黑暗中，黑暗不能胜过光。
verses.textZhCuv: 光照在黑暗里，黑暗却不接受光。
verses.textEnNiv: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
verses.textEnEsv: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not comprehend it.
verses.textEnNlt: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness can never extinguish it.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not grasp it.
verses.textEn: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.

verses.textZh: 有一个人，名叫约翰，是神所差来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人，名叫约翰，是神所差来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人，是从神那里差来的，名叫约翰。
verses.textEnNiv: There was a man sent from God whose name was John.
verses.textEnEsv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.textEnNkjv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.textEnNlt: God sent a man, John the Baptist,
verses.textEnNasb: A man came, one sent from God, and his name was John.
verses.textEn: There was a man sent from God whose name was John.

verses.textZh: 他来是要作见证，就是为光作见证，使众人借着他可以相信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他来是要作见证，就是为光作见证，使众人借着他可以相信。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人来，为要作见证，就是为光作见证，叫众人因他可以信。
verses.textEnNiv: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all might believe.
verses.textEnEsv: He came as a witness, to bear witness about the light, that all might believe through him.
verses.textEnNkjv: This man came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all through him might believe.
verses.textEnNlt: to tell about the light so that everyone might believe because of his testimony.
verses.textEnNasb: He came as a witness, to testify about the Light, so that all might believe through him.
verses.textEn: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all might believe.

verses.textZh: 他不是那光，而是要为那光作见证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不是那光，而是要为那光作见证。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不是那光，乃是要为光作见证。
verses.textEnNiv: He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.
verses.textEnEsv: He was not the light, but came to bear witness about the light.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was not that Light, but wassent to bear witness of that Light.
verses.textEnNlt: John himself was not the light; he was simply a witness to tell about the light.
verses.textEnNasb: He was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.
verses.textEn: He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.

verses.textZh: 那光来到世界，是普照世人的真光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那光来到世界，是普照世人的真光。
verses.textZhCuv: 那光是真光，照亮一切生在世上的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The true light that gives light to everyone was coming into the world.
verses.textEnEsv: The true light, which gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: That was the true Light which gives light to every man coming into the world.
verses.textEnNlt: The one who is the true light, who gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.
verses.textEnNasb: This was the true Light that, coming into the world, enlightens every person.
verses.textEn: The true light that gives light to everyone was coming into the world.

verses.textZh: 他在世界，世界也是借着他造的，世界却不认识他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在世界，世界也是借着他造的，世界却不认识他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在世界，世界也是藉着他造的，世界却不认识他。
verses.textEnNiv: He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.
verses.textEnEsv: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, yet the world did not know him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was in the world, and the world was made through Him, and the world did not know Him.
verses.textEnNlt: He came into the very world he created, but the world didn’t recognize him.
verses.textEnNasb: He was in the world, and the world came into being through Him, and yet the world did not know Him.
verses.textEn: He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.

verses.textZh: 他到自己的地方来，自己的人却不接受他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他到自己的地方来，自己的人却不接受他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他到自己的地方来，自己的人倒不接待他。
verses.textEnNiv: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.
verses.textEnEsv: He came to his own, and his own people did not receive him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
verses.textEnNlt: He came to his own people, and even they rejected him.
verses.textEnNasb: He came to His own, and His own people did not accept Him.
verses.textEn: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.

verses.textZh: 凡接受他的，就是信他名的人，他就赐给他们权利，成为神的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡接受他的，就是信他名的人，他就赐给他们权利，成为神的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡接待他的，就是信他名的人，他就赐他们权柄作神的儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God—
verses.textEnEsv: But to all who did receive him, who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: But as many as received Him, to them He gave the right to become children of God, to those who believe in His name:
verses.textEnNlt: But to all who believed him and accepted him, he gave the right to become children of God.
verses.textEnNasb: But as many as received Him, to them He gave the right to become children of God, to those who believe in His name,
verses.textEn: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God—

verses.textZh: 他们不是从血统生的，不是从肉身的意思生的，也不是从人意生的，而是从神生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不是从血统生的，不是从肉身的意思生的，也不是从人意生的，而是从神生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这等人不是从血气生的，不是从情欲生的，也不是从人意生的，乃是从神生的。
verses.textEnNiv: children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband’s will, but born of God.
verses.textEnEsv: who were born, not of blood nor of the will of the flesh nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.textEnNlt: They are reborn—not with a physical birth resulting from human passion or plan, but a birth that comes from God.
verses.textEnNasb: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of a man, but of God.
verses.textEn: children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband’s will, but born of God.

verses.textZh: 道成了肉身，住在我们中间，满有恩典和真理。我们见过他的荣光，正是从父而来的独生子的荣光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 道成了肉身，住在我们中间，满有恩典和真理。我们见过他的荣光，正是从父而来的独生子的荣光。
verses.textZhCuv: 道成了肉身，住在我们中间，充充满满地有恩典有真理。我们也见过他的荣光，正是父独生子的荣光。
verses.textEnNiv: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we have seen his glory, glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Word became human and made his home among us. He was full of unfailing love and faithfulness. And we have seen his glory, the glory of the Father’s one and only Son.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us; and we saw His glory, glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
verses.textEn: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.

verses.textZh: 约翰为他作见证，大声说："这一位就是我所说的：‘那在我以后来的，位分比我高，因为他本来是在我以前的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰为他作见证，大声说："这一位就是我所说的：‘那在我以后来的，位分比我高，因为他本来是在我以前的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰为他作见证，喊着说：「这就是我曾说：『那在我以后来的，反成了在我以前的，因他本来在我以前。』」
verses.textEnNiv: (John testified concerning him. He cried out, saying, "This is the one I spoke about when I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’ ")
verses.textEnEsv: ( John bore witness about him, and cried out, "This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me ranks before me, because he was before me.’")
verses.textEnNkjv: John bore witness of Him and cried out, saying, "This was He of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me is preferred before me, for He was before me.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: John testified about him when he shouted to the crowds, "This is the one I was talking about when I said, ‘Someone is coming after me who is far greater than I am, for he existed long before me.’"
verses.textEnNasb: John *testified about Him and called out, saying, "This was He of whom I said, ‘He who is coming after me has proved to be my superior, because He existed before me.’ "
verses.textEn: (John testified concerning him. He cried out, saying, "This is the one I spoke about when I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’ ")

verses.textZh: 从他的丰盛里我们都领受了，而且恩上加恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从他的丰盛里我们都领受了，而且恩上加恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 从他丰满的恩典里，我们都领受了，而且恩上加恩。
verses.textEnNiv: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.
verses.textEnEsv: For from his fullness we have all received, grace upon grace.
verses.textEnNkjv: And of His fullness we have all received, and grace for grace.
verses.textEnNlt: From his abundance we have all received one gracious blessing after another.
verses.textEnNasb: For of His fullness we have all received, and grace upon grace.
verses.textEn: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.

verses.textZh: 律法是借着摩西颁布的，恩典和真理却是借着耶稣基督而来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 律法是借着摩西颁布的，恩典和真理却是借着耶稣基督而来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 律法本是藉着摩西传的；恩典和真理都是由耶稣基督来的。
verses.textEnNiv: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the law was given through Moses, but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: For the law was given through Moses, but God’s unfailing love and faithfulness came through Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Law was given through Moses; grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 从来没有人见过神，只有在父怀里的独生子把他彰显出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从来没有人见过神，只有在父怀里的独生子把他彰显出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 从来没有人看见神，只有在父怀里的独生子将他表明出来。
verses.textEnNiv: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is himself God and is in closest relationship with the Father, has made him known.
verses.textEnEsv: No one has ever seen God; God the only Son, who is at the Father’s side, he has made him known.
verses.textEnNkjv: No one has seen God at any time. The only begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, He has declared Him.
verses.textEnNlt: No one has ever seen God. But the unique One, who is himself God, is near to the Father’s heart. He has revealed God to us.
verses.textEnNasb: No one has seen God at any time; God the only Son, who is in the arms of the Father, He has explained Him.
verses.textEn: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is himself God and is in closest relationship with the Father, has made him known.

verses.textZh: 以下是约翰的见证：犹太人从耶路撒冷派祭司和利未人到约翰那里，问他："你是谁？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是约翰的见证：犹太人从耶路撒冷派祭司和利未人到约翰那里，问他："你是谁？"
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰所作的见证记在下面：犹太人从耶路撒冷差祭司和利未人到约翰那里，问他说：「你是谁？」
verses.textEnNiv: Now this was John’s testimony when the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him who he was.
verses.textEnEsv: And this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, "Who are you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, "Who are you?"
verses.textEnNlt: This was John’s testimony when the Jewish leaders sent priests and Temple assistants from Jerusalem to ask John, "Who are you?"
verses.textEnNasb: This is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites to him from Jerusalem to ask him, "Who are you?"
verses.textEn: Now this was John’s testimony when the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him who he was.

verses.textZh: 约翰并不否认，坦白地承认说："我不是基督。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰并不否认，坦白地承认说："我不是基督。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他就明说，并不隐瞒，明说：「我不是基督。」
verses.textEnNiv: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, "I am not the Messiah."
verses.textEnEsv: He confessed, and did not deny, but confessed, "I am not the Christ."
verses.textEnNkjv: He confessed, and did not deny, but confessed, "I am not the Christ."
verses.textEnNlt: He came right out and said, "I am not the Messiah."
verses.textEnNasb: And he confessed and did not deny; and this is what he confessed: "I am not the Christ."
verses.textEn: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, "I am not the Messiah."

verses.textZh: 他们又问："那么你是谁？是以利亚吗？"他说："我不是。""是那位先知吗？"他回答："不是。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又问："那么你是谁？是以利亚吗？"他说："我不是。""是那位先知吗？"他回答："不是。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又问他说：「这样，你是谁呢？是以利亚吗？」他说：「我不是。」「是那先知吗？」他回答说：「不是。」
verses.textEnNiv: They asked him, "Then who are you? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" He answered, "No."
verses.textEnEsv: And they asked him, "What then? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" And he answered, "No."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they asked him, "What then? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" And he answered, "No."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well then, who are you?" they asked. "Are you Elijah?" "No," he replied. "Are you the Prophet we are expecting?" "No."
verses.textEnNasb: And so they asked him, "What then? Are you Elijah?" And he *said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" And he answered, "No."
verses.textEn: They asked him, "Then who are you? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" He answered, "No."

verses.textZh: 于是他们再问："你是谁？好让我们回复派我们来的人。你说你自己是谁？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们再问："你是谁？好让我们回复派我们来的人。你说你自己是谁？"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是他们说：「你到底是谁，叫我们好回复差我们来的人。你自己说，你是谁？」
verses.textEnNiv: Finally they said, "Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"
verses.textEnEsv: So they said to him, "Who are you? We need to give an answer to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to him, "Who are you, that we may give an answer to those who sent us? What do you say about yourself?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Then who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you have to say about yourself?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to him, "Who are you? Tell us, so that we may give an answer to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"
verses.textEn: Finally they said, "Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"

verses.textZh: 他说："我就是在旷野呼喊者的声音：‘修直主的路！’正如以赛亚先知所说的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："我就是在旷野呼喊者的声音：‘修直主的路！’正如以赛亚先知所说的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「我就是那在旷野有人声喊着说：『修直主的道路』，正如先知以赛亚所说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet, "I am the voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "I am the voice of one crying out in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as the prophet Isaiah said."
verses.textEnNkjv: He said: "I am ‘The voice of one crying in the wilderness: "Make straight the way of the Lord," ’ as the prophet Isaiah said."
verses.textEnNlt: John replied in the words of the prophet Isaiah: "I am a voice shouting in the wilderness, ‘Clear the way for the Lord ’s coming!’"
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "I am the voice of one calling out in the wilderness, ‘Make the way of the Lord straight,’ as Isaiah the prophet said."
verses.textEn: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet, "I am the voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’ "

verses.textZh: 这些人是法利赛人派来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人是法利赛人派来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些人是法利赛人差来的 ；
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Pharisees who had been sent
verses.textEnEsv: (Now they had been sent from the Pharisees.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Now those who were sent were from the Pharisees.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Pharisees who had been sent
verses.textEnNasb: And the messengers had been sent from the Pharisees.
verses.textEn: Now the Pharisees who had been sent

verses.textZh: 他们问约翰："你既然不是基督，不是以利亚，也不是那位先知，那么你为甚么施洗呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们问约翰："你既然不是基督，不是以利亚，也不是那位先知，那么你为甚么施洗呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就问他说：「你既不是基督，不是以利亚，也不是那先知，为什么施洗呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: questioned him, "Why then do you baptize if you are not the Messiah, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"
verses.textEnEsv: They asked him, "Then why are you baptizing, if you are neither the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they asked him, saying, "Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"
verses.textEnNlt: asked him, "If you aren’t the Messiah or Elijah or the Prophet, what right do you have to baptize?"
verses.textEnNasb: They asked him, and said to him, "Why then are you baptizing, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"
verses.textEn: questioned him, "Why then do you baptize if you are not the Messiah, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"

verses.textZh: 约翰回答："我是用水施洗，但有一位站在你们中间，是你们不认识的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰回答："我是用水施洗，但有一位站在你们中间，是你们不认识的；
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰回答说：「我是用水施洗，但有一位站在你们中间，是你们不认识的，
verses.textEnNiv: "I baptize with water," John replied, "but among you stands one you do not know.
verses.textEnEsv: John answered them, "I baptize with water, but among you stands one you do not know,
verses.textEnNkjv: John answered them, saying, "I baptize with water, but there stands One among you whom you do not know.
verses.textEnNlt: John told them, "I baptize with water, but right here in the crowd is someone you do not recognize.
verses.textEnNasb: John answered them, saying, "I baptize in water, but among you stands One whom you do not know.
verses.textEn: "I baptize with water," John replied, "but among you stands one you do not know.

verses.textZh: 他是在我以后来的，我就是给他解鞋带也不配。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是在我以后来的，我就是给他解鞋带也不配。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就是那在我以后来的，我给他解鞋带也不配。」
verses.textEnNiv: He is the one who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie."
verses.textEnEsv: even he who comes after me, the strap of whose sandal I am not worthy to untie."
verses.textEnNkjv: It is He who, coming after me, is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I am not worthy to loose."
verses.textEnNlt: Though his ministry follows mine, I’m not even worthy to be his slave and untie the straps of his sandal."
verses.textEnNasb: It is He who comes after me, of whom I am not worthy even to untie the strap of His sandal."
verses.textEn: He is the one who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie."

verses.textZh: 这些事发生在约旦河东的伯大尼，约翰施洗的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事发生在约旦河东的伯大尼，约翰施洗的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是在约旦河外伯大尼 ，约翰施洗的地方作的见证。
verses.textEnNiv: This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.textEnEsv: These things took place in Bethany across the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.textEnNlt: This encounter took place in Bethany, an area east of the Jordan River, where John was baptizing.
verses.textEnNasb: These things took place in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing people.
verses.textEn: This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

verses.textZh: 第二天，约翰见耶稣迎面而来，就说："看哪，神的羊羔，是除去世人的罪孽的！
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，约翰见耶稣迎面而来，就说："看哪，神的羊羔，是除去世人的罪孽的！
verses.textZhCuv: 次日，约翰看见耶稣来到他那里，就说：「看哪，神的羔羊，除去 世人罪孽的！
verses.textEnNiv: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, "Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.textEnEsv: The next day he saw Jesus coming toward him, and said, "Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.textEnNkjv: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him, and said, "Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.textEnNlt: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, "Look! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.textEnNasb: The next day he *saw Jesus coming to him, and *said, "Behold, the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.textEn: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, "Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

verses.textZh: 这一位就是我所说的：‘有一个人，是在我以后来的，位分比我高，因为他本来是在我以前的。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一位就是我所说的：‘有一个人，是在我以后来的，位分比我高，因为他本来是在我以前的。’
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是我曾说：『有一位在我以后来、反成了在我以前的，因他本来在我以前。』
verses.textEnNiv: This is the one I meant when I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’
verses.textEnEsv: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who ranks before me, because he was before me.’
verses.textEnNkjv: This is He of whom I said, ‘After me comes a Man who is preferred before me, for He was before me.’
verses.textEnNlt: He is the one I was talking about when I said, ‘A man is coming after me who is far greater than I am, for he existed long before me.’
verses.textEnNasb: This is He in behalf of whom I said, ‘After me is coming a Man who has proved to be my superior, because He existed before me.’
verses.textEn: This is the one I meant when I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’

verses.textZh: 我本来不认识他，但为了要把他显明给以色列人，因此我来用水施洗。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我本来不认识他，但为了要把他显明给以色列人，因此我来用水施洗。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我先前不认识他，如今我来用水施洗，为要叫他显明给以色列人。」
verses.textEnNiv: I myself did not know him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that he might be revealed to Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: I myself did not know him, but for this purpose I came baptizing with water, that he might be revealed to Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: I did not know Him; but that He should be revealed to Israel, therefore I came baptizing with water."
verses.textEnNlt: I did not recognize him as the Messiah, but I have been baptizing with water so that he might be revealed to Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: And I did not recognize Him, but so that He would be revealed to Israel, I came baptizing in water."
verses.textEn: I myself did not know him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that he might be revealed to Israel."

verses.textZh: 约翰又作见证说："我曾看见圣灵，好象鸽子从天上降下来，停留在他的身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰又作见证说："我曾看见圣灵，好象鸽子从天上降下来，停留在他的身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰又作见证说：「我曾看见圣灵，仿佛鸽子从天降下，住在他的身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then John gave this testimony: "I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.
verses.textEnEsv: And John bore witness: "I saw the Spirit descend from heaven like a dove, and it remained on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And John bore witness, saying, "I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and He remained upon Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then John testified, "I saw the Holy Spirit descending like a dove from heaven and resting upon him.
verses.textEnNasb: And John testified, saying, "I have seen the Spirit descending as a dove out of heaven, and He remained upon Him.
verses.textEn: Then John gave this testimony: "I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.

verses.textZh: 我本来不认识他，但那差我来用水施洗的对我说：‘你看见圣灵降下来，停留在谁身上，谁就是用圣灵施洗的。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我本来不认识他，但那差我来用水施洗的对我说：‘你看见圣灵降下来，停留在谁身上，谁就是用圣灵施洗的。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我先前不认识他，只是那差我来用水施洗的、对我说：『你看见圣灵降下来，住在谁的身上，谁就是用圣灵施洗的。』
verses.textEnNiv: And I myself did not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
verses.textEnEsv: I myself did not know him, but he who sent me to baptize with water said to me, ‘He on whom you see the Spirit descend and remain, this is he who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.’
verses.textEnNkjv: I did not know Him, but He who sent me to baptize with water said to me, ‘Upon whom you see the Spirit descending, and remaining on Him, this is He who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.’
verses.textEnNlt: I didn’t know he was the one, but when God sent me to baptize with water, he told me, ‘The one on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
verses.textEnNasb: And I did not recognize Him, but He who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘He upon whom you see the Spirit descending and remaining upon Him, this is the One who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
verses.textEn: And I myself did not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’

verses.textZh: 我看见了，就作见证说：‘这就是神的儿子。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见了，就作见证说：‘这就是神的儿子。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见了，就证明这是神的儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: I have seen and I testify that this is God’s Chosen One."
verses.textEnEsv: And I have seen and have borne witness that this is the Son of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God."
verses.textEnNlt: I saw this happen to Jesus, so I testify that he is the Chosen One of God. "
verses.textEnNasb: And I myself have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God."
verses.textEn: I have seen and I testify that this is God’s Chosen One."

verses.textZh: 过了一天，约翰和他的两个门徒又站在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了一天，约翰和他的两个门徒又站在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 再次日，约翰同两个门徒站在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
verses.textEnEsv: The next day again John was standing with two of his disciples,
verses.textEnNkjv: Again, the next day, John stood with two of his disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: The following day John was again standing with two of his disciples.
verses.textEnNasb: Again the next day John was standing with two of his disciples,
verses.textEn: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.

verses.textZh: 约翰看见耶稣走过的时候，就说："看哪，神的羊羔！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰看见耶稣走过的时候，就说："看哪，神的羊羔！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他见耶稣行走，就说：「看哪，这是神的羔羊！」
verses.textEnNiv: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, "Look, the Lamb of God!"
verses.textEnEsv: and he looked at Jesus as he walked by and said, "Behold, the Lamb of God!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And looking at Jesus as He walked, he said, "Behold the Lamb of God!"
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus walked by, John looked at him and declared, "Look! There is the Lamb of God!"
verses.textEnNasb: and he looked at Jesus as He walked, and *said, "Behold, the Lamb of God!"
verses.textEn: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, "Look, the Lamb of God!"

verses.textZh: 那两个门徒听见他的话，就跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那两个门徒听见他的话，就跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 两个门徒听见他的话，就跟从了耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: The two disciples heard him say this, and they followed Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: When John’s two disciples heard this, they followed Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.textEn: When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.

verses.textZh: 耶稣转过身来，看见他们跟着，就问："你们要甚么？"他们说："<red>拉比，你在哪里住？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣转过身来，看见他们跟着，就问："你们要甚么？"他们说："<red>拉比，你在哪里住？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣转过身来，看见他们跟着，就问他们说：「<red>你们要什么？</red>」他们说：「<red>拉比，在哪里住？</red>」（拉比翻出来就是夫子。）
verses.textEnNiv: Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, <red>“What do you want?”</red> They said, “Rabbi” (which means “Teacher”), “where are you staying?”
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus turned and saw them following and said to them, "What are you seeking?" And they said to him, "Rabbi" (which means Teacher), "where are you staying?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus turned, and seeing them following, said to them, "What do you seek?" They said to Him, "Rabbi" (which is to say, when translated, Teacher), "where are You staying?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus looked around and saw them following. "What do you want?" he asked them. They replied, "Rabbi" (which means "Teacher"), "where are you staying?"
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus turned and saw them following, and *said to them, "What are you seeking?" They said to Him, "Rabbi (which translated means Teacher), where are You staying?"
verses.textEn: Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, <red>“What do you want?”</red> They said, “Rabbi” (which means “Teacher”), “where are you staying?”

verses.textZh: <red>他说："你们来看吧！"于是他们就去看他所住的地方。那一天他们就和耶稣住在一起；那时大约是下午四点钟。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他说："你们来看吧！"于是他们就去看他所住的地方。那一天他们就和耶稣住在一起；那时大约是下午四点钟。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们来看。</red>」他们就去看他在哪里住，这一天便与他同住；那时约有申正了。
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Come,”</red> he replied, <red>“and you will see.”</red> So they went and saw where he was staying, and they spent that day with him. It was about four in the afternoon.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Come and you will see." So they came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day, for it was about the tenth hour.
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to them, "Come and see." They came and saw where He was staying, and remained with Him that day (now it was about the tenth hour).
verses.textEnNlt: "Come and see," he said. It was about four o’clock in the afternoon when they went with him to the place where he was staying, and they remained with him the rest of the day.
verses.textEnNasb: He *said to them, "Come, and you will see." So they came and saw where He was staying, and they stayed with Him that day; it was about the tenth hour.
verses.textEn: <red>“Come,”</red> he replied, <red>“and you will see.”</red> So they went and saw where he was staying, and they spent that day with him. It was about four in the afternoon.

verses.textZh: 听了约翰的话而跟从耶稣的那两个人，一个是西门．彼得的弟弟安得烈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听了约翰的话而跟从耶稣的那两个人，一个是西门．彼得的弟弟安得烈。
verses.textZhCuv: 听见约翰的话跟从耶稣的那两个人，一个是西门‧彼得的兄弟安得烈。
verses.textEnNiv: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: One of the two who heard John speak and followed Jesus was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: One of the two who heard John speak, and followed Him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.textEnNlt: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of these men who heard what John said and then followed Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: One of the two who heard John speak, and followed Him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.textEn: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他先找到自己的哥哥西门，告诉他："我们遇见弥赛亚了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他先找到自己的哥哥西门，告诉他："我们遇见弥赛亚了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他先找着自己的哥哥西门，对他说：「我们遇见弥赛亚了。」（弥赛亚翻出来就是基督。）
verses.textEnNiv: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother Simon and tell him, "We have found the Messiah" (that is, the Christ).
verses.textEnEsv: He first found his own brother Simon and said to him, "We have found the Messiah" (which means Christ).
verses.textEnNkjv: He first found his own brother Simon, and said to him, "We have found the Messiah" (which is translated, the Christ).
verses.textEnNlt: Andrew went to find his brother, Simon, and told him, "We have found the Messiah" (which means "Christ" ).
verses.textEnNasb: He first *found his own brother Simon and *said to him, "We have found the Messiah" (which translated means Christ).
verses.textEn: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother Simon and tell him, "We have found the Messiah" (that is, the Christ).

verses.textZh: 安得烈就带他到耶稣那里。耶稣定睛看着他，说："<red>你是约翰的儿子西门，你要称为矶法。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 安得烈就带他到耶稣那里。耶稣定睛看着他，说："<red>你是约翰的儿子西门，你要称为矶法。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是领他去见耶稣。耶稣看着他，说：「<red>你是约翰的儿子西门 ，你要称为矶法。</red>」（矶法翻出来就是彼得。）
verses.textEnNiv: And he brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, <red>“You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas”</red> (which, when translated, is Peter).
verses.textEnEsv: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, "You are Simon the son of John. You shall be called Cephas" (which means Peter ).
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought him to Jesus. Now when Jesus looked at him, He said, "You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas" (which is translated, A Stone).
verses.textEnNlt: Then Andrew brought Simon to meet Jesus. Looking intently at Simon, Jesus said, "Your name is Simon, son of John—but you will be called Cephas" (which means "Peter" ).
verses.textEnNasb: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, "You are Simon the son of John; you shall be called Cephas" (which is translated Peter).
verses.textEn: And he brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, <red>“You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas”</red> (which, when translated, is Peter).

verses.textZh: 再过一天，耶稣决定往加利利去；他遇见腓力，就对他说："<red>来跟从我！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 再过一天，耶稣决定往加利利去；他遇见腓力，就对他说："<red>来跟从我！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 又次日，耶稣想要往加利利去，遇见腓力，就对他说：「<red>来跟从我吧。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: The next day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. Finding Philip, he said to him, <red>“Follow me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. He found Philip and said to him, "Follow me."
verses.textEnNkjv: The following day Jesus wanted to go to Galilee, and He found Philip and said to him, "Follow Me."
verses.textEnNlt: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. He found Philip and said to him, "Come, follow me."
verses.textEnNasb: The next day He decided to go to Galilee, and He *found Philip. And Jesus *said to him, "Follow Me."
verses.textEn: The next day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. Finding Philip, he said to him, <red>“Follow me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 腓力是伯赛大人，与安得烈和彼得同乡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 腓力是伯赛大人，与安得烈和彼得同乡。
verses.textZhCuv: 这腓力是伯赛大人，和安得烈、彼得同城。
verses.textEnNiv: Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethsaida.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.textEnNlt: Philip was from Bethsaida, Andrew and Peter’s hometown.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.textEn: Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethsaida.

verses.textZh: 腓力找到拿但业，告诉他："摩西在律法书上所写的，和众先知所记的那位，我们已经遇见了，他就是约瑟的儿子拿撒勒人耶稣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 腓力找到拿但业，告诉他："摩西在律法书上所写的，和众先知所记的那位，我们已经遇见了，他就是约瑟的儿子拿撒勒人耶稣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 腓力找着拿但业，对他说：「摩西在律法上所写的和众先知所记的那一位，我们遇见了，就是约瑟的儿子拿撒勒人耶稣。」
verses.textEnNiv: Philip found Nathanael and told him, "We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law, and about whom the prophets also wrote—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."
verses.textEnEsv: Philip found Nathanael and said to him, "We have found him of whom Moses in the Law and also the prophets wrote, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."
verses.textEnNkjv: Philip found Nathanael and said to him, "We have found Him of whom Moses in the law, and also the prophets, wrote—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."
verses.textEnNlt: Philip went to look for Nathanael and told him, "We have found the very person Moses and the prophets wrote about! His name is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth."
verses.textEnNasb: Philip *found Nathanael and *said to him, "We have found Him of whom Moses wrote in the Law, and the prophets also wrote: Jesus the son of Joseph, from Nazareth!"
verses.textEn: Philip found Nathanael and told him, "We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law, and about whom the prophets also wrote—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."

verses.textZh: 拿但业说："拿撒勒还能出甚么好的吗？"腓力说："你来看！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿但业说："拿撒勒还能出甚么好的吗？"腓力说："你来看！"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿但业对他说：「拿撒勒还能出什么好的吗？」腓力说：「你来看！」
verses.textEnNiv: "Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?" Nathanael asked. "Come and see," said Philip.
verses.textEnEsv: Nathanael said to him, "Can anything good come out of Nazareth?" Philip said to him, "Come and see."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Nathanael said to him, "Can anything good come out of Nazareth?" Philip said to him, "Come and see."
verses.textEnNlt: "Nazareth!" exclaimed Nathanael. "Can anything good come from Nazareth?" "Come and see for yourself," Philip replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Nathanael said to him, "Can anything good be from Nazareth?" Philip *said to him, "Come and see."
verses.textEn: "Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?" Nathanael asked. "Come and see," said Philip.

verses.textZh: 耶稣看见拿但业向他走过来，就论到他说："<red>看哪，这的确是个以色列人，他心里没有诡诈。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看见拿但业向他走过来，就论到他说："<red>看哪，这的确是个以色列人，他心里没有诡诈。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣看见拿但业来，就指着他说：「<red>看哪，这是个真以色列人，他心里是没有诡诈的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, <red>“Here truly is an Israelite in whom there is no deceit.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him and said of him, "Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom there is no deceit!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward Him, and said of him, "Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!"
verses.textEnNlt: As they approached, Jesus said, "Now here is a genuine son of Israel—a man of complete integrity."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to Him, and *said of him, "Here is truly an Israelite, in whom there is no deceit!"
verses.textEn: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, <red>“Here truly is an Israelite in whom there is no deceit.”</red>

verses.textZh: 拿但业问他："<red>你怎么认识我呢？</red>"耶稣回答："<red>腓力还没有招呼你，你在无花果树下的时候，我就看见你了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿但业问他："<red>你怎么认识我呢？</red>"耶稣回答："<red>腓力还没有招呼你，你在无花果树下的时候，我就看见你了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿但业对耶稣说：「<red>你从哪里知道我呢？</red>」耶稣回答说：「<red>腓力还没有招呼你，你在无花果树底下，我就看见你了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, <red>“I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Nathanael said to him, "How do you know me?" Jesus answered him, "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Nathanael said to Him, "How do You know me?" Jesus answered and said to him, "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you."
verses.textEnNlt: "How do you know about me?" Nathanael asked. Jesus replied, "I could see you under the fig tree before Philip found you."
verses.textEnNasb: Nathanael *said to Him, "How do You know me?" Jesus answered and said to him, "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you."
verses.textEn: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, <red>“I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 拿但业说："拉比，你是神的儿子，你是以色列的王！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿但业说："拉比，你是神的儿子，你是以色列的王！"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿但业说：「拉比，你是神的儿子，你是以色列的王！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Nathanael declared, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the king of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: Nathanael answered him, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Nathanael answered and said to Him, "Rabbi, You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Nathanael exclaimed, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God—the King of Israel!"
verses.textEnNasb: Nathanael answered Him, "Rabbi, You are the Son of God; You are the King of Israel!"
verses.textEn: Then Nathanael declared, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the king of Israel."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>因为我告诉你‘我看见你在无花果树下’，你就信了吗？你还要看见比这些更大的事。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>因为我告诉你‘我看见你在无花果树下’，你就信了吗？你还要看见比这些更大的事。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>因为我说『在无花果树底下看见你』，你就信吗？你将要看见比这更大的事</red>」；
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, <red>“You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree. You will see greater things than that.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered him, "Because I said to you, ‘I saw you under the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "Because I said to you, ‘I saw you under the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus asked him, "Do you believe this just because I told you I had seen you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than this."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered and said to him, "Because I said to you that I saw you under the fig tree, do you believe? You will see greater things than these."
verses.textEn: Jesus said, <red>“You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree. You will see greater things than that.”</red>

verses.textZh: 又对他说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，你们要看见天开了，神的众使者在人子的身上，上去下来。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又对他说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，你们要看见天开了，神的众使者在人子的身上，上去下来。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「<red>我实实在在地告诉你们，你们将要看见天开了，神的使者上去下来在人子身上。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He then added, <red>“Very truly I tell you, you will see ‘heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on’ the Son of Man.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "Truly, truly, I say to you, you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to him, "Most assuredly, I say to you, hereafter you shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of Man."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "I tell you the truth, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God going up and down on the Son of Man, the one who is the stairway between heaven and earth. "
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to him, "Truly, truly, I say to you, you will see heaven opened and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man."
verses.textEn: He then added, <red>“Very truly I tell you, you will see ‘heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on’ the Son of Man.”</red>

verses.textZh: 第三天，在加利利的迦拿有婚筵，耶稣的母亲在那里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三天，在加利利的迦拿有婚筵，耶稣的母亲在那里；
verses.textZhCuv: 第三日，在加利利的迦拿有娶亲的筵席，耶稣的母亲在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
verses.textEnEsv: On the third day there was a wedding at Cana in Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the third day there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day there was a wedding celebration in the village of Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
verses.textEnNasb: On the third day there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there;
verses.textEn: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,

verses.textZh: 耶稣和门徒也被邀请参加婚筵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣和门徒也被邀请参加婚筵。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣和他的门徒也被请去赴席。
verses.textEnNiv: and Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus also was invited to the wedding with his disciples.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now both Jesus and His disciples were invited to the wedding.
verses.textEnNlt: and Jesus and his disciples were also invited to the celebration.
verses.textEnNasb: and both Jesus and His disciples were invited to the wedding.
verses.textEn: and Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.

verses.textZh: 酒用尽了，耶稣的母亲对他说："他们没有酒了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 酒用尽了，耶稣的母亲对他说："他们没有酒了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 酒用尽了，耶稣的母亲对他说：「他们没有酒了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the wine was gone, Jesus’ mother said to him, "They have no more wine."
verses.textEnEsv: When the wine ran out, the mother of Jesus said to him, "They have no wine."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they ran out of wine, the mother of Jesus said to Him, "They have no wine."
verses.textEnNlt: The wine supply ran out during the festivities, so Jesus’ mother told him, "They have no more wine."
verses.textEnNasb: When the wine ran out, the mother of Jesus *said to Him, "They have no wine."
verses.textEn: When the wine was gone, Jesus’ mother said to him, "They have no more wine."

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："母亲 ，我跟你有甚么关系呢？我的时候还没有到。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："母亲 ，我跟你有甚么关系呢？我的时候还没有到。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>母亲 ，我与你有什么相干？我的时候还没有到。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woman, why do you involve me?”</red> Jesus replied. <red>“My hour has not yet come.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to her, "Woman, what does this have to do with me? My hour has not yet come."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to her, "Woman, what does your concern have to do with Me? My hour has not yet come."
verses.textEnNlt: "Dear woman, that’s not our problem," Jesus replied. "My time has not yet come."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus *said to her, " What business do you have with Me, woman? My hour has not yet come."
verses.textEn: <red>“Woman, why do you involve me?”</red> Jesus replied. <red>“My hour has not yet come.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他母亲告诉仆人说："他吩咐你们甚么，就作甚么。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他母亲告诉仆人说："他吩咐你们甚么，就作甚么。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他母亲对用人说：「他告诉你们什么，你们就做什么。」
verses.textEnNiv: His mother said to the servants, "Do whatever he tells you."
verses.textEnEsv: His mother said to the servants, "Do whatever he tells you."
verses.textEnNkjv: His mother said to the servants, "Whatever He says to you, do it."
verses.textEnNlt: But his mother told the servants, "Do whatever he tells you."
verses.textEnNasb: His mother *said to the servants, "Whatever He tells you, do it."
verses.textEn: His mother said to the servants, "Do whatever he tells you."

verses.textZh: 在那里有六口石缸，每口可盛两三桶水，是为犹太人行洁净礼用的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里有六口石缸，每口可盛两三桶水，是为犹太人行洁净礼用的。
verses.textZhCuv: 照犹太人洁净的规矩，有六口石缸摆在那里，每口可以盛两三桶水。
verses.textEnNiv: Nearby stood six stone water jars, the kind used by the Jews for ceremonial washing, each holding from twenty to thirty gallons.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there were six stone water jars there for the Jewish rites of purification, each holding twenty or thirty gallons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there were set there six waterpots of stone, according to the manner of purification of the Jews, containing twenty or thirty gallons apiece.
verses.textEnNlt: Standing nearby were six stone water jars, used for Jewish ceremonial washing. Each could hold twenty to thirty gallons.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there were six stone waterpots standing there for the Jewish custom of purification, containing two or three measures each.
verses.textEn: Nearby stood six stone water jars, the kind used by the Jews for ceremonial washing, each holding from twenty to thirty gallons.

verses.textZh: 耶稣吩咐仆人："<red>把缸都倒满水！</red>"他们就倒满了，直到缸口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣吩咐仆人："<red>把缸都倒满水！</red>"他们就倒满了，直到缸口。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对用人说：「<red>把缸倒满了水。</red>」他们就倒满了，直到缸口。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to the servants, <red>“Fill the jars with water”;</red> so they filled them to the brim.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to the servants, "Fill the jars with water." And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to them, "Fill the waterpots with water." And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told the servants, "Fill the jars with water." When the jars had been filled,
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to them, "Fill the waterpots with water." So they filled them up to the brim.
verses.textEn: Jesus said to the servants, <red>“Fill the jars with water”;</red> so they filled them to the brim.

verses.textZh: 耶稣又吩咐他们："<red>现在舀出来，送给筵席的总管！</red>"他们就送去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又吩咐他们："<red>现在舀出来，送给筵席的总管！</red>"他们就送去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又说：「<red>现在可以舀出来，送给管筵席的。</red>」他们就送了去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he told them, <red>“Now draw some out and take it to the master of the banquet.”</red> They did so,
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Now draw some out and take it to the master of the feast." So they took it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Draw some out now, and take it to the master of the feast." And they took it.
verses.textEnNlt: he said, "Now dip some out, and take it to the master of ceremonies." So the servants followed his instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to them, "Draw some out now and take it to the headwaiter." And they took it to him.
verses.textEn: Then he told them, <red>“Now draw some out and take it to the master of the banquet.”</red> They did so,

verses.textZh: 总管尝了那水变的酒，不知道是从哪里来的，只有舀水的仆人知道。总管就叫新郎来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 总管尝了那水变的酒，不知道是从哪里来的，只有舀水的仆人知道。总管就叫新郎来，
verses.textZhCuv: 管筵席的尝了那水变的酒，并不知道是哪里来的，只有舀水的用人知道。管筵席的便叫新郎来，
verses.textEnNiv: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not realize where it had come from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
verses.textEnEsv: When the master of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and did not know where it came from (though the servants who had drawn the water knew), the master of the feast called the bridegroom
verses.textEnNkjv: When the master of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and did not know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the master of the feast called the bridegroom.
verses.textEnNlt: When the master of ceremonies tasted the water that was now wine, not knowing where it had come from (though, of course, the servants knew), he called the bridegroom over.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the headwaiter tasted the water which had become wine, and did not know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the headwaiter *called the groom,
verses.textEn: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not realize where it had come from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside

verses.textZh: 对他说："人人都是先摆上好酒，等到亲友喝够了，才摆上次等的，你倒把好酒留到现在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他说："人人都是先摆上好酒，等到亲友喝够了，才摆上次等的，你倒把好酒留到现在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「人都是先摆上好酒，等客喝足了，才摆上次的，你倒把好酒留到如今！」
verses.textEnNiv: and said, "Everyone brings out the choice wine first and then the cheaper wine after the guests have had too much to drink; but you have saved the best till now."
verses.textEnEsv: and said to him, "Everyone serves the good wine first, and when people have drunk freely, then the poor wine. But you have kept the good wine until now."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to him, "Every man at the beginning sets out the good wine, and when the guests have well drunk, then the inferior. You have kept the good wine until now!"
verses.textEnNlt: "A host always serves the best wine first," he said. "Then, when everyone has had a lot to drink, he brings out the less expensive wine. But you have kept the best until now!"
verses.textEnNasb: and *said to him, "Every man serves the good wine first, and when the guests are drunk, then he serves the poorer wine; but you have kept the good wine until now."
verses.textEn: and said, "Everyone brings out the choice wine first and then the cheaper wine after the guests have had too much to drink; but you have saved the best till now."

verses.textZh: 这是耶稣所行的第一件神迹，是在加利利的迦拿行的。他显出了自己的荣耀，他的门徒就信了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是耶稣所行的第一件神迹，是在加利利的迦拿行的。他显出了自己的荣耀，他的门徒就信了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是耶稣所行的头一件神迹，是在加利利的迦拿行的，显出他的荣耀来；他的门徒就信他了。
verses.textEnNiv: What Jesus did here in Cana of Galilee was the first of the signs through which he revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
verses.textEnEsv: This, the first of his signs, Jesus did at Cana in Galilee, and manifested his glory. And his disciples believed in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: This beginning of signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and manifested His glory; and His disciples believed in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: This miraculous sign at Cana in Galilee was the first time Jesus revealed his glory. And his disciples believed in him.
verses.textEnNasb: This beginning of His signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed His glory; and His disciples believed in Him.
verses.textEn: What Jesus did here in Cana of Galilee was the first of the signs through which he revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

verses.textZh: 这事以后，耶稣和母亲、弟弟、门徒，都下到迦百农去，在那里住了没有几天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，耶稣和母亲、弟弟、门徒，都下到迦百农去，在那里住了没有几天。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，耶稣与他的母亲、弟兄，和门徒都下迦百农去，在那里住了不多几日。
verses.textEnNiv: After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and brothers and his disciples. There they stayed for a few days.
verses.textEnEsv: After this he went down to Capernaum, with his mother and his brothers and his disciples, and they stayed there for a few days.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this He went down to Capernaum, He, His mother, His brothers, and His disciples; and they did not stay there many days.
verses.textEnNlt: After the wedding he went to Capernaum for a few days with his mother, his brothers, and his disciples.
verses.textEnNasb: After this He went down to Capernaum, He and His mother, and His brothers and His disciples; and they stayed there a few days.
verses.textEn: After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and brothers and his disciples. There they stayed for a few days.

verses.textZh: 犹太人的逾越节近了，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人的逾越节近了，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人的逾越节近了，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textEnNiv: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: It was nearly time for the Jewish Passover celebration, so Jesus went to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: The Passover of the Jews was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他在圣殿的外院里看见有卖牛羊鸽子的，和坐在那里兑换银钱的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在圣殿的外院里看见有卖牛羊鸽子的，和坐在那里兑换银钱的，
verses.textZhCuv: 看见殿里有卖牛、羊、鸽子的，并有兑换银钱的人坐在那里，
verses.textEnNiv: In the temple courts he found people selling cattle, sheep and doves, and others sitting at tables exchanging money.
verses.textEnEsv: In the temple he found those who were selling oxen and sheep and pigeons, and the money-changers sitting there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He found in the temple those who sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the money changers doing business.
verses.textEnNlt: In the Temple area he saw merchants selling cattle, sheep, and doves for sacrifices; he also saw dealers at tables exchanging foreign money.
verses.textEnNasb: And within the temple grounds He found those who were selling oxen, sheep, and doves, and the money changers seated at their tables.
verses.textEn: In the temple courts he found people selling cattle, sheep and doves, and others sitting at tables exchanging money.

verses.textZh: 就用绳索做了一条鞭子，把众人连牛带羊都从外院赶出去，倒掉兑换银钱的人的钱，推翻他们的桌子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就用绳索做了一条鞭子，把众人连牛带羊都从外院赶出去，倒掉兑换银钱的人的钱，推翻他们的桌子；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就拿绳子做成鞭子，把牛羊都赶出殿去，倒出兑换银钱之人的银钱，推翻他们的桌子，
verses.textEnNiv: So he made a whip out of cords, and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle; he scattered the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
verses.textEnEsv: And making a whip of cords, he drove them all out of the temple, with the sheep and oxen. And he poured out the coins of the money-changers and overturned their tables.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had made a whip of cords, He drove them all out of the temple, with the sheep and the oxen, and poured out the changers’ money and overturned the tables.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus made a whip from some ropes and chased them all out of the Temple. He drove out the sheep and cattle, scattered the money changers’ coins over the floor, and turned over their tables.
verses.textEnNasb: And He made a whip of cords, and drove them all out of the temple area, with the sheep and the oxen; and He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables;
verses.textEn: So he made a whip out of cords, and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle; he scattered the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.

verses.textZh: 又对卖鸽子的说："<red>把这些东西搬出去，不要把我父的殿当作巿场。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又对卖鸽子的说："<red>把这些东西搬出去，不要把我父的殿当作巿场。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对卖鸽子的说：「<red>把这些东西拿去！不要将我父的殿当作买卖的地方。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: To those who sold doves he said, <red>“Get these out of here! Stop turning my Father’s house into a market!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he told those who sold the pigeons, "Take these things away; do not make my Father’s house a house of trade."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to those who sold doves, "Take these things away! Do not make My Father’s house a house of merchandise!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then, going over to the people who sold doves, he told them, "Get these things out of here. Stop turning my Father’s house into a marketplace!"
verses.textEnNasb: and to those who were selling the doves He said, "Take these things away from here; stop making My Father’s house a place of business!"
verses.textEn: To those who sold doves he said, <red>“Get these out of here! Stop turning my Father’s house into a market!”</red>

verses.textZh: 他的门徒就想起经上记着："我为你的殿心中迫切，如同火烧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的门徒就想起经上记着："我为你的殿心中迫切，如同火烧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的门徒就想起经上记着说：「我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧。」
verses.textEnNiv: His disciples remembered that it is written: "Zeal for your house will consume me."
verses.textEnEsv: His disciples remembered that it was written, "Zeal for your house will consume me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then His disciples remembered that it was written, "Zeal for Your house has eaten Me up."
verses.textEnNlt: Then his disciples remembered this prophecy from the Scriptures: "Passion for God’s house will consume me."
verses.textEnNasb: His disciples remembered that it was written: "Zeal for Your house will consume me."
verses.textEn: His disciples remembered that it is written: "Zeal for your house will consume me."

verses.textZh: 犹太人就问他："你可以显甚么神迹给我们看，证明你有权作这些事呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人就问他："你可以显甚么神迹给我们看，证明你有权作这些事呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 因此犹太人问他说：「你既做这些事，还显什么神迹给我们看呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The Jews then responded to him, "What sign can you show us to prove your authority to do all this?"
verses.textEnEsv: So the Jews said to him, "What sign do you show us for doing these things?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Jews answered and said to Him, "What sign do You show to us, since You do these things?"
verses.textEnNlt: But the Jewish leaders demanded, "What are you doing? If God gave you authority to do this, show us a miraculous sign to prove it."
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews then said to Him, "What sign do You show us as Your authority for doing these things?"
verses.textEn: The Jews then responded to him, "What sign can you show us to prove your authority to do all this?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>你们拆毁这殿，我三天之内要把它建造起来。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>你们拆毁这殿，我三天之内要把它建造起来。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>你们拆毁这殿，我三日内要再建立起来。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered them, <red>“Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," Jesus replied. "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered them, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."
verses.textEn: Jesus answered them, <red>“Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days.”</red>

verses.textZh: 犹太人说："这殿建了四十六年，你三天之内就能把它建造起来吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人说："这殿建了四十六年，你三天之内就能把它建造起来吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人便说：「这殿是四十六年才造成的，你三日内就再建立起来吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you are going to raise it in three days?"
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews then said, "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and will you raise it up in three days?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Jews said, "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and will You raise it up in three days?"
verses.textEnNlt: "What!" they exclaimed. "It has taken forty-six years to build this Temple, and you can rebuild it in three days?"
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews then said, "It took forty-six years to build this temple, and yet You will raise it up in three days?"
verses.textEn: They replied, "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you are going to raise it in three days?"

verses.textZh: 但耶稣所说的殿，就是他的身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶稣所说的殿，就是他的身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶稣这话是以他的身体为殿。
verses.textEnNiv: But the temple he had spoken of was his body.
verses.textEnEsv: But he was speaking about the temple of his body.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He was speaking of the temple of His body.
verses.textEnNlt: But when Jesus said "this temple," he meant his own body.
verses.textEnNasb: But He was speaking about the temple of His body.
verses.textEn: But the temple he had spoken of was his body.

verses.textZh: 所以当耶稣从死人中复活以后，门徒想起了他说过这话，就信了圣经和耶稣所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以当耶稣从死人中复活以后，门徒想起了他说过这话，就信了圣经和耶稣所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以到他从死里复活以后，门徒就想起他说过这话，便信了圣经和耶稣所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples recalled what he had said. Then they believed the scripture and the words that Jesus had spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when He had risen from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this to them; and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.
verses.textEnNlt: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered he had said this, and they believed both the Scriptures and what Jesus had said.
verses.textEnNasb: So when He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered that He said this; and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had spoken.
verses.textEn: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples recalled what he had said. Then they believed the scripture and the words that Jesus had spoken.

verses.textZh: 耶稣在耶路撒冷过逾越节的时候，许多人看见他所行的神迹，就信了他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣在耶路撒冷过逾越节的时候，许多人看见他所行的神迹，就信了他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶稣在耶路撒冷过逾越节的时候，有许多人看见他所行的神迹，就信了他的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Now while he was in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, many people saw the signs he was performing and believed in his name.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, many believed in his name when they saw the signs that he was doing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in His name when they saw the signs which He did.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of the miraculous signs Jesus did in Jerusalem at the Passover celebration, many began to trust in him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when He was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in His name as they observed His signs which He was doing.
verses.textEn: Now while he was in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, many people saw the signs he was performing and believed in his name.

verses.textZh: 耶稣却不信任他们，因为他知道所有的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣却不信任他们，因为他知道所有的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣却不将自己交托他们；因为他知道万人，
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus would not entrust himself to them, for he knew all people.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus on his part did not entrust himself to them, because he knew all people
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus did not commit Himself to them, because He knew all men,
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus didn’t trust them, because he knew all about people.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus, on His part, was not entrusting Himself to them, because He knew all people,
verses.textEn: But Jesus would not entrust himself to them, for he knew all people.

verses.textZh: 也不需要谁指证人是怎样的，因为他知道人心里存的是甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不需要谁指证人是怎样的，因为他知道人心里存的是甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 也用不着谁见证人怎样，因他知道人心里所存的。
verses.textEnNiv: He did not need any testimony about mankind, for he knew what was in each person.
verses.textEnEsv: and needed no one to bear witness about man, for he himself knew what was in man.
verses.textEnNkjv: and had no need that anyone should testify of man, for He knew what was in man.
verses.textEnNlt: No one needed to tell him about human nature, for he knew what was in each person’s heart.
verses.textEnNasb: and because He did not need anyone to testify about mankind, for He Himself knew what was in mankind.
verses.textEn: He did not need any testimony about mankind, for he knew what was in each person.

verses.textZh: 有一个法利赛人，名叫尼哥德慕，是犹太人的官长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个法利赛人，名叫尼哥德慕，是犹太人的官长。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个法利赛人，名叫尼哥德慕，是犹太人的官。
verses.textEnNiv: Now there was a Pharisee, a man named Nicodemus who was a member of the Jewish ruling council.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
verses.textEnNkjv: There was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a man named Nicodemus, a Jewish religious leader who was a Pharisee.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews;
verses.textEn: Now there was a Pharisee, a man named Nicodemus who was a member of the Jewish ruling council.

verses.textZh: 他夜间来到耶稣那里，对他说："拉比，我们知道你是从神那里来的教师，因为如果没有神同在，你所行的这些神迹，就没有人能行。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他夜间来到耶稣那里，对他说："拉比，我们知道你是从神那里来的教师，因为如果没有神同在，你所行的这些神迹，就没有人能行。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这人夜里来见耶稣，说：「拉比，我们知道你是由神那里来作师傅的；因为你所行的神迹，若没有神同在，无人能行。」
verses.textEnNiv: He came to Jesus at night and said, "Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs you are doing if God were not with him."
verses.textEnEsv: This man came to Jesus by night and said to him, "Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do unless God is with him."
verses.textEnNkjv: This man came to Jesus by night and said to Him, "Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher come from God; for no one can do these signs that You do unless God is with him."
verses.textEnNlt: After dark one evening, he came to speak with Jesus. "Rabbi," he said, "we all know that God has sent you to teach us. Your miraculous signs are evidence that God is with you."
verses.textEnNasb: this man came to Jesus at night and said to Him, "Rabbi, we know that You have come from God as a teacher; for no one can do these signs that You do unless God is with him."
verses.textEn: He came to Jesus at night and said, "Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs you are doing if God were not with him."

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>我实实在在告诉你，人若不重生，就不能见神的国。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>我实实在在告诉你，人若不重生，就不能见神的国。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>我实实在在地告诉你，人若不重生，就不能见神的国。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Very truly I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless they are born again.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered him, "Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one is born again he cannot see the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "Most assuredly, I say to you, unless one is born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, unless you are born again, you cannot see the Kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus responded and said to him, "Truly, truly, I say to you, unless someone is born again he cannot see the kingdom of God."
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Very truly I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless they are born again.”</red>

verses.textZh: 尼哥德慕说："人老了，怎能重生呢？难道他能再进母腹生出来吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼哥德慕说："人老了，怎能重生呢？难道他能再进母腹生出来吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 尼哥德慕说：「人已经老了，如何能重生呢？岂能再进母腹生出来吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "How can someone be born when they are old?" Nicodemus asked. "Surely they cannot enter a second time into their mother’s womb to be born!"
verses.textEnEsv: Nicodemus said to him, "How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Nicodemus said to Him, "How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?"
verses.textEnNlt: "What do you mean?" exclaimed Nicodemus. "How can an old man go back into his mother’s womb and be born again?"
verses.textEnNasb: Nicodemus *said to Him, "How can a person be born when he is old? He cannot enter his mother’s womb a second time and be born, can he?"
verses.textEn: "How can someone be born when they are old?" Nicodemus asked. "Surely they cannot enter a second time into their mother’s womb to be born!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："我实实在在告诉你，人若不是从水和圣灵生的，就不能进神的国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："我实实在在告诉你，人若不是从水和圣灵生的，就不能进神的国。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你，人若不是从水和圣灵生的，就不能进神的国。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“Very truly I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born of water and the Spirit.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered, "Most assuredly, I say to you, unless one is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "I assure you, no one can enter the Kingdom of God without being born of water and the Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered, "Truly, truly, I say to you, unless someone is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“Very truly I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born of water and the Spirit.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>从肉身生的就是肉身，从灵生的就是灵。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>从肉身生的就是肉身，从灵生的就是灵。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>从肉身生的就是肉身；从灵生的就是灵。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh, and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh, and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Humans can reproduce only human life, but the Holy Spirit gives birth to spiritual life.
verses.textEnNasb: That which has been born of the flesh is flesh, and that which has been born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.textEn: <red>Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你不要因为我对你说‘你们必须重生’而感到希奇。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你不要因为我对你说‘你们必须重生’而感到希奇。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我说：『你们必须重生』，你不要以为希奇。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You should not be surprised at my saying, ‘You must be born again.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do not marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born again.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born again.’
verses.textEnNlt: So don’t be surprised when I say, ‘You must be born again.’
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be amazed that I said to you, ‘You must be born again.’
verses.textEn: <red>You should not be surprised at my saying, ‘You must be born again.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>风随意而吹，你听见它的响声，却不知道它从哪里来，往哪里去；凡从圣灵生的，也是这样。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>风随意而吹，你听见它的响声，却不知道它从哪里来，往哪里去；凡从圣灵生的，也是这样。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>风随着意思吹，你听见风的响声，却不晓得从哪里来，往哪里去；凡从圣灵生的，也是如此。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The wind blows where it wishes, and you hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it goes. So it is with everyone who is born of the Spirit."
verses.textEnNkjv: The wind blows where it wishes, and you hear the sound of it, but cannot tell where it comes from and where it goes. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit."
verses.textEnNlt: The wind blows wherever it wants. Just as you can hear the wind but can’t tell where it comes from or where it is going, so you can’t explain how people are born of the Spirit."
verses.textEnNasb: The wind blows where it wishes, and you hear the sound of it, but you do not know where it is coming from and where it is going; so is everyone who has been born of the Spirit."
verses.textEn: <red>The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”</red>

verses.textZh: 尼哥德慕说："怎能有这事呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼哥德慕说："怎能有这事呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 尼哥德慕问他说：「怎能有这事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "How can this be?" Nicodemus asked.
verses.textEnEsv: Nicodemus said to him, "How can these things be?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Nicodemus answered and said to Him, "How can these things be?"
verses.textEnNlt: "How are these things possible?" Nicodemus asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Nicodemus responded and said to Him, "How can these things be?"
verses.textEn: "How can this be?" Nicodemus asked.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："你是以色列人的教师，还不明白这事吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："你是以色列人的教师，还不明白这事吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「你是以色列人的先生，还不明白这事吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp are Israel’s teacher,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“and do you not understand these things?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered him, "Are you the teacher of Israel and yet you do not understand these things?
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "Are you the teacher of Israel, and do not know these things?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "You are a respected Jewish teacher, and yet you don’t understand these things?
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered and said to him, "You are the teacher of Israel, and yet you do not understand these things?
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp are Israel’s teacher,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“and do you not understand these things?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实实在在告诉你，我们知道的，才讲论；见过的，就作证，然而你们却不接受我们的见证。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实实在在告诉你，我们知道的，才讲论；见过的，就作证，然而你们却不接受我们的见证。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实实在在地告诉你，我们所说的是我们知道的；我们所见证的是我们见过的；你们却不领受我们的见证。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Very truly I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, but still you people do not accept our testimony.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, truly, I say to you, we speak of what we know, and bear witness to what we have seen, but you do not receive our testimony.
verses.textEnNkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, We speak what We know and testify what We have seen, and you do not receive Our witness.
verses.textEnNlt: I assure you, we tell you what we know and have seen, and yet you won’t believe our testimony.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, truly, I say to you, we speak of what we know and testify of what we have seen, and you people do not accept our testimony.
verses.textEn: <red>Very truly I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, but still you people do not accept our testimony.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我对你们讲地上的事，你们尚且不信，如果讲天上的事，怎能相信呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我对你们讲地上的事，你们尚且不信，如果讲天上的事，怎能相信呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我对你们说地上的事，你们尚且不信，若说天上的事，如何能信呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have spoken to you of earthly things and you do not believe; how then will you believe if I speak of heavenly things?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If I have told you earthly things and you do not believe, how can you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.textEnNkjv: If I have told you earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.textEnNlt: But if you don’t believe me when I tell you about earthly things, how can you possibly believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
verses.textEnNasb: If I told you earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.textEn: <red>I have spoken to you of earthly things and you do not believe; how then will you believe if I speak of heavenly things?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>除了那从天上降下来的人子 ，没有人升过天。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>除了那从天上降下来的人子 ，没有人升过天。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>除了从天降下、仍旧在天的人子，没有人升过天。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven—the Son of Man.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: No one has ascended into heaven except he who descended from heaven, the Son of Man.
verses.textEnNkjv: No one has ascended to heaven but He who came down from heaven, that is, the Son of Man who is in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: No one has ever gone to heaven and returned. But the Son of Man has come down from heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: No one has ascended into heaven, except He who descended from heaven: the Son of Man.
verses.textEn: <red>No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven—the Son of Man.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>摩西在旷野怎样把铜蛇举起，人子也必照样被举起来，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>摩西在旷野怎样把铜蛇举起，人子也必照样被举起来，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>摩西在旷野怎样举蛇，人子也必照样被举起来，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
verses.textEnNkjv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
verses.textEnNlt: And as Moses lifted up the bronze snake on a pole in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
