verses.textEnNasb: And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
verses.textEn: <red>Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>使所有信他的人都得永生。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>使所有信他的人都得永生。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>叫一切信他的都得永生 。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>that everyone who believes may have eternal life in him.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: that whoever believes in him may have eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have eternal life.
verses.textEnNlt: so that everyone who believes in him will have eternal life.
verses.textEnNasb: so that everyone who believes will have eternal life in Him.
verses.textEn: <red>that everyone who believes may have eternal life in him.”</red>

verses.textZh: "神爱世人，甚至把他的独生子赐给他们，叫一切信他的，不至灭亡，反得永生。
verses.textZhCnvs: "神爱世人，甚至把他的独生子赐给他们，叫一切信他的，不至灭亡，反得永生。
verses.textZhCuv: 「神爱世人，甚至将他的独生子赐给他们，叫一切信他的，不致灭亡，反得永生。
verses.textEnNiv: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.
verses.textEnEsv: "For God so loved the world, that he gave his only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.
verses.textEnNlt: "For this is how God loved the world: He gave his one and only Son, so that everyone who believes in him will not perish but have eternal life.
verses.textEnNasb: "For God so loved the world, that He gave His only Son, so that everyone who believes in Him will not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.textEn: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

verses.textZh: 因为神差他的儿子到世上来，不是要定世人的罪，而是要使世人借着他得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神差他的儿子到世上来，不是要定世人的罪，而是要使世人借着他得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神差他的儿子降世，不是要定世人的罪 ，乃是要叫世人因他得救。
verses.textEnNiv: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.
verses.textEnEsv: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but in order that the world might be saved through him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but that the world through Him might be saved.
verses.textEnNlt: God sent his Son into the world not to judge the world, but to save the world through him.
verses.textEnNasb: For God did not send the Son into the world to judge the world, but so that the world might be saved through Him.
verses.textEn: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.

verses.textZh: 信他的，不被定罪；不信的，罪已经定了，因为他不信神独生子的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 信他的，不被定罪；不信的，罪已经定了，因为他不信神独生子的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 信他的人，不被定罪；不信的人，罪已经定了，因为他不信神独生子的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already because they have not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe is condemned already, because he has not believed in the name of the only Son of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who believes in Him is not condemned; but he who does not believe is condemned already, because he has not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
verses.textEnNlt: "There is no judgment against anyone who believes in him. But anyone who does not believe in him has already been judged for not believing in God’s one and only Son.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who believes in Him is not judged; the one who does not believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only Son of God.
verses.textEn: Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already because they have not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.

verses.textZh: 光来到世上，世人因为自己的行为邪恶，不爱光倒爱黑暗，定他们罪的原因，就在这里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 光来到世上，世人因为自己的行为邪恶，不爱光倒爱黑暗，定他们罪的原因，就在这里。
verses.textZhCuv: 光来到世间，世人因自己的行为是恶的，不爱光，倒爱黑暗，定他们的罪就是在此。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but people loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil.
verses.textEnEsv: And this is the judgment: the light has come into the world, and people loved the darkness rather than the light because their works were evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the condemnation, that the light has come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
verses.textEnNlt: And the judgment is based on this fact: God’s light came into the world, but people loved the darkness more than the light, for their actions were evil.
verses.textEnNasb: And this is the judgment, that the Light has come into the world, and people loved the darkness rather than the Light; for their deeds were evil.
verses.textEn: This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but people loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil.

verses.textZh: 凡作恶的都恨光，不来接近光，免得他的恶行暴露出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡作恶的都恨光，不来接近光，免得他的恶行暴露出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡作恶的便恨光，并不来就光，恐怕他的行为受责备。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that their deeds will be exposed.
verses.textEnEsv: For everyone who does wicked things hates the light and does not come to the light, lest his works should be exposed.
verses.textEnNkjv: For everyone practicing evil hates the light and does not come to the light, lest his deeds should be exposed.
verses.textEnNlt: All who do evil hate the light and refuse to go near it for fear their sins will be exposed.
verses.textEnNasb: For everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come to the Light, so that his deeds will not be exposed.
verses.textEn: Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that their deeds will be exposed.

verses.textZh: 凡行真理的，就来接近光，好显明他所作的都是靠着神而作的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡行真理的，就来接近光，好显明他所作的都是靠着神而作的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但行真理的必来就光，要显明他所行的是靠神而行。」
verses.textEnNiv: But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what they have done has been done in the sight of God.
verses.textEnEsv: But whoever does what is true comes to the light, so that it may be clearly seen that his works have been carried out in God."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his deeds may be clearly seen, that they have been done in God."
verses.textEnNlt: But those who do what is right come to the light so others can see that they are doing what God wants. "
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who practices the truth comes to the Light, so that his deeds will be revealed as having been performed in God."
verses.textEn: But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what they have done has been done in the sight of God.

verses.textZh: 这事以后，耶稣和门徒来到犹太地，他和他们住在那里，并且施洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，耶稣和门徒来到犹太地，他和他们住在那里，并且施洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，耶稣和门徒到了犹太地，在那里居住，施洗。
verses.textEnNiv: After this, Jesus and his disciples went out into the Judean countryside, where he spent some time with them, and baptized.
verses.textEnEsv: After this Jesus and his disciples went into the Judean countryside, and he remained there with them and was baptizing.
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things Jesus and His disciples came into the land of Judea, and there He remained with them and baptized.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus and his disciples left Jerusalem and went into the Judean countryside. Jesus spent some time with them there, baptizing people.
verses.textEnNasb: After these things Jesus and His disciples came into the land of Judea; and there He was spending time with them and baptizing.
verses.textEn: After this, Jesus and his disciples went out into the Judean countryside, where he spent some time with them, and baptized.

verses.textZh: 约翰也在靠近撒冷的艾嫩施洗，因为那里水多；众人都去受洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰也在靠近撒冷的艾嫩施洗，因为那里水多；众人都去受洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰在靠近撒冷的哀嫩也施洗；因为那里水多，众人都去受洗。（
verses.textEnNiv: Now John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water, and people were coming and being baptized.
verses.textEnEsv: John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because water was plentiful there, and people were coming and being baptized
verses.textEnNkjv: Now John also was baptizing in Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there. And they came and were baptized.
verses.textEnNlt: At this time John the Baptist was baptizing at Aenon, near Salim, because there was plenty of water there; and people kept coming to him for baptism.
verses.textEnNasb: Now John also was baptizing in Aenon, near Salim, because there was an abundance of water there; and people were coming and being baptized—
verses.textEn: Now John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water, and people were coming and being baptized.

verses.textZh: 那时约翰还没有入狱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时约翰还没有入狱。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时约翰还没有下在监里。）
verses.textEnNiv: (This was before John was put in prison.)
verses.textEnEsv: (for John had not yet been put in prison).
verses.textEnNkjv: For John had not yet been thrown into prison.
verses.textEnNlt: (This was before John was thrown into prison.)
verses.textEnNasb: for John had not yet been thrown into prison.
verses.textEn: (This was before John was put in prison.)

verses.textZh: 约翰的门徒和一个犹太人为洁净礼发生辩论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰的门徒和一个犹太人为洁净礼发生辩论。
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰的门徒和一个犹太人辩论洁净的礼，
verses.textEnNiv: An argument developed between some of John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the matter of ceremonial washing.
verses.textEnEsv: Now a discussion arose between some of John’s disciples and a Jew over purification.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then there arose a dispute between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purification.
verses.textEnNlt: A debate broke out between John’s disciples and a certain Jew over ceremonial cleansing.
verses.textEnNasb: Then a matter of dispute developed on the part of John’s disciples with a Jew about purification.
verses.textEn: An argument developed between some of John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the matter of ceremonial washing.

verses.textZh: 他们来到约翰那里，对他说："拉比，你看，从前和你在约旦河东，你为他作见证的那一位，他也在施洗，众人都到他那里去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到约翰那里，对他说："拉比，你看，从前和你在约旦河东，你为他作见证的那一位，他也在施洗，众人都到他那里去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就来见约翰，说：「拉比，从前同你在约旦河外、你所见证的那位，现在施洗，众人都往他那里去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: They came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, that man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan—the one you testified about—look, he is baptizing, and everyone is going to him."
verses.textEnEsv: And they came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, he who was with you across the Jordan, to whom you bore witness—look, he is baptizing, and all are going to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, He who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified—behold, He is baptizing, and all are coming to Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: So John’s disciples came to him and said, "Rabbi, the man you met on the other side of the Jordan River, the one you identified as the Messiah, is also baptizing people. And everybody is going to him instead of coming to us."
verses.textEnNasb: And they came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, He who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified—behold, He is baptizing and all the people are coming to Him."
verses.textEn: They came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, that man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan—the one you testified about—look, he is baptizing, and everyone is going to him."

verses.textZh: 约翰回答："除了从天上赐下来给他的，人就不能得到甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰回答："除了从天上赐下来给他的，人就不能得到甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰说：「若不是从天上赐的，人就不能得什么。
verses.textEnNiv: To this John replied, "A person can receive only what is given them from heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: John answered, "A person cannot receive even one thing unless it is given him from heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: John answered and said, "A man can receive nothing unless it has been given to him from heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: John replied, "No one can receive anything unless God gives it from heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: John replied, "A person can receive not even one thing unless it has been given to him from heaven.
verses.textEn: To this John replied, "A person can receive only what is given them from heaven.

verses.textZh: 你们自己可以为我作证：我曾说，我不是基督，不过是奉差遣作他的先锋的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们自己可以为我作证：我曾说，我不是基督，不过是奉差遣作他的先锋的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾说：『我不是基督，是奉差遣在他前面的』，你们自己可以给我作见证。
verses.textEnNiv: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Messiah but am sent ahead of him.’
verses.textEnEsv: You yourselves bear me witness, that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but I have been sent before him.’
verses.textEnNkjv: You yourselves bear me witness, that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before Him.’
verses.textEnNlt: You yourselves know how plainly I told you, ‘I am not the Messiah. I am only here to prepare the way for him.’
verses.textEnNasb: You yourselves are my witnesses that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent ahead of Him.’
verses.textEn: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Messiah but am sent ahead of him.’

verses.textZh: 娶新娘的是新郎。新郎的好友站在那里听着，听见新郎的声音就非常喜乐。因此，我这喜乐满溢了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 娶新娘的是新郎。新郎的好友站在那里听着，听见新郎的声音就非常喜乐。因此，我这喜乐满溢了！
verses.textZhCuv: 娶新妇的就是新郎；新郎的朋友站着，听见新郎的声音就甚喜乐。故此，我这喜乐满足了。
verses.textEnNiv: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend who attends the bridegroom waits and listens for him, and is full of joy when he hears the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
verses.textEnEsv: The one who has the bride is the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly at the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore this joy of mine is now complete.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore this joy of mine is fulfilled.
verses.textEnNlt: It is the bridegroom who marries the bride, and the bridegroom’s friend is simply glad to stand with him and hear his vows. Therefore, I am filled with joy at his success.
verses.textEnNasb: He who has the bride is the groom; but the friend of the groom, who stands and listens to him, rejoices greatly because of the groom’s voice. So this joy of mine has been made full.
verses.textEn: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend who attends the bridegroom waits and listens for him, and is full of joy when he hears the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.

verses.textZh: 他必兴旺，我必衰微。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必兴旺，我必衰微。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必兴旺，我必衰微。」
verses.textEnNiv: He must become greater; I must become less."
verses.textEnEsv: He must increase, but I must decrease."
verses.textEnNkjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.textEnNlt: He must become greater and greater, and I must become less and less.
verses.textEnNasb: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.textEn: He must become greater; I must become less."

verses.textZh: "那从天上来的，是在万有之上；从地上来的，是属于地，所讲的也是属于地。那从天上来的，是超越万有之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那从天上来的，是在万有之上；从地上来的，是属于地，所讲的也是属于地。那从天上来的，是超越万有之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「从天上来的是在万有之上；从地上来的是属乎地，他所说的也是属乎地。从天上来的是在万有之上。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who comes from above is above all; the one who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks as one from the earth. The one who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.textEnEsv: He who comes from above is above all. He who is of the earth belongs to the earth and speaks in an earthly way. He who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who comes from above is above all; he who is of the earth is earthly and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.textEnNlt: "He has come from above and is greater than anyone else. We are of the earth, and we speak of earthly things, but he has come from heaven and is greater than anyone else.
verses.textEnNasb: "He who comes from above is above all; the one who is only from the earth is of the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.textEn: The one who comes from above is above all; the one who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks as one from the earth. The one who comes from heaven is above all.

verses.textZh: 他把所见所闻的见证出来，可是没有人接受他的见证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把所见所闻的见证出来，可是没有人接受他的见证。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将所见所闻的见证出来，只是没有人领受他的见证。
verses.textEnNiv: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.
verses.textEnEsv: He bears witness to what he has seen and heard, yet no one receives his testimony.
verses.textEnNkjv: And what He has seen and heard, that He testifies; and no one receives His testimony.
verses.textEnNlt: He testifies about what he has seen and heard, but how few believe what he tells them!
verses.textEnNasb: What He has seen and heard, of this He testifies; and no one accepts His testimony.
verses.textEn: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.

verses.textZh: 那接受他的见证的，就确认神是真的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那接受他的见证的，就确认神是真的。
verses.textZhCuv: 那领受他见证的，就印上印，证明神是真的。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever has accepted it has certified that God is truthful.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever receives his testimony sets his seal to this, that God is true.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has received His testimony has certified that God is true.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who accepts his testimony can affirm that God is true.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has accepted His testimony has certified that God is true.
verses.textEn: Whoever has accepted it has certified that God is truthful.

verses.textZh: 神所差来的那一位讲神的话，因为神把圣灵无限地赐给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神所差来的那一位讲神的话，因为神把圣灵无限地赐给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 神所差来的就说神的话，因为神赐圣灵给他是没有限量的。
verses.textEnNiv: For the one whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
verses.textEnEsv: For he whom God has sent utters the words of God, for he gives the Spirit without measure.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God does not give the Spirit by measure.
verses.textEnNlt: For he is sent by God. He speaks God’s words, for God gives him the Spirit without limit.
verses.textEnNasb: For He whom God sent speaks the words of God; for He does not give the Spirit sparingly.
verses.textEn: For the one whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.

verses.textZh: 父爱子，已经把万有交在他手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 父爱子，已经把万有交在他手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 父爱子，已将万有交在他手里。
verses.textEnNiv: The Father loves the Son and has placed everything in his hands.
verses.textEnEsv: The Father loves the Son and has given all things into his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into His hand.
verses.textEnNlt: The Father loves his Son and has put everything into his hands.
verses.textEnNasb: The Father loves the Son and has entrusted all things to His hand.
verses.textEn: The Father loves the Son and has placed everything in his hands.

verses.textZh: 信子的，有永生；不信从子的，必不得见永生，神的震怒却常在他身上。"

verses.textZhCuv: 信子的人有永生；不信子的人得不着永生 ，神的震怒常在他身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever rejects the Son will not see life, for God’s wrath remains on them.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life; whoever does not obey the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who believes in the Son has everlasting life; and he who does not believe the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God abides on him."
verses.textEnNlt: And anyone who believes in God’s Son has eternal life. Anyone who doesn’t obey the Son will never experience eternal life but remains under God’s angry judgment."
verses.textEnNasb: The one who believes in the Son has eternal life; but the one who does not obey the Son will not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him."
verses.textEn: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever rejects the Son will not see life, for God’s wrath remains on them.

verses.textEn: Now Jesus learned that the Pharisees had heard that he was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John—

verses.textZhCnvs: 他必须经过撒玛利亚。

verses.textEnNiv: So he left Judea and went back once more to Galilee.

verses.textEnNkjv: He left Judea and departed again to Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: So he left Judea and returned to Galilee.
verses.textEnNasb: He left Judea and went away again to Galilee.
verses.textEn: So he left Judea and went back once more to Galilee.

verses.textZh: 于是到了撒玛利亚的一座城，名叫叙加；这城靠近雅各给他儿子约瑟的那块地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是到了撒玛利亚的一座城，名叫叙加；这城靠近雅各给他儿子约瑟的那块地。

verses.textEnEsv: And he had to pass through Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He needed to go through Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: He had to go through Samaria on the way.
verses.textEnNasb: And He had to pass through Samaria.
verses.textEn: Now he had to go through Samaria.

verses.textZh: 在那里有雅各井。耶稣因为旅途疲倦了，就坐在井旁；那时大约正午。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里有雅各井。耶稣因为旅途疲倦了，就坐在井旁；那时大约正午。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是到了撒马利亚的一座城，名叫叙加，靠近雅各给他儿子约瑟的那块地。
verses.textEnNiv: So he came to a town in Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
verses.textEnEsv: So he came to a town of Samaria called Sychar, near the field that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He came to a city of Samaria which is called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.textEnNlt: Eventually he came to the Samaritan village of Sychar, near the field that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.textEnNasb: So He *came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of land that Jacob gave to his son Joseph;
verses.textEn: So he came to a town in Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph.

verses.textZh: 有一个撒玛利亚妇人来打水。耶稣对她说："请给我水喝。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个撒玛利亚妇人来打水。耶稣对她说："请给我水喝。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里有雅各井；耶稣因走路困乏，就坐在井旁。那时约有午正。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob’s well was there, and Jesus, tired as he was from the journey, sat down by the well. It was about noon.
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob’s well was there; so Jesus, wearied as he was from his journey, was sitting beside the well. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied from His journey, sat thus by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob’s well was there; and Jesus, tired from the long walk, sat wearily beside the well about noontime.
verses.textEnNasb: and Jacob’s well was there. So Jesus, tired from His journey, was just sitting by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.textEn: Jacob’s well was there, and Jesus, tired as he was from the journey, sat down by the well. It was about noon.

verses.textZh: <red>那时，他的门徒都进城买食物去了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时，他的门徒都进城买食物去了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个撒马利亚的妇人来打水。耶稣对她说：「<red>请你给我水喝。</red>」（
verses.textEnNiv: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, <red>“Will you give me a drink?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: A woman from Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, "Give me a drink."
verses.textEnNkjv: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, "Give Me a drink."
verses.textEnNlt: Soon a Samaritan woman came to draw water, and Jesus said to her, "Please give me a drink."
verses.textEnNasb: A woman of Samaria *came to draw water. Jesus *said to her, "Give Me a drink."
verses.textEn: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, <red>“Will you give me a drink?”</red>

verses.textZh: 撒玛利亚妇人对耶稣说："你是犹太人，怎么向我，一个撒玛利亚妇人要水喝呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒玛利亚妇人对耶稣说："你是犹太人，怎么向我，一个撒玛利亚妇人要水喝呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时门徒进城买食物去了。）
verses.textEnNiv: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
verses.textEnEsv: (For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.)
verses.textEnNkjv: For His disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
verses.textEnNlt: He was alone at the time because his disciples had gone into the village to buy some food.
verses.textEnNasb: For His disciples had gone away to the city to buy food.
verses.textEn: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答她："你若知道神的恩赐，和对你说‘请给我水喝’的是谁，你必早已求他，他也必早把活水赐给你了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答她："你若知道神的恩赐，和对你说‘请给我水喝’的是谁，你必早已求他，他也必早把活水赐给你了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒马利亚的妇人对他说：「你既是犹太人，怎么向我一个撒马利亚妇人要水喝呢？」原来犹太人和撒马利亚人没有来往。
verses.textEnNiv: The Samaritan woman said to him, "You are a Jew and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink?" (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans. )
verses.textEnEsv: The Samaritan woman said to him, "How is it that you, a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a woman of Samaria?" ( For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the woman of Samaria said to Him, "How is it that You, being a Jew, ask a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?" For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.
verses.textEnNlt: The woman was surprised, for Jews refuse to have anything to do with Samaritans. She said to Jesus, "You are a Jew, and I am a Samaritan woman. Why are you asking me for a drink?"
verses.textEnNasb: So the Samaritan woman *said to Him, "How is it that You, though You are a Jew, are asking me for a drink, though I am a Samaritan woman?" (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
verses.textEn: The Samaritan woman said to him, "You are a Jew and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink?" (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans. )

verses.textZh: 妇人说："<red>先生，你没有打水的器具，井又深，你从哪里得活水呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人说："<red>先生，你没有打水的器具，井又深，你从哪里得活水呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>你若知道神的恩赐，和对你说『给我水喝』的是谁，你必早求他，他也必早给了你活水。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered her, <red>“If you knew the gift of God and who it is that asks you for a drink, you would have asked him and he would have given you living water.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered her, "If you knew the gift of God, and who it is that is saying to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to her, "If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give Me a drink,’ you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "If you only knew the gift God has for you and who you are speaking to, you would ask me, and I would give you living water."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus replied to her, "If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who is saying to you, ‘Give Me a drink,’ you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water."
verses.textEn: Jesus answered her, <red>“If you knew the gift of God and who it is that asks you for a drink, you would have asked him and he would have given you living water.”</red>

verses.textZh: 我们的祖先雅各把这口井留给我们，他自己和子孙以及牲畜都喝这井的水，难道你比他还大吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的祖先雅各把这口井留给我们，他自己和子孙以及牲畜都喝这井的水，难道你比他还大吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人说：「先生，没有打水的器具，井又深，你从哪里得活水呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Sir," the woman said, "you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?
verses.textEnEsv: The woman said to him, "Sir, you have nothing to draw water with, and the well is deep. Where do you get that living water?
verses.textEnNkjv: The woman said to Him, "Sir, You have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. Where then do You get that living water?
verses.textEnNlt: "But sir, you don’t have a rope or a bucket," she said, "and this well is very deep. Where would you get this living water?
verses.textEnNasb: She *said to Him, " Sir, You have no bucket and the well is deep; where then do You get this living water?
verses.textEn: "Sir," the woman said, "you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："凡喝这水的，还要再渴；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："凡喝这水的，还要再渴；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的祖宗雅各将这井留给我们，他自己和儿子并牲畜也都喝这井里的水，难道你比他还大吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did also his sons and his livestock?"
verses.textEnEsv: Are you greater than our father Jacob? He gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his sons and his livestock."
verses.textEnNkjv: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank from it himself, as well as his sons and his livestock?"
verses.textEnNlt: And besides, do you think you’re greater than our ancestor Jacob, who gave us this well? How can you offer better water than he and his sons and his animals enjoyed?"
verses.textEnNasb: You are not greater than our father Jacob, are You, who gave us the well and drank of it himself, and his sons and his cattle?"
verses.textEn: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did also his sons and his livestock?"

verses.textZh: 人若喝我所赐的水，就永远不渴。我所赐的水要在他里面成为涌流的泉源，直涌到永生。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若喝我所赐的水，就永远不渴。我所赐的水要在他里面成为涌流的泉源，直涌到永生。"
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「凡喝这水的还要再渴；</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to her, "Whoever drinks of this water will thirst again,

verses.textZhCnvs: <red>妇人说："先生，请把这水赐给我，使我不渴，也不用来这里打水。"</red>

verses.textEnNiv: <red>but whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never be thirsty again. The water that I will give him will become in him a spring of water welling up to eternal life."
verses.textEnNkjv: but whoever drinks of the water that I shall give him will never thirst. But the water that I shall give him will become in him a fountain of water springing up into everlasting life."
verses.textEnNlt: But those who drink the water I give will never be thirsty again. It becomes a fresh, bubbling spring within them, giving them eternal life."
verses.textEnNasb: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him shall never be thirsty; but the water that I will give him will become in him a fountain of water springing up to eternal life."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："你去，叫你的丈夫，然后回到这里来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："你去，叫你的丈夫，然后回到这里来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人说：「先生，请把这水赐给我，叫我不渴，也不用来这么远打水。」
verses.textEnNiv: The woman said to him, "Sir, give me this water so that I won’t get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water."
verses.textEnEsv: The woman said to him, "Sir, give me this water, so that I will not be thirsty or have to come here to draw water."
verses.textEnNkjv: The woman said to Him, "Sir, give me this water, that I may not thirst, nor come here to draw."
verses.textEnNlt: "Please, sir," the woman said, "give me this water! Then I’ll never be thirsty again, and I won’t have to come here to get water."
verses.textEnNasb: The woman *said to Him, " Sir, give me this water so that I will not be thirsty, nor come all the way here to draw water."
verses.textEn: The woman said to him, "Sir, give me this water so that I won’t get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water."

verses.textZh: 妇人对他说："<red>我没有丈夫。</red>"耶稣说："<red>你说‘没有丈夫’是不错的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人对他说："<red>我没有丈夫。</red>"耶稣说："<red>你说‘没有丈夫’是不错的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你去叫你丈夫也到这里来。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He told her, <red>“Go, call your husband and come back.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to her, "Go, call your husband, and come here."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to her, "Go, call your husband, and come here."
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and get your husband," Jesus told her.
verses.textEnNasb: He *said to her, "Go, call your husband and come here."
verses.textEn: He told her, <red>“Go, call your husband and come back.”</red>

verses.textZh: 你以前有五个丈夫，现在有的并不是你的丈夫；你说这话是真的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你以前有五个丈夫，现在有的并不是你的丈夫；你说这话是真的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人说：「<red>我没有丈夫。</red>」耶稣说：「你说没有丈夫是不错的。
verses.textEnNiv: “I have no husband,” she replied. Jesus said to her, <red>“You are right when you say you have no husband.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The woman answered him, "I have no husband." Jesus said to her, "You are right in saying, ‘I have no husband’;
verses.textEnNkjv: The woman answered and said, "I have no husband." Jesus said to her, "You have well said, ‘I have no husband,’
verses.textEnNlt: "I don’t have a husband," the woman replied. Jesus said, "You’re right! You don’t have a husband—

verses.textEn: “I have no husband,” she replied. Jesus said to her, <red>“You are right when you say you have no husband.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>妇人说："先生，我看出你是先知。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>妇人说："先生，我看出你是先知。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你已经有五个丈夫，你现在有的并不是你的丈夫。你这话是真的。」</red>

verses.textEnEsv: for you have had five husbands, and the one you now have is not your husband. What you have said is true."
verses.textEnNkjv: for you have had five husbands, and the one whom you now have is not your husband; in that you spoke truly."
verses.textEnNlt: for you have had five husbands, and you aren’t even married to the man you’re living with now. You certainly spoke the truth!"
verses.textEnNasb: for you have had five husbands, and the one whom you now have is not your husband; this which you have said is true."
verses.textEn: <red>The fact is, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have just said is quite true.”</red>

verses.textZh: 我们的祖先在这山上敬拜神，而你们却说，敬拜的地方必须在耶路撒冷。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的祖先在这山上敬拜神，而你们却说，敬拜的地方必须在耶路撒冷。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人说：「先生，我看出你是先知。
verses.textEnNiv: "Sir," the woman said, "I can see that you are a prophet.
verses.textEnEsv: The woman said to him, "Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
verses.textEnNkjv: The woman said to Him, "Sir, I perceive that You are a prophet.
verses.textEnNlt: "Sir," the woman said, "you must be a prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: The woman *said to Him, " Sir, I perceive that You are a prophet.
verses.textEn: "Sir," the woman said, "I can see that you are a prophet.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："妇人，你应当信我，时候将到，那时你们敬拜父，不在这山上，也不在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："妇人，你应当信我，时候将到，那时你们敬拜父，不在这山上，也不在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的祖宗在这山上礼拜，你们倒说，应当礼拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。」
verses.textEnNiv: Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews claim that the place where we must worship is in Jerusalem."
verses.textEnEsv: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship."
verses.textEnNkjv: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where one ought to worship."
verses.textEnNlt: So tell me, why is it that you Jews insist that Jerusalem is the only place of worship, while we Samaritans claim it is here at Mount Gerizim, where our ancestors worshiped?"
verses.textEnNasb: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, and yet you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where one must worship."
verses.textEn: Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews claim that the place where we must worship is in Jerusalem."

verses.textZh: <red>你们敬拜你们所不知道的，我们却敬拜我们所知道的，因为救恩是从犹太人出来的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们敬拜你们所不知道的，我们却敬拜我们所知道的，因为救恩是从犹太人出来的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「妇人，你当信我。时候将到，你们拜父，也不在这山上，也不在耶路撒冷。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woman,”</red> Jesus replied, <red>“believe me, a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to her, "Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to her, "Woman, believe Me, the hour is coming when you will neither on this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, worship the Father.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Believe me, dear woman, the time is coming when it will no longer matter whether you worship the Father on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to her, "Believe Me, woman, that a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: <red>“Woman,”</red> Jesus replied, <red>“believe me, a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而时候将到，现在就是了，那用心灵按真理敬拜父的，才是真正敬拜的人；因为父在寻找这样敬拜他的人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而时候将到，现在就是了，那用心灵按真理敬拜父的，才是真正敬拜的人；因为父在寻找这样敬拜他的人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们所拜的，你们不知道；我们所拜的，我们知道，因为救恩是从犹太人出来的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we know, for salvation is from the Jews.
verses.textEnNkjv: You worship what you do not know; we know what we worship, for salvation is of the Jews.
verses.textEnNlt: You Samaritans know very little about the one you worship, while we Jews know all about him, for salvation comes through the Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, because salvation is from the Jews.
verses.textEn: <red>You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>神是灵，敬拜他的必须借着灵按真理敬拜他。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>神是灵，敬拜他的必须借着灵按真理敬拜他。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>时候将到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心灵和诚实拜他，因为父要这样的人拜他。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth, for they are the kind of worshipers the Father seeks.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the hour is coming, and is now here, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father is seeking such people to worship him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the hour is coming, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth; for the Father is seeking such to worship Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But the time is coming—indeed it’s here now—when true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth. The Father is looking for those who will worship him that way.
verses.textEnNasb: But a time is coming, and even now has arrived, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth; for such people the Father seeks to be His worshipers.
verses.textEn: <red>Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth, for they are the kind of worshipers the Father seeks.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>妇人说："我知道那称为基督的弥赛亚要来；他来了，要把一切都告诉我们。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>妇人说："我知道那称为基督的弥赛亚要来；他来了，要把一切都告诉我们。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>神是个灵 ，所以拜他的必须用心灵和诚实拜他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth."
verses.textEnNkjv: God is Spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth."
verses.textEnNlt: For God is Spirit, so those who worship him must worship in spirit and in truth."
verses.textEnNasb: God is spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth."
verses.textEn: <red>God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："我这现在跟你说话的就是他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："我这现在跟你说话的就是他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人说：「我知道弥赛亚（就是那称为基督的）要来；他来了，必将一切的事都告诉我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: The woman said, "I know that Messiah" (called Christ) "is coming. When he comes, he will explain everything to us."
verses.textEnEsv: The woman said to him, "I know that Messiah is coming (he who is called Christ). When he comes, he will tell us all things."
verses.textEnNkjv: The woman said to Him, "I know that Messiah is coming" (who is called Christ). "When He comes, He will tell us all things."
verses.textEnNlt: The woman said, "I know the Messiah is coming—the one who is called Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us."
verses.textEnNasb: The woman *said to Him, "I know that Messiah is coming (He who is called Christ); when that One comes, He will declare all things to us."
verses.textEn: The woman said, "I know that Messiah" (called Christ) "is coming. When he comes, he will explain everything to us."

verses.textZh: 正在这时候，门徒回来了，见耶稣和一个妇人说话，就很希奇；但是没有人问："你要甚么？"或说："<red>你为甚么跟她说话？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 正在这时候，门徒回来了，见耶稣和一个妇人说话，就很希奇；但是没有人问："你要甚么？"或说："<red>你为甚么跟她说话？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>这和你说话的就是他！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus declared, <red>“I, the one speaking to you—I am he.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to her, "I who speak to you am he."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to her, "I who speak to you am He."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus told her, " I Am the Messiah!"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to her, "I am He, the One speaking to you."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus declared, <red>“I, the one speaking to you—I am he.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那妇人撇下了她的水罐，进到城里去，对众人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那妇人撇下了她的水罐，进到城里去，对众人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当下门徒回来，就希奇耶稣和一个妇人说话；只是没有人说：「你是要什么？」或说：「你为什么和她说话？」
verses.textEnNiv: Just then his disciples returned and were surprised to find him talking with a woman. But no one asked, "What do you want?" or "Why are you talking with her?"
verses.textEnEsv: Just then his disciples came back. They marveled that he was talking with a woman, but no one said, "What do you seek?" or, "Why are you talking with her?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And at this point His disciples came, and they marveled that He talked with a woman; yet no one said, "What do You seek?" or, "Why are You talking with her?"
verses.textEnNlt: Just then his disciples came back. They were shocked to find him talking to a woman, but none of them had the nerve to ask, "What do you want with her?" or "Why are you talking to her?"
verses.textEnNasb: And at this point His disciples came, and they were amazed that He had been speaking with a woman, yet no one said, "What are You seeking?" or, "Why are You speaking with her?"
verses.textEn: Just then his disciples returned and were surprised to find him talking with a woman. But no one asked, "What do you want?" or "Why are you talking with her?"

verses.textZh: "你们来，看看一个人，他把我所作的一切都说出来，难道这人就是基督吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们来，看看一个人，他把我所作的一切都说出来，难道这人就是基督吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那妇人就留下水罐子，往城里去，对众人说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,
verses.textEnEsv: So the woman left her water jar and went away into town and said to the people,
verses.textEnNkjv: The woman then left her waterpot, went her way into the city, and said to the men,
verses.textEnNlt: The woman left her water jar beside the well and ran back to the village, telling everyone,
verses.textEnNasb: So the woman left her waterpot and went into the city, and *said to the people,
verses.textEn: Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,

verses.textZh: 众人就出城，往耶稣那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人就出城，往耶稣那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们来看！有一个人将我素来所行的一切事都给我说出来了，莫非这就是基督吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Messiah?"
verses.textEnEsv: "Come, see a man who told me all that I ever did. Can this be the Christ?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Come, see a Man who told me all things that I ever did. Could this be the Christ?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Come and see a man who told me everything I ever did! Could he possibly be the Messiah?"
verses.textEnNasb: "Come, see a Man who told me all the things that I have done; this is not the Christ, is He?"
verses.textEn: "Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Messiah?"

verses.textZh: 当时，门徒对耶稣说："拉比，请吃。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，门徒对耶稣说："拉比，请吃。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人就出城，往耶稣那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: They came out of the town and made their way toward him.
verses.textEnEsv: They went out of the town and were coming to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they went out of the city and came to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people came streaming from the village to see him.
verses.textEnNasb: They left the city and were coming to Him.
verses.textEn: They came out of the town and made their way toward him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："我有食物吃，是你们所不知道的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："我有食物吃，是你们所不知道的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这其间，门徒对耶稣说：「拉比，请吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile his disciples urged him, "Rabbi, eat something."
verses.textEnEsv: Meanwhile the disciples were urging him, saying, "Rabbi, eat."
verses.textEnNkjv: In the meantime His disciples urged Him, saying, "Rabbi, eat."
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the disciples were urging Jesus, "Rabbi, eat something."
verses.textEnNasb: Meanwhile the disciples were urging Him, saying, "Rabbi, eat something."
verses.textEn: Meanwhile his disciples urged him, "Rabbi, eat something."

verses.textZh: 门徒就彼此说："<red>难道有人拿东西给他吃了吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒就彼此说："<red>难道有人拿东西给他吃了吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我有食物吃，是你们不知道的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: But he said to them, <red>“I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to them, "I have food to eat that you do not know about."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said to them, "I have food to eat of which you do not know."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus replied, "I have a kind of food you know nothing about."
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to them, "I have food to eat that you do not know about."
verses.textEn: But he said to them, <red>“I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："我的食物就是遵行差我来者的旨意，并且完成他的工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："我的食物就是遵行差我来者的旨意，并且完成他的工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒就彼此对问说：「莫非有人拿什么给他吃吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then his disciples said to each other, "Could someone have brought him food?"
verses.textEnEsv: So the disciples said to one another, "Has anyone brought him something to eat?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the disciples said to one another, "Has anyone brought Him anything to eat?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Did someone bring him food while we were gone?" the disciples asked each other.
verses.textEnNasb: So the disciples were saying to one another, "No one brought Him anything to eat, did he?"
verses.textEn: Then his disciples said to each other, "Could someone have brought him food?"

verses.textZh: <red>你们不是说‘还有四个月才到收获的时候’吗？我告诉你们，举目向田观看，庄稼已经熟了，可以收割了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们不是说‘还有四个月才到收获的时候’吗？我告诉你们，举目向田观看，庄稼已经熟了，可以收割了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「我的食物就是遵行差我来者的旨意，做成他的工。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“My food,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to them, "My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me, and to finish His work.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus explained: "My nourishment comes from doing the will of God, who sent me, and from finishing his work.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to them, "My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me, and to accomplish His work.
verses.textEn: <red>“My food,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>收割的人得到工资，也积储五谷直到永生，使撒种的和收割的一同快乐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>收割的人得到工资，也积储五谷直到永生，使撒种的和收割的一同快乐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们岂不说『到收割的时候还有四个月』吗？我告诉你们，举目向田观看，庄稼已经熟了 ，可以收割了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Don’t you have a saying, ‘It’s still four months until harvest’? I tell you, open your eyes and look at the fields! They are ripe for harvest.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not say, ‘There are yet four months, then comes the harvest’? Look, I tell you, lift up your eyes, and see that the fields are white for harvest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months and then comes the harvest’? Behold, I say to you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are already white for harvest!
verses.textEnNlt: You know the saying, ‘Four months between planting and harvest.’ But I say, wake up and look around. The fields are already ripe for harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months, and then comes the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, raise your eyes and observe the fields, that they are white for harvest.
verses.textEn: <red>Don’t you have a saying, ‘It’s still four months until harvest’? I tell you, open your eyes and look at the fields! They are ripe for harvest.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>‘这人撒种，那人收割’，这话是真的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>‘这人撒种，那人收割’，这话是真的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>收割的人得工价，积蓄五谷到永生，叫撒种的和收割的一同快乐。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Even now the one who reaps draws a wage and harvests a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may be glad together.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Already the one who reaps is receiving wages and gathering fruit for eternal life, so that sower and reaper may rejoice together.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit for eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
verses.textEnNlt: The harvesters are paid good wages, and the fruit they harvest is people brought to eternal life. What joy awaits both the planter and the harvester alike!
verses.textEnNasb: Already the one who reaps is receiving wages and is gathering fruit for eternal life, so that the one who sows and the one who reaps may rejoice together.
verses.textEn: <red>Even now the one who reaps draws a wage and harvests a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may be glad together.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我派你们去收割你们所没有劳苦的；别人劳苦，你们却享受他们劳苦的成果。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我派你们去收割你们所没有劳苦的；别人劳苦，你们却享受他们劳苦的成果。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>俗语说：『那人撒种，这人收割』，这话可见是真的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Thus the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For here the saying holds true, ‘One sows and another reaps.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For in this the saying is true: ‘One sows and another reaps.’
verses.textEnNlt: You know the saying, ‘One plants and another harvests.’ And it’s true.
verses.textEnNasb: For in this case the saying is true: ‘One sows and another reaps.’
verses.textEn: <red>Thus the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因着那妇人作见证的话："他把我所作的一切都说出来了"，那城里就有许多撒玛利亚人信了耶稣。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因着那妇人作见证的话："他把我所作的一切都说出来了"，那城里就有许多撒玛利亚人信了耶稣。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我差你们去收你们所没有劳苦的；别人劳苦，你们享受他们所劳苦的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I sent you to reap what you have not worked for. Others have done the hard work, and you have reaped the benefits of their labor.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I sent you to reap that for which you did not labor. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor."
verses.textEnNkjv: I sent you to reap that for which you have not labored; others have labored, and you have entered into their labors."
verses.textEnNlt: I sent you to harvest where you didn’t plant; others had already done the work, and now you will get to gather the harvest."
verses.textEnNasb: I sent you to reap that for which you have not labored; others have labored, and you have come into their labor."
verses.textEn: <red>I sent you to reap what you have not worked for. Others have done the hard work, and you have reaped the benefits of their labor.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他们来到耶稣那里，求他和他们同住，耶稣就在那里住了两天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们来到耶稣那里，求他和他们同住，耶稣就在那里住了两天。
verses.textZhCuv: 那城里有好些撒马利亚人信了耶稣，因为那妇人作见证说：「他将我素来所行的一切事都给我说出来了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the woman’s testimony, "He told me everything I ever did."
verses.textEnEsv: Many Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the woman’s testimony, "He told me all that I ever did."
verses.textEnNkjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed in Him because of the word of the woman who testified, "He told me all that I ever did."
verses.textEnNlt: Many Samaritans from the village believed in Jesus because the woman had said, "He told me everything I ever did!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now from that city many of the Samaritans believed in Him because of the word of the woman who testified, "He told me all the things that I have done."
verses.textEn: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the woman’s testimony, "He told me everything I ever did."

verses.textZh: 因着耶稣的话，信他的人就更多了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着耶稣的话，信他的人就更多了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是撒马利亚人来见耶稣，求他在他们那里住下，他便在那里住了两天。
verses.textEnNiv: So when the Samaritans came to him, they urged him to stay with them, and he stayed two days.
verses.textEnEsv: So when the Samaritans came to him, they asked him to stay with them, and he stayed there two days.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when the Samaritans had come to Him, they urged Him to stay with them; and He stayed there two days.
verses.textEnNlt: When they came out to see him, they begged him to stay in their village. So he stayed for two days,
verses.textEnNasb: So when the Samaritans came to Jesus, they were asking Him to stay with them; and He stayed there two days.
verses.textEn: So when the Samaritans came to him, they urged him to stay with them, and he stayed two days.

verses.textZh: 他们就对那妇人说："现在我们信，不再是因为你的话，而是因为我们亲自听见了，知道这位真是世人的救主。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就对那妇人说："现在我们信，不再是因为你的话，而是因为我们亲自听见了，知道这位真是世人的救主。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶稣的话，信的人就更多了，
verses.textEnNiv: And because of his words many more became believers.
verses.textEnEsv: And many more believed because of his word.
verses.textEnNkjv: And many more believed because of His own word.
verses.textEnNlt: long enough for many more to hear his message and believe.
verses.textEnNasb: Many more believed because of His word;
verses.textEn: And because of his words many more became believers.

verses.textZh: 两天之后，耶稣离开那里，往加利利去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两天之后，耶稣离开那里，往加利利去。
verses.textZhCuv: 便对妇人说：「现在我们信，不是因为你的话，是我们亲自听见了，知道这真是救世主。」
verses.textEnNiv: They said to the woman, "We no longer believe just because of what you said; now we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man really is the Savior of the world."
verses.textEnEsv: They said to the woman, "It is no longer because of what you said that we believe, for we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this is indeed the Savior of the world."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to the woman, "Now we believe, not because of what you said, for we ourselves have heard Him and we know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world."
verses.textEnNlt: Then they said to the woman, "Now we believe, not just because of what you told us, but because we have heard him ourselves. Now we know that he is indeed the Savior of the world."
verses.textEnNasb: and they were saying to the woman, "It is no longer because of what you said that we believe, for we have heard for ourselves and know that this One truly is the Savior of the world."
verses.textEn: They said to the woman, "We no longer believe just because of what you said; now we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man really is the Savior of the world."

verses.textZh: 耶稣自己说过："先知在本乡是不受尊敬的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣自己说过："先知在本乡是不受尊敬的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 过了那两天，耶稣离了那地方，往加利利去。
verses.textEnNiv: After the two days he left for Galilee.
verses.textEnEsv: After the two days he departed for Galilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after the two days He departed from there and went to Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: At the end of the two days, Jesus went on to Galilee.
verses.textEnNasb: And after the two days, He departed from there for Galilee.
verses.textEn: After the two days he left for Galilee.

verses.textZh: 耶稣到了加利利的时候，加利利人都欢迎他，因为他们曾经上耶路撒冷去过节，见过他所行的一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣到了加利利的时候，加利利人都欢迎他，因为他们曾经上耶路撒冷去过节，见过他所行的一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶稣自己作过见证说：「先知在本地是没有人尊敬的。」
verses.textEnNiv: (Now Jesus himself had pointed out that a prophet has no honor in his own country.)
verses.textEnEsv: (For Jesus himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown.)
verses.textEnNkjv: For Jesus Himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
verses.textEnNlt: He himself had said that a prophet is not honored in his own hometown.
verses.textEnNasb: For Jesus Himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
verses.textEn: (Now Jesus himself had pointed out that a prophet has no honor in his own country.)

verses.textZh: 耶稣又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他变水为酒的地方。有一个大臣，他的儿子在迦百农患病。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他变水为酒的地方。有一个大臣，他的儿子在迦百农患病。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了加利利，加利利人既然看见他在耶路撒冷过节所行的一切事，就接待他，因为他们也是上去过节。
verses.textEnNiv: When he arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him. They had seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, for they also had been there.
verses.textEnEsv: So when he came to Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him, having seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the feast. For they too had gone to the feast.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when He came to Galilee, the Galileans received Him, having seen all the things He did in Jerusalem at the feast; for they also had gone to the feast.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet the Galileans welcomed him, for they had been in Jerusalem at the Passover celebration and had seen everything he did there.
verses.textEnNasb: So when He came to Galilee, the Galileans received Him, only because they had seen all the things that He did in Jerusalem at the feast; for they themselves also went to the feast.
verses.textEn: When he arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him. They had seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, for they also had been there.

verses.textZh: 他听见耶稣从犹太到了加利利，就来见他，求他下去医治他的儿子，因为他的儿子快要死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他听见耶稣从犹太到了加利利，就来见他，求他下去医治他的儿子，因为他的儿子快要死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他从前变水为酒的地方。有一个大臣，他的儿子在迦百农患病。
verses.textEnNiv: Once more he visited Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
verses.textEnEsv: So he came again to Cana in Galilee, where he had made the water wine. And at Capernaum there was an official whose son was ill.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus came again to Cana of Galilee where He had made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.textEnNlt: As he traveled through Galilee, he came to Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was a government official in nearby Capernaum whose son was very sick.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore He came again to Cana of Galilee, where He had made the water into wine. And there was a royal official whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.textEn: Once more he visited Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："你们若看不见神迹奇事，总是不肯信。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："你们若看不见神迹奇事，总是不肯信。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他听见耶稣从犹太到了加利利，就来见他，求他下去医治他的儿子，因为他儿子快要死了。
verses.textEnNiv: When this man heard that Jesus had arrived in Galilee from Judea, he went to him and begged him to come and heal his son, who was close to death.
verses.textEnEsv: When this man heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went to him and asked him to come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to Him and implored Him to come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
verses.textEnNlt: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went and begged Jesus to come to Capernaum to heal his son, who was about to die.
verses.textEnNasb: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea into Galilee, he went to Him and began asking Him to come down and heal his son; for he was at the point of death.
verses.textEn: When this man heard that Jesus had arrived in Galilee from Judea, he went to him and begged him to come and heal his son, who was close to death.

verses.textZh: <red>大臣说："先生，求你趁我的孩子还没有死就下去吧！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>大臣说："先生，求你趁我的孩子还没有死就下去吧！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就对他说：「<red>若不看见神迹奇事，你们总是不信。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Unless you people see signs and wonders,”</red> Jesus told him, <red>“you will never believe.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus said to him, "Unless you see signs and wonders you will not believe."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to him, "Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will by no means believe."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus asked, "Will you never believe in me unless you see miraculous signs and wonders?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus said to him, "Unless you people see signs and wonders, you simply will not believe."
verses.textEn: <red>“Unless you people see signs and wonders,”</red> Jesus told him, <red>“you will never believe.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣告诉他："回去吧，你的儿子好了。"那人信耶稣对他说的话，就回去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣告诉他："回去吧，你的儿子好了。"那人信耶稣对他说的话，就回去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那大臣说：「先生，求你趁着我的孩子还没有死就下去。」
verses.textEnNiv: The royal official said, "Sir, come down before my child dies."
verses.textEnEsv: The official said to him, "Sir, come down before my child dies."
verses.textEnNkjv: The nobleman said to Him, "Sir, come down before my child dies!"
verses.textEnNlt: The official pleaded, "Lord, please come now before my little boy dies."
verses.textEnNasb: The royal official *said to Him, " Sir, come down before my child dies."
verses.textEn: The royal official said, "Sir, come down before my child dies."

verses.textZh: <red>正下去的时候，他的仆人迎着他走来，说他的孩子好了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>正下去的时候，他的仆人迎着他走来，说他的孩子好了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>回去吧，你的儿子活了！</red>」那人信耶稣所说的话就回去了。
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Go,”</red> Jesus replied, <red>“your son will live.”</red> The man took Jesus at his word and departed.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "Go; your son will live." The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him and went on his way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "Go your way; your son lives." So the man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus told him, "Go back home. Your son will live!" And the man believed what Jesus said and started home.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to him, "Go; your son is alive." The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him and went home.
verses.textEn: <red>“Go,”</red> Jesus replied, <red>“your son will live.”</red> The man took Jesus at his word and departed.

verses.textZh: 他就向仆人查问孩子是甚么时候好转的。他们告诉他："昨天下午一点钟，热就退了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就向仆人查问孩子是甚么时候好转的。他们告诉他："昨天下午一点钟，热就退了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 正下去的时候，他的仆人迎见他，说他的儿子活了。
verses.textEnNiv: While he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was living.
verses.textEnEsv: As he was going down, his servants met him and told him that his son was recovering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him and told him, saying, "Your son lives!"
verses.textEnNlt: While the man was on his way, some of his servants met him with the news that his son was alive and well.
verses.textEnNasb: And as he was now going down, his slaves met him, saying that his son was alive.
verses.textEn: While he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was living.

verses.textZh: 这父亲就知道，那正是耶稣告诉他"你的儿子好了"的时候，他自己和全家就信了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这父亲就知道，那正是耶稣告诉他"你的儿子好了"的时候，他自己和全家就信了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就问什么时候见好的。他们说：「昨日未时热就退了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When he inquired as to the time when his son got better, they said to him, "Yesterday, at one in the afternoon, the fever left him."
verses.textEnEsv: So he asked them the hour when he began to get better, and they said to him, "Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he inquired of them the hour when he got better. And they said to him, "Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him."
verses.textEnNlt: He asked them when the boy had begun to get better, and they replied, "Yesterday afternoon at one o’clock his fever suddenly disappeared!"
verses.textEnNasb: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. Then they said to him, "Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him."
verses.textEn: When he inquired as to the time when his son got better, they said to him, "Yesterday, at one in the afternoon, the fever left him."

verses.textZh: <red>这是耶稣从犹太回到加利利以后所行的第二件神迹。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这是耶稣从犹太回到加利利以后所行的第二件神迹。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 他便知道这正是耶稣对他说「<red>你儿子活了</red>」的时候；他自己和全家就都信了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the father realized that this was the exact time at which Jesus had said to him, <red>“Your son will live.”</red> So he and his whole household believed.
verses.textEnEsv: The father knew that was the hour when Jesus had said to him, "Your son will live." And he himself believed, and all his household.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the father knew that itwas at the same hour in which Jesus said to him, "Your son lives." And he himself believed, and his whole household.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the father realized that that was the very time Jesus had told him, "Your son will live." And he and his entire household believed in Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, "Your son is alive"; and he himself believed, and his entire household.
verses.textEn: Then the father realized that this was the exact time at which Jesus had said to him, <red>“Your son will live.”</red> So he and his whole household believed.

verses.textZh: 这是耶稣在加利利行的第二件神迹，是他从犹太回去以后行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是耶稣在加利利行的第二件神迹，是他从犹太回去以后行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是耶稣在加利利行的第二件神迹，是他从犹太回去以后行的。
verses.textEnNiv: This was the second sign Jesus performed after coming from Judea to Galilee.
verses.textEnEsv: This was now the second sign that Jesus did when he had come from Judea to Galilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: This again is the second sign Jesus did when He had come out of Judea into Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: This was the second miraculous sign Jesus did in Galilee after coming from Judea.
verses.textEnNasb: This is again a second sign that Jesus performed when He had come from Judea into Galilee.
verses.textEn: This was the second sign Jesus performed after coming from Judea to Galilee.

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，到了犹太人的一个节期，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，到了犹太人的一个节期，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，到了犹太人的一个节期，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later, Jesus went up to Jerusalem for one of the Jewish festivals.
verses.textEnEsv: After this there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward Jesus returned to Jerusalem for one of the Jewish holy days.
verses.textEnNasb: After these things there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Some time later, Jesus went up to Jerusalem for one of the Jewish festivals.

verses.textZh: 在耶路撒冷靠近羊门有一个水池，希伯来话叫作毕士大，池边有五条走廊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶路撒冷靠近羊门有一个水池，希伯来话叫作毕士大，池边有五条走廊。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶路撒冷，靠近羊门有一个池子，希伯来话叫作毕士大，旁边有五个廊子；
verses.textEnNiv: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool, which in Aramaic is called Bethesda and which is surrounded by five covered colonnades.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there is in Jerusalem by the Sheep Gate a pool, in Aramaic called Bethesda, which has five roofed colonnades.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there is in Jerusalem by the Sheep Gate a pool, which is called in Hebrew, Bethesda, having five porches.
verses.textEnNlt: Inside the city, near the Sheep Gate, was the pool of Bethesda, with five covered porches.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in Jerusalem, by the Sheep Gate, there is a pool which in Hebrew is called Bethesda, having five porticoes.
verses.textEn: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool, which in Aramaic is called Bethesda and which is surrounded by five covered colonnades.

verses.textZh: 在那里躺着许多病人，有瞎眼的、瘸腿的和瘫痪的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里躺着许多病人，有瞎眼的、瘸腿的和瘫痪的。
verses.textZhCuv: 里面躺着瞎眼的、瘸腿的、血气枯干的许多病人。
verses.textEnNiv: Here a great number of disabled people used to lie—the blind, the lame, the paralyzed.
verses.textEnEsv: In these lay a multitude of invalids—blind, lame, and paralyzed.
verses.textEnNkjv: In these lay a great multitude of sick people, blind, lame, paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water.
verses.textEnNlt: Crowds of sick people—blind, lame, or paralyzed—lay on the porches.
verses.textEnNasb: In these porticoes lay a multitude of those who were sick, blind, limping, or paralyzed.
verses.textEn: Here a great number of disabled people used to lie—the blind, the lame, the paralyzed.

verses.textZh: 那里有一个人，病了三十八年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那里有一个人，病了三十八年。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里有一个人，病了三十八年。
verses.textEnNiv: One who was there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
verses.textEnEsv: One man was there who had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
verses.textEnNkjv: For an angel went down at a certain time into the pool and stirred up the water; then whoever stepped in first, after the stirring of the water, was made well of whatever disease he had.
verses.textEnNlt: One of the men lying there had been sick for thirty-eight years.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a man was there who had been ill for thirty-eight years.
verses.textEn: One who was there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.

verses.textZh: 耶稣看见他躺着，知道他病了很久，就问他："你要痊愈吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看见他躺着，知道他病了很久，就问他："你要痊愈吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣看见他躺着，知道他病了许久，就问他说：「你要痊愈吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw him lying there and learned that he had been in this condition for a long time, he asked him, "Do you want to get well?"
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus saw him lying there and knew that he had already been there a long time, he said to him, "Do you want to be healed?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain man was there who had an infirmity thirty-eight years.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus saw him and knew he had been ill for a long time, he asked him, "Would you like to get well?"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus, upon seeing this man lying there and knowing that he had already been in that condition for a long time, *said to him, "Do you want to get well?"
verses.textEn: When Jesus saw him lying there and learned that he had been in this condition for a long time, he asked him, "Do you want to get well?"

verses.textZh: 病人回答："<red>先生，水动的时候，没有人把我放在池里；自己想去的时候，总是给别人抢先。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 病人回答："<red>先生，水动的时候，没有人把我放在池里；自己想去的时候，总是给别人抢先。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 病人回答说：「<red>先生，水动的时候，没有人把我放在池子里；我正去的时候，就有别人比我先下去。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw him lying there and learned that he had been in this condition for a long time, he asked him, <red>“Do you want to get well?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The sick man answered him, "Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, and while I am going another steps down before me."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he already had been inthatcondition a long time, He said to him, "Do you want to be made well?"
verses.textEnNlt: "I can’t, sir," the sick man said, "for I have no one to put me into the pool when the water bubbles up. Someone else always gets there ahead of me."
verses.textEnNasb: The sick man answered Him, "Sir, I have no man to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I am coming, another steps down before me."
verses.textEn: When Jesus saw him lying there and learned that he had been in this condition for a long time, he asked him, <red>“Do you want to get well?”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："起来，拿着你的褥子走吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："起来，拿着你的褥子走吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「起来，拿你的褥子走吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to him, "Get up! Pick up your mat and walk."
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "Get up, take up your bed, and walk."
verses.textEnNkjv: The sick man answered Him, "Sir, I have no man to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up; but while I am coming, another steps down before me."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told him, "Stand up, pick up your mat, and walk!"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to him, "Get up, pick up your pallet and walk."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to him, "Get up! Pick up your mat and walk."

verses.textZh: <red>那人立刻痊愈，就拿起褥子走了。 那天正是安息日。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那人立刻痊愈，就拿起褥子走了。 那天正是安息日。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那人立刻痊愈，就拿起褥子来走了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to him, <red>“Get up! Pick up your mat and walk.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And at once the man was healed, and he took up his bed and walked. Now that day was the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "Rise, take up your bed and walk."
verses.textEnNlt: Instantly, the man was healed! He rolled up his sleeping mat and began walking! But this miracle happened on the Sabbath,
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately the man became well, and picked up his pallet and began to walk. Now it was a Sabbath on that day.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to him, <red>“Get up! Pick up your mat and walk.”</red>

verses.textZh: 因此犹太人对那医好了的人说："今天是安息日，你拿着褥子是不可以的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此犹太人对那医好了的人说："今天是安息日，你拿着褥子是不可以的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那天是安息日，所以犹太人对那医好的人说：「今天是安息日，你拿褥子是不可的。」
verses.textEnNiv: and so the Jewish leaders said to the man who had been healed, "It is the Sabbath; the law forbids you to carry your mat."
verses.textEnEsv: So the Jews said to the man who had been healed, "It is the Sabbath, and it is not lawful for you to take up your bed."
verses.textEnNkjv: And immediately the man was made well, took up his bed, and walked. And that day was the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNlt: so the Jewish leaders objected. They said to the man who was cured, "You can’t work on the Sabbath! The law doesn’t allow you to carry that sleeping mat!"
verses.textEnNasb: So the Jews were saying to the man who was cured, "It is a Sabbath, and it is not permissible for you to carry your pallet."
verses.textEn: and so the Jewish leaders said to the man who had been healed, "It is the Sabbath; the law forbids you to carry your mat."

verses.textZh: 他却回答："那使我痊愈的对我说：‘拿起你的褥子走吧’。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他却回答："那使我痊愈的对我说：‘拿起你的褥子走吧’。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他却回答说：「那使我痊愈的，对我说：『拿你的褥子走吧。』」
verses.textEnNiv: But he replied, "The man who made me well said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But he answered them, "The man who healed me, that man said to me, ‘Take up your bed, and walk.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: The Jews therefore said to him who was cured, "It is the Sabbath; it is not lawful for you to carry your bed."
verses.textEnNlt: But he replied, "The man who healed me told me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But he answered them, "He who made me well was the one who said to me, ‘Pick up your pallet and walk.’ "
verses.textEn: But he replied, "The man who made me well said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’ "

verses.textZh: 他们就问："<red>那对你说‘拿起来走吧’的是谁？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就问："<red>那对你说‘拿起来走吧’的是谁？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们问他说：「<red>对你说『拿褥子走』的是什么人？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: But he replied, “The man who made me well said to me, <red>‘Pick up your mat and walk.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They asked him, "Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your bed and walk’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered them, "He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your bed and walk.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Who said such a thing as that?" they demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: They asked him, "Who is the Man who said to you, ‘Pick it up and walk’?"
verses.textEn: But he replied, “The man who made me well said to me, <red>‘Pick up your mat and walk.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 那医好了的人不知道他是谁，因为那里人很多，耶稣已经避开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那医好了的人不知道他是谁，因为那里人很多，耶稣已经避开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那医好的人不知道是谁；因为那里的人多，耶稣已经躲开了。
verses.textEnNiv: The man who was healed had no idea who it was, for Jesus had slipped away into the crowd that was there.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the man who had been healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, as there was a crowd in the place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they asked him, "Who is the Man who said to you, ‘Take up your bed and walk’?"
verses.textEnNlt: The man didn’t know, for Jesus had disappeared into the crowd.
verses.textEnNasb: But the man who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away while there was a crowd in that place.
verses.textEn: The man who was healed had no idea who it was, for Jesus had slipped away into the crowd that was there.

verses.textZh: 后来，耶稣在殿里遇见那人，对他说："你已经痊愈了，不可再犯罪，免得招来更大的祸患。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，耶稣在殿里遇见那人，对他说："你已经痊愈了，不可再犯罪，免得招来更大的祸患。"
verses.textZhCuv: 后来耶稣在殿里遇见他，对他说：「你已经痊愈了，不要再犯罪，恐怕你遭遇的更加利害。」
verses.textEnNiv: Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, "See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you."
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, "See, you are well! Sin no more, that nothing worse may happen to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the one who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a multitude being in that place.
verses.textEnNlt: But afterward Jesus found him in the Temple and told him, "Now you are well; so stop sinning, or something even worse may happen to you."
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward, Jesus *found him in the temple and said to him, "Behold, you have become well; do not sin anymore, so that nothing worse happens to you."
verses.textEn: Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, "See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you."

verses.textZh: <red>那人就去告诉犹太人，使他痊愈的就是耶稣。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那人就去告诉犹太人，使他痊愈的就是耶稣。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那人就去告诉犹太人，使他痊愈的是耶稣。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, <red>“See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had healed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, "See, you have been made well. Sin no more, lest a worse thing come upon you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man went and told the Jewish leaders that it was Jesus who had healed him.
verses.textEnNasb: The man went away, and informed the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
verses.textEn: Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, <red>“See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 从此犹太人就迫害耶稣，因为他常常在安息日作这些事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从此犹太人就迫害耶稣，因为他常常在安息日作这些事。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以犹太人逼迫耶稣，因为他在安息日做了这事。
verses.textEnNiv: So, because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jewish leaders began to persecute him.
verses.textEnEsv: And this was why the Jews were persecuting Jesus, because he was doing these things on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNkjv: The man departed and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Jewish leaders began harassing Jesus for breaking the Sabbath rules.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason the Jews were persecuting Jesus, because He was doing these things on a Sabbath.
verses.textEn: So, because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jewish leaders began to persecute him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣却对他们说："我父作工直到现在，我也作工。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣却对他们说："我父作工直到现在，我也作工。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就对他们说：「我父做事直到如今，我也做事。」
verses.textEnNiv: In his defense Jesus said to them, "My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I too am working."
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus answered them, "My Father is working until now, and I am working."
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill Him, because He had done these things on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus replied, "My Father is always working, and so am I."
verses.textEnNasb: But He answered them, "My Father is working until now, and I Myself am working."
