verses.textEn: In his defense Jesus said to them, "My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I too am working."

verses.textZh: <red>因此犹太人就更想杀耶稣，因为他不但破坏安息日，而且称神为自己的父，把自己与神当作平等。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因此犹太人就更想杀耶稣，因为他不但破坏安息日，而且称神为自己的父，把自己与神当作平等。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以犹太人越发想要杀他；因他不但犯了安息日，并且称神为他的父，将自己和神当作平等。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: In his defense Jesus said to them, <red>“My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I too am working.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: This was why the Jews were seeking all the more to kill him, because not only was he breaking the Sabbath, but he was even calling God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus answered them, "My Father has been working until now, and I have been working."
verses.textEnNlt: So the Jewish leaders tried all the harder to find a way to kill him. For he not only broke the Sabbath, he called God his Father, thereby making himself equal with God.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason therefore the Jews were seeking all the more to kill Him, because He not only was breaking the Sabbath, but also was calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.
verses.textEn: In his defense Jesus said to them, <red>“My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I too am working.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对他们说："我实实在在告诉你们，子靠着自己不能作甚么，只能作他看见父所作的；因为父所作的事，子也照样作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对他们说："我实实在在告诉你们，子靠着自己不能作甚么，只能作他看见父所作的；因为父所作的事，子也照样作。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，子凭着自己不能做什么，惟有看见父所做的，子才能做；父所做的事，子也照样做。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus gave them this answer: "Very truly I tell you, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing, because whatever the Father does the Son also does.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus said to them, "Truly, truly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of his own accord, but only what he sees the Father doing. For whatever the Father does, that the Son does likewise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill Him, because He not only broke the Sabbath, but also said that God was His Father, making Himself equal with God.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus explained, "I tell you the truth, the Son can do nothing by himself. He does only what he sees the Father doing. Whatever the Father does, the Son also does.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Jesus answered and was saying to them, "Truly, truly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of Himself, unless it is something He sees the Father doing; for whatever the Father does, these things the Son also does in the same way.
verses.textEn: Jesus gave them this answer: "Very truly I tell you, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing, because whatever the Father does the Son also does.

verses.textZh: <red>父爱子，把自己所作的一切指示给他看，还要把比这些更大的事指示给他看，使你们惊奇。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父爱子，把自己所作的一切指示给他看，还要把比这些更大的事指示给他看，使你们惊奇。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>父爱子，将自己所做的一切事指给他看，还要将比这更大的事指给他看，叫你们希奇。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus gave them this answer: <red>“Very truly I tell you, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing, because whatever the Father does the Son also does.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For the Father loves the Son and shows him all that he himself is doing. And greater works than these will he show him, so that you may marvel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus answered and said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of Himself, but what He sees the Father do; for whatever He does, the Son also does in like manner.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Father loves the Son and shows him everything he is doing. In fact, the Father will show him how to do even greater works than healing this man. Then you will truly be astonished.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Father loves the Son and shows Him all things that He Himself is doing; and the Father will show Him greater works than these, so that you will be amazed.
verses.textEn: Jesus gave them this answer: <red>“Very truly I tell you, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing, because whatever the Father does the Son also does.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父怎样叫死人复活，使他们得生命，子也照样随自己的意思使人得生命。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父怎样叫死人复活，使他们得生命，子也照样随自己的意思使人得生命。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>父怎样叫死人起来，使他们活着，子也照样随自己的意思使人活着。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For the Father loves the Son and shows him all he does. Yes, and he will show him even greater works than these, so that you will be amazed.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom he will.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Father loves the Son, and shows Him all things that He Himself does; and He will show Him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
verses.textEnNlt: For just as the Father gives life to those he raises from the dead, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants.
verses.textEnNasb: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so the Son also gives life to whom He wishes.
verses.textEn: <red>For the Father loves the Son and shows him all he does. Yes, and he will show him even greater works than these, so that you will be amazed.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父不审判人，却已经把审判的权柄完全交给子，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父不审判人，却已经把审判的权柄完全交给子，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>父不审判什么人，乃将审判的事全交与子，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son gives life to whom he is pleased to give it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For the Father judges no one, but has given all judgment to the Son,
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the Father raises the dead and gives life to them, even so the Son gives life to whom He will.
verses.textEnNlt: In addition, the Father judges no one. Instead, he has given the Son absolute authority to judge,
verses.textEnNasb: For not even the Father judges anyone, but He has given all judgment to the Son,
verses.textEn: <red>For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son gives life to whom he is pleased to give it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>使所有的人尊敬子好象尊敬父一样。不尊敬子的，就是不尊敬那差他来的父。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>使所有的人尊敬子好象尊敬父一样。不尊敬子的，就是不尊敬那差他来的父。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>叫人都尊敬子如同尊敬父一样。不尊敬子的，就是不尊敬差子来的父。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Moreover, the Father judges no one, but has entrusted all judgment to the Son,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: that all may honor the Son, just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Father judges no one, but has committed all judgment to the Son,
verses.textEnNlt: so that everyone will honor the Son, just as they honor the Father. Anyone who does not honor the Son is certainly not honoring the Father who sent him.
verses.textEnNasb: so that all will honor the Son just as they honor the Father. The one who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
verses.textEn: <red>Moreover, the Father judges no one, but has entrusted all judgment to the Son,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，那听见我的话又信那差我来的，就有永生，不被定罪，而是已经出死入生了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，那听见我的话又信那差我来的，就有永生，不被定罪，而是已经出死入生了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实实在在地告诉你们，那听我话、又信差我来者的，就有永生；不至于定罪，是已经出死入生了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father, who sent him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life. He does not come into judgment, but has passed from death to life.
verses.textEnNkjv: that all should honor the Son just as they honor the Father. He who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
verses.textEnNlt: "I tell you the truth, those who listen to my message and believe in God who sent me have eternal life. They will never be condemned for their sins, but they have already passed from death into life.
verses.textEnNasb: "Truly, truly, I say to you, the one who hears My word, and believes Him who sent Me, has eternal life, and does not come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
verses.textEn: <red>that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father, who sent him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，时候将到，现在就是了，死人要听见神儿子的声音，听见的人就要活了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，时候将到，现在就是了，死人要听见神儿子的声音，听见的人就要活了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实实在在地告诉你们，时候将到，现在就是了，死人要听见神儿子的声音，听见的人就要活了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Very truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has crossed over from death to life.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Truly, truly, I say to you, an hour is coming, and is now here, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Most assuredly, I say to you, he who hears My word and believes in Him who sent Me has everlasting life, and shall not come into judgment, but has passed from death into life.
verses.textEnNlt: "And I assure you that the time is coming, indeed it’s here now, when the dead will hear my voice—the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen will live.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, truly, I say to you, a time is coming and even now has arrived, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
verses.textEn: <red>“Very truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has crossed over from death to life.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>就如父是生命的源头，照样他也使子成为生命的源头，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>就如父是生命的源头，照样他也使子成为生命的源头，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为父怎样在自己有生命，就赐给他儿子也照样在自己有生命，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Very truly I tell you, a time is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son also to have life in himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, the hour is coming, and now is, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God; and those who hear will live.
verses.textEnNlt: The Father has life in himself, and he has granted that same life-giving power to his Son.
verses.textEnNasb: For just as the Father has life in Himself, so He gave to the Son also to have life in Himself;
verses.textEn: <red>Very truly I tell you, a time is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>并且把执行审判的权柄赐给他，因为他是人子。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>并且把执行审判的权柄赐给他，因为他是人子。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>并且因为他是人子，就赐给他行审判的权柄。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son also to have life in himself.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he has given him authority to execute judgment, because he is the Son of Man.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the Father has life in Himself, so He has granted the Son to have life in Himself,
verses.textEnNlt: And he has given him authority to judge everyone because he is the Son of Man.
verses.textEnNasb: and He gave Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
verses.textEn: <red>For as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son also to have life in himself.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们不要把这事看作希奇，因为时候将到，那时所有在坟墓里的都要听见他的声音，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们不要把这事看作希奇，因为时候将到，那时所有在坟墓里的都要听见他的声音，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们不要把这事看作希奇。时候要到，凡在坟墓里的，都要听见他的声音，就出来：</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do not marvel at this, for an hour is coming when all who are in the tombs will hear his voice
verses.textEnNkjv: and has given Him authority to execute judgment also, because He is the Son of Man.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be so surprised! Indeed, the time is coming when all the dead in their graves will hear the voice of God’s Son,
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be amazed at this; for a time is coming when all who are in the tombs will hear His voice,
verses.textEn: <red>And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>并且都要出来；行善的复活得生命，作恶的复活被定罪。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>并且都要出来；行善的复活得生命，作恶的复活被定罪。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>行善的，复活得生；作恶的，复活定罪。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Dop not be amazed at this, for a time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and come out, those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not marvel at this; for the hour is coming in which all who are in the graves will hear His voice
verses.textEnNlt: and they will rise again. Those who have done good will rise to experience eternal life, and those who have continued in evil will rise to experience judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: and will come out: those who did the good deeds to a resurrection of life, those who committed the bad deeds to a resurrection of judgment.
verses.textEn: <red>“Dop not be amazed at this, for a time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我靠着自己不能作甚么，我怎样听见，就怎样审判。我的审判是公义的，因为我不寻求自己的意思，只求那差我来者的旨意。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我靠着自己不能作甚么，我怎样听见，就怎样审判。我的审判是公义的，因为我不寻求自己的意思，只求那差我来者的旨意。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>我凭着自己不能做什么，我怎么听见就怎么审判。我的审判也是公平的；因为我不求自己的意思，只求那差我来者的意思。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and come out—those who have done what is good will rise to live, and those who have done what is evil will rise to be condemned.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I can do nothing on my own. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is just, because I seek not my own will but the will of him who sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: and come forth— those who have done good, to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of condemnation.
verses.textEnNlt: I can do nothing on my own. I judge as God tells me. Therefore, my judgment is just, because I carry out the will of the one who sent me, not my own will.
verses.textEnNasb: "I can do nothing on My own. As I hear, I judge; and My judgment is righteous, because I do not seek My own will but the will of Him who sent Me.
verses.textEn: <red>and come out—those who have done what is good will rise to live, and those who have done what is evil will rise to be condemned.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我若为自己作证，我的见证就不真。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我若为自己作证，我的见证就不真。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我若为自己作见证，我的见证就不真。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>By myself I can do nothing; I judge only as I hear, and my judgment is just, for I seek not to please myself but him who sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If I alone bear witness about myself, my testimony is not true.
verses.textEnNkjv: I can of Myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and My judgment is righteous, because I do not seek My own will but the will of the Father who sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "If I were to testify on my own behalf, my testimony would not be valid.
verses.textEnNasb: "If I alone testify about Myself, My testimony is not true.
verses.textEn: <red>By myself I can do nothing; I judge only as I hear, and my judgment is just, for I seek not to please myself but him who sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而另有一位为我作证的，我知道他为我作的见证是真的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而另有一位为我作证的，我知道他为我作的见证是真的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>另有一位给我作见证，我也知道他给我作的见证是真的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“If I testify about myself, my testimony is not true.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: There is another who bears witness about me, and I know that the testimony that he bears about me is true.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If I bear witness of Myself, My witness is not true.
verses.textEnNlt: But someone else is also testifying about me, and I assure you that everything he says about me is true.
verses.textEnNasb: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that the testimony which He gives about Me is true.
verses.textEn: <red>“If I testify about myself, my testimony is not true.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们曾经派人到约翰那里，他为真理作过见证。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们曾经派人到约翰那里，他为真理作过见证。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们曾差人到约翰那里，他为真理作过见证。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>There is another who testifies in my favor, and I know that his testimony about me is true.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You sent to John, and he has borne witness to the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is another who bears witness of Me, and I know that the witness which He witnesses of Me is true.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, you sent investigators to listen to John the Baptist, and his testimony about me was true.
verses.textEnNasb: You have sent messengers to John, and he has testified to the truth.
verses.textEn: <red>There is another who testifies in my favor, and I know that his testimony about me is true.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我不接受从人而来的见证，但我说这些事，是要你们得救。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我不接受从人而来的见证，但我说这些事，是要你们得救。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>其实，我所受的见证不是从人来的；然而，我说这些话，为要叫你们得救。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp have sent to John and he has testified to the truth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Not that the testimony that I receive is from man, but I say these things so that you may be saved.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have sent to John, and he has borne witness to the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: Of course, I have no need of human witnesses, but I say these things so you might be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: But the testimony I receive is not from man, but I say these things so that you may be saved.
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp have sent to John and he has testified to the truth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>约翰是一盏点亮的灯，你们情愿暂时在他的光中欢乐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>约翰是一盏点亮的灯，你们情愿暂时在他的光中欢乐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>约翰是点着的明灯，你们情愿暂时喜欢他的光。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Not that I accept human testimony; but I mention it that you may be saved.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He was a burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I do not receive testimony from man, but I say these things that you may be saved.
verses.textEnNlt: John was like a burning and shining lamp, and you were excited for a while about his message.
verses.textEnNasb: He was the lamp that was burning and shining, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
verses.textEn: <red>Not that I accept human testimony; but I mention it that you may be saved.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但我有比约翰更大的见证，因为父赐给我要我完成的工作，就是我所要作的，证明我是父所差来的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但我有比约翰更大的见证，因为父赐给我要我完成的工作，就是我所要作的，证明我是父所差来的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但我有比约翰更大的见证；因为父交给我要我成就的事，就是我所做的事，这便见证我是父所差来的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you chose for a time to enjoy his light.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the testimony that I have is greater than that of John. For the works that the Father has given me to accomplish, the very works that I am doing, bear witness about me that the Father has sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing for a time to rejoice in his light.
verses.textEnNlt: But I have a greater witness than John—my teachings and my miracles. The Father gave me these works to accomplish, and they prove that he sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: But the testimony I have is greater than the testimony of John; for the works which the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works that I do—testify about Me, that the Father has sent Me.
verses.textEn: <red>John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you chose for a time to enjoy his light.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>差我来的父亲自为我作了见证。他的声音，你们从没有听过；他的容貌，你们从没有见过；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>差我来的父亲自为我作了见证。他的声音，你们从没有听过；他的容貌，你们从没有见过；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>差我来的父也为我作过见证。你们从来没有听见他的声音，也没有看见他的形象。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I have testimony weightier than that of John. For the works that the Father has given me to finish—the very works that I am doing—testify that the Father has sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the Father who sent me has himself borne witness about me. His voice you have never heard, his form you have never seen,
verses.textEnNkjv: But I have a greater witness than John’s; for the works which the Father has given Me to finish—the very works that I do—bear witness of Me, that the Father has sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Father who sent me has testified about me himself. You have never heard his voice or seen him face to face,
verses.textEnNasb: And the Father who sent Me, He has testified about Me. You have neither heard His voice at any time, nor seen His form.
verses.textEn: <red>“I have testimony weightier than that of John. For the works that the Father has given me to finish—the very works that I am doing—testify that the Father has sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他的道，你们也不放在心里，因为你们不信他所差来的那一位。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他的道，你们也不放在心里，因为你们不信他所差来的那一位。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们并没有他的道存在心里；因为他所差来的，你们不信。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And the Father who sent me has himself testified concerning me. You have never heard his voice nor seen his form,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and you do not have his word abiding in you, for you do not believe the one whom he has sent.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Father Himself, who sent Me, has testified of Me. You have neither heard His voice at any time, nor seen His form.
verses.textEnNlt: and you do not have his message in your hearts, because you do not believe me—the one he sent to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Also you do not have His word remaining in you, because you do not believe Him whom He sent.
verses.textEn: <red>And the Father who sent me has himself testified concerning me. You have never heard his voice nor seen his form,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们研究圣经，因为你们认为圣经中有永生，其实为我作证的就是这圣经，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们研究圣经，因为你们认为圣经中有永生，其实为我作证的就是这圣经，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们查考圣经 ，因你们以为内中有永生；给我作见证的就是这经。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>nor does his word dwell in you, for you do not believe the one he sent.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You search the Scriptures because you think that in them you have eternal life; and it is they that bear witness about me,
verses.textEnNkjv: But you do not have His word abiding in you, because whom He sent, Him you do not believe.
verses.textEnNlt: "You search the Scriptures because you think they give you eternal life. But the Scriptures point to me!
verses.textEnNasb: You examine the Scriptures because you think that in them you have eternal life; and it is those very Scriptures that testify about Me;
verses.textEn: <red>nor does his word dwell in you, for you do not believe the one he sent.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而你们却不肯到我这里来得生命。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而你们却不肯到我这里来得生命。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然而，你们不肯到我这里来得生命。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You study the Scriptures diligently because you think that in them you have eternal life. These are the very Scriptures that testify about me,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: yet you refuse to come to me that you may have life.
verses.textEnNkjv: You search the Scriptures, for in them you think you have eternal life; and these are they which testify of Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet you refuse to come to me to receive this life.
verses.textEnNasb: and yet you are unwilling to come to Me so that you may have life.
verses.textEn: <red>You study the Scriptures diligently because you think that in them you have eternal life. These are the very Scriptures that testify about me,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我不接受从人而来的称赞；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我不接受从人而来的称赞；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我不受从人来的荣耀。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>yet you refuse to come to me to have life.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I do not receive glory from people.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you are not willing to come to Me that you may have life.
verses.textEnNlt: "Your approval means nothing to me,
verses.textEnNasb: I do not receive glory from people;
verses.textEn: <red>yet you refuse to come to me to have life.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我知道你们心里没有神的爱。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我知道你们心里没有神的爱。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但我知道，你们心里没有神的爱。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I do not accept glory from human beings,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I know that you do not have the love of God within you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I do not receive honor from men.
verses.textEnNlt: because I know you don’t have God’s love within you.
verses.textEnNasb: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God in yourselves.
verses.textEn: <red>“I do not accept glory from human beings,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我奉我父的名而来，你们不接待我；如果有别人以自己的名义而来，你们倒接待他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我奉我父的名而来，你们不接待我；如果有别人以自己的名义而来，你们倒接待他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我奉我父的名来，你们并不接待我；若有别人奉自己的名来，你们倒要接待他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>but I know you. I know that you do not have the love of God in your hearts.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I have come in my Father’s name, and you do not receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I know you, that you do not have the love of God in you.
verses.textEnNlt: For I have come to you in my Father’s name, and you have rejected me. Yet if others come in their own name, you gladly welcome them.
verses.textEnNasb: I have come in My Father’s name, and you do not receive Me; if another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
verses.textEn: <red>but I know you. I know that you do not have the love of God in your hearts.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们彼此接受称赞，却不寻求从独一的神而来的称赞，怎么能信呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们彼此接受称赞，却不寻求从独一的神而来的称赞，怎么能信呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们互相受荣耀，却不求从独一之神来的荣耀，怎能信我呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have come in my Father’s name, and you do not accept me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will accept him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: How can you believe, when you receive glory from one another and do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
verses.textEnNkjv: I have come in My Father’s name, and you do not receive Me; if another comes in his own name, him you will receive.
verses.textEnNlt: No wonder you can’t believe! For you gladly honor each other, but you don’t care about the honor that comes from the one who alone is God.
verses.textEnNasb: How can you believe, when you accept glory from one another and you do not seek the glory that is from the one and only God?
verses.textEn: <red>I have come in my Father’s name, and you do not accept me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will accept him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不要以为我要向父控告你们，有一位控告你们的，就是你们所仰赖的摩西。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不要以为我要向父控告你们，有一位控告你们的，就是你们所仰赖的摩西。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不要想我在父面前要告你们；有一位告你们的，就是你们所仰赖的摩西。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>How can you believe since you accept glory from one another but do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you: Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
verses.textEnNkjv: How can you believe, who receive honor from one another, and do not seek the honor that comes from the only God?
verses.textEnNlt: "Yet it isn’t I who will accuse you before the Father. Moses will accuse you! Yes, Moses, in whom you put your hopes.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father; the one who accuses you is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
verses.textEn: <red>How can you believe since you accept glory from one another but do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们若信摩西，也必信我，因为他所写的书曾论及我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们若信摩西，也必信我，因为他所写的书曾论及我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们如果信摩西，也必信我，因为他书上有指着我写的话。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“But do not think I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, on whom your hopes are set.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote of me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not think that I shall accuse you to the Father; there is one who accuses you—Moses, in whom you trust.
verses.textEnNlt: If you really believed Moses, you would believe me, because he wrote about me.
verses.textEnNasb: For if you believed Moses, you would believe Me; for he wrote about Me.
verses.textEn: <red>“But do not think I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, on whom your hopes are set.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们若不信他所写的，怎能信我的话呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们若不信他所写的，怎能信我的话呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若不信他的书，怎能信我的话呢？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you believed Moses, you would believe me, for he wrote about me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe my words?"
verses.textEnNkjv: For if you believed Moses, you would believe Me; for he wrote about Me.
verses.textEnNlt: But since you don’t believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?"
verses.textEnNasb: But if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe My words?"
verses.textEn: <red>If you believed Moses, you would believe me, for he wrote about me.</red>

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，耶稣渡过加利利海，就是提比里亚海。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，耶稣渡过加利利海，就是提比里亚海。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，耶稣渡过加利利海，就是提比哩亚海。
verses.textEnNiv: Some time after this, Jesus crossed to the far shore of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias),
verses.textEnEsv: After this Jesus went away to the other side of the Sea of Galilee, which is the Sea of Tiberias.
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things Jesus went over the Sea of Galilee, which is theSea of Tiberias.
verses.textEnNlt: After this, Jesus crossed over to the far side of the Sea of Galilee, also known as the Sea of Tiberias.
verses.textEnNasb: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (or Tiberias).
verses.textEn: Some time after this, Jesus crossed to the far shore of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias),

verses.textZh: 有一大群人，因为看见了他在病人身上所行的神迹，就跟随了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一大群人，因为看见了他在病人身上所行的神迹，就跟随了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多人因为看见他在病人身上所行的神迹，就跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: and a great crowd of people followed him because they saw the signs he had performed by healing the sick.
verses.textEnEsv: And a large crowd was following him, because they saw the signs that he was doing on the sick.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a great multitude followed Him, because they saw His signs which He performed on those who were diseased.
verses.textEnNlt: A huge crowd kept following him wherever he went, because they saw his miraculous signs as he healed the sick.
verses.textEnNasb: A large crowd was following Him, because they were watching the signs which He was performing on those who were sick.
verses.textEn: and a great crowd of people followed him because they saw the signs he had performed by healing the sick.

verses.textZh: 耶稣上了山，同门徒坐在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣上了山，同门徒坐在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣上了山，和门徒一同坐在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus went up on a mountainside and sat down with his disciples.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus went up on the mountain, and there he sat down with his disciples.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus went up on the mountain, and there He sat with His disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus climbed a hill and sat down with his disciples around him.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus went up on the mountain, and there He sat with His disciples.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus went up on a mountainside and sat down with his disciples.

verses.textZh: 那时犹太人的逾越节近了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时犹太人的逾越节近了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时犹太人的逾越节近了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Jewish Passover Festival was near.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Passover, a feast of the Jews, was near.
verses.textEnNlt: (It was nearly time for the Jewish Passover celebration.)
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was near.
verses.textEn: The Jewish Passover Festival was near.

verses.textZh: 耶稣举目观看，见一大群人向他走过来，就对腓力说："<red>我们从哪里买饼给这些人吃呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣举目观看，见一大群人向他走过来，就对腓力说："<red>我们从哪里买饼给这些人吃呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣举目看见许多人来，就对腓力说：「<red>我们从哪里买饼叫这些人吃呢？</red>」（
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus looked up and saw a great crowd coming toward him, he said to Philip, <red>“Where shall we buy bread for these people to eat?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Lifting up his eyes, then, and seeing that a large crowd was coming toward him, Jesus said to Philip, "Where are we to buy bread, so that these people may eat?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus lifted up His eyes, and seeing a great multitude coming toward Him, He said to Philip, "Where shall we buy bread, that these may eat?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus soon saw a huge crowd of people coming to look for him. Turning to Philip, he asked, "Where can we buy bread to feed all these people?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus, after raising His eyes and seeing that a large crowd was coming to Him, *said to Philip, "Where are we to buy bread so that these people may eat?"
verses.textEn: When Jesus looked up and saw a great crowd coming toward him, he said to Philip, <red>“Where shall we buy bread for these people to eat?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他说这话，是要试验腓力，因他自己早已知道要怎样作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说这话，是要试验腓力，因他自己早已知道要怎样作。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说这话是要试验腓力；他自己原知道要怎样行。）
verses.textEnNiv: He asked this only to test him, for he already had in mind what he was going to do.
verses.textEnEsv: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.textEnNkjv: But this He said to test him, for He Himself knew what He would do.
verses.textEnNlt: He was testing Philip, for he already knew what he was going to do.
verses.textEnNasb: But He was saying this only to test him, for He Himself knew what He intended to do.
verses.textEn: He asked this only to test him, for he already had in mind what he was going to do.

verses.textZh: 腓力回答："就算二百银币买的饼，每人分一点，也是不够的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 腓力回答："就算二百银币买的饼，每人分一点，也是不够的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 腓力回答说：「就是二十两银子的饼，叫他们各人吃一点也是不够的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Philip answered him, "It would take more than half a year’s wages to buy enough bread for each one to have a bite!"
verses.textEnEsv: Philip answered him, "Two hundred denarii worth of bread would not be enough for each of them to get a little."
verses.textEnNkjv: Philip answered Him, "Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may have a little."
verses.textEnNlt: Philip replied, "Even if we worked for months, we wouldn’t have enough money to feed them!"
verses.textEnNasb: Philip answered Him, "Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not enough for them, for each to receive just a little!"
verses.textEn: Philip answered him, "It would take more than half a year’s wages to buy enough bread for each one to have a bite!"

verses.textZh: 有一个门徒，就是西门．彼得的弟弟安得烈，对耶稣说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个门徒，就是西门．彼得的弟弟安得烈，对耶稣说：
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个门徒，就是西门‧彼得的兄弟安得烈，对耶稣说：
verses.textEnNiv: Another of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, spoke up,
verses.textEnEsv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, spoke up.
verses.textEnNasb: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, *said to Him,
verses.textEn: Another of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, spoke up,

verses.textZh: "这里有个小孩子，带着五个大麦饼、两条鱼；只是分给这么多人，有甚么用呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "这里有个小孩子，带着五个大麦饼、两条鱼；只是分给这么多人，有甚么用呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 「在这里有一个孩童，带着五个大麦饼、两条鱼，只是分给这许多人还算什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Here is a boy with five small barley loaves and two small fish, but how far will they go among so many?"
verses.textEnEsv: "There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are they for so many?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "There is a lad here who has five barley loaves and two small fish, but what are they among so many?"
verses.textEnNlt: "There’s a young boy here with five barley loaves and two fish. But what good is that with this huge crowd?"
verses.textEnNasb: "There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish; but what are these for so many people?"
verses.textEn: "Here is a boy with five small barley loaves and two small fish, but how far will they go among so many?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣吩咐他们："<red>你们叫众人坐下。</red>"原来那地方的草很多，众人就坐下，单是男人的数目约有五千。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣吩咐他们："<red>你们叫众人坐下。</red>"原来那地方的草很多，众人就坐下，单是男人的数目约有五千。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们叫众人坐下。</red>」原来那地方的草多，众人就坐下，数目约有五千。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, <red>“Have the people sit down.”</red> There was plenty of grass in that place, and they sat down (about five thousand men were there).
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said, "Have the people sit down." Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, about five thousand in number.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said, "Make the people sit down." Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell everyone to sit down," Jesus said. So they all sat down on the grassy slopes. (The men alone numbered about 5,000.)
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said, "Have the people recline to eat." Now there was plenty of grass in the place. So the men reclined, about five thousand in number.
verses.textEn: Jesus said, <red>“Have the people sit down.”</red> There was plenty of grass in that place, and they sat down (about five thousand men were there).

verses.textZh: 耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，就分给坐着的人；分鱼也是这样，都是随着他们所要的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，就分给坐着的人；分鱼也是这样，都是随着他们所要的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，就分给那坐着的人；分鱼也是这样，都随着他们所要的。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus then took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted. He did the same with the fish.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus then took the loaves, and when he had given thanks, he distributed them to those who were seated. So also the fish, as much as they wanted.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus took the loaves, and when He had given thanks He distributed them to the disciples, and the disciples to those sitting down; and likewise of the fish, as much as they wanted.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus took the loaves, gave thanks to God, and distributed them to the people. Afterward he did the same with the fish. And they all ate as much as they wanted.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus then took the loaves, and after giving thanks He distributed them to those who were reclining; likewise also of the fish, as much as they wanted.
verses.textEn: Jesus then took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted. He did the same with the fish.

verses.textZh: 他们吃饱了之后，耶稣对门徒说："<red>把剩下的零碎收拾起来，免得浪费。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们吃饱了之后，耶稣对门徒说："<red>把剩下的零碎收拾起来，免得浪费。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们吃饱了，耶稣对门徒说：「<red>把剩下的零碎收拾起来，免得有糟蹋的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When they had all had enough to eat, he said to his disciples, <red>“Gather the pieces that are left over. Let nothing be wasted.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had eaten their fill, he told his disciples, "Gather up the leftover fragments, that nothing may be lost."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they were filled, He said to His disciples, "Gather up the fragments that remain, so that nothing is lost."
verses.textEnNlt: After everyone was full, Jesus told his disciples, "Now gather the leftovers, so that nothing is wasted."
verses.textEnNasb: And when they had eaten their fill, He *said to His disciples, "Gather up the leftover pieces so that nothing will be lost."
verses.textEn: When they had all had enough to eat, he said to his disciples, <red>“Gather the pieces that are left over. Let nothing be wasted.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒就把众人吃剩那五个大麦饼的零碎收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒就把众人吃剩那五个大麦饼的零碎收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们便将那五个大麦饼的零碎，就是众人吃了剩下的，收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
verses.textEnNiv: So they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.
verses.textEnEsv: So they gathered them up and filled twelve baskets with fragments from the five barley loaves left by those who had eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves which were left over by those who had eaten.
verses.textEnNlt: So they picked up the pieces and filled twelve baskets with scraps left by the people who had eaten from the five barley loaves.
verses.textEnNasb: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with pieces from the five barley loaves which were left over by those who had eaten.
verses.textEn: So they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.

verses.textZh: 众人看见耶稣所行的神迹，就说："这真是那要到世上来的先知。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人看见耶稣所行的神迹，就说："这真是那要到世上来的先知。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人看见耶稣所行的神迹，就说：「这真是那要到世间来的先知！」
verses.textEnNiv: After the people saw the sign Jesus performed, they began to say, "Surely this is the Prophet who is to come into the world."
verses.textEnEsv: When the people saw the sign that he had done, they said, "This is indeed the Prophet who is to come into the world!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then those men, when they had seen the sign that Jesus did, said, "This is truly the Prophet who is to come into the world."
verses.textEnNlt: When the people saw him do this miraculous sign, they exclaimed, "Surely, he is the Prophet we have been expecting!"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore when the people saw the sign which He had performed, they said, "This is truly the Prophet who is to come into the world."
verses.textEn: After the people saw the sign Jesus performed, they began to say, "Surely this is the Prophet who is to come into the world."

verses.textZh: 耶稣知道群众要来强迫他作王，就独自又退到山上去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣知道群众要来强迫他作王，就独自又退到山上去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣既知道众人要来强逼他作王，就独自又退到山上去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus, knowing that they intended to come and make him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by himself.
verses.textEnEsv: Perceiving then that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, Jesus withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore when Jesus perceived that they were about to come and take Him by force to make Him king, He departed again to the mountain by Himself alone.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus saw that they were ready to force him to be their king, he slipped away into the hills by himself.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus, aware that they intended to come and take Him by force to make Him king, withdrew again to the mountain by Himself, alone.
verses.textEn: Jesus, knowing that they intended to come and make him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by himself.

verses.textZh: 到了晚上，他的门徒下到海边去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了晚上，他的门徒下到海边去。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了晚上，他的门徒下海边去，
verses.textEnNiv: When evening came, his disciples went down to the lake,
verses.textEnEsv: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,
verses.textEnNlt: That evening Jesus’ disciples went down to the shore to wait for him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,
verses.textEn: When evening came, his disciples went down to the lake,

verses.textZh: 他们上了船，要渡海往迦百农去。那时天已经黑了，耶稣还没有到他们那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们上了船，要渡海往迦百农去。那时天已经黑了，耶稣还没有到他们那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 上了船，要过海往迦百农去。天已经黑了，耶稣还没有来到他们那里。
verses.textEnNiv: where they got into a boat and set off across the lake for Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet joined them.
verses.textEnEsv: got into a boat, and started across the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: got into the boat, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was already dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
verses.textEnNlt: But as darkness fell and Jesus still hadn’t come back, they got into the boat and headed across the lake toward Capernaum.
verses.textEnNasb: and after getting into a boat, they started to cross the sea to Capernaum. It had already become dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.
verses.textEn: where they got into a boat and set off across the lake for Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet joined them.

verses.textZh: 忽然海上起了狂风，波浪翻腾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然海上起了狂风，波浪翻腾。
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然狂风大作，海就翻腾起来。
verses.textEnNiv: A strong wind was blowing and the waters grew rough.
verses.textEnEsv: The sea became rough because a strong wind was blowing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the sea arose because a great wind was blowing.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon a gale swept down upon them, and the sea grew very rough.
verses.textEnNasb: In addition, the sea began getting rough, because a strong wind was blowing.
verses.textEn: A strong wind was blowing and the waters grew rough.

verses.textZh: 门徒摇橹约行了五六公里，看见耶稣在海面上行走，渐渐靠近船，就害怕起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒摇橹约行了五六公里，看见耶稣在海面上行走，渐渐靠近船，就害怕起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒摇橹，约行了十里多路，看见耶稣在海面上走，渐渐近了船，他们就害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the water; and they were frightened.
verses.textEnEsv: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and coming near the boat, and they were frightened.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near the boat; and they were afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: They had rowed three or four miles when suddenly they saw Jesus walking on the water toward the boat. They were terrified,
verses.textEnNasb: Then, when they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they *saw Jesus walking on the sea and coming near the boat; and they were frightened.
verses.textEn: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the water; and they were frightened.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>是我，不要怕。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>是我，不要怕。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>是我，不要怕！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: But he said to them, <red>“It is I; don’t be afraid.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to them, "It is I; do not be afraid."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said to them, "It is I; do not be afraid."
verses.textEnNlt: but he called out to them, "Don’t be afraid. I am here! "
verses.textEnNasb: But He *said to them, "It is I; do not be afraid."
verses.textEn: But he said to them, <red>“It is I; don’t be afraid.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们这才把他接上船，船就立刻到了他们要去的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们这才把他接上船，船就立刻到了他们要去的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒就喜欢接他上船，船立时到了他们所要去的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they were willing to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they were glad to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat was at the land to which they were going.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they willingly received Him into the boat, and immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they were eager to let him in the boat, and immediately they arrived at their destination!
verses.textEnNasb: So they were willing to take Him into the boat, and immediately the boat was at the land to which they were going.
verses.textEn: Then they were willing to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the shore where they were heading.

verses.textZh: 第二天，站在海那边的群众，看见只有一只小船留在那里，并且知道耶稣没有和他的门徒一同上船，门徒是自己去的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，站在海那边的群众，看见只有一只小船留在那里，并且知道耶稣没有和他的门徒一同上船，门徒是自己去的；
verses.textZhCuv: 第二日，站在海那边的众人知道那里没有别的船，只有一只小船，又知道耶稣没有同他的门徒上船，乃是门徒自己去的。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the opposite shore of the lake realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not entered it with his disciples, but that they had gone away alone.
verses.textEnEsv: On the next day the crowd that remained on the other side of the sea saw that there had been only one boat there, and that Jesus had not entered the boat with his disciples, but that his disciples had gone away alone.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the following day, when the people who were standing on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except that one which His disciples had entered, and that Jesus had not entered the boat with His disciples, but His disciples had gone away alone—
verses.textEnNlt: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the far shore saw that the disciples had taken the only boat, and they realized Jesus had not gone with them.
verses.textEnNasb: The next day the crowd that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other small boat there except one, and that Jesus had not gotten into the boat with His disciples, but that His disciples had departed alone.
verses.textEn: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the opposite shore of the lake realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not entered it with his disciples, but that they had gone away alone.

verses.textZh: 不过有几只从提比里亚来的船停在那里，靠近他们在主祝谢以后吃饼的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过有几只从提比里亚来的船停在那里，靠近他们在主祝谢以后吃饼的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，有几只小船从提比哩亚来，靠近主祝谢后分饼给人吃的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Then some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
verses.textEnEsv: Other boats from Tiberias came near the place where they had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
verses.textEnNkjv: however, other boats came from Tiberias, near the place where they ate bread after the Lord had given thanks—
verses.textEnNlt: Several boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the Lord had blessed the bread and the people had eaten.
verses.textEnNasb: Other small boats came from Tiberias near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
verses.textEn: Then some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

verses.textZh: 群众见耶稣和门徒都不在那里，就上船往迦百农去找耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众见耶稣和门徒都不在那里，就上船往迦百农去找耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人见耶稣和门徒都不在那里，就上了船，往迦百农去找耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Once the crowd realized that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum in search of Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: So when the crowd saw that Jesus was not there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and went to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: when the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, nor His disciples, they also got into boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went across to Capernaum to look for him.
verses.textEnNasb: So when the crowd saw that Jesus was not there, nor His disciples, they themselves got into the small boats and came to Capernaum, looking for Jesus.
verses.textEn: Once the crowd realized that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum in search of Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他们在对岸找到了耶稣，就问他："拉比，你几时到这里来的？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在对岸找到了耶稣，就问他："拉比，你几时到这里来的？"
verses.textZhCuv: 既在海那边找着了，就对他说：「拉比，是几时到这里来的？」
verses.textEnNiv: When they found him on the other side of the lake, they asked him, "Rabbi, when did you get here?"
verses.textEnEsv: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they said to him, "Rabbi, when did you come here?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, "Rabbi, when did You come here?"
verses.textEnNlt: They found him on the other side of the lake and asked, "Rabbi, when did you get here?"
verses.textEnNasb: And when they found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, "Rabbi, when did You get here?"
verses.textEn: When they found him on the other side of the lake, they asked him, "Rabbi, when did you get here?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："我实实在在告诉你们，你们找我，不是因为看见了神迹，而是因为吃了饼又吃饱了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："我实实在在告诉你们，你们找我，不是因为看见了神迹，而是因为吃了饼又吃饱了。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们找我，并不是因见了神迹，乃是因吃饼得饱。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“Very truly I tell you, you are looking for me, not because you saw the signs I performed but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "Truly, truly, I say to you, you are seeking me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate your fill of the loaves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered them and said, "Most assuredly, I say to you, you seek Me, not because you saw the signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, you want to be with me because I fed you, not because you understood the miraculous signs.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered them and said, "Truly, truly, I say to you, you seek Me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate some of the loaves and were filled.
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“Very truly I tell you, you are looking for me, not because you saw the signs I performed but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不要为那必朽坏的食物操劳，却要为那存到永生的食物操劳，就是人子所要赐给你们的，因为人子是父神所印证的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不要为那必朽坏的食物操劳，却要为那存到永生的食物操劳，就是人子所要赐给你们的，因为人子是父神所印证的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不要为那必坏的食物劳力，要为那存到永生的食物劳力，就是人子要赐给你们的，因为人子是父神所印证的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Do not work for food that spoils, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on him God the Father has placed his seal of approval.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do not work for the food that perishes, but for the food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For on him God the Father has set his seal."
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not labor for the food which perishes, but for the food which endures to everlasting life, which the Son of Man will give you, because God the Father has set His seal on Him."
verses.textEnNlt: But don’t be so concerned about perishable things like food. Spend your energy seeking the eternal life that the Son of Man can give you. For God the Father has given me the seal of his approval."
verses.textEnNasb: Do not work for the food that perishes, but for the food that lasts for eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you, for on Him the Father, God, has set His seal."
verses.textEn: <red>Do not work for food that spoils, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on him God the Father has placed his seal of approval.”</red>

verses.textZh: 众人又问他："我们应该作甚么，才算是作神的工作呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人又问他："我们应该作甚么，才算是作神的工作呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人问他说：「我们当行什么才算做神的工呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they asked him, "What must we do to do the works God requires?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then they said to him, "What must we do, to be doing the works of God?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to Him, "What shall we do, that we may work the works of God?"
verses.textEnNlt: They replied, "We want to perform God’s works, too. What should we do?"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore they said to Him, "What are we to do, so that we may accomplish the works of God?"
verses.textEn: Then they asked him, "What must we do to do the works God requires?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>信神所差来的，就是作神的工了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>信神所差来的，就是作神的工了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>信神所差来的，这就是做神的工。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“The work of God is this: to believe in the one he has sent.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "This is the work of God, that you believe in Him whom He sent."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told them, "This is the only work God wants from you: Believe in the one he has sent."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered and said to them, "This is the work of God, that you believe in Him whom He has sent."
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“The work of God is this: to believe in the one he has sent.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他们就说："你要行甚么神迹，让我们看了就信你呢？你到底能作甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们就说："你要行甚么神迹，让我们看了就信你呢？你到底能作甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又说：「你行什么神迹，叫我们看见就信你；你到底做什么事呢？
verses.textEnNiv: So they asked him, "What sign then will you give that we may see it and believe you? What will you do?
verses.textEnEsv: So they said to him, "Then what sign do you do, that we may see and believe you? What work do you perform?
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they said to Him, "What sign will You perform then, that we may see it and believe You? What work will You do?
verses.textEnNlt: They answered, "Show us a miraculous sign if you want us to believe in you. What can you do?
verses.textEnNasb: So they said to Him, "What then are You doing as a sign, so that we may see, and believe You? What work are You performing?
verses.textEn: So they asked him, "What sign then will you give that we may see it and believe you? What will you do?

verses.textZh: 我们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，正如经上所记：‘他把从天上来的食物赐给他们吃。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，正如经上所记：‘他把从天上来的食物赐给他们吃。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，如经上写着说：『他从天上赐下粮来给他们吃。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Our ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written, ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Our fathers ate the manna in the desert; as it is written, ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: After all, our ancestors ate manna while they journeyed through the wilderness! The Scriptures say, ‘Moses gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written: ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’ "
verses.textEn: Our ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，不是摩西把那从天上来的食物赐给你们，而是我父把天上来的真食物赐给你们；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，不是摩西把那从天上来的食物赐给你们，而是我父把天上来的真食物赐给你们；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，那从天上来的粮不是摩西赐给你们的，乃是我父将天上来的真粮赐给你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to them, <red>“Very truly I tell you, it is not Moses who has given you the bread from heaven, but it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus then said to them, "Truly, truly, I say to you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread from heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, Moses did not give you the bread from heaven, but My Father gives you the true bread from heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said, "I tell you the truth, Moses didn’t give you bread from heaven. My Father did. And now he offers you the true bread from heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus then said to them, "Truly, truly, I say to you, it is not Moses who has given you the bread out of heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread out of heaven.
verses.textEn: Jesus said to them, <red>“Very truly I tell you, it is not Moses who has given you the bread from heaven, but it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为神的食物就是从天上降下来，把生命赐给世人的那一位。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为神的食物就是从天上降下来，把生命赐给世人的那一位。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为神的粮就是那从天上降下来、赐生命给世界的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For the bread of God is the bread that comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For the bread of God is he who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."
verses.textEnNlt: The true bread of God is the one who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."
verses.textEnNasb: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world."
verses.textEn: <red>For the bread of God is the bread that comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们对耶稣说："主啊，求你常把这食物赐给我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对耶稣说："主啊，求你常把这食物赐给我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「主啊，常将这粮赐给我们！」
verses.textEnNiv: "Sir," they said, "always give us this bread."
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "Sir, give us this bread always."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to Him, "Lord, give us this bread always."
verses.textEnNlt: "Sir," they said, "give us that bread every day."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to Him, "Lord, always give us this bread."
verses.textEn: "Sir," they said, "always give us this bread."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>我就是生命的食物，到我这里来的，必定不饿；信我的，永远不渴。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>我就是生命的食物，到我这里来的，必定不饿；信我的，永远不渴。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「我就是生命的粮。到我这里来的，必定不饿；信我的，永远不渴。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus declared, <red>“I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life; whoever comes to me shall not hunger, and whoever believes in me shall never thirst.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life. He who comes to Me shall never hunger, and he who believes in Me shall never thirst.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never be hungry again. Whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life; the one who comes to Me will not be hungry, and the one who believes in Me will never be thirsty.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus declared, <red>“I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但我告诉你们，你们虽然见了我，还是不信。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但我告诉你们，你们虽然见了我，还是不信。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是我对你们说过，你们已经看见我，还是不信。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I said to you that you have seen me and yet do not believe.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I said to you that you have seen Me and yet do not believe.
verses.textEnNlt: But you haven’t believed in me even though you have seen me.
verses.textEnNasb: But I said to you that you have indeed seen Me, and yet you do not believe.
verses.textEn: <red>But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡是父赐给我的人，必到我这里来；到我这里来的，我决不丢弃他，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡是父赐给我的人，必到我这里来；到我这里来的，我决不丢弃他，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡父所赐给我的人必到我这里来；到我这里来的，我总不丢弃他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>All those the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: All that the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never cast out.
verses.textEnNkjv: All that the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will by no means cast out.
verses.textEnNlt: However, those the Father has given me will come to me, and I will never reject them.
verses.textEnNasb: Everything that the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I certainly will not cast out.
verses.textEn: <red>All those the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为我从天上降下来，不是要行自己的意思，而是要行那差我来者的旨意。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为我从天上降下来，不是要行自己的意思，而是要行那差我来者的旨意。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为我从天上降下来，不是要按自己的意思行，乃是要按那差我来者的意思行。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For I have come down from heaven not to do my will but to do the will of him who sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will but the will of him who sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: For I have come down from heaven to do the will of God who sent me, not to do my own will.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
verses.textEn: <red>For I have come down from heaven not to do my will but to do the will of him who sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那差我来者的旨意就是：他所赐给我的人，我连一个也不失落，并且在末日我要使他们复活。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那差我来者的旨意就是：他所赐给我的人，我连一个也不失落，并且在末日我要使他们复活。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>差我来者的意思就是：他所赐给我的，叫我一个也不失落，在末日却叫他复活。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And this is the will of him who sent me, that I shall lose none of all those he has given me, but raise them up at the last day.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And this is the will of him who sent me, that I should lose nothing of all that he has given me, but raise it up on the last day.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the will of the Father who sent Me, that of all He has given Me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up at the last day.
verses.textEnNlt: And this is the will of God, that I should not lose even one of all those he has given me, but that I should raise them up at the last day.
verses.textEnNasb: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that of everything that He has given Me I will lose nothing, but will raise it up on the last day.
verses.textEn: <red>And this is the will of him who sent me, that I shall lose none of all those he has given me, but raise them up at the last day.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为我父的旨意，是要使所有看见了子而信的人有永生，并且在末日我要使他们复活。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为我父的旨意，是要使所有看见了子而信的人有永生，并且在末日我要使他们复活。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为我父的意思是叫一切见子而信的人得永生，并且在末日我要叫他复活。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For my Father’s will is that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in him shall have eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For this is the will of my Father, that everyone who looks on the Son and believes in him should have eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day."
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in Him may have everlasting life; and I will raise him up at the last day."
verses.textEnNlt: For it is my Father’s will that all who see his Son and believe in him should have eternal life. I will raise them up at the last day."
verses.textEnNasb: For this is the will of My Father, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in Him will have eternal life, and I Myself will raise him up on the last day."
verses.textEn: <red>For my Father’s will is that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in him shall have eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.”</red>

verses.textZh: 犹太人因为耶稣说"<red>我是从天上降下来的食物</red>"，就纷纷议论他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人因为耶稣说"<red>我是从天上降下来的食物</red>"，就纷纷议论他。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人因为耶稣说「<red>我是从天上降下来的粮</red>」，就私下议论他，
verses.textEnNiv: At this the Jews there began to grumble about him because he said, <red>“I am the bread that came down from heaven.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So the Jews grumbled about him, because he said, "I am the bread that came down from heaven."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Jews then complained about Him, because He said, "I am the bread which came down from heaven."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people began to murmur in disagreement because he had said, "I am the bread that came down from heaven."
verses.textEnNasb: So then the Jews were complaining about Him because He said, "I am the bread that came down out of heaven."
verses.textEn: At this the Jews there began to grumble about him because he said, <red>“I am the bread that came down from heaven.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们说："<red>这不是约瑟的儿子耶稣吗？他的父母我们不都认识吗？他现在怎么说‘我是从天上降下来的’呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："<red>这不是约瑟的儿子耶稣吗？他的父母我们不都认识吗？他现在怎么说‘我是从天上降下来的’呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「<red>这不是约瑟的儿子耶稣吗？他的父母我们岂不认得吗？他如今怎么说『我是从天上降下来的』呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: They said, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can he now say, <red>‘I came down from heaven’?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They said, "Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How does he now say, ‘I have come down from heaven’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How is it then that He says, ‘I have come down from heaven’?"
verses.textEnNlt: They said, "Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph? We know his father and mother. How can he say, ‘I came down from heaven’?"
verses.textEnNasb: And they were saying, "Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How does He now say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?"
verses.textEn: They said, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can he now say, <red>‘I came down from heaven’?”</red>

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣回答："你们不要彼此议论。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣回答："你们不要彼此议论。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「你们不要大家议论。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Stop grumbling among yourselves,”</red> Jesus answered.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "Do not grumble among yourselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus therefore answered and said to them, "Do not murmur among yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus replied, "Stop complaining about what I said.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered and said to them, "Stop complaining among yourselves.
verses.textEn: <red>“Stop grumbling among yourselves,”</red> Jesus answered.

verses.textZh: <red>如果不是差我来的父吸引人，就没有人能到我这里来；到我这里来的，在末日我要使他复活。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果不是差我来的父吸引人，就没有人能到我这里来；到我这里来的，在末日我要使他复活。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若不是差我来的父吸引人，就没有能到我这里来的；到我这里来的，在末日我要叫他复活。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them, and I will raise them up at the last day.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him. And I will raise him up on the last day.
verses.textEnNkjv: No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.textEnNlt: For no one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them to me, and at the last day I will raise them up.
verses.textEnNasb: No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him; and I will raise him up on the last day.
verses.textEn: <red>“No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them, and I will raise them up at the last day.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>先知书上记着：‘众人都必受神的教导。’凡听见从父那里来的教训而又学习的，必到我这里来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>先知书上记着：‘众人都必受神的教导。’凡听见从父那里来的教训而又学习的，必到我这里来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>在先知书上写着说：『他们都要蒙神的教训。』凡听见父之教训又学习的，就到我这里来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It is written in the Prophets: ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from him comes to me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: It is written in the Prophets, ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard and learned from the Father comes to me—
verses.textEnNkjv: It is written in the prophets, ‘And they shall all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who has heard and learned from the Father comes to Me.
verses.textEnNlt: As it is written in the Scriptures, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him comes to me.
verses.textEnNasb: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they shall all be taught of God.’ Everyone who has heard and learned from the Father, comes to Me.
verses.textEn: <red>It is written in the Prophets: ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from him comes to me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这不是说有人见过父；只有从神那里来的那一位，他才见过父。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这不是说有人见过父；只有从神那里来的那一位，他才见过父。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这不是说有人看见过父，惟独从神来的，他看见过父。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God; only he has seen the Father.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: not that anyone has seen the Father except he who is from God; he has seen the Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except He who is from God; He has seen the Father.
verses.textEnNlt: (Not that anyone has ever seen the Father; only I, who was sent from God, have seen him.)
verses.textEnNasb: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except the One who is from God; He has seen the Father.
verses.textEn: <red>No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God; only he has seen the Father.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，信的人有永生。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，信的人有永生。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实实在在地告诉你们，信的人有永生。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Very truly I tell you, the one who believes has eternal life.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever believes has eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, he who believes in Me has everlasting life.
verses.textEnNlt: "I tell you the truth, anyone who believes has eternal life.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, truly, I say to you, the one who believes has eternal life.
verses.textEn: <red>Very truly I tell you, the one who believes has eternal life.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我就是生命的食物，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我就是生命的食物，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我就是生命的粮。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I am the bread of life.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am the bread of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the bread of life.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I am the bread of life!
verses.textEnNasb: I am the bread of life.
verses.textEn: <red>I am the bread of life.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，还是死了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，还是死了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，还是死了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Your ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
verses.textEnNlt: Your ancestors ate manna in the wilderness, but they all died.
verses.textEnNasb: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
verses.textEn: <red>Your ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这是从天上降下来的食物，使人吃了就不死。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这是从天上降下来的食物，使人吃了就不死。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这是从天上降下来的粮，叫人吃了就不死。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which anyone may eat and not die.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that one may eat of it and not die.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the bread which comes down from heaven, that one may eat of it and not die.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who eats the bread from heaven, however, will never die.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the bread that comes down out of heaven, so that anyone may eat from it and not die.
verses.textEn: <red>But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which anyone may eat and not die.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我就是从天上降下来生命的食物，人若吃了这食物，就必活到永远。我要赐的食物就是我的肉，是为了世人的生命而赐的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我就是从天上降下来生命的食物，人若吃了这食物，就必活到永远。我要赐的食物就是我的肉，是为了世人的生命而赐的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我是从天上降下来生命的粮；人若吃这粮，就必永远活着。我所要赐的粮就是我的肉，为世人之生命所赐的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever. This bread is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And the bread that I will give for the life of the world is my flesh."
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever; and the bread that I shall give is My flesh, which I shall give for the life of the world."
verses.textEnNlt: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Anyone who eats this bread will live forever; and this bread, which I will offer so the world may live, is my flesh."
verses.textEnNasb: I am the living bread that came down out of heaven; if anyone eats from this bread, he will live forever; and the bread which I will give for the life of the world also is My flesh."
verses.textEn: <red>I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever. This bread is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是，犹太人彼此争论，说："这个人怎能把他的肉给我们吃呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，犹太人彼此争论，说："这个人怎能把他的肉给我们吃呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，犹太人彼此争论说：「这个人怎能把他的肉给我们吃呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Jews began to argue sharply among themselves, "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?"
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews then disputed among themselves, saying, "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The Jews therefore quarreled among themselves, saying, "How can this Man give us His flesh to eat?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people began arguing with each other about what he meant. "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?" they asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Jews began to argue with one another, saying, "How can this Man give us His flesh to eat?"
verses.textEn: Then the Jews began to argue sharply among themselves, "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣就对他们说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，你们若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就没有生命在你们里面。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就对他们说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，你们若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就没有生命在你们里面。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就没有生命在你们里面。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to them, <red>“Very truly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus said to them, "Truly, truly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, you have no life in you.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus said again, "I tell you the truth, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you cannot have eternal life within you.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus said to them, "Truly, truly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, you have no life in yourselves.
verses.textEn: Jesus said to them, <red>“Very truly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>吃我肉、喝我血的，就有永生，在末日我要使他复活；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>吃我肉、喝我血的，就有永生，在末日我要使他复活；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>吃我肉、喝我血的人就有永生，在末日我要叫他复活。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever feeds on my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.textEnNlt: But anyone who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise that person at the last day.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day.
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为我的肉是真正的食物，我的血是真正的饮料。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为我的肉是真正的食物，我的血是真正的饮料。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For my flesh is real food and my blood is real drink.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For my flesh is true food, and my blood is true drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: For My flesh is food indeed, and My blood is drink indeed.
verses.textEnNlt: For my flesh is true food, and my blood is true drink.
verses.textEnNasb: For My flesh is true food, and My blood is true drink.
verses.textEn: <red>For my flesh is real food and my blood is real drink.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>吃我肉、喝我血的人，就住在我里面，我也住在他里面。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>吃我肉、喝我血的人，就住在我里面，我也住在他里面。</red>
