verses.textZhCuv: <red>吃我肉、喝我血的人常在我里面，我也常在他里面。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever feeds on my flesh and drinks my blood abides in me, and I in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who eats My flesh and drinks My blood abides in Me, and I in him.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in him.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me, and I in him.
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>正如永活的父差遣了我，我也因父活着；照样，吃我肉的人也必因我而活。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>正如永活的父差遣了我，我也因父活着；照样，吃我肉的人也必因我而活。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>永活的父怎样差我来，我又因父活着；照样，吃我肉的人也要因我活着。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so the one who feeds on me will live because of me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so whoever feeds on me, he also will live because of me.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the living Father sent Me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
verses.textEnNlt: I live because of the living Father who sent me; in the same way, anyone who feeds on me will live because of me.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as the living Father sent Me, and I live because of the Father, the one who eats Me, he also will live because of Me.
verses.textEn: <red>Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so the one who feeds on me will live because of me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这就是从天上降下来的食物，不像吗哪，你们的祖宗吃过，还是死了；吃这食物的，必活到永远。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这就是从天上降下来的食物，不像吗哪，你们的祖宗吃过，还是死了；吃这食物的，必活到永远。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这就是从天上降下来的粮。吃这粮的人就永远活着，不像你们的祖宗吃过吗哪还是死了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>This is the bread that came down from heaven. Your ancestors ate manna and died, but whoever feeds on this bread will live forever.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: This is the bread that came down from heaven, not like the bread the fathers ate, and died. Whoever feeds on this bread will live forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the bread which came down from heaven—not as your fathers ate the manna, and are dead. He who eats this bread will live forever."
verses.textEnNlt: I am the true bread that came down from heaven. Anyone who eats this bread will not die as your ancestors did (even though they ate the manna) but will live forever."
verses.textEnNasb: This is the bread that came down out of heaven, not as the fathers ate and died; the one who eats this bread will live forever."
verses.textEn: <red>This is the bread that came down from heaven. Your ancestors ate manna and died, but whoever feeds on this bread will live forever.”</red>

verses.textZh: 这些话是耶稣在迦百农会堂里教导人的时候说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些话是耶稣在迦百农会堂里教导人的时候说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些话是耶稣在迦百农会堂里教训人说的。
verses.textEnNiv: He said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said these things in the synagogue, as he taught at Capernaum.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things He said in the synagogue as He taught in Capernaum.
verses.textEnNlt: He said these things while he was teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
verses.textEnNasb: These things He said in the synagogue as He taught in Capernaum.
verses.textEn: He said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.

verses.textZh: 他的门徒中，有许多人听了，就说："这话很难，谁能接受呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的门徒中，有许多人听了，就说："这话很难，谁能接受呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的门徒中有好些人听见了，就说：「这话甚难，谁能听呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: On hearing it, many of his disciples said, "This is a hard teaching. Who can accept it?"
verses.textEnEsv: When many of his disciples heard it, they said, "This is a hard saying; who can listen to it?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore many of His disciples, when they heard this, said, "This is a hard saying; who can understand it?"
verses.textEnNlt: Many of his disciples said, "This is very hard to understand. How can anyone accept it?"
verses.textEnNasb: So then many of His disciples, when they heard this, said, "This statement is very unpleasant; who can listen to it?"
verses.textEn: On hearing it, many of his disciples said, "This is a hard teaching. Who can accept it?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣心里知道门徒为了这事议论纷纷，就对他们说："<red>这话使你们动摇吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣心里知道门徒为了这事议论纷纷，就对他们说："<red>这话使你们动摇吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣心里知道门徒为这话议论，就对他们说：「这话是叫你们厌弃 吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Aware that his disciples were grumbling about this, Jesus said to them, <red>“Does this offend you?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus, knowing in himself that his disciples were grumbling about this, said to them, "Do you take offense at this?
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus knew in Himself that His disciples complained about this, He said to them, "Does this offend you?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus was aware that his disciples were complaining, so he said to them, "Does this offend you?
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus, aware that His disciples were complaining about this, said to them, "Is this offensive to you?
verses.textEn: Aware that his disciples were grumbling about this, Jesus said to them, <red>“Does this offend you?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们看见人子升到他原来所在的地方，又怎样呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们看见人子升到他原来所在的地方，又怎样呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>倘或你们看见人子升到他原来所在之处，怎么样呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then what if you see the Son of Man ascend to where he was before!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then what if you were to see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
verses.textEnNkjv: What then if you should see the Son of Man ascend where He was before?
verses.textEnNlt: Then what will you think if you see the Son of Man ascend to heaven again?
verses.textEnNasb: What then if you see the Son of Man ascending to where He was before?
verses.textEn: <red>Then what if you see the Son of Man ascend to where he was before!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>使人活的是灵，肉体是无济于事的。我对你们所说的话是灵、是生命。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>使人活的是灵，肉体是无济于事的。我对你们所说的话是灵、是生命。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>叫人活着的乃是灵，肉体是无益的。我对你们所说的话就是灵，就是生命。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing. The words I have spoken to you—they are full of the Spirit and life.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: It is the Spirit who gives life; the flesh is no help at all. The words that I have spoken to you are spirit and life.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is the Spirit who gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and they are life.
verses.textEnNlt: The Spirit alone gives eternal life. Human effort accomplishes nothing. And the very words I have spoken to you are spirit and life.
verses.textEnNasb: It is the Spirit who gives life; the flesh provides no benefit; the words that I have spoken to you are spirit, and are life.
verses.textEn: <red>The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing. The words I have spoken to you—they are full of the Spirit and life.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而你们中间却有不信的人。"原来从起初耶稣就知道那些不信的是谁，那要把他出卖的又是谁。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而你们中间却有不信的人。"原来从起初耶稣就知道那些不信的是谁，那要把他出卖的又是谁。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是你们中间有不信的人。」耶稣从起头就知道谁不信他，谁要卖他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Yet there are some of you who do not believe.”</red> For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray him.
verses.textEnEsv: But there are some of you who do not believe." (For Jesus knew from the beginning who those were who did not believe, and who it was who would betray him.)
verses.textEnNkjv: But there are some of you who do not believe." For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who did not believe, and who would betray Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But some of you do not believe me." (For Jesus knew from the beginning which ones didn’t believe, and he knew who would betray him.)
verses.textEnNasb: But there are some of you who do not believe." For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who did not believe, and who it was who would betray Him.
verses.textEn: <red>Yet there are some of you who do not believe.”</red> For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣跟着说："<red>所以我对你们说过，如果不是父所赐的，没有人能到我这里来。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣跟着说："<red>所以我对你们说过，如果不是父所赐的，没有人能到我这里来。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又说：「<red>所以我对你们说过，若不是蒙我父的恩赐，没有人能到我这里来。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He went on to say, <red>“This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless the Father has enabled them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless it is granted him by the Father."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Therefore I have said to you that no one can come to Me unless it has been granted to him by My Father."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "That is why I said that people can’t come to me unless the Father gives them to me."
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying, "For this reason I have told you that no one can come to Me unless it has been granted him from the Father."
verses.textEn: He went on to say, <red>“This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless the Father has enabled them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 从此，他的门徒中有许多人退去了，不再与他同行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从此，他的门徒中有许多人退去了，不再与他同行。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此，他门徒中多有退去的，不再和他同行。
verses.textEnNiv: From this time many of his disciples turned back and no longer followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: After this many of his disciples turned back and no longer walked with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: From that time many of His disciples went back and walked with Him no more.
verses.textEnNlt: At this point many of his disciples turned away and deserted him.
verses.textEnNasb: As a result of this many of His disciples left, and would no longer walk with Him.
verses.textEn: From this time many of his disciples turned back and no longer followed him.

verses.textZh: <red>于是耶稣对十二门徒说："你们也想离去吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>于是耶稣对十二门徒说："你们也想离去吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就对那十二个门徒说：「<red>你们也要去吗？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp do not want to leave too, do you?”</red> Jesus asked the Twelve.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus said to the twelve, "Do you want to go away as well?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to the twelve, "Do you also want to go away?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus turned to the Twelve and asked, "Are you also going to leave?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus said to the twelve, "You do not want to leave also, do you?"
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp do not want to leave too, do you?”</red> Jesus asked the Twelve.

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得回答："主啊，你有永生之道，我们还跟从谁呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得回答："主啊，你有永生之道，我们还跟从谁呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得回答说：「主啊，你有永生之道，我们还归从谁呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Simon Peter answered him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.
verses.textEnEsv: Simon Peter answered him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life,
verses.textEnNkjv: But Simon Peter answered Him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.
verses.textEnNlt: Simon Peter replied, "Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words that give eternal life.
verses.textEnNasb: Simon Peter answered Him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have words of eternal life.
verses.textEn: Simon Peter answered him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.

verses.textZh: 我们已经相信，并且知道你是神的圣者。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们已经相信，并且知道你是神的圣者。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们已经信了，又知道你是神的圣者。」
verses.textEnNiv: We have come to believe and to know that you are the Holy One of God."
verses.textEnEsv: and we have believed, and have come to know, that you are the Holy One of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also we have come to believe and know that You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
verses.textEnNlt: We believe, and we know you are the Holy One of God. "
verses.textEnNasb: And we have already believed and have come to know that You are the Holy One of God."
verses.textEn: We have come to believe and to know that you are the Holy One of God."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>我不是拣选了你们十二个人吗？但你们中间有一个是魔鬼。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>我不是拣选了你们十二个人吗？但你们中间有一个是魔鬼。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我不是拣选了你们十二个门徒吗？但你们中间有一个是魔鬼。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus replied, <red>“Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "Did I not choose you, the twelve? And yet one of you is a devil."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered them, "Did I not choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said, "I chose the twelve of you, but one is a devil."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered them, "Did I Myself not choose you, the twelve? And yet one of you is a devil."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus replied, <red>“Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣这话是指着加略人西门的儿子犹大说的，因为他虽然是十二门徒之一，却要出卖耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣这话是指着加略人西门的儿子犹大说的，因为他虽然是十二门徒之一，却要出卖耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣这话是指着加略人西门的儿子犹大说的；他本是十二个门徒里的一个，后来要卖耶稣的。
verses.textEnNiv: (He meant Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, who, though one of the Twelve, was later to betray him.)
verses.textEnEsv: He spoke of Judas the son of Simon Iscariot, for he, one of the twelve, was going to betray him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He spoke of Judas Iscariot, theson of Simon, for it was he who would betray Him, being one of the twelve.
verses.textEnNlt: He was speaking of Judas, son of Simon Iscariot, one of the Twelve, who would later betray him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now He meant Judas the son of Simon Iscariot; for he, one of the twelve, was going to betray Him.
verses.textEn: (He meant Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, who, though one of the Twelve, was later to betray him.)

verses.textZh: 这事以后，耶稣周游加利利，不愿在犹太往来，因为犹太人想要杀他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，耶稣周游加利利，不愿在犹太往来，因为犹太人想要杀他。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，耶稣在加利利游行，不愿在犹太游行，因为犹太人想要杀他。
verses.textEnNiv: After this, Jesus went around in Galilee. He did not want to go about in Judea because the Jewish leaders there were looking for a way to kill him.
verses.textEnEsv: After this Jesus went about in Galilee. He would not go about in Judea, because the Jews were seeking to kill him.
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee; for He did not want to walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill Him.
verses.textEnNlt: After this, Jesus traveled around Galilee. He wanted to stay out of Judea, where the Jewish leaders were plotting his death.
verses.textEnNasb: After these things Jesus was walking in Galilee, for He was unwilling to walk in Judea because the Jews were seeking to kill Him.
verses.textEn: After this, Jesus went around in Galilee. He did not want to go about in Judea because the Jewish leaders there were looking for a way to kill him.

verses.textZh: 犹太人的住棚节快到了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人的住棚节快到了，
verses.textZhCuv: 当时犹太人的住棚节近了。
verses.textEnNiv: But when the Jewish Festival of Tabernacles was near,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Jews’ Feast of Booths was at hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Jews’ Feast of Tabernacles was at hand.
verses.textEnNlt: But soon it was time for the Jewish Festival of Shelters,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was near.
verses.textEn: But when the Jewish Festival of Tabernacles was near,

verses.textZh: 耶稣的弟弟就对他说："你应当离开这里上犹太去，好让你的门徒也可以看见你所行的事；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣的弟弟就对他说："你应当离开这里上犹太去，好让你的门徒也可以看见你所行的事；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣的弟兄就对他说：「你离开这里上犹太去吧，叫你的门徒也看见你所行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus’ brothers said to him, "Leave Galilee and go to Judea, so that your disciples there may see the works you do.
verses.textEnEsv: So his brothers said to him, "Leave here and go to Judea, that your disciples also may see the works you are doing.
verses.textEnNkjv: His brothers therefore said to Him, "Depart from here and go into Judea, that Your disciples also may see the works that You are doing.
verses.textEnNlt: and Jesus’ brothers said to him, "Leave here and go to Judea, where your followers can see your miracles!
verses.textEnNasb: So His brothers said to Him, "Move on from here and go into Judea, so that Your disciples also may see Your works which You are doing.
verses.textEn: Jesus’ brothers said to him, "Leave Galilee and go to Judea, so that your disciples there may see the works you do.

verses.textZh: 因为没有人想引人注目，却在暗处行事的。你既然行这些事，就应该向世人显明自己。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为没有人想引人注目，却在暗处行事的。你既然行这些事，就应该向世人显明自己。"
verses.textZhCuv: 人要显扬名声，没有在暗处行事的；你如果行这些事，就当将自己显明给世人看。」
verses.textEnNiv: No one who wants to become a public figure acts in secret. Since you are doing these things, show yourself to the world."
verses.textEnEsv: For no one works in secret if he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, show yourself to the world."
verses.textEnNkjv: For no one does anything in secret while he himself seeks to be known openly. If You do these things, show Yourself to the world."
verses.textEnNlt: You can’t become famous if you hide like this! If you can do such wonderful things, show yourself to the world!"
verses.textEnNasb: For no one does anything in secret when he himself is striving to be known publicly. If You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world."
verses.textEn: No one who wants to become a public figure acts in secret. Since you are doing these things, show yourself to the world."

verses.textZh: 原来连他的弟弟也不信他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来连他的弟弟也不信他。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为连他的弟兄说这话，是因为不信他。
verses.textEnNiv: For even his own brothers did not believe in him.
verses.textEnEsv: For not even his brothers believed in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For even His brothers did not believe in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
verses.textEnNasb: For not even His brothers believed in Him.
verses.textEn: For even his own brothers did not believe in him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣就对他们说："<red>我的时候还没有到，你们的时候却常常是方便的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就对他们说："<red>我的时候还没有到，你们的时候却常常是方便的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣就对他们说：「我的时候还没有到；你们的时候常是方便的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore Jesus told them, <red>“My time is not yet here; for you any time will do.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "My time has not yet come, but your time is always here.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Now is not the right time for me to go, but you can go anytime.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus *said to them, "My time is not yet here, but your time is always ready.
verses.textEn: Therefore Jesus told them, <red>“My time is not yet here; for you any time will do.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>世人不能恨你们，却憎恨我，因为我指证他们的行为是邪恶的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>世人不能恨你们，却憎恨我，因为我指证他们的行为是邪恶的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>世人不能恨你们，却是恨我，因为我指证他们所做的事是恶的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify that its works are evil.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify about it that its works are evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me because I testify of it that its works are evil.
verses.textEnNlt: The world can’t hate you, but it does hate me because I accuse it of doing evil.
verses.textEnNasb: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me because I testify about it, that its deeds are evil.
verses.textEn: <red>The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify that its works are evil.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们上去过节吧！我现在不上去过这个节，因为我的时机还没有成熟。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们上去过节吧！我现在不上去过这个节，因为我的时机还没有成熟。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们上去过节吧，我现在不上去过这节，因为我的时候还没有满。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You go to the festival. I am not going up to this festival, because my time has not yet fully come.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You go up to the feast. I am not going up to this feast, for my time has not yet fully come."
verses.textEnNkjv: You go up to this feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, for My time has not yet fully come."
verses.textEnNlt: You go on. I’m not going to this festival, because my time has not yet come."
verses.textEnNasb: Go up to the feast yourselves; I am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet fully arrived."
verses.textEn: <red>You go to the festival. I am not going up to this festival, because my time has not yet fully come.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他说了这些话以后，仍然住在加利利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说了这些话以后，仍然住在加利利。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说了这话，仍旧住在加利利。
verses.textEnNiv: After he had said this, he stayed in Galilee.
verses.textEnEsv: After saying this, he remained in Galilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had said these things to them, He remained in Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: After saying these things, Jesus remained in Galilee.
verses.textEnNasb: Now having said these things to them, He stayed in Galilee.
verses.textEn: After he had said this, he stayed in Galilee.

verses.textZh: 然而，他的弟弟上去过节以后，他也上去过节，不是公开地去，却是暗中地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，他的弟弟上去过节以后，他也上去过节，不是公开地去，却是暗中地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他弟兄上去以后，他也上去过节，不是明去，似乎是暗去的。
verses.textEnNiv: However, after his brothers had left for the festival, he went also, not publicly, but in secret.
verses.textEnEsv: But after his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly but in private.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when His brothers had gone up, then He also went up to the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
verses.textEnNlt: But after his brothers left for the festival, Jesus also went, though secretly, staying out of public view.
verses.textEnNasb: But when His brothers had gone up to the feast, then He Himself also went up, not publicly, but as though in secret.
verses.textEn: However, after his brothers had left for the festival, he went also, not publicly, but in secret.

verses.textZh: 过节的时候，犹太人寻找耶稣，说："那人在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 过节的时候，犹太人寻找耶稣，说："那人在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 正在节期，犹太人寻找耶稣，说：「他在哪里？」
verses.textEnNiv: Now at the festival the Jewish leaders were watching for Jesus and asking, "Where is he?"
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews were looking for him at the feast, and saying, "Where is he?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Jews sought Him at the feast, and said, "Where is He?"
verses.textEnNlt: The Jewish leaders tried to find him at the festival and kept asking if anyone had seen him.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Jews were looking for Him at the feast and saying, "Where is He?"
verses.textEn: Now at the festival the Jewish leaders were watching for Jesus and asking, "Where is he?"

verses.textZh: 群众因他纷纷议论，有的说："他是好人。"有的说："不，他是欺骗众人的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众因他纷纷议论，有的说："他是好人。"有的说："不，他是欺骗众人的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人为他纷纷议论，有的说：「他是好人。」有的说：「不然，他是迷惑众人的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Among the crowds there was widespread whispering about him. Some said, "He is a good man." Others replied, "No, he deceives the people."
verses.textEnEsv: And there was much muttering about him among the people. While some said, "He is a good man," others said, "No, he is leading the people astray."
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was much complaining among the people concerning Him. Some said, "He is good"; others said, "No, on the contrary, He deceives the people."
verses.textEnNlt: There was a lot of grumbling about him among the crowds. Some argued, "He’s a good man," but others said, "He’s nothing but a fraud who deceives the people."
verses.textEnNasb: And there was a great deal of talk about Him in secret among the crowds: some were saying, "He is a good man"; others were saying, "No, on the contrary, He is misleading the people."
verses.textEn: Among the crowds there was widespread whispering about him. Some said, "He is a good man." Others replied, "No, he deceives the people."

verses.textZh: 但没有人敢公开讲论他，因为怕犹太人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但没有人敢公开讲论他，因为怕犹太人。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是没有人明明地讲论他，因为怕犹太人。
verses.textEnNiv: But no one would say anything publicly about him for fear of the leaders.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet for fear of the Jews no one spoke openly of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, no one spoke openly of Him for fear of the Jews.
verses.textEnNlt: But no one had the courage to speak favorably about him in public, for they were afraid of getting in trouble with the Jewish leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: However, no one was speaking openly about Him, for fear of the Jews.
verses.textEn: But no one would say anything publicly about him for fear of the leaders.

verses.textZh: 节期当中，耶稣上圣殿去教导人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 节期当中，耶稣上圣殿去教导人。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了节期，耶稣上殿里去教训人。
verses.textEnNiv: Not until halfway through the festival did Jesus go up to the temple courts and begin to teach.
verses.textEnEsv: About the middle of the feast Jesus went up into the temple and began teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now about the middle of the feast Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, midway through the festival, Jesus went up to the Temple and began to teach.
verses.textEnNasb: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple area, and began to teach.
verses.textEn: Not until halfway through the festival did Jesus go up to the temple courts and begin to teach.

verses.textZh: 犹太人就希奇，说："这个人没有学过，怎会通晓经书呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人就希奇，说："这个人没有学过，怎会通晓经书呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人就希奇，说：「这个人没有学过，怎么明白书呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The Jews there were amazed and asked, "How did this man get such learning without having been taught?"
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, "How is it that this man has learning, when he has never studied?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Jews marveled, saying, "How does this Man know letters, having never studied?"
verses.textEnNlt: The people were surprised when they heard him. "How does he know so much when he hasn’t been trained?" they asked.
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews then were astonished, saying, "How has this Man become learned, not having been educated?"
verses.textEn: The Jews there were amazed and asked, "How did this man get such learning without having been taught?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>我的教训不是我自己的，而是出于那差我来的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>我的教训不是我自己的，而是出于那差我来的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「我的教训不是我自己的，乃是那差我来者的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“My teaching is not my own. It comes from the one who sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus answered them, "My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered them and said, "My doctrine is not Mine, but His who sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus told them, "My message is not my own; it comes from God who sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus answered them and said, "My teaching is not My own, but His who sent Me.
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“My teaching is not my own. It comes from the one who sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人若愿意遵行神的旨意，就会知道这教训是出于神，还是我凭着自己的意思说的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人若愿意遵行神的旨意，就会知道这教训是出于神，还是我凭着自己的意思说的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人若立志遵着他的旨意行，就必晓得这教训或是出于神，或是我凭着自己说的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Anyone who chooses to do the will of God will find out whether my teaching comes from God or whether I speak on my own.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone’s will is to do God’s will, he will know whether the teaching is from God or whether I am speaking on my own authority.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone wills to do His will, he shall know concerning the doctrine, whether it is from God or whether I speak on My own authority.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who wants to do the will of God will know whether my teaching is from God or is merely my own.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone is willing to do His will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is of God, or I am speaking from Myself.
verses.textEn: <red>Anyone who chooses to do the will of God will find out whether my teaching comes from God or whether I speak on my own.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那凭着自己的意思说的，是求自己的荣誉；但那寻求差他来者的荣耀的，才是真诚的人，在他里面没有不义。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那凭着自己的意思说的，是求自己的荣誉；但那寻求差他来者的荣耀的，才是真诚的人，在他里面没有不义。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人凭着自己说，是求自己的荣耀；惟有求那差他来者的荣耀，这人是真的，在他心里没有不义。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever speaks on their own does so to gain personal glory, but he who seeks the glory of the one who sent him is a man of truth; there is nothing false about him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The one who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory; but the one who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and in him there is no falsehood.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory; but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is true, and no unrighteousness is in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who speak for themselves want glory only for themselves, but a person who seeks to honor the one who sent him speaks truth, not lies.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who speaks from himself seeks his own glory; but He who is seeking the glory of the One who sent Him, He is true, and there is no unrighteousness in Him.
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever speaks on their own does so to gain personal glory, but he who seeks the glory of the one who sent him is a man of truth; there is nothing false about him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>摩西不是曾经把律法传给你们吗？你们竟然没有一个人遵行律法。你们为甚么想要杀我呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>摩西不是曾经把律法传给你们吗？你们竟然没有一个人遵行律法。你们为甚么想要杀我呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>摩西岂不是传律法给你们吗？你们却没有一个人守律法。为什么想要杀我呢？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill me?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet none of you keeps the law. Why do you seek to kill me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Did not Moses give you the law, yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill Me?"
verses.textEnNlt: Moses gave you the law, but none of you obeys it! In fact, you are trying to kill me."
verses.textEnNasb: "Did Moses not give you the Law, and yet none of you carries out the Law? Why are you seeking to kill Me?"
verses.textEn: <red>Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill me?”</red>

verses.textZh: 群众回答："你是鬼附的，谁想要杀你呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众回答："你是鬼附的，谁想要杀你呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人回答说：「你是被鬼附着了！谁想要杀你？」
verses.textEnNiv: "You are demon-possessed," the crowd answered. "Who is trying to kill you?"
verses.textEnEsv: The crowd answered, "You have a demon! Who is seeking to kill you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The people answered and said, "You have a demon. Who is seeking to kill You?"
verses.textEnNlt: The crowd replied, "You’re demon possessed! Who’s trying to kill you?"
verses.textEnNasb: The crowd answered, "You have a demon! Who is seeking to kill You?"
verses.textEn: "You are demon-possessed," the crowd answered. "Who is trying to kill you?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>我行了一件事，你们都以为希奇。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>我行了一件事，你们都以为希奇。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「我做了一件事，你们都以为希奇。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to them, <red>“I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "I did one work, and you all marvel at it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "I did one work, and you all marvel.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "I did one miracle on the Sabbath, and you were amazed.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered them, "I did one deed, and you all are astonished.
verses.textEn: Jesus said to them, <red>“I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>摩西曾经把割礼传给你们 ，因此，你们在安息日也给人行割礼。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>摩西曾经把割礼传给你们 ，因此，你们在安息日也给人行割礼。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>摩西传割礼给你们（其实不是从摩西起的，乃是从祖先起的），因此你们也在安息日给人行割礼。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Yet, because Moses gave you circumcision (though actually it did not come from Moses, but from the patriarchs), you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Moses gave you circumcision (not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers), and you circumcise a man on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moses therefore gave you circumcision (not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers), and you circumcise a man on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNlt: But you work on the Sabbath, too, when you obey Moses’ law of circumcision. (Actually, this tradition of circumcision began with the patriarchs, long before the law of Moses.)
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers), and even on a Sabbath you circumcise a man.
verses.textEn: <red>Yet, because Moses gave you circumcision (though actually it did not come from Moses, but from the patriarchs), you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果人在安息日行割礼，为的是要遵守摩西的律法，那么我在安息日使一个人全身健康，你们就向我生气吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果人在安息日行割礼，为的是要遵守摩西的律法，那么我在安息日使一个人全身健康，你们就向我生气吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人若在安息日受割礼，免得违背摩西的律法，我在安息日叫一个人全然好了，你们就向我生气吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Now if a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, why are you angry with me for healing a man’s whole body on the Sabbath?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If on the Sabbath a man receives circumcision, so that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because on the Sabbath I made a man’s whole body well?
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man receives circumcision on the Sabbath, so that the law of Moses should not be broken, are you angry with Me because I made a man completely well on the Sabbath?
verses.textEnNlt: For if the correct time for circumcising your son falls on the Sabbath, you go ahead and do it so as not to break the law of Moses. So why should you be angry with me for healing a man on the Sabbath?
verses.textEnNasb: If a man receives circumcision on a Sabbath so that the Law of Moses will not be broken, are you angry at Me because I made an entire man well on a Sabbath?
verses.textEn: <red>Now if a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, why are you angry with me for healing a man’s whole body on the Sabbath?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不要按外貌判断人，总要公公平平地判断人。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不要按外貌判断人，总要公公平平地判断人。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不可按外貌断定是非，总要按公平断定是非。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Stop judging by mere appearances, but instead judge correctly.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do not judge by appearances, but judge with right judgment."
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not judge according to appearance, but judge with righteous judgment."
verses.textEnNlt: Look beneath the surface so you can judge correctly."
verses.textEnNasb: Do not judge by the outward appearance, but judge with righteous judgment."
verses.textEn: <red>Stop judging by mere appearances, but instead judge correctly.”</red>

verses.textZh: 当时，有些耶路撒冷人说："这不是他们想要杀的人吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，有些耶路撒冷人说："这不是他们想要杀的人吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷人中有的说：「这不是他们想要杀的人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: At that point some of the people of Jerusalem began to ask, "Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
verses.textEnEsv: Some of the people of Jerusalem therefore said, "Is not this the man whom they seek to kill?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now some of them from Jerusalem said, "Is this not He whom they seek to kill?
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the people who lived in Jerusalem started to ask each other, "Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
verses.textEnNasb: So some of the people of Jerusalem were saying, "Is this Man not the one whom they are seeking to kill?
verses.textEn: At that point some of the people of Jerusalem began to ask, "Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?

verses.textZh: 你看，他还在公开地讲话，竟然没有人对他说甚么，难道官长们真的认为这个人就是基督吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看，他还在公开地讲话，竟然没有人对他说甚么，难道官长们真的认为这个人就是基督吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你看他还明明地讲道，他们也不向他说什么，难道官长真知道这是基督吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Here he is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying a word to him. Have the authorities really concluded that he is the Messiah?
verses.textEnEsv: And here he is, speaking openly, and they say nothing to him! Can it be that the authorities really know that this is the Christ?
verses.textEnNkjv: But look! He speaks boldly, and they say nothing to Him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is truly the Christ?
verses.textEnNlt: But here he is, speaking in public, and they say nothing to him. Could our leaders possibly believe that he is the Messiah?
verses.textEnNasb: And yet look, He is speaking publicly, and they are saying nothing to Him. The rulers do not really know that this is the Christ, do they?
verses.textEn: Here he is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying a word to him. Have the authorities really concluded that he is the Messiah?

verses.textZh: 可是我们知道这个人是从哪里来的，只是基督来的时候，没有人知道他是从哪里来的！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是我们知道这个人是从哪里来的，只是基督来的时候，没有人知道他是从哪里来的！"
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，我们知道这个人从哪里来；只是基督来的时候，没有人知道他从哪里来。」
verses.textEnNiv: But we know where this man is from; when the Messiah comes, no one will know where he is from."
verses.textEnEsv: But we know where this man comes from, and when the Christ appears, no one will know where he comes from."
verses.textEnNkjv: However, we know where this Man is from; but when the Christ comes, no one knows where He is from."
verses.textEnNlt: But how could he be? For we know where this man comes from. When the Messiah comes, he will simply appear; no one will know where he comes from."
verses.textEnNasb: However, we know where this Man is from; but when the Christ comes, no one knows where He is from."
verses.textEn: But we know where this man is from; when the Messiah comes, no one will know where he is from."

verses.textZh: 当时耶稣在殿里教导人，大声说："<red>你们以为认识我，也知道我从哪里来，其实我不是凭着自己的意思来的，但那差我来的是真实的，你们却不认识他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时耶稣在殿里教导人，大声说："<red>你们以为认识我，也知道我从哪里来，其实我不是凭着自己的意思来的，但那差我来的是真实的，你们却不认识他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，耶稣在殿里教训人，大声说：「你们也知道我，也知道我从哪里来；我来并不是由于自己。但那差我来的是真的。你们不认识他，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, <red>“Yes, you know me, and you know where I am from. I am not here on my own authority, but he who sent me is true. You do not know him,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus proclaimed, as he taught in the temple, "You know me, and you know where I come from. But I have not come of my own accord. He who sent me is true, and him you do not know.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus cried out, as He taught in the temple, saying, "You both know Me, and you know where I am from; and I have not come of Myself, but He who sent Me is true, whom you do not know.
verses.textEnNlt: While Jesus was teaching in the Temple, he called out, "Yes, you know me, and you know where I come from. But I’m not here on my own. The one who sent me is true, and you don’t know him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, "You both know Me and you know where I am from; and I have not come of Myself, but He who sent Me is true, whom you do not know.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, <red>“Yes, you know me, and you know where I am from. I am not here on my own authority, but he who sent me is true. You do not know him,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而我认识他，因为我从他那里来，也是他差我来的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而我认识他，因为我从他那里来，也是他差我来的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我却认识他；因为我是从他来的，他也是差了我来。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>but I know him because I am from him and he sent me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I know him, for I come from him, and he sent me."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I know Him, for I am from Him, and He sent Me."
verses.textEnNlt: But I know him because I come from him, and he sent me to you."
verses.textEnNasb: I do know Him, because I am from Him, and He sent Me."
verses.textEn: <red>but I know him because I am from him and he sent me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他们想逮捕他，只是没有人下手，因为他的时候还没有到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们想逮捕他，只是没有人下手，因为他的时候还没有到。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就想要捉拿耶稣；只是没有人下手，因为他的时候还没有到。
verses.textEnNiv: At this they tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.textEnEsv: So they were seeking to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they sought to take Him; but no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the leaders tried to arrest him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
verses.textEnNasb: So they were seeking to arrest Him; and yet no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.
verses.textEn: At this they tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

verses.textZh: 群众中有许多人信了他。他们说："基督来的时候，他所行的神迹，能比这人所行的更多吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众中有许多人信了他。他们说："基督来的时候，他所行的神迹，能比这人所行的更多吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 但众人中间有好些信他的，说：「基督来的时候，他所行的神迹岂能比这人所行的更多吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Still, many in the crowd believed in him. They said, "When the Messiah comes, will he perform more signs than this man?"
verses.textEnEsv: Yet many of the people believed in him. They said, "When the Christ appears, will he do more signs than this man has done?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And many of the people believed in Him, and said, "When the Christ comes, will He do more signs than these which this Man has done?"
verses.textEnNlt: Many among the crowds at the Temple believed in him. "After all," they said, "would you expect the Messiah to do more miraculous signs than this man has done?"
verses.textEnNasb: But many of the crowd believed in Him; and they were saying, "When the Christ comes, He will not perform more signs than those which this man has done, will He?"
verses.textEn: Still, many in the crowd believed in him. They said, "When the Messiah comes, will he perform more signs than this man?"

verses.textZh: 法利赛人听见群众纷纷议论这些关于耶稣的事，祭司长和法利赛人就派差役去逮捕耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人听见群众纷纷议论这些关于耶稣的事，祭司长和法利赛人就派差役去逮捕耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人听见众人为耶稣这样纷纷议论，祭司长和法利赛人就打发差役去捉拿他。
verses.textEnNiv: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering such things about him. Then the chief priests and the Pharisees sent temple guards to arrest him.
verses.textEnEsv: The Pharisees heard the crowd muttering these things about him, and the chief priests and Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Pharisees heard the crowd murmuring these things concerning Him, and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take Him.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Pharisees heard that the crowds were whispering such things, they and the leading priests sent Temple guards to arrest Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering these things about Him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest Him.
verses.textEn: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering such things about him. Then the chief priests and the Pharisees sent temple guards to arrest him.

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣说："<red>我跟你们在一起的时候不多了，我要回到那差我来的那里去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣说："<red>我跟你们在一起的时候不多了，我要回到那差我来的那里去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是耶稣说：「我还有不多的时候和你们同在，以后就回到差我来的那里去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, <red>“I am with you for only a short time, and then I am going to the one who sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus then said, "I will be with you a little longer, and then I am going to him who sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "I shall be with you a little while longer, and then I go to Him who sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus told them, "I will be with you only a little longer. Then I will return to the one who sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Jesus said, "For a little while longer I am going to be with you, and then I am going to Him who sent Me.
verses.textEn: Jesus said, <red>“I am with you for only a short time, and then I am going to the one who sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要寻找我，却找不着；我所在的地方，你们是不能去的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要寻找我，却找不着；我所在的地方，你们是不能去的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要找我，却找不着；我所在的地方你们不能到。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You will look for me, but you will not find me; and where I am, you cannot come.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You will seek me and you will not find me. Where I am you cannot come."
verses.textEnNkjv: You will seek Me and not find Me, and where I am you cannot come."
verses.textEnNlt: You will search for me but not find me. And you cannot go where I am going."
verses.textEnNasb: You will seek Me, and will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come."
verses.textEn: <red>You will look for me, but you will not find me; and where I am, you cannot come.”</red>

verses.textZh: 犹太人彼此说："这个人要到哪里去，使我们找不着他呢？难道他要到散居在希腊人中的犹太人那里，去教导希腊人吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人彼此说："这个人要到哪里去，使我们找不着他呢？难道他要到散居在希腊人中的犹太人那里，去教导希腊人吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人就彼此对问说：「这人要往哪里去，叫我们找不着呢？难道他要往散住希腊中的犹太人那里去教训希腊人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: The Jews said to one another, "Where does this man intend to go that we cannot find him? Will he go where our people live scattered among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews said to one another, "Where does this man intend to go that we will not find him? Does he intend to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Jews said among themselves, "Where does He intend to go that we shall not find Him? Does He intend to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
verses.textEnNlt: The Jewish leaders were puzzled by this statement. "Where is he planning to go?" they asked. "Is he thinking of leaving the country and going to the Jews in other lands? Maybe he will even teach the Greeks!
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews then said to one another, "Where does this Man intend to go that we will not find Him? He does not intend to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks, does He?
verses.textEn: The Jews said to one another, "Where does this man intend to go that we cannot find him? Will he go where our people live scattered among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?

verses.textZh: 他说‘你们要寻找我，却找不着；我所在的地方，你们是不能去的’这话，是甚么意思呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说‘你们要寻找我，却找不着；我所在的地方，你们是不能去的’这话，是甚么意思呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他说：『你们要找我，却找不着；我所在的地方，你们不能到』，这话是什么意思呢？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: What did he mean when he said, <red>‘You will look for me, but you will not find me,’</red> and <red>‘Where I am, you cannot come’?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: What does he mean by saying, ‘You will seek me and you will not find me,’ and, ‘Where I am you cannot come’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: What is this thing that He said, ‘You will seek Me and not find Me, and where I am you cannot come’?"
verses.textEnNlt: What does he mean when he says, ‘You will search for me but not find me,’ and ‘You cannot go where I am going’?"
verses.textEnNasb: What is this statement that He said, ‘You will seek Me, and will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come’?"
verses.textEn: What did he mean when he said, <red>‘You will look for me, but you will not find me,’</red> and <red>‘Where I am, you cannot come’?”</red>

verses.textZh: 节期的最后一天，就是最隆重的那一天，耶稣站着高声说："<red>人若渴了，可以到我这里来喝！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 节期的最后一天，就是最隆重的那一天，耶稣站着高声说："<red>人若渴了，可以到我这里来喝！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>节期的末日，就是最大之日，耶稣站着高声说：「人若渴了，可以到我这里来喝。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: On the last and greatest day of the festival, Jesus stood and said in a loud voice, <red>“Let anyone who is thirsty come to me and drink.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: On the last day of the feast, the great day, Jesus stood up and cried out, "If anyone thirsts, let him come to me and drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, "If anyone thirsts, let him come to Me and drink.
verses.textEnNlt: On the last day, the climax of the festival, Jesus stood and shouted to the crowds, "Anyone who is thirsty may come to me!
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the last day, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, "If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.
verses.textEn: On the last and greatest day of the festival, Jesus stood and said in a loud voice, <red>“Let anyone who is thirsty come to me and drink.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>信我的人，就像圣经所说的，从他的腹中要涌流出活水的江河来。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>信我的人，就像圣经所说的，从他的腹中要涌流出活水的江河来。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>信我的人就如经上所说：『从他腹中要流出活水的江河来。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever believes in me, as the Scripture has said, ‘Out of his heart will flow rivers of living water.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: He who believes in Me, as the Scripture has said, out of his heart will flow rivers of living water."
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who believes in me may come and drink! For the Scriptures declare, ‘Rivers of living water will flow from his heart.’"
verses.textEnNasb: The one who believes in Me, as the Scripture said, ‘ From his innermost being will flow rivers of living water.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他这话是指着信他的人要接受圣灵说的；那时圣灵还没有降临，因为耶稣还没有得着荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他这话是指着信他的人要接受圣灵说的；那时圣灵还没有降临，因为耶稣还没有得着荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣这话是指着信他之人要受圣灵说的。那时还没有赐下圣灵来，因为耶稣尚未得着荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: By this he meant the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were later to receive. Up to that time the Spirit had not been given, since Jesus had not yet been glorified.
verses.textEnEsv: Now this he said about the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were to receive, for as yet the Spirit had not been given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.
verses.textEnNkjv: But this He spoke concerning the Spirit, whom those believing in Him would receive; for the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.
verses.textEnNlt: (When he said "living water," he was speaking of the Spirit, who would be given to everyone believing in him. But the Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet entered into his glory.)
verses.textEnNasb: But this He said in reference to the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were to receive; for the Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.
verses.textEn: By this he meant the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were later to receive. Up to that time the Spirit had not been given, since Jesus had not yet been glorified.

verses.textZh: 群众中有人听了这些话，就说："这真是‘那位先知’！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众中有人听了这些话，就说："这真是‘那位先知’！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人听见这话，有的说：「这真是那先知。」
verses.textEnNiv: On hearing his words, some of the people said, "Surely this man is the Prophet."
verses.textEnEsv: When they heard these words, some of the people said, "This really is the Prophet."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore many from the crowd, when they heard this saying, said, "Truly this is the Prophet."
verses.textEnNlt: When the crowds heard him say this, some of them declared, "Surely this man is the Prophet we’ve been expecting."
verses.textEnNasb: Some of the people therefore, after they heard these words, were saying, "This truly is the Prophet."
verses.textEn: On hearing his words, some of the people said, "Surely this man is the Prophet."

verses.textZh: 另有人说："他是基督。"还有人说："基督是从加利利出来的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 另有人说："他是基督。"还有人说："基督是从加利利出来的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 有的说：「这是基督。」但也有的说：「基督岂是从加利利出来的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Others said, "He is the Messiah." Still others asked, "How can the Messiah come from Galilee?
verses.textEnEsv: Others said, "This is the Christ." But some said, "Is the Christ to come from Galilee?
verses.textEnNkjv: Others said, "This is the Christ." But some said, "Will the Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.textEnNlt: Others said, "He is the Messiah." Still others said, "But he can’t be! Will the Messiah come from Galilee?
verses.textEnNasb: Others were saying, "This is the Christ." But others were saying, "Surely the Christ is not coming from Galilee, is He?
verses.textEn: Others said, "He is the Messiah." Still others asked, "How can the Messiah come from Galilee?

verses.textZh: 圣经不是说基督是大卫的后裔，是从大卫本乡伯利恒出来的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣经不是说基督是大卫的后裔，是从大卫本乡伯利恒出来的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 经上岂不是说『基督是大卫的后裔，从大卫本乡伯利恒出来的』吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Does not Scripture say that the Messiah will come from David’s descendants and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived?"
verses.textEnEsv: Has not the Scripture said that the Christ comes from the offspring of David, and comes from Bethlehem, the village where David was?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Has not the Scripture said that the Christ comes from the seed of David and from the town of Bethlehem, where David was?"
verses.textEnNlt: For the Scriptures clearly state that the Messiah will be born of the royal line of David, in Bethlehem, the village where King David was born."
verses.textEnNasb: Has the Scripture not said that the Christ comes from the descendants of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?"
verses.textEn: Does not Scripture say that the Messiah will come from David’s descendants and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived?"

verses.textZh: 群众因为耶稣的缘故，就起了纷争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众因为耶稣的缘故，就起了纷争。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是众人因着耶稣起了纷争。
verses.textEnNiv: Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: So there was a division among the people over him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So there was a division among the people because of Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So the crowd was divided about him.
verses.textEnNasb: So a dissension occurred in the crowd because of Him.
verses.textEn: Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他们中间有人想逮捕耶稣，只是没有人下手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中间有人想逮捕耶稣，只是没有人下手。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中有人要捉拿他，只是无人下手。
verses.textEnNiv: Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.
verses.textEnEsv: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid hands on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now some of them wanted to take Him, but no one laid hands on Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Some even wanted him arrested, but no one laid a hand on him.
verses.textEnNasb: And some of them wanted to arrest Him, but no one laid hands on Him.
verses.textEn: Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.

verses.textZh: 差役回到祭司长和法利赛人那里。他们就问差役："你们为甚么没有把他带来？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 差役回到祭司长和法利赛人那里。他们就问差役："你们为甚么没有把他带来？"
verses.textZhCuv: 差役回到祭司长和法利赛人那里。他们对差役说：「你们为什么没有带他来呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Finally the temple guards went back to the chief priests and the Pharisees, who asked them, "Why didn’t you bring him in?"
verses.textEnEsv: The officers then came to the chief priests and Pharisees, who said to them, "Why did you not bring him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the officers came to the chief priests and Pharisees, who said to them, "Why have you not brought Him?"
verses.textEnNlt: When the Temple guards returned without having arrested Jesus, the leading priests and Pharisees demanded, "Why didn’t you bring him in?"
verses.textEnNasb: The officers then came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, "Why did you not bring Him?"
verses.textEn: Finally the temple guards went back to the chief priests and the Pharisees, who asked them, "Why didn’t you bring him in?"

verses.textZh: 差役回答："从来没有人像他这样讲话的！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 差役回答："从来没有人像他这样讲话的！"
verses.textZhCuv: 差役回答说：「从来没有像他这样说话的！」
verses.textEnNiv: "No one ever spoke the way this man does," the guards replied.
verses.textEnEsv: The officers answered, "No one ever spoke like this man!"
verses.textEnNkjv: The officers answered, "No man ever spoke like this Man!"
verses.textEnNlt: "We have never heard anyone speak like this!" the guards responded.
verses.textEnNasb: The officers answered, "Never has a man spoken in this way!"
verses.textEn: "No one ever spoke the way this man does," the guards replied.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人说："连你们也受了欺骗吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人说："连你们也受了欺骗吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人说：「你们也受了迷惑吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "You mean he has deceived you also?" the Pharisees retorted.
verses.textEnEsv: The Pharisees answered them, "Have you also been deceived?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Pharisees answered them, "Are you also deceived?
verses.textEnNlt: "Have you been led astray, too?" the Pharisees mocked.
verses.textEnNasb: The Pharisees then replied to them, "You have not been led astray too, have you?
verses.textEn: "You mean he has deceived you also?" the Pharisees retorted.

verses.textZh: 官长或法利赛人中间有谁是信他的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 官长或法利赛人中间有谁是信他的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 官长或是法利赛人岂有信他的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed in him?
verses.textEnEsv: Have any of the authorities or the Pharisees believed in him?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have any of the rulers or the Pharisees believed in Him?
verses.textEnNlt: "Is there a single one of us rulers or Pharisees who believes in him?
verses.textEnNasb: Not one of the rulers or Pharisees has believed in Him, has he?
verses.textEn: "Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed in him?

verses.textZh: 至于这群不明白律法的人，他们是可咒诅的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于这群不明白律法的人，他们是可咒诅的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但这些不明白律法的百姓是被咒诅的！」
verses.textEnNiv: No! But this mob that knows nothing of the law—there is a curse on them."
verses.textEnEsv: But this crowd that does not know the law is accursed."
verses.textEnNkjv: But this crowd that does not know the law is accursed."
verses.textEnNlt: This foolish crowd follows him, but they are ignorant of the law. God’s curse is on them!"
verses.textEnNasb: But this crowd that does not know the Law is accursed!"
verses.textEn: No! But this mob that knows nothing of the law—there is a curse on them."

verses.textZh: 他们当中有一个人，就是以前来见耶稣的尼哥德慕，对他们说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们当中有一个人，就是以前来见耶稣的尼哥德慕，对他们说：
verses.textZhCuv: 内中有尼哥德慕，就是从前去见耶稣的，对他们说：
verses.textEnNiv: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who was one of their own number, asked,
verses.textEnEsv: Nicodemus, who had gone to him before, and who was one of them, said to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Nicodemus (he who came to Jesus by night, being one of them) said to them,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Nicodemus, the leader who had met with Jesus earlier, spoke up.
verses.textEnNasb: Nicodemus (the one who came to Him before, being one of them) *said to them,
verses.textEn: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who was one of their own number, asked,

verses.textZh: "如果不先听取他本人的口供，查明他所作的事，我们的律法怎能把他定罪呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果不先听取他本人的口供，查明他所作的事，我们的律法怎能把他定罪呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 「不先听本人的口供，不知道他所做的事，难道我们的律法还定他的罪吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him to find out what he has been doing?"
verses.textEnEsv: "Does our law judge a man without first giving him a hearing and learning what he does?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Does our law judge a man before it hears him and knows what he is doing?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Is it legal to convict a man before he is given a hearing?" he asked.
verses.textEnNasb: "Our Law does not judge the person unless it first hears from him and knows what he is doing, does it?"
verses.textEn: "Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him to find out what he has been doing?"

verses.textZh: 他们回答："你也是从加利利出来的吗？你去考查一下，就知道先知是不会从加利利兴起的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："你也是从加利利出来的吗？你去考查一下，就知道先知是不会从加利利兴起的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答说：「你也是出于加利利吗？你且去查考，就可知道加利利没有出过先知。」
verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "Are you from Galilee, too? Look into it, and you will find that a prophet does not come out of Galilee." [The earliest manuscripts and many other ancient witnesses do not have John 7:53—8:11. A few manuscripts include these verses, wholly or in part, after John 7:36, John 21:25, Luke 21:38 or Luke 24:53.]
verses.textEnEsv: They replied, "Are you from Galilee too? Search and see that no prophet arises from Galilee." [The earliest manuscripts do not include 7:53–8:11.] [[
verses.textEnNkjv: They answered and said to him, "Are you also from Galilee? Search and look, for no prophet has arisen out of Galilee."
verses.textEnNlt: They replied, "Are you from Galilee, too? Search the Scriptures and see for yourself—no prophet ever comes from Galilee!" ---------- [The most ancient Greek manuscripts do not include John 7:53–8:11.]
verses.textEnNasb: They answered and said to him, "You are not from Galilee as well, are you? Examine the Scriptures, and see that no prophet arises out of Galilee."
verses.textEn: They replied, "Are you from Galilee, too? Look into it, and you will find that a prophet does not come out of Galilee." [The earliest manuscripts and many other ancient witnesses do not have John 7:53—8:11. A few manuscripts include these verses, wholly or in part, after John 7:36, John 21:25, Luke 21:38 or Luke 24:53.]

verses.textZh: 于是各人都回家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是各人都回家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是各人都回家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they all went home,
verses.textEnEsv: They went each to his own house,
verses.textEnNkjv: And everyone went to his own house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the meeting broke up, and everybody went home.
verses.textEnNasb: [[ And everyone went to his home.
verses.textEn: Then they all went home,

verses.textZh: 耶稣往橄榄山去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣往橄榄山去。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是各人都回家去了；耶稣却往橄榄山去，
verses.textEnNiv: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEnEsv: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus returned to the Mount of Olives,
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEn: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

verses.textZh: 黎明的时候，他又到圣殿去，众人都来到他那里，他就坐下教导他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 黎明的时候，他又到圣殿去，众人都来到他那里，他就坐下教导他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 清早又回到殿里。众百姓都到他那里去，他就坐下，教训他们。
verses.textEnNiv: At dawn he appeared again in the temple courts, where all the people gathered around him, and he sat down to teach them.
verses.textEnEsv: Early in the morning he came again to the temple. All the people came to him, and he sat down and taught them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now early in the morning He came again into the temple, and all the people came to Him; and He sat down and taught them.
verses.textEnNlt: but early the next morning he was back again at the Temple. A crowd soon gathered, and he sat down and taught them.
verses.textEnNasb: And early in the morning He came again into the temple area, and all the people were coming to Him; and He sat down and began teaching them.
verses.textEn: At dawn he appeared again in the temple courts, where all the people gathered around him, and he sat down to teach them.

verses.textZh: 经学家和法利赛人带了一个行淫时被抓到的妇人来，叫她站在中间，
verses.textZhCnvs: 经学家和法利赛人带了一个行淫时被抓到的妇人来，叫她站在中间，
verses.textZhCuv: 文士和法利赛人带着一个行淫时被拿的妇人来，叫她站在当中，
verses.textEnNiv: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees brought in a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before the group
verses.textEnEsv: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman who had been caught in adultery, and placing her in the midst
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the scribes and Pharisees brought to Him a woman caught in adultery. And when they had set her in the midst,
verses.textEnNlt: As he was speaking, the teachers of religious law and the Pharisees brought a woman who had been caught in the act of adultery. They put her in front of the crowd.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the scribes and the Pharisees *brought a woman caught in the act of adultery, and after placing her in the center of the courtyard,
verses.textEn: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees brought in a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before the group

verses.textZh: 就对耶稣说："先生，这妇人是正在犯奸淫的时候被抓到的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就对耶稣说："先生，这妇人是正在犯奸淫的时候被抓到的。
verses.textZhCuv: 就对耶稣说：「夫子，这妇人是正行淫之时被拿的。
verses.textEnNiv: and said to Jesus, "Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
verses.textEnEsv: they said to him, "Teacher, this woman has been caught in the act of adultery.
verses.textEnNkjv: they said to Him, "Teacher, this woman was caught in adultery, in the very act.
verses.textEnNlt: "Teacher," they said to Jesus, "this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
verses.textEnNasb: they *said to Him, "Teacher, this woman has been caught in the very act of committing adultery.
verses.textEn: and said to Jesus, "Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.

verses.textZh: 摩西在律法上吩咐我们把这样的妇人用石头打死，你怎样说呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西在律法上吩咐我们把这样的妇人用石头打死，你怎样说呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西在律法上吩咐我们把这样的妇人用石头打死。你说该把她怎么样呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such women. Now what do you say?"
verses.textEnEsv: Now in the Law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. So what do you say?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Moses, in the law, commanded us that such should be stoned. But what do You say?"
verses.textEnNlt: The law of Moses says to stone her. What do you say?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the Law, Moses commanded us to stone such women; what then do You say?"
verses.textEn: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such women. Now what do you say?"

verses.textZh: 他们说这话是要试探耶稣，要找把柄来控告他。耶稣却弯下身，用指头在地上写字。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说这话是要试探耶稣，要找把柄来控告他。耶稣却弯下身，用指头在地上写字。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说这话，乃试探耶稣，要得着告他的把柄。耶稣却弯着腰，用指头在地上画字。
verses.textEnNiv: They were using this question as a trap, in order to have a basis for accusing him. But Jesus bent down and started to write on the ground with his finger.
verses.textEnEsv: This they said to test him, that they might have some charge to bring against him. Jesus bent down and wrote with his finger on the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: This they said, testing Him, that they might have something of which to accuse Him. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with His finger, as though He did not hear.
verses.textEnNlt: They were trying to trap him into saying something they could use against him, but Jesus stooped down and wrote in the dust with his finger.
verses.textEnNasb: Now they were saying this to test Him, so that they might have grounds for accusing Him. But Jesus stooped down and with His finger wrote on the ground.
verses.textEn: They were using this question as a trap, in order to have a basis for accusing him. But Jesus bent down and started to write on the ground with his finger.

verses.textZh: 他们不住地问耶稣，他就挺起身来，说："你们中间谁是没有罪的，他就可以先拿起石头打她。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不住地问耶稣，他就挺起身来，说："你们中间谁是没有罪的，他就可以先拿起石头打她。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们还是不住地问他，耶稣就直起腰来，对他们说：「你们中间谁是没有罪的，谁就可以先拿石头打她。」
verses.textEnNiv: When they kept on questioning him, he straightened up and said to them, "Let any one of you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her."
verses.textEnEsv: And as they continued to ask him, he stood up and said to them, "Let him who is without sin among you be the first to throw a stone at her."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they continued asking Him, He raised Himself up and said to them, "He who is without sin among you, let him throw a stone at her first."
verses.textEnNlt: They kept demanding an answer, so he stood up again and said, "All right, but let the one who has never sinned throw the first stone!"
verses.textEnNasb: When they persisted in asking Him, He straightened up and said to them, "He who is without sin among you, let him be the first to throw a stone at her."
verses.textEn: When they kept on questioning him, he straightened up and said to them, "Let any one of you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her."

verses.textZh: 于是又弯下身在地上写字。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是又弯下身在地上写字。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是又弯着腰，用指头在地上画字。
verses.textEnNiv: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And once more he bent down and wrote on the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: And again He stooped down and wrote on the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he stooped down again and wrote in the dust.
verses.textEnNasb: And again He stooped down and wrote on the ground.
verses.textEn: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.

verses.textZh: 他们听了这话，就从年老的开始，一个一个地都离开了，留下的只有耶稣和那个还站在那里的妇人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听了这话，就从年老的开始，一个一个地都离开了，留下的只有耶稣和那个还站在那里的妇人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们听见这话，就从老到少，一个一个地都出去了，只剩下耶稣一人，还有那妇人仍然站在当中。
verses.textEnNiv: At this, those who heard began to go away one at a time, the older ones first, until only Jesus was left, with the woman still standing there.
verses.textEnEsv: But when they heard it, they went away one by one, beginning with the older ones, and Jesus was left alone with the woman standing before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then those who heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning with the oldest even to the last. And Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
verses.textEnNlt: When the accusers heard this, they slipped away one by one, beginning with the oldest, until only Jesus was left in the middle of the crowd with the woman.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they heard this, they began leaving, one by one, beginning with the older ones, and He was left alone, and the woman where she was, in the center of the courtyard.
verses.textEn: At this, those who heard began to go away one at a time, the older ones first, until only Jesus was left, with the woman still standing there.

verses.textZh: 耶稣挺起身来，问她："妇人，他们在哪里？没有人定你的罪吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣挺起身来，问她："妇人，他们在哪里？没有人定你的罪吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就直起腰来，对她说：「妇人，那些人在哪里呢？没有人定你的罪吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus straightened up and asked her, "Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?"
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus stood up and said to her, "Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus had raised Himself up and saw no one but the woman, He said to her, "Woman, where are those accusers of yours? Has no one condemned you?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus stood up again and said to the woman, "Where are your accusers? Didn’t even one of them condemn you?"
verses.textEnNasb: And straightening up, Jesus said to her, "Woman, where are they? Did no one condemn you?"
verses.textEn: Jesus straightened up and asked her, "Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?"

verses.textZh: 她说："主啊！没有。"耶稣说："我也不定你的罪。走吧，从现在起不要再犯罪了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她说："主啊！没有。"耶稣说："我也不定你的罪。走吧，从现在起不要再犯罪了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她说：「主啊，没有。」耶稣说：「我也不定你的罪。去吧，从此不要再犯罪了！」
verses.textEnNiv: "No one, sir," she said. "Then neither do I condemn you," Jesus declared. "Go now and leave your life of sin."
verses.textEnEsv: She said, "No one, Lord." And Jesus said, "Neither do I condemn you; go, and from now on sin no more."]]
verses.textEnNkjv: She said, "No one, Lord." And Jesus said to her, "Neither do I condemn you; go and sin no more."
verses.textEnNlt: "No, Lord," she said. And Jesus said, "Neither do I. Go and sin no more." ----------
verses.textEnNasb: She said, "No one, Lord." And Jesus said, "I do not condemn you, either. Go. From now on do not sin any longer."]]
verses.textEn: "No one, sir," she said. "Then neither do I condemn you," Jesus declared. "Go now and leave your life of sin."

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对众人说："<red>我是世界的光，跟从我的，必定不在黑暗里走，却要得着生命的光。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对众人说："<red>我是世界的光，跟从我的，必定不在黑暗里走，却要得着生命的光。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又对众人说：「<red>我是世界的光。跟从我的，就不在黑暗里走，必要得着生命的光。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, <red>“I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Again Jesus spoke to them, saying, "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus spoke to them again, saying, "I am the light of the world. He who follows Me shall not walk in darkness, but have the light of life."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus spoke to the people once more and said, "I am the light of the world. If you follow me, you won’t have to walk in darkness, because you will have the light that leads to life."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jesus again spoke to them, saying, "I am the Light of the world; the one who follows Me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the Light of life."
verses.textEn: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, <red>“I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.”</red>

verses.textZh: 法利赛人对他说："你为自己作证，你的见证不是真实的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人对他说："你为自己作证，你的见证不是真实的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人对他说：「你是为自己作见证，你的见证不真。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Pharisees challenged him, "Here you are, appearing as your own witness; your testimony is not valid."
verses.textEnEsv: So the Pharisees said to him, "You are bearing witness about yourself; your testimony is not true."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Pharisees therefore said to Him, "You bear witness of Yourself; Your witness is not true."
verses.textEnNlt: The Pharisees replied, "You are making those claims about yourself! Such testimony is not valid."
verses.textEnNasb: So the Pharisees said to Him, "You are testifying about Yourself; Your testimony is not true."
verses.textEn: The Pharisees challenged him, "Here you are, appearing as your own witness; your testimony is not valid."

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："即使我为自己作证，我的见证还是真实的，因为我知道我从哪里来，往哪里去，但你们却不知道我从哪里来，往哪里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："即使我为自己作证，我的见证还是真实的，因为我知道我从哪里来，往哪里去，但你们却不知道我从哪里来，往哪里去。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「我虽然为自己作见证，我的见证还是真的；因我知道我从哪里来，往哪里去；你们却不知道我从哪里来，往哪里去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“Even if I testify on my own behalf, my testimony is valid, for I know where I came from and where I am going. But you have no idea where I come from or where I am going.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "Even if I do bear witness about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from and where I am going, but you do not know where I come from or where I am going.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "Even if I bear witness of Myself, My witness is true, for I know where I came from and where I am going; but you do not know where I come from and where I am going.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told them, "These claims are valid even though I make them about myself. For I know where I came from and where I am going, but you don’t know this about me.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered and said to them, "Even if I am testifying about Myself, My testimony is true, because I know where I came from and where I am going; but you do not know where I come from or where I am going.
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“Even if I testify on my own behalf, my testimony is valid, for I know where I came from and where I am going. But you have no idea where I come from or where I am going.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们按着外貌判断人，我却不判断人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们按着外貌判断人，我却不判断人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们是以外貌 判断人，我却不判断人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You judge by human standards; I pass judgment on no one.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.
verses.textEnNkjv: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.
verses.textEnNlt: You judge me by human standards, but I do not judge anyone.
verses.textEnNasb: You judge according to the flesh; I am not judging anyone.
verses.textEn: <red>You judge by human standards; I pass judgment on no one.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>即使我判断人，我的判断也是正确的，因为我不是独自一人，而是差我来的父和我在一起。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>即使我判断人，我的判断也是正确的，因为我不是独自一人，而是差我来的父和我在一起。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就是判断人，我的判断也是真的；因为不是我独自在这里，还有差我来的父与我同在。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But if I do judge, my decisions are true, because I am not alone. I stand with the Father, who sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Yet even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for it is not I alone who judge, but I and the Father who sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And yet if I do judge, My judgment is true; for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: And if I did, my judgment would be correct in every respect because I am not alone. The Father who sent me is with me.
verses.textEnNasb: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true; for I am not alone in it, but I and the Father who sent Me.
verses.textEn: <red>But if I do judge, my decisions are true, because I am not alone. I stand with the Father, who sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们的律法上也写着：‘两个人的见证才是真的。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们的律法上也写着：‘两个人的见证才是真的。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们的律法上也记着说：『两个人的见证是真的。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In your own Law it is written that the testimony of two witnesses is true.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: In your Law it is written that the testimony of two people is true.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is also written in your law that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.textEnNlt: Your own law says that if two people agree about something, their witness is accepted as fact.
verses.textEnNasb: Even in your Law it has been written that the testimony of two people is true.
verses.textEn: <red>In your own Law it is written that the testimony of two witnesses is true.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我为自己作证，差我来的父也为我作证。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我为自己作证，差我来的父也为我作证。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我是为自己作见证，还有差我来的父也是为我作见证。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I am one who testifies for myself; my other witness is the Father, who sent me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am the one who bears witness about myself, and the Father who sent me bears witness about me."
verses.textEnNkjv: I am One who bears witness of Myself, and the Father who sent Me bears witness of Me."
verses.textEnNlt: I am one witness, and my Father who sent me is the other."
verses.textEnNasb: I am He who testifies about Myself, and the Father who sent Me testifies about Me."
verses.textEn: <red>I am one who testifies for myself; my other witness is the Father, who sent me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们问："<red>你的父在哪里？</red>"耶稣回答："<red>你们不认识我，也不认识我的父；如果你们认识我，也就认识我的父了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们问："<red>你的父在哪里？</red>"耶稣回答："<red>你们不认识我，也不认识我的父；如果你们认识我，也就认识我的父了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就问他说：「<red>你的父在哪里？</red>」耶稣回答说：「<red>你们不认识我，也不认识我的父；若是认识我，也就认识我的父。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they asked him, “Where is your father?” <red>“Youp do not know me or my Father,”</red> Jesus replied. <red>“If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him therefore, "Where is your Father?" Jesus answered, "You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to Him, "Where is Your Father?" Jesus answered, "You know neither Me nor My Father. If you had known Me, you would have known My Father also."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where is your father?" they asked. Jesus answered, "Since you don’t know who I am, you don’t know who my Father is. If you knew me, you would also know my Father."
verses.textEnNasb: So they were saying to Him, "Where is Your Father?" Jesus answered, "You know neither Me nor My Father; if you knew Me, you would know My Father also."
verses.textEn: Then they asked him, “Where is your father?” <red>“Youp do not know me or my Father,”</red> Jesus replied. <red>“If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”</red>

verses.textZh: 这些话是耶稣在殿里教导人的时候，在银库的院中说的。当时没有人逮捕他，因为他的时候还没有到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些话是耶稣在殿里教导人的时候，在银库的院中说的。当时没有人逮捕他，因为他的时候还没有到。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些话是耶稣在殿里的库房、教训人时所说的，也没有人拿他，因为他的时候还没有到。
verses.textEnNiv: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts near the place where the offerings were put. Yet no one seized him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.textEnEsv: These words he spoke in the treasury, as he taught in the temple; but no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.textEnNkjv: These words Jesus spoke in the treasury, as He taught in the temple; and no one laid hands on Him, for His hour had not yet come.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus made these statements while he was teaching in the section of the Temple known as the Treasury. But he was not arrested, because his time had not yet come.
verses.textEnNasb: These words He spoke in the treasury, as He taught in the temple area; and no one arrested Him, because His hour had not yet come.
verses.textEn: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts near the place where the offerings were put. Yet no one seized him, because his hour had not yet come.

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>我要去了，你们要寻找我，并且要在自己的罪中死亡；我去的地方，你们不能到。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>我要去了，你们要寻找我，并且要在自己的罪中死亡；我去的地方，你们不能到。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又对他们说：「<red>我要去了，你们要找我，并且你们要死在罪中。我所去的地方，你们不能到。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Once more Jesus said to them, <red>“I am going away, and you will look for me, and you will die in your sin. Where I go, you cannot come.”</red>
