verses.textEnEsv: So he said to them again, "I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them again, "I am going away, and you will seek Me, and will die in your sin. Where I go you cannot come."
verses.textEnNlt: Later Jesus said to them again, "I am going away. You will search for me but will die in your sin. You cannot come where I am going."
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said again to them, "I am going away, and you will look for Me, and will die in your sin; where I am going, you cannot come."
verses.textEn: Once more Jesus said to them, <red>“I am going away, and you will look for me, and you will die in your sin. Where I go, you cannot come.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是犹太人说："<red>他说‘我去的地方，你们不能到’，难道他要自杀吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是犹太人说："<red>他说‘我去的地方，你们不能到’，难道他要自杀吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人说：「<red>他说『我所去的地方，你们不能到』，难道他要自尽吗？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: This made the Jews ask, “Will he kill himself? Is that why he says, <red>‘Where I go, you cannot come’?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So the Jews said, "Will he kill himself, since he says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Jews said, "Will He kill Himself, because He says, ‘Where I go you cannot come’?"
verses.textEnNlt: The people asked, "Is he planning to commit suicide? What does he mean, ‘You cannot come where I am going’?"
verses.textEnNasb: So the Jews were saying, "Surely He will not kill Himself, will He, since He says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?"
verses.textEn: This made the Jews ask, “Will he kill himself? Is that why he says, <red>‘Where I go, you cannot come’?”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>你们是从地上来的，我是从天上来的；你们属这世界，我却不属这世界，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>你们是从地上来的，我是从天上来的；你们属这世界，我却不属这世界，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「你们是从下头来的，我是从上头来的；你们是属这世界的，我不是属这世界的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: But he continued, <red>“You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "You are from beneath; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus continued, "You are from below; I am from above. You belong to this world; I do not.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying to them, "You are from below, I am from above; you are of this world, I am not of this world.
verses.textEn: But he continued, <red>“You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以我对你们说，你们要在自己的罪中死亡；你们若不信我就是‘那一位’，就要在自己的罪中死亡。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以我对你们说，你们要在自己的罪中死亡；你们若不信我就是‘那一位’，就要在自己的罪中死亡。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以我对你们说，你们要死在罪中。你们若不信我是基督，必要死在罪中。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I told you that you would die in your sins; if you do not believe that I am he, you will indeed die in your sins.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I told you that you would die in your sins, for unless you believe that I am he you will die in your sins."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I said to you that you will die in your sins; for if you do not believe that I am He, you will die in your sins."
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I said that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I Am who I claim to be, you will die in your sins."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I said to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am, you will die in your sins."
verses.textEn: <red>I told you that you would die in your sins; if you do not believe that I am he, you will indeed die in your sins.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们就问："你是谁？"耶稣说："<red>我不是从起初就告诉你们吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就问："你是谁？"耶稣说："<red>我不是从起初就告诉你们吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就问他说：「<red>你是谁？</red>」耶稣对他们说：「就是我从起初所告诉你们的。
verses.textEnNiv: “Who are you?” they asked. <red>“Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,”</red> Jesus replied.
verses.textEnEsv: So they said to him, "Who are you?" Jesus said to them, "Just what I have been telling you from the beginning.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to Him, "Who are You?" And Jesus said to them, "Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
verses.textEnNlt: "Who are you?" they demanded. Jesus replied, "The one I have always claimed to be.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they were saying to Him, "Who are You?" Jesus said to them, " What have I even been saying to you from the beginning?
verses.textEn: “Who are you?” they asked. <red>“Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,”</red> Jesus replied.

verses.textZh: <red>关于你们，我有许多事要说，要判断；但那差我来的是真实的，我从他那里听见的，就告诉世人。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>关于你们，我有许多事要说，要判断；但那差我来的是真实的，我从他那里听见的，就告诉世人。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我有许多事讲论你们，判断你们；但那差我来的是真的，我在他那里所听见的，我就传给世人。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I have much to say in judgment of you. But he who sent me is trustworthy, and what I have heard from him I tell the world.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I have much to say about you and much to judge, but he who sent me is true, and I declare to the world what I have heard from him."
verses.textEnNkjv: I have many things to say and to judge concerning you, but He who sent Me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I heard from Him."
verses.textEnNlt: I have much to say about you and much to condemn, but I won’t. For I say only what I have heard from the one who sent me, and he is completely truthful."
verses.textEnNasb: I have many things to say and to judge regarding you, but He who sent Me is true; and the things which I heard from Him, these I say to the world."
verses.textEn: <red>“I have much to say in judgment of you. But he who sent me is trustworthy, and what I have heard from him I tell the world.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们不明白耶稣是对他们讲论父的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不明白耶稣是对他们讲论父的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不明白耶稣是指着父说的。
verses.textEnNiv: They did not understand that he was telling them about his Father.
verses.textEnEsv: They did not understand that he had been speaking to them about the Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: They did not understand that He spoke to them of the Father.
verses.textEnNlt: But they still didn’t understand that he was talking about his Father.
verses.textEnNasb: They did not realize that He was speaking to them about the Father.
verses.textEn: They did not understand that he was telling them about his Father.

verses.textZh: 所以耶稣说："<red>你们举起了人子以后，必定知道我就是‘那一位’，并且知道我不凭着自己作甚么事；我说的这些话，是照着父所教导我的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶稣说："<red>你们举起了人子以后，必定知道我就是‘那一位’，并且知道我不凭着自己作甚么事；我说的这些话，是照着父所教导我的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以耶稣说：「你们举起人子以后，必知道我是基督，并且知道我没有一件事是凭着自己做的。我说这些话乃是照着父所教训我的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: So Jesus said, <red>“When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he and that I do nothing on my own but speak just what the Father has taught me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus said to them, "When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and that I do nothing on my own authority, but speak just as the Father taught me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "When you lift up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He, and that I do nothing of Myself; but as My Father taught Me, I speak these things.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus said, "When you have lifted up the Son of Man on the cross, then you will understand that I Am he. I do nothing on my own but say only what the Father taught me.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus said, "When you lift up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am, and I do nothing on My own, but I say these things as the Father instructed Me.
verses.textEn: So Jesus said, <red>“When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he and that I do nothing on my own but speak just what the Father has taught me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那差我来的和我同在，他没有留下我独自一人，因为我常作他喜悦的事。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那差我来的和我同在，他没有留下我独自一人，因为我常作他喜悦的事。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那差我来的是与我同在；他没有撇下我独自在这里，因为我常做他所喜悦的事。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The one who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, for I always do what pleases him.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he who sent me is with me. He has not left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He who sent Me is with Me. The Father has not left Me alone, for I always do those things that please Him."
verses.textEnNlt: And the one who sent me is with me—he has not deserted me. For I always do what pleases him."
verses.textEnNasb: And He who sent Me is with Me; He has not left Me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to Him."
verses.textEn: <red>The one who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, for I always do what pleases him.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说这些话的时候，就有许多人信了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说这些话的时候，就有许多人信了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说这话的时候，就有许多人信他。
verses.textEnNiv: Even as he spoke, many believed in him.
verses.textEnEsv: As he was saying these things, many believed in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: As He spoke these words, many believed in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then many who heard him say these things believed in him.
verses.textEnNasb: As He said these things, many came to believe in Him.
verses.textEn: Even as he spoke, many believed in him.

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣对信了他的犹太人说："<red>你们若持守我的道，就真是我的门徒了；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣对信了他的犹太人说："<red>你们若持守我的道，就真是我的门徒了；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对信他的犹太人说：「你们若常常遵守我的道，就真是我的门徒；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: To the Jews who had believed him, Jesus said, <red>“If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus said to the Jews who had believed him, "If you abide in my word, you are truly my disciples,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to those Jews who believed Him, "If you abide in My word, you are My disciples indeed.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said to the people who believed in him, "You are truly my disciples if you remain faithful to my teachings.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus was saying to those Jews who had believed Him, "If you continue in My word, then you are truly My disciples;
verses.textEn: To the Jews who had believed him, Jesus said, <red>“If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们必定认识真理，真理必定使你们自由。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们必定认识真理，真理必定使你们自由。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们必晓得真理，真理必叫你们得以自由。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free."
verses.textEnNlt: And you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."
verses.textEnNasb: and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."
verses.textEn: <red>Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们说："我们是亚伯拉罕的后裔，从来没有被谁奴役过，你怎么说‘你们必得自由’呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："我们是亚伯拉罕的后裔，从来没有被谁奴役过，你怎么说‘你们必得自由’呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答说：「我们是亚伯拉罕的后裔，从来没有作过谁的奴仆。你怎么说『你们必得以自由』呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: They answered him, "We are Abraham’s descendants and have never been slaves of anyone. How can you say that we shall be set free?"
verses.textEnEsv: They answered him, "We are offspring of Abraham and have never been enslaved to anyone. How is it that you say, ‘You will become free’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: They answered Him, "We are Abraham’s descendants, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How can You say, ‘You will be made free’?"
verses.textEnNlt: "But we are descendants of Abraham," they said. "We have never been slaves to anyone. What do you mean, ‘You will be set free’?"
verses.textEnNasb: They answered Him, "We are Abraham’s descendants and have never been enslaved to anyone; how is it that You say, ‘You will become free’?"
verses.textEn: They answered him, "We are Abraham’s descendants and have never been slaves of anyone. How can you say that we shall be set free?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，凡犯罪的都是罪的奴隶。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，凡犯罪的都是罪的奴隶。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，所有犯罪的就是罪的奴仆。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Very truly I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "Truly, truly, I say to you, everyone who practices sin is a slave to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, whoever commits sin is a slave of sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, everyone who sins is a slave of sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered them, "Truly, truly I say to you, everyone who commits sin is a slave of sin.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Very truly I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>奴隶不能永远住在家里，唯有儿子才可以永远住在家里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>奴隶不能永远住在家里，唯有儿子才可以永远住在家里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>奴仆不能永远住在家里；儿子是永远住在家里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Now a slave has no permanent place in the family, but a son belongs to it forever.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The slave does not remain in the house forever; the son remains forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a slave does not abide in the house forever, but a son abides forever.
verses.textEnNlt: A slave is not a permanent member of the family, but a son is part of the family forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the slave does not remain in the house forever; the son does remain forever.
verses.textEn: <red>Now a slave has no permanent place in the family, but a son belongs to it forever.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，神的儿子若使你们自由，你们就真的得自由了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，神的儿子若使你们自由，你们就真的得自由了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以天父的儿子若叫你们自由，你们就真自由了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore if the Son makes you free, you shall be free indeed.
verses.textEnNlt: So if the Son sets you free, you are truly free.
verses.textEnNasb: So if the Son sets you free, you really will be free.
verses.textEn: <red>So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我知道你们是亚伯拉罕的后裔；但你们想杀我，因为你们心里不能容纳我的道。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我知道你们是亚伯拉罕的后裔；但你们想杀我，因为你们心里不能容纳我的道。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我知道你们是亚伯拉罕的子孙，你们却想要杀我，因为你们心里容不下我的道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I know that you are Abraham’s descendants. Yet you are looking for a way to kill me, because you have no room for my word.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I know that you are offspring of Abraham; yet you seek to kill me because my word finds no place in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I know that you are Abraham’s descendants, but you seek to kill Me, because My word has no place in you.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I realize that you are descendants of Abraham. And yet some of you are trying to kill me because there’s no room in your hearts for my message.
verses.textEnNasb: I know that you are Abraham’s descendants; yet you are seeking to kill Me, because My word has no place in you.
verses.textEn: <red>I know that you are Abraham’s descendants. Yet you are looking for a way to kill me, because you have no room for my word.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我所说的，是我在父那里看见的；但你们所作的，却是从你们的父那里听见的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我所说的，是我在父那里看见的；但你们所作的，却是从你们的父那里听见的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我所说的是在我父那里看见的；你们所行的是在你们的父那里听见的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I am telling you what I have seen in the Father’s presence, and you are doing what you have heard from your father.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I speak of what I have seen with my Father, and you do what you have heard from your father."
verses.textEnNkjv: I speak what I have seen with My Father, and you do what you have seen with your father."
verses.textEnNlt: I am telling you what I saw when I was with my Father. But you are following the advice of your father."
verses.textEnNasb: I speak of the things which I have seen with My Father; therefore you also do the things which you heard from your father."
verses.textEn: <red>I am telling you what I have seen in the Father’s presence, and you are doing what you have heard from your father.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们说："<red>我们的祖宗是亚伯拉罕。</red>"耶稣说："<red>你们若是亚伯拉罕的子孙，就必作亚伯拉罕所作的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："<red>我们的祖宗是亚伯拉罕。</red>"耶稣说："<red>你们若是亚伯拉罕的子孙，就必作亚伯拉罕所作的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「<red>我们的父就是亚伯拉罕。</red>」耶稣说：「你们若是亚伯拉罕的儿子，就必行亚伯拉罕所行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: “Abraham is our father,” they answered. <red>“If you were Abraham’s children,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“then you would do what Abraham did.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They answered him, "Abraham is our father." Jesus said to them, "If you were Abraham’s children, you would be doing the works Abraham did,
verses.textEnNkjv: They answered and said to Him, "Abraham is our father." Jesus said to them, "If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
verses.textEnNlt: "Our father is Abraham!" they declared. "No," Jesus replied, "for if you were really the children of Abraham, you would follow his example.
verses.textEnNasb: They answered and said to Him, "Abraham is our father." Jesus *said to them, "If you are Abraham’s children, do the deeds of Abraham.
verses.textEn: “Abraham is our father,” they answered. <red>“If you were Abraham’s children,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“then you would do what Abraham did.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>现在我把从神那里听见的真理告诉了你们，你们竟然想杀我，这不是亚伯拉罕所作的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>现在我把从神那里听见的真理告诉了你们，你们竟然想杀我，这不是亚伯拉罕所作的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我将在神那里所听见的真理告诉了你们，现在你们却想要杀我，这不是亚伯拉罕所行的事。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>As it is, you are looking for a way to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do such things.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. This is not what Abraham did.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now you seek to kill Me, a Man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham did not do this.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, you are trying to kill me because I told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham never did such a thing.
verses.textEnNasb: But as it is, you are seeking to kill Me, a Man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God; this Abraham did not do.
verses.textEn: <red>As it is, you are looking for a way to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do such things.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要作的，正是你们的父要作的。"他们说："我们不是从淫乱生的；我们只有一位父，就是神。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要作的，正是你们的父要作的。"他们说："我们不是从淫乱生的；我们只有一位父，就是神。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 你们是行你们父所行的事。」他们说：「<red>我们不是从淫乱生的；我们只有一位父，就是神。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You are doing the works of your own father.”</red> “We are not illegitimate children,” they protested. “The only Father we have is God himself.”
verses.textEnEsv: You are doing the works your father did." They said to him, "We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father—even God."
verses.textEnNkjv: You do the deeds of your father." Then they said to Him, "We were not born of fornication; we have one Father—God."
verses.textEnNlt: No, you are imitating your real father." They replied, "We aren’t illegitimate children! God himself is our true Father."
verses.textEnNasb: You are doing the deeds of your father." They said to Him, "We were not born as a result of sexual immorality; we have one Father: God."
verses.textEn: <red>You are doing the works of your own father.”</red> “We are not illegitimate children,” they protested. “The only Father we have is God himself.”

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>如果神是你们的父，你们就必爱我，因为我是从神那里来的；我已经来到这里。我不是凭着自己来的，而是神差了我来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>如果神是你们的父，你们就必爱我，因为我是从神那里来的；我已经来到这里。我不是凭着自己来的，而是神差了我来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「倘若神是你们的父，你们就必爱我；因为我本是出于神，也是从神而来，并不是由着自己来，乃是他差我来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to them, <red>“If God were your Father, you would love me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on my own; God sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "If God were your Father, you would love me, for I came from God and I am here. I came not of my own accord, but he sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to them, "If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I proceeded forth and came from God; nor have I come of Myself, but He sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told them, "If God were your Father, you would love me, because I have come to you from God. I am not here on my own, but he sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to them, "If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I came forth from God and am here; for I have not even come on My own, but He sent Me.
verses.textEn: Jesus said to them, <red>“If God were your Father, you would love me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on my own; God sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们为甚么不明白我的话呢？因为我的道你们听不进去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们为甚么不明白我的话呢？因为我的道你们听不进去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们为什么不明白我的话呢？无非是因你们不能听我的道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Why is my language not clear to you? Because you are unable to hear what I say.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you not understand what I say? It is because you cannot bear to hear my word.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you not understand My speech? Because you are not able to listen to My word.
verses.textEnNlt: Why can’t you understand what I am saying? It’s because you can’t even hear me!
verses.textEnNasb: Why do you not understand what I am saying? It is because you cannot listen to My word.
verses.textEn: <red>Why is my language not clear to you? Because you are unable to hear what I say.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们是出于你们的父魔鬼，喜欢按着你们的父的私欲行事。他从起初就是杀人的凶手，不守真理，因为他心里没有真理。他说谎是出于本性，因为他本来就是说谎者，也是说谎的人的父。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们是出于你们的父魔鬼，喜欢按着你们的父的私欲行事。他从起初就是杀人的凶手，不守真理，因为他心里没有真理。他说谎是出于本性，因为他本来就是说谎者，也是说谎的人的父。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们是出于你们的父魔鬼，你们父的私欲你们偏要行。他从起初是杀人的，不守真理，因他心里没有真理。他说谎是出于自己；因他本来是说谎的，也是说谎之人的父。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, not holding to the truth, for there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, for he is a liar and the father of lies.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You are of your father the devil, and your will is to do your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks out of his own character, for he is a liar and the father of lies.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are of your father the devil, and the desires of your father you want to do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks from his own resources, for he is a liar and the father of it.
verses.textEnNlt: For you are the children of your father the devil, and you love to do the evil things he does. He was a murderer from the beginning. He has always hated the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, it is consistent with his character; for he is a liar and the father of lies.
verses.textEnNasb: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth because there is no truth in him. Whenever he tells a lie, he speaks from his own nature, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
verses.textEn: <red>You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, not holding to the truth, for there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, for he is a liar and the father of lies.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我讲真理，你们却因此不信我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我讲真理，你们却因此不信我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我将真理告诉你们，你们就因此不信我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Yet because I tell the truth, you do not believe me!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But because I tell the truth, you do not believe me.
verses.textEnNkjv: But because I tell the truth, you do not believe Me.
verses.textEnNlt: So when I tell the truth, you just naturally don’t believe me!
verses.textEnNasb: But because I say the truth, you do not believe Me.
verses.textEn: <red>Yet because I tell the truth, you do not believe me!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们中间有谁能指证我有罪呢？我既然讲真理，你们为甚么不信我呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们中间有谁能指证我有罪呢？我既然讲真理，你们为甚么不信我呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们中间谁能指证我有罪呢？我既然将真理告诉你们，为什么不信我呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Can any of you prove me guilty of sin? If I am telling the truth, why don’t you believe me?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Which one of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
verses.textEnNkjv: Which of you convicts Me of sin? And if I tell the truth, why do you not believe Me?
verses.textEnNlt: Which of you can truthfully accuse me of sin? And since I am telling you the truth, why don’t you believe me?
verses.textEnNasb: Which one of you convicts Me of sin? If I speak truth, why do you not believe Me?
verses.textEn: <red>Can any of you prove me guilty of sin? If I am telling the truth, why don’t you believe me?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>出于神的，就听神的话；你们不听，因为你们不是出于神的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>出于神的，就听神的话；你们不听，因为你们不是出于神的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>出于神的，必听神的话；你们不听，因为你们不是出于神。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever belongs to God hears what God says. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is of God hears the words of God. The reason why you do not hear them is that you are not of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is of God hears God’s words; therefore you do not hear, because you are not of God."
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who belongs to God listens gladly to the words of God. But you don’t listen because you don’t belong to God."
verses.textEnNasb: The one who is of God hears the words of God; for this reason you do not hear them, because you are not of God."
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever belongs to God hears what God says. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”</red>

verses.textZh: 犹太人对耶稣说："我们说你是撒玛利亚人，并且是鬼附的，不是很对吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人对耶稣说："我们说你是撒玛利亚人，并且是鬼附的，不是很对吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人回答说：「我们说你是撒马利亚人，并且是鬼附着的，这话岂不正对吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: The Jews answered him, "Aren’t we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?"
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews answered him, "Are we not right in saying that you are a Samaritan and have a demon?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Jews answered and said to Him, "Do we not say rightly that You are a Samaritan and have a demon?"
verses.textEnNlt: The people retorted, "You Samaritan devil! Didn’t we say all along that you were possessed by a demon?"
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews answered and said to Him, "Do we not rightly say that You are a Samaritan, and You have a demon?"
verses.textEn: The Jews answered him, "Aren’t we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣回答："我不是鬼附的。我尊敬我的父，你们却侮辱我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣回答："我不是鬼附的。我尊敬我的父，你们却侮辱我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「我不是鬼附着的；我尊敬我的父，你们倒轻慢我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I am not possessed by a demon,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "I do not have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered, "I do not have a demon; but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "No," Jesus said, "I have no demon in me. For I honor my Father—and you dishonor me.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered, "I do not have a demon; on the contrary, I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
verses.textEn: <red>“I am not possessed by a demon,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我不求自己的荣耀，但有一位是为我求荣耀，并且是审判人的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我不求自己的荣耀，但有一位是为我求荣耀，并且是审判人的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我不求自己的荣耀，有一位为我求荣耀、定是非的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I am not seeking glory for myself; but there is one who seeks it, and he is the judge.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Yet I do not seek my own glory; there is One who seeks it, and he is the judge.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I do not seek My own glory; there is One who seeks and judges.
verses.textEnNlt: And though I have no wish to glorify myself, God is going to glorify me. He is the true judge.
verses.textEnNasb: But I am not seeking My glory; there is One who seeks it, and judges.
verses.textEn: <red>I am not seeking glory for myself; but there is one who seeks it, and he is the judge.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，人若遵守我的道，必定永远不见死亡。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，人若遵守我的道，必定永远不见死亡。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实实在在地告诉你们，人若遵守我的道，就永远不见死。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Very truly I tell you, whoever obeys my word will never see death.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, truly, I say to you, if anyone keeps my word, he will never see death."
verses.textEnNkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, if anyone keeps My word he shall never see death."
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, anyone who obeys my teaching will never die!"
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, truly I say to you, if anyone follows My word, he will never see death."
verses.textEn: <red>Very truly I tell you, whoever obeys my word will never see death.”</red>

verses.textZh: 犹太人对他说："现在我们知道你的确是鬼附的。亚伯拉罕死了，先知们也死了，你还说‘人若遵守我的道，必定永远不尝死味’，
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人对他说："现在我们知道你的确是鬼附的。亚伯拉罕死了，先知们也死了，你还说‘人若遵守我的道，必定永远不尝死味’，
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人对他说：「现在我们知道你是鬼附着的。亚伯拉罕死了，众先知也死了，你还说：『人若遵守我的道，就永远不尝死味。』
verses.textEnNiv: At this they exclaimed, "Now we know that you are demon-possessed! Abraham died and so did the prophets, yet you say that whoever obeys your word will never taste death.
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews said to him, "Now we know that you have a demon! Abraham died, as did the prophets, yet you say, ‘If anyone keeps my word, he will never taste death.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Jews said to Him, "Now we know that You have a demon! Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and You say, ‘If anyone keeps My word he shall never taste death.’
verses.textEnNlt: The people said, "Now we know you are possessed by a demon. Even Abraham and the prophets died, but you say, ‘Anyone who obeys my teaching will never die!’
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews said to Him, "Now we know that You have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets as well; and yet You say, ‘If anyone follows My word, he will never taste of death.’
verses.textEn: At this they exclaimed, "Now we know that you are demon-possessed! Abraham died and so did the prophets, yet you say that whoever obeys your word will never taste death.

verses.textZh: 难道你比我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕还大吗？他死了，先知们也死了；你把自己当作甚么人呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道你比我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕还大吗？他死了，先知们也死了；你把自己当作甚么人呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 难道你比我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕还大吗？他死了，众先知也死了，你将自己当作什么人呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?"
verses.textEnEsv: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? And the prophets died! Who do you make yourself out to be?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Are You greater than our father Abraham, who is dead? And the prophets are dead. Who do You make Yourself out to be?"
verses.textEnNlt: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?"
verses.textEnNasb: You are not greater than our father Abraham, who died, are You? The prophets died too. Whom do You make Yourself out to be?"
verses.textEn: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："如果我荣耀自己，我的荣耀就算不得甚么；那使我得荣耀的是我的父，就是你们说是你们的神的那一位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："如果我荣耀自己，我的荣耀就算不得甚么；那使我得荣耀的是我的父，就是你们说是你们的神的那一位。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「我若荣耀自己，我的荣耀就算不得什么；荣耀我的乃是我的父，就是你们所说是你们的神。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“If I glorify myself, my glory means nothing. My Father, whom you claim as your God, is the one who glorifies me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered, "If I honor Myself, My honor is nothing. It is My Father who honors Me, of whom you say that He is your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus answered, "If I want glory for myself, it doesn’t count. But it is my Father who will glorify me. You say, ‘He is our God,’
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered, "If I glorify Myself, My glory is nothing; it is My Father who glorifies Me, of whom you say, ‘He is our God’;
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“If I glorify myself, my glory means nothing. My Father, whom you claim as your God, is the one who glorifies me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是你们不认识他，我却认识他。如果我说我不认识他，我就像你们一样是说谎的；然而我认识他，也遵守他的道。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>可是你们不认识他，我却认识他。如果我说我不认识他，我就像你们一样是说谎的；然而我认识他，也遵守他的道。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们未曾认识他；我却认识他。我若说不认识他，我就是说谎的，像你们一样；但我认识他，也遵守他的道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Though you do not know him, I know him. If I said I did not, I would be a liar like you, but I do know him and obey his word.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But you have not known him. I know him. If I were to say that I do not know him, I would be a liar like you, but I do know him and I keep his word.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet you have not known Him, but I know Him. And if I say, ‘I do not know Him,’ I shall be a liar like you; but I do know Him and keep His word.
verses.textEnNlt: but you don’t even know him. I know him. If I said otherwise, I would be as great a liar as you! But I do know him and obey him.
verses.textEnNasb: and you have not come to know Him, but I know Him. And if I say that I do not know Him, I will be a liar like you; but I do know Him, and I follow His word.
verses.textEn: <red>Though you do not know him, I know him. If I said I did not, I would be a liar like you, but I do know him and obey his word.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕，因为可以看见我的日子就欢喜，既然看见了，他就很快乐。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕，因为可以看见我的日子就欢喜，既然看见了，他就很快乐。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕欢欢喜喜地仰望我的日子，既看见了就快乐。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see my day. He saw it and was glad."
verses.textEnNkjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see My day, and he saw it and was glad."
verses.textEnNlt: Your father Abraham rejoiced as he looked forward to my coming. He saw it and was glad."
verses.textEnNasb: Your father Abraham was overjoyed that he would see My day, and he saw it and rejoiced."
verses.textEn: <red>Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad.”</red>

verses.textZh: 犹太人对他说："你还不到五十岁，怎会见过亚伯拉罕呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人对他说："你还不到五十岁，怎会见过亚伯拉罕呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人说：「你还没有五十岁，岂见过亚伯拉罕呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "You are not yet fifty years old," they said to him, "and you have seen Abraham!"
verses.textEnEsv: So the Jews said to him, "You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Jews said to Him, "You are not yet fifty years old, and have You seen Abraham?"
verses.textEnNlt: The people said, "You aren’t even fifty years old. How can you say you have seen Abraham? "
verses.textEnNasb: So the Jews said to Him, "You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?"
verses.textEn: "You are not yet fifty years old," they said to him, "and you have seen Abraham!"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："我实实在在告诉你们，亚伯拉罕出生以前，我已经存在了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："我实实在在告诉你们，亚伯拉罕出生以前，我已经存在了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我实实在在地告诉你们，还没有亚伯拉罕就有了我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Very truly I tell you,”</red> Jesus answered, <red>“before Abraham was born, I am!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "Truly, truly, I say to you, before Abraham was, I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, before Abraham was, I AM."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus answered, "I tell you the truth, before Abraham was even born, I Am ! "
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to them, "Truly, truly I say to you, before Abraham was born, I am."
verses.textEn: <red>“Very truly I tell you,”</red> Jesus answered, <red>“before Abraham was born, I am!”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他们拿起石头要打他。耶稣却躲起来，从殿里出去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们拿起石头要打他。耶稣却躲起来，从殿里出去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是他们拿石头要打他；耶稣却躲藏，从殿里出去了。
verses.textEnNiv: At this, they picked up stones to stone him, but Jesus hid himself, slipping away from the temple grounds.
verses.textEnEsv: So they picked up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they took up stones to throw at Him; but Jesus hid Himself and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
verses.textEnNlt: At that point they picked up stones to throw at him. But Jesus was hidden from them and left the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore they picked up stones to throw at Him, but Jesus hid Himself and left the temple grounds.
verses.textEn: At this, they picked up stones to stone him, but Jesus hid himself, slipping away from the temple grounds.

verses.textZh: 耶稣走路的时候，看见一个生下来就瞎眼的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣走路的时候，看见一个生下来就瞎眼的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣过去的时候，看见一个人生来是瞎眼的。
verses.textEnNiv: As he went along, he saw a man blind from birth.
verses.textEnEsv: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as Jesus passed by, He saw a man who was blind from birth.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus was walking along, he saw a man who had been blind from birth.
verses.textEnNasb: As Jesus passed by, He saw a man who had been blind from birth.
verses.textEn: As he went along, he saw a man blind from birth.

verses.textZh: 他的门徒问他："拉比，这人生下来就瞎眼，是谁犯了罪？是他呢，还是他的父母呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的门徒问他："拉比，这人生下来就瞎眼，是谁犯了罪？是他呢，还是他的父母呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒问耶稣说：「拉比，这人生来是瞎眼的，是谁犯了罪？是这人呢？是他父母呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: His disciples asked him, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"
verses.textEnEsv: And his disciples asked him, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And His disciples asked Him, saying, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Rabbi," his disciples asked him, "why was this man born blind? Was it because of his own sins or his parents’ sins?"
verses.textEnNasb: And His disciples asked Him, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he would be born blind?"
verses.textEn: His disciples asked him, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣回答："不是他犯了罪，也不是他的父母犯了罪，而是要在他身上彰显神的作为。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣回答："不是他犯了罪，也不是他的父母犯了罪，而是要在他身上彰显神的作为。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「也不是这人犯了罪，也不是他父母犯了罪，是要在他身上显出神的作为来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Neither this man nor his parents sinned,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“but this happened so that the works of God might be displayed in him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "It was not that this man sinned, or his parents, but that the works of God might be displayed in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered, "Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but that the works of God should be revealed in him.
verses.textEnNlt: "It was not because of his sins or his parents’ sins," Jesus answered. "This happened so the power of God could be seen in him.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered, "It was neither that this man sinned, nor his parents; but it was so that the works of God might be displayed in him.
verses.textEn: <red>“Neither this man nor his parents sinned,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“but this happened so that the works of God might be displayed in him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>趁着白昼，我们必须作那差我来者的工；黑夜一到，就没有人能作工了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>趁着白昼，我们必须作那差我来者的工；黑夜一到，就没有人能作工了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>趁着白日，我们必须做那差我来者的工；黑夜将到，就没有人能做工了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>As long as it is day, we must do the works of him who sent me. Night is coming, when no one can work.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: We must work the works of him who sent me while it is day; night is coming, when no one can work.
verses.textEnNkjv: I must work the works of Him who sent Me while it is day; the night is coming when no one can work.
verses.textEnNlt: We must quickly carry out the tasks assigned us by the one who sent us. The night is coming, and then no one can work.
verses.textEnNasb: We must carry out the works of Him who sent Me as long as it is day; night is coming, when no one can work.
verses.textEn: <red>As long as it is day, we must do the works of him who sent me. Night is coming, when no one can work.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我在世上的时候，是世界的光。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我在世上的时候，是世界的光。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我在世上的时候，是世上的光。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world."
verses.textEnNkjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world."
verses.textEnNlt: But while I am here in the world, I am the light of the world."
verses.textEnNasb: While I am in the world, I am the Light of the world."
verses.textEn: <red>While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”</red>

verses.textZh: 说了这话，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和了一点泥，把泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 说了这话，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和了一点泥，把泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说了这话，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
verses.textEnNiv: After saying this, he spit on the ground, made some mud with the saliva, and put it on the man’s eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: Having said these things, he spit on the ground and made mud with the saliva. Then he anointed the man’s eyes with the mud
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had said these things, He spat on the ground and made clay with the saliva; and He anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he spit on the ground, made mud with the saliva, and spread the mud over the blind man’s eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: When He had said this, He spit on the ground, and made mud from the saliva, and applied the mud to his eyes,
verses.textEn: After saying this, he spit on the ground, made some mud with the saliva, and put it on the man’s eyes.

verses.textZh: <red>对他说："你去西罗亚池洗一洗吧。" 于是他就去了，洗完了，走的时候，就看见了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>对他说："你去西罗亚池洗一洗吧。" 于是他就去了，洗完了，走的时候，就看见了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「<red>你往西罗亚池子里去洗。</red>」（西罗亚翻出来就是「奉差遣」。）他去一洗，回头就看见了。
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Go,”</red> he told him, <red>“wash in the Pool of Siloam”</red> (this word means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to him, "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam" (which means Sent). So he went and washed and came back seeing.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to him, "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam" (which is translated, Sent). So he went and washed, and came back seeing.
verses.textEnNlt: He told him, "Go wash yourself in the pool of Siloam" (Siloam means "sent"). So the man went and washed and came back seeing!
verses.textEnNasb: and said to him, "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam" (which is translated, Sent). So he left and washed, and came back seeing.
verses.textEn: <red>“Go,”</red> he told him, <red>“wash in the Pool of Siloam”</red> (this word means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.

verses.textZh: 那时，邻居和以前常常见他讨饭的人说："这不是那一向坐着讨饭的人吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，邻居和以前常常见他讨饭的人说："这不是那一向坐着讨饭的人吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的邻舍和那素常见他是讨饭的，就说：「这不是那从前坐着讨饭的人吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: His neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging asked, "Isn’t this the same man who used to sit and beg?"
verses.textEnEsv: The neighbors and those who had seen him before as a beggar were saying, "Is this not the man who used to sit and beg?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the neighbors and those who previously had seen that he was blind said, "Is not this he who sat and begged?"
verses.textEnNlt: His neighbors and others who knew him as a blind beggar asked each other, "Isn’t this the man who used to sit and beg?"
verses.textEnNasb: So the neighbors, and those who previously saw him as a beggar, were saying, "Is this not the one who used to sit and beg?"
verses.textEn: His neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging asked, "Isn’t this the same man who used to sit and beg?"

verses.textZh: 有的说："是他。"有的说："不是他，只是像他。"他自己说："是我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有的说："是他。"有的说："不是他，只是像他。"他自己说："是我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人说：「是他」；又有人说：「不是，却是像他。」他自己说：「是我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Some claimed that he was. Others said, "No, he only looks like him." But he himself insisted, "I am the man."
verses.textEnEsv: Some said, "It is he." Others said, "No, but he is like him." He kept saying, "I am the man."
verses.textEnNkjv: Some said, "This is he." Others said, "He is like him." He said, "I am he."
verses.textEnNlt: Some said he was, and others said, "No, he just looks like him!" But the beggar kept saying, "Yes, I am the same one!"
verses.textEnNasb: Others were saying, "This is he," still others were saying, "No, but he is like him." The man himself kept saying, "I am the one."
verses.textEn: Some claimed that he was. Others said, "No, he only looks like him." But he himself insisted, "I am the man."

verses.textZh: 他们就问他："你的眼睛是怎样开的呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就问他："你的眼睛是怎样开的呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对他说：「你的眼睛是怎么开的呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "How then were your eyes opened?" they asked.
verses.textEnEsv: So they said to him, "Then how were your eyes opened?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they said to him, "How were your eyes opened?"
verses.textEnNlt: They asked, "Who healed you? What happened?"
verses.textEnNasb: So they were saying to him, "How then were your eyes opened?"
verses.textEn: "How then were your eyes opened?" they asked.

verses.textZh: 他回答："那名叫耶稣的人和了一点泥，抹在我的眼上，对我说：‘你去西罗亚池洗一洗吧。’我去一洗，就看见了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："那名叫耶稣的人和了一点泥，抹在我的眼上，对我说：‘你去西罗亚池洗一洗吧。’我去一洗，就看见了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他回答说：「有一个人，名叫耶稣，他和泥抹我的眼睛，对我说：『你往西罗亚池子去洗。』我去一洗，就看见了。」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "The man they call Jesus made some mud and put it on my eyes. He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed, and then I could see."
verses.textEnEsv: He answered, "The man called Jesus made mud and anointed my eyes and said to me, ‘Go to Siloam and wash.’ So I went and washed and received my sight."
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered and said, "A Man called Jesus made clay and anointed my eyes and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went and washed, and I received sight."
verses.textEnNlt: He told them, "The man they call Jesus made mud and spread it over my eyes and told me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash yourself.’ So I went and washed, and now I can see!"
verses.textEnNasb: He answered, "The Man who is called Jesus made mud, and spread it on my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to Siloam and wash’; so I went away and washed, and I received sight."
verses.textEn: He replied, "The man they call Jesus made some mud and put it on my eyes. He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed, and then I could see."

verses.textZh: 他们说："那人在哪里？"他说："我不知道。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："那人在哪里？"他说："我不知道。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「那个人在哪里？」他说：「我不知道。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Where is this man?" they asked him. "I don’t know," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "Where is he?" He said, "I do not know."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to him, "Where is He?" He said, "I do not know."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where is he now?" they asked. "I don’t know," he replied.
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to him, "Where is He?" He *said, "I do not know."
verses.textEn: "Where is this man?" they asked him. "I don’t know," he said.

verses.textZh: 他们就把那个从前瞎眼的人带到法利赛人那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就把那个从前瞎眼的人带到法利赛人那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们把从前瞎眼的人带到法利赛人那里。
verses.textEnNiv: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.
verses.textEnEsv: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had formerly been blind.
verses.textEnNkjv: They brought him who formerly was blind to the Pharisees.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they took the man who had been blind to the Pharisees,
verses.textEnNasb: They *brought the man who was previously blind to the Pharisees.
verses.textEn: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.

verses.textZh: 耶稣和了泥开他眼睛的那一天，正是安息日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣和了泥开他眼睛的那一天，正是安息日。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣和泥开他眼睛的日子是安息日。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened the man’s eyes was a Sabbath.
verses.textEnEsv: Now it was a Sabbath day when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was a Sabbath when Jesus made the clay and opened his eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: because it was on the Sabbath that Jesus had made the mud and healed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was a Sabbath on the day that Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
verses.textEn: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened the man’s eyes was a Sabbath.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人又问他是怎样可以看见的。他告诉他们："耶稣把泥抹在我的眼上，我一洗就看见了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人又问他是怎样可以看见的。他告诉他们："耶稣把泥抹在我的眼上，我一洗就看见了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人也问他是怎么得看见的。瞎子对他们说：「他把泥抹在我的眼睛上，我去一洗，就看见了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. "He put mud on my eyes," the man replied, "and I washed, and now I see."
verses.textEnEsv: So the Pharisees again asked him how he had received his sight. And he said to them, "He put mud on my eyes, and I washed, and I see."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Pharisees also asked him again how he had received his sight. He said to them, "He put clay on my eyes, and I washed, and I see."
verses.textEnNlt: The Pharisees asked the man all about it. So he told them, "He put the mud over my eyes, and when I washed it away, I could see!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Pharisees also were asking him again how he received his sight. And he said to them, "He applied mud to my eyes, and I washed, and I see."
verses.textEn: Therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. "He put mud on my eyes," the man replied, "and I washed, and now I see."

verses.textZh: 有几个法利赛人说："那个人不是从神那里来的，因为他不守安息日。"另外有些人说："一个罪人怎能行这样的神迹呢？"他们就起了纷争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有几个法利赛人说："那个人不是从神那里来的，因为他不守安息日。"另外有些人说："一个罪人怎能行这样的神迹呢？"他们就起了纷争。
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人中有的说：「这个人不是从神来的，因为他不守安息日。」又有人说：「一个罪人怎能行这样的神迹呢？」他们就起了纷争。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the Pharisees said, "This man is not from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath." But others asked, "How can a sinner perform such signs?" So they were divided.
verses.textEnEsv: Some of the Pharisees said, "This man is not from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath." But others said, "How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?" And there was a division among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore some of the Pharisees said, "This Man is not from God, because He does not keep the Sabbath." Others said, "How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?" And there was a division among them.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the Pharisees said, "This man Jesus is not from God, for he is working on the Sabbath." Others said, "But how could an ordinary sinner do such miraculous signs?" So there was a deep division of opinion among them.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore some of the Pharisees were saying, "This Man is not from God, because He does not keep the Sabbath." But others were saying, "How can a man who is a sinner perform such signs?" And there was dissension among them.
verses.textEn: Some of the Pharisees said, "This man is not from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath." But others asked, "How can a sinner perform such signs?" So they were divided.

verses.textZh: 他们再对瞎子说："他既然开了你的眼睛，你说他是甚么人？"他说："他是个先知。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们再对瞎子说："他既然开了你的眼睛，你说他是甚么人？"他说："他是个先知。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又对瞎子说：「他既然开了你的眼睛，你说他是怎样的人呢？」他说：「是个先知。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they turned again to the blind man, "What have you to say about him? It was your eyes he opened." The man replied, "He is a prophet."
verses.textEnEsv: So they said again to the blind man, "What do you say about him, since he has opened your eyes?" He said, "He is a prophet."
verses.textEnNkjv: They said to the blind man again, "What do you say about Him because He opened your eyes?" He said, "He is a prophet."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Pharisees again questioned the man who had been blind and demanded, "What’s your opinion about this man who healed you?" The man replied, "I think he must be a prophet."
verses.textEnNasb: So they *said again to the man who was blind, "What do you say about Him, since He opened your eyes?" And he said, "He is a prophet."
verses.textEn: Then they turned again to the blind man, "What have you to say about him? It was your eyes he opened." The man replied, "He is a prophet."

verses.textZh: 犹太人不信他从前是瞎眼，现在才能看见的，于是把他的父母叫来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人不信他从前是瞎眼，现在才能看见的，于是把他的父母叫来，
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人不信他从前是瞎眼，后来能看见的，等到叫了他的父母来，
verses.textEnNiv: They still did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight until they sent for the man’s parents.
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of the man who had received his sight
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind and received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight.
verses.textEnNlt: The Jewish leaders still refused to believe the man had been blind and could now see, so they called in his parents.
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews then did not believe it about him, that he had been blind and had received sight, until they called the parents of the very one who had received his sight,
verses.textEn: They still did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight until they sent for the man’s parents.

verses.textZh: 问他们："这是你们所说那生下来就瞎眼的儿子吗？现在他怎么又能看见呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 问他们："这是你们所说那生下来就瞎眼的儿子吗？现在他怎么又能看见呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 问他们说：「这是你们的儿子吗？你们说他生来是瞎眼的，如今怎么能看见了呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Is this your son?" they asked. "Is this the one you say was born blind? How is it that now he can see?"
verses.textEnEsv: and asked them, "Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How then does he now see?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they asked them, saying, "Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How then does he now see?"
verses.textEnNlt: They asked them, "Is this your son? Was he born blind? If so, how can he now see?"
verses.textEnNasb: and they questioned them, saying, "Is this your son, who you say was born blind? Then how does he now see?"
verses.textEn: "Is this your son?" they asked. "Is this the one you say was born blind? How is it that now he can see?"

verses.textZh: 他的父母回答："我们知道他是我们的儿子，生下来就瞎眼；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的父母回答："我们知道他是我们的儿子，生下来就瞎眼；
verses.textZhCuv: 他父母回答说：「他是我们的儿子，生来就瞎眼，这是我们知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: "We know he is our son," the parents answered, "and we know he was born blind.
verses.textEnEsv: His parents answered, "We know that this is our son and that he was born blind.
verses.textEnNkjv: His parents answered them and said, "We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
verses.textEnNlt: His parents replied, "We know this is our son and that he was born blind,
verses.textEnNasb: His parents then answered and said, "We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
verses.textEn: "We know he is our son," the parents answered, "and we know he was born blind.

verses.textZh: 现在他是怎样可以看见的，我们不知道；谁开了他的眼睛，我们也不知道。你们问他吧；他已经长大成人，可以替自己讲话了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在他是怎样可以看见的，我们不知道；谁开了他的眼睛，我们也不知道。你们问他吧；他已经长大成人，可以替自己讲话了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于他如今怎么能看见，我们却不知道；是谁开了他的眼睛，我们也不知道。他已经成了人，你们问他吧，他自己必能说。」
verses.textEnNiv: But how he can see now, or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. Ask him. He is of age; he will speak for himself."
verses.textEnEsv: But how he now sees we do not know, nor do we know who opened his eyes. Ask him; he is of age. He will speak for himself."
verses.textEnNkjv: but by what means he now sees we do not know, or who opened his eyes we do not know. He is of age; ask him. He will speak for himself."
verses.textEnNlt: but we don’t know how he can see or who healed him. Ask him. He is old enough to speak for himself."
verses.textEnNasb: but how he now sees, we do not know; or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him; he is of age, he will speak for himself."
verses.textEn: But how he can see now, or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. Ask him. He is of age; he will speak for himself."

verses.textZh: 他的父母这样说，是因为怕犹太人，原来犹太人已经定好了，不论谁承认耶稣是基督，就要把那人赶出会堂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的父母这样说，是因为怕犹太人，原来犹太人已经定好了，不论谁承认耶稣是基督，就要把那人赶出会堂。
verses.textZhCuv: 他父母说这话，是怕犹太人；因为犹太人已经商议定了，若有认耶稣是基督的，要把他赶出会堂。
verses.textEnNiv: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders, who already had decided that anyone who acknowledged that Jesus was the Messiah would be put out of the synagogue.
verses.textEnEsv: (His parents said these things because they feared the Jews, for the Jews had already agreed that if anyone should confess Jesus to be Christ, he was to be put out of the synagogue.
verses.textEnNkjv: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews, for the Jews had agreed already that if anyone confessed that He was Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
verses.textEnNlt: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders, who had announced that anyone saying Jesus was the Messiah would be expelled from the synagogue.
verses.textEnNasb: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews; for the Jews had already reached the decision that if anyone confessed Him to be Christ, he was to be excommunicated from the synagogue.
verses.textEn: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders, who already had decided that anyone who acknowledged that Jesus was the Messiah would be put out of the synagogue.

verses.textZh: 因此他的父母说："他已经长大成人，你们问他吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此他的父母说："他已经长大成人，你们问他吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因此他父母说：「他已经成了人，你们问他吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: That was why his parents said, "He is of age; ask him."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore his parents said, "He is of age; ask him.")
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore his parents said, "He is of age; ask him."
verses.textEnNlt: That’s why they said, "He is old enough. Ask him."
verses.textEnNasb: It was for this reason that his parents said, "He is of age; ask him."
verses.textEn: That was why his parents said, "He is of age; ask him."

verses.textZh: 于是法利赛人第二次把那从前瞎眼的人叫来，对他说："你应当归荣耀给神，我们知道这人是个罪人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是法利赛人第二次把那从前瞎眼的人叫来，对他说："你应当归荣耀给神，我们知道这人是个罪人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以法利赛人第二次叫了那从前瞎眼的人来，对他说：「你该将荣耀归给神，我们知道这人是个罪人。」
verses.textEnNiv: A second time they summoned the man who had been blind. "Give glory to God by telling the truth," they said. "We know this man is a sinner."
verses.textEnEsv: So for the second time they called the man who had been blind and said to him, "Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they again called the man who was blind, and said to him, "Give God the glory! We know that this Man is a sinner."
verses.textEnNlt: So for the second time they called in the man who had been blind and told him, "God should get the glory for this, because we know this man Jesus is a sinner."
verses.textEnNasb: So for a second time they summoned the man who had been blind, and said to him, "Give glory to God; we know that this Man is a sinner."
verses.textEn: A second time they summoned the man who had been blind. "Give glory to God by telling the truth," they said. "We know this man is a sinner."

verses.textZh: 那人回答："他是不是个罪人，我不知道；我只知道一件事，就是我本来是瞎眼的，现在能看见了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人回答："他是不是个罪人，我不知道；我只知道一件事，就是我本来是瞎眼的，现在能看见了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「他是个罪人不是，我不知道；有一件事我知道，从前我是眼瞎的，如今能看见了。」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "Whether he is a sinner or not, I don’t know. One thing I do know. I was blind but now I see!"
verses.textEnEsv: He answered, "Whether he is a sinner I do not know. One thing I do know, that though I was blind, now I see."
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered and said, "Whether He is a sinner ornot I do not know. One thing I know: that though I was blind, now I see."
verses.textEnNlt: "I don’t know whether he is a sinner," the man replied. "But I know this: I was blind, and now I can see!"
verses.textEnNasb: He then answered, "Whether He is a sinner, I do not know; one thing I do know, that though I was blind, now I see."
verses.textEn: He replied, "Whether he is a sinner or not, I don’t know. One thing I do know. I was blind but now I see!"

verses.textZh: 他们就问："他向你作了甚么呢？他怎样开了你的眼睛呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就问："他向你作了甚么呢？他怎样开了你的眼睛呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就问他说：「他向你做什么？是怎么开了你的眼睛呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they asked him, "What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?"
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to him again, "What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?"
verses.textEnNlt: "But what did he do?" they asked. "How did he heal you?"
verses.textEnNasb: So they said to him, "What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?"
verses.textEn: Then they asked him, "What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?"

verses.textZh: 他回答："我已经告诉你们，但是你们不听；为甚么现在又想听呢？你们也想成为他的门徒吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："我已经告诉你们，但是你们不听；为甚么现在又想听呢？你们也想成为他的门徒吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他回答说：「我方才告诉你们，你们不听，为什么又要听呢？莫非你们也要作他的门徒吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, "I have told you already and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples too?"
verses.textEnEsv: He answered them, "I have told you already, and you would not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become his disciples?"
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered them, "I told you already, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become His disciples?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Look!" the man exclaimed. "I told you once. Didn’t you listen? Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples, too?"
verses.textEnNasb: He answered them, "I told you already and you did not listen; why do you want to hear it again? You do not want to become His disciples too, do you?"
verses.textEn: He answered, "I have told you already and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples too?"

verses.textZh: 他们就骂他，说："你才是他的门徒，我们是摩西的门徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就骂他，说："你才是他的门徒，我们是摩西的门徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就骂他说：「你是他的门徒；我们是摩西的门徒。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they hurled insults at him and said, "You are this fellow’s disciple! We are disciples of Moses!
verses.textEnEsv: And they reviled him, saying, "You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they reviled him and said, "You are His disciple, but we are Moses’ disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they cursed him and said, "You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses!
verses.textEnNasb: They spoke abusively to him and said, "You are His disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
verses.textEn: Then they hurled insults at him and said, "You are this fellow’s disciple! We are disciples of Moses!

verses.textZh: 我们知道神曾对摩西说话；只是这个人，我们不知道他从哪里来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道神曾对摩西说话；只是这个人，我们不知道他从哪里来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神对摩西说话是我们知道的；只是这个人，我们不知道他从哪里来！」
verses.textEnNiv: We know that God spoke to Moses, but as for this fellow, we don’t even know where he comes from."
verses.textEnEsv: We know that God has spoken to Moses, but as for this man, we do not know where he comes from."
verses.textEnNkjv: We know that God spoke to Moses; asfor this fellow, we do not know where He is from."
verses.textEnNlt: We know God spoke to Moses, but we don’t even know where this man comes from."
verses.textEnNasb: We know that God has spoken to Moses, but as for this Man, we do not know where He is from."
verses.textEn: We know that God spoke to Moses, but as for this fellow, we don’t even know where he comes from."

verses.textZh: 那人对他们说："这就奇怪了，他开了我的眼睛，你们竟然不知道他从哪里来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人对他们说："这就奇怪了，他开了我的眼睛，你们竟然不知道他从哪里来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人回答说：「他开了我的眼睛，你们竟不知道他从哪里来，这真是奇怪！
verses.textEnNiv: The man answered, "Now that is remarkable! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: The man answered, "Why, this is an amazing thing! You do not know where he comes from, and yet he opened my eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: The man answered and said to them, "Why, this is a marvelous thing, that you do not know where He is from; yet He has opened my eyes!
verses.textEnNlt: "Why, that’s very strange!" the man replied. "He healed my eyes, and yet you don’t know where he comes from?
verses.textEnNasb: The man answered and said to them, "Well, here is the amazing thing, that you do not know where He is from, and yet He opened my eyes!
verses.textEn: The man answered, "Now that is remarkable! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

verses.textZh: 我们知道神不听罪人的祈求，只听那敬畏神，遵行他旨意的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道神不听罪人的祈求，只听那敬畏神，遵行他旨意的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们知道神不听罪人，惟有敬奉神、遵行他旨意的，神才听他。
verses.textEnNiv: We know that God does not listen to sinners. He listens to the godly person who does his will.
verses.textEnEsv: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, God listens to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now we know that God does not hear sinners; but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does His will, He hears him.
verses.textEnNlt: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but he is ready to hear those who worship him and do his will.
verses.textEnNasb: We know that God does not listen to sinners; but if someone is God-fearing and does His will, He listens to him.
verses.textEn: We know that God does not listen to sinners. He listens to the godly person who does his will.

verses.textZh: 自古以来，没有人听过生下来就是瞎眼的，有人可以开他们的眼睛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自古以来，没有人听过生下来就是瞎眼的，有人可以开他们的眼睛。
verses.textZhCuv: 从创世以来，未曾听见有人把生来是瞎子的眼睛开了。
verses.textEnNiv: Nobody has ever heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.
verses.textEnEsv: Never since the world began has it been heard that anyone opened the eyes of a man born blind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Since the world began it has been unheard of that anyone opened the eyes of one who was born blind.
verses.textEnNlt: Ever since the world began, no one has been able to open the eyes of someone born blind.
verses.textEnNasb: Since the beginning of time it has never been heard that anyone opened the eyes of a person born blind.
verses.textEn: Nobody has ever heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.

verses.textZh: 这人若不是从神那里来的，他就不能作甚么。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人若不是从神那里来的，他就不能作甚么。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这人若不是从神来的，什么也不能做。」
verses.textEnNiv: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing."
verses.textEnEsv: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing."
verses.textEnNkjv: If this Man were not from God, He could do nothing."
verses.textEnNlt: If this man were not from God, he couldn’t have done it."
verses.textEnNasb: If this Man were not from God, He could do nothing."
verses.textEn: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing."

verses.textZh: 他们说："你的确是在罪中生的，还敢教训我们吗？"就把他赶出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："你的确是在罪中生的，还敢教训我们吗？"就把他赶出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答说：「你全然生在罪孽中，还要教训我们吗？」于是把他赶出去了。
verses.textEnNiv: To this they replied, "You were steeped in sin at birth; how dare you lecture us!" And they threw him out.
verses.textEnEsv: They answered him, "You were born in utter sin, and would you teach us?" And they cast him out.
verses.textEnNkjv: They answered and said to him, "You were completely born in sins, and are you teaching us?" And they cast him out.
verses.textEnNlt: "You were born a total sinner!" they answered. "Are you trying to teach us?" And they threw him out of the synagogue.
verses.textEnNasb: They answered him, "You were born entirely in sins, and yet you are teaching us?" So they put him out.
verses.textEn: To this they replied, "You were steeped in sin at birth; how dare you lecture us!" And they threw him out.

verses.textZh: 耶稣听见他们把他赶出去，后来遇见他的时候，就对他说："<red>你信人子吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣听见他们把他赶出去，后来遇见他的时候，就对他说："<red>你信人子吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣听说他们把他赶出去，后来遇见他，就说：「<red>你信神的儿子吗？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and when he found him, he said, <red>“Do you believe in the Son of Man?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out, and having found him he said, "Do you believe in the Son of Man?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when He had found him, He said to him, "Do you believe in the Son of God?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus heard what had happened, he found the man and asked, "Do you believe in the Son of Man? "
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus heard that they had put him out, and upon finding him, He said, "Do you believe in the Son of Man?"
verses.textEn: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and when he found him, he said, <red>“Do you believe in the Son of Man?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他说："先生，谁是人子，好让我信他呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："先生，谁是人子，好让我信他呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他回答说：「主啊，谁是神的儿子，叫我信他呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Who is he, sir?" the man asked. "Tell me so that I may believe in him."
verses.textEnEsv: He answered, "And who is he, sir, that I may believe in him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered and said, "Who is He, Lord, that I may believe in Him?"
verses.textEnNlt: The man answered, "Who is he, sir? I want to believe in him."
verses.textEnNasb: He answered by saying, "And who is He, Sir, that I may believe in Him?"
verses.textEn: "Who is he, sir?" the man asked. "Tell me so that I may believe in him."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>你已经见过他，现在跟你说话的就是他。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>你已经见过他，现在跟你说话的就是他。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你已经看见他，现在和你说话的就是他。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, <red>“You have now seen him; in fact, he is the one speaking with you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "You have seen him, and it is he who is speaking to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said to him, "You have both seen Him and it is He who is talking with you."
verses.textEnNlt: "You have seen him," Jesus said, "and he is speaking to you!"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to him, "You have both seen Him, and He is the One who is talking with you."
verses.textEn: Jesus said, <red>“You have now seen him; in fact, he is the one speaking with you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那人说："主啊，我信。"就向他下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人说："主啊，我信。"就向他下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「主啊，我信！」就拜耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man said, "Lord, I believe," and he worshiped him.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Lord, I believe," and he worshiped him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Lord, I believe!" And he worshiped Him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, Lord, I believe!" the man said. And he worshiped Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "I believe, Lord." And he worshiped Him.
verses.textEn: Then the man said, "Lord, I believe," and he worshiped him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>我到这世上来是为了审判，使那看不见的能够看见，能看见的反而成了瞎眼的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>我到这世上来是为了审判，使那看不见的能够看见，能看见的反而成了瞎眼的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我为审判到这世上来，叫不能看见的，可以看见；能看见的，反瞎了眼。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, <red>“For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind will see and those who see will become blind.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said, "For judgment I came into this world, that those who do not see may see, and those who see may become blind."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said, "For judgment I have come into this world, that those who do not see may see, and that those who see may be made blind."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus told him, "I entered this world to render judgment—to give sight to the blind and to show those who think they see that they are blind."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said, "For judgment I came into this world, so that those who do not see may see, and those who see may become blind."
verses.textEn: Jesus said, <red>“For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind will see and those who see will become blind.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有些和耶稣在一起的法利赛人听了这话，就说："难道我们也是瞎眼的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些和耶稣在一起的法利赛人听了这话，就说："难道我们也是瞎眼的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 同他在那里的法利赛人听见这话，就说：「难道我们也瞎了眼吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Some Pharisees who were with him heard him say this and asked, "What? Are we blind too?"
verses.textEnEsv: Some of the Pharisees near him heard these things, and said to him, "Are we also blind?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard these words, and said to Him, "Are we blind also?"
verses.textEnNlt: Some Pharisees who were standing nearby heard him and asked, "Are you saying we’re blind?"
verses.textEnNasb: Those who were with Him from the Pharisees heard these things and said to Him, "We are not blind too, are we?"
verses.textEn: Some Pharisees who were with him heard him say this and asked, "What? Are we blind too?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>如果你们是瞎眼的，就没有罪了；但现在你们说‘我们能看见’，所以你们还是有罪的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>如果你们是瞎眼的，就没有罪了；但现在你们说‘我们能看见’，所以你们还是有罪的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>你们若瞎了眼，就没有罪了；但如今你们说『我们能看见』，所以你们的罪还在。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, <red>“If you were blind, you would not be guilty of sin; but now that you claim you can see, your guilt remains.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "If you were blind, you would have no guilt; but now that you say, ‘We see,’ your guilt remains.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to them, "If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you were blind, you wouldn’t be guilty," Jesus replied. "But you remain guilty because you claim you can see.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to them, "If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now that you maintain, ‘We see,’ your sin remains.
verses.textEn: Jesus said, <red>“If you were blind, you would not be guilty of sin; but now that you claim you can see, your guilt remains.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我实实在在告诉你们，那不从门进羊圈，倒从别处爬进去的，那人就是贼，就是强盗；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我实实在在告诉你们，那不从门进羊圈，倒从别处爬进去的，那人就是贼，就是强盗；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我实实在在地告诉你们，人进羊圈，不从门进去，倒从别处爬进去，那人就是贼，就是强盗。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Very truly I tell you Pharisees, anyone who does not enter the sheep pen by the gate, but climbs in by some other way, is a thief and a robber.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Truly, truly, I say to you, he who does not enter the sheepfold by the door but climbs in by another way, that man is a thief and a robber.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Most assuredly, I say to you, he who does not enter the sheepfold by the door, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.textEnNlt: "I tell you the truth, anyone who sneaks over the wall of a sheepfold, rather than going through the gate, must surely be a thief and a robber!
verses.textEnNasb: "Truly, truly I say to you, the one who does not enter by the door into the fold of the sheep, but climbs up some other way, he is a thief and a robber.
verses.textEn: <red>“Very truly I tell you Pharisees, anyone who does not enter the sheep pen by the gate, but climbs in by some other way, is a thief and a robber.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那从门进去的，才是羊的牧人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那从门进去的，才是羊的牧人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>从门进去的，才是羊的牧人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he who enters by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who enters by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: But the one who enters through the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who enters by the door is a shepherd of the sheep.
verses.textEn: <red>The one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>看门的给他开门，羊也听他的声音；他按着名字呼叫自己的羊，领牠们出来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>看门的给他开门，羊也听他的声音；他按着名字呼叫自己的羊，领牠们出来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>看门的就给他开门；羊也听他的声音。他按着名叫自己的羊，把羊领出来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: To him the gatekeeper opens. The sheep hear his voice, and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
verses.textEnNkjv: To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice; and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
verses.textEnNlt: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep recognize his voice and come to him. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
verses.textEnNasb: To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep listen to his voice, and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
verses.textEn: <red>The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他把自己的羊领出来以后，就走在前头，羊也跟随他，因为认得他的声音。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他把自己的羊领出来以后，就走在前头，羊也跟随他，因为认得他的声音。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>既放出自己的羊来，就在前头走，羊也跟着他，因为认得他的声音。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When he has brought out all his own, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
verses.textEnNlt: After he has gathered his own flock, he walks ahead of them, and they follow him because they know his voice.
verses.textEnNasb: When he puts all his own sheep outside, he goes ahead of them, and the sheep follow him because they know his voice.
verses.textEn: <red>When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>牠们决不会跟随陌生人，反而逃避他，因为不认得陌生人的声音。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>牠们决不会跟随陌生人，反而逃避他，因为不认得陌生人的声音。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>羊不跟着生人；因为不认得他的声音，必要逃跑。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will run away from him because they do not recognize a stranger’s voice.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: A stranger they will not follow, but they will flee from him, for they do not know the voice of strangers."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him, for they do not know the voice of strangers."
verses.textEnNlt: They won’t follow a stranger; they will run from him because they don’t know his voice."
verses.textEnNasb: However, a stranger they simply will not follow, but will flee from him, because they do not know the voice of strangers."
verses.textEn: <red>But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will run away from him because they do not recognize a stranger’s voice.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说了这个譬喻，他们却不明白他所说的是甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说了这个譬喻，他们却不明白他所说的是甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣将这比喻告诉他们，但他们不明白所说的是什么意思。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus used this figure of speech, but the Pharisees did not understand what he was telling them.
verses.textEnEsv: This figure of speech Jesus used with them, but they did not understand what he was saying to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus used this illustration, but they did not understand the things which He spoke to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who heard Jesus use this illustration didn’t understand what he meant,
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus told them this figure of speech, but they did not understand what the things which He was saying to them meant.
verses.textEn: Jesus used this figure of speech, but the Pharisees did not understand what he was telling them.

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣又说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，我就是羊的门。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣又说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，我就是羊的门。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，耶稣又对他们说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，我就是羊的门。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore Jesus said again, <red>“Very truly I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.</red>
