verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus again said to them, "Truly, truly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them again, "Most assuredly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: so he explained it to them: "I tell you the truth, I am the gate for the sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus said to them again, "Truly, truly I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.textEn: Therefore Jesus said again, <red>“Very truly I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所有在我以先来的，都是贼和强盗；羊却不听从他们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所有在我以先来的，都是贼和强盗；羊却不听从他们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡在我以先来的都是贼，是强盗；羊却不听他们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>All who have come before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep have not listened to them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: All who ever came before Me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them.
verses.textEnNlt: All who came before me were thieves and robbers. But the true sheep did not listen to them.
verses.textEnNasb: All those who came before Me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
verses.textEn: <red>All who have come before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep have not listened to them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我就是门，如果有人借着我进来，就必定得救，并且可以出、可以入，也可以找到草场。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我就是门，如果有人借着我进来，就必定得救，并且可以出、可以入，也可以找到草场。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我就是门；凡从我进来的，必然得救，并且出入得草吃。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved. They will come in and go out, and find pasture.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am the door. If anyone enters by me, he will be saved and will go in and out and find pasture.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the door. If anyone enters by Me, he will be saved, and will go in and out and find pasture.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I am the gate. Those who come in through me will be saved. They will come and go freely and will find good pastures.
verses.textEnNasb: I am the door; if anyone enters through Me, he will be saved, and will go in and out and find pasture.
verses.textEn: <red>I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved. They will come in and go out, and find pasture.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>贼来了，不过是要偷窃、杀害、毁坏；我来了，是要使羊得生命，并且得的更丰盛。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>贼来了，不过是要偷窃、杀害、毁坏；我来了，是要使羊得生命，并且得的更丰盛。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>盗贼来，无非要偷窃，杀害，毁坏；我来了，是要叫羊 得生命，并且得的更丰盛。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I came that they may have life and have it abundantly.
verses.textEnNkjv: The thief does not come except to steal, and to kill, and to destroy. I have come that they may have life, and that they may have it more abundantly.
verses.textEnNlt: The thief’s purpose is to steal and kill and destroy. My purpose is to give them a rich and satisfying life.
verses.textEnNasb: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I came so that they would have life, and have it abundantly.
verses.textEn: <red>The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我是好牧人，好牧人为羊舍命。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我是好牧人，好牧人为羊舍命。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我是好牧人；好牧人为羊舍命。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd gives His life for the sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd sacrifices his life for the sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am the good shepherd; the good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
verses.textEn: <red>“I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那作雇工不是牧人的，羊也不是自己的，他一见狼来，就把羊撇下逃跑，狼就抓住羊群，把他们驱散了；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那作雇工不是牧人的，羊也不是自己的，他一见狼来，就把羊撇下逃跑，狼就抓住羊群，把他们驱散了；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若是雇工，不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，他看见狼来，就撇下羊逃走；狼抓住羊，赶散了羊群。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The hired hand is not the shepherd and does not own the sheep. So when he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf attacks the flock and scatters it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He who is a hired hand and not a shepherd, who does not own the sheep, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and flees, and the wolf snatches them and scatters them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But a hireling, he who is not the shepherd, one who does not own the sheep, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and flees; and the wolf catches the sheep and scatters them.
verses.textEnNlt: A hired hand will run when he sees a wolf coming. He will abandon the sheep because they don’t belong to him and he isn’t their shepherd. And so the wolf attacks them and scatters the flock.
verses.textEnNasb: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who is not the owner of the sheep, sees the wolf coming, and leaves the sheep and flees; and the wolf snatches them and scatters the flock.
verses.textEn: <red>The hired hand is not the shepherd and does not own the sheep. So when he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf attacks the flock and scatters it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为他是个雇工，对羊群漠不关心。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为他是个雇工，对羊群漠不关心。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>雇工逃走，因他是雇工，并不顾念羊。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The man runs away because he is a hired hand and cares nothing for the sheep.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He flees because he is a hired hand and cares nothing for the sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hireling flees because he is a hireling and does not care about the sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: The hired hand runs away because he’s working only for the money and doesn’t really care about the sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: He flees because he is a hired hand and does not care about the sheep.
verses.textEn: <red>The man runs away because he is a hired hand and cares nothing for the sheep.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我是好牧人，我认识我的羊，我的羊也认识我，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我是好牧人，我认识我的羊，我的羊也认识我，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我是好牧人；我认识我的羊，我的羊也认识我，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I am the good shepherd; I know my sheep and my sheep know me—</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am the good shepherd. I know my own and my own know me,
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the good shepherd; and I know My sheep, and am known by My own.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am the good shepherd; I know my own sheep, and they know me,
verses.textEnNasb: I am the good shepherd, and I know My own, and My own know Me,
verses.textEn: <red>“I am the good shepherd; I know my sheep and my sheep know me—</red>

verses.textZh: <red>好象父认识我，我也认识父一样；并且我为羊舍命。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>好象父认识我，我也认识父一样；并且我为羊舍命。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>正如父认识我，我也认识父一样；并且我为羊舍命。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>just as the Father knows me and I know the Father—and I lay down my life for the sheep.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: just as the Father knows me and I know the Father; and I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the Father knows Me, even so I know the Father; and I lay down My life for the sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: just as my Father knows me and I know the Father. So I sacrifice my life for the sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father; and I lay down My life for the sheep.
verses.textEn: <red>just as the Father knows me and I know the Father—and I lay down my life for the sheep.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我还有别的羊，不在这羊圈里；我必须把牠们领来，牠们也要听我的声音，并且要合成一群，归于一个牧人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我还有别的羊，不在这羊圈里；我必须把牠们领来，牠们也要听我的声音，并且要合成一群，归于一个牧人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我另外有羊，不是这圈里的；我必须领他们来，他们也要听我的声音，并且要合成一群，归一个牧人了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have other sheep that are not of this sheep pen. I must bring them also. They too will listen to my voice, and there shall be one flock and one shepherd.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will listen to my voice. So there will be one flock, one shepherd.
verses.textEnNkjv: And other sheep I have which are not of this fold; them also I must bring, and they will hear My voice; and there will be one flock and one shepherd.
verses.textEnNlt: I have other sheep, too, that are not in this sheepfold. I must bring them also. They will listen to my voice, and there will be one flock with one shepherd.
verses.textEnNasb: And I have other sheep that are not of this fold; I must bring them also, and they will listen to My voice; and they will become one flock, with one shepherd.
verses.textEn: <red>I have other sheep that are not of this sheep pen. I must bring them also. They too will listen to my voice, and there shall be one flock and one shepherd.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父爱我，因为我把生命舍去，好再把它取回来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父爱我，因为我把生命舍去，好再把它取回来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我父爱我；因我将命舍去，好再取回来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The reason my Father loves me is that I lay down my life—only to take it up again.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For this reason the Father loves me, because I lay down my life that I may take it up again.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore My Father loves Me, because I lay down My life that I may take it again.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Father loves me because I sacrifice my life so I may take it back again.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason the Father loves Me, because I lay down My life so that I may take it back.
verses.textEn: <red>The reason my Father loves me is that I lay down my life—only to take it up again.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>没有人能夺去我的生命，是我自己舍去的。我有权把生命舍去，也有权把它取回来；这是我从我的父所领受的命令。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>没有人能夺去我的生命，是我自己舍去的。我有权把生命舍去，也有权把它取回来；这是我从我的父所领受的命令。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>没有人夺我的命去，是我自己舍的。我有权柄舍了，也有权柄取回来。这是我从我父所受的命令。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This command I received from my Father.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it up again. This charge I have received from my Father."
verses.textEnNkjv: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of Myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This command I have received from My Father."
verses.textEnNlt: No one can take my life from me. I sacrifice it voluntarily. For I have the authority to lay it down when I want to and also to take it up again. For this is what my Father has commanded."
verses.textEnNasb: No one has taken it away from Me, but I lay it down on My own. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it back. This commandment I received from My Father."
verses.textEn: <red>No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This command I received from my Father.”</red>

verses.textZh: 犹太人因着这些话又起了纷争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人因着这些话又起了纷争。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人为这些话又起了纷争。
verses.textEnNiv: The Jews who heard these words were again divided.
verses.textEnEsv: There was again a division among the Jews because of these words.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore there was a division again among the Jews because of these sayings.
verses.textEnNlt: When he said these things, the people were again divided in their opinions about him.
verses.textEnNasb: Dissension occurred again among the Jews because of these words.
verses.textEn: The Jews who heard these words were again divided.

verses.textZh: 他们当中有许多人说："他是鬼附的，他发疯了；为甚么要听他呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们当中有许多人说："他是鬼附的，他发疯了；为甚么要听他呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 内中有好些人说：「他是被鬼附着，而且疯了，为什么听他呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Many of them said, "He is demon-possessed and raving mad. Why listen to him?"
verses.textEnEsv: Many of them said, "He has a demon, and is insane; why listen to him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And many of them said, "He has a demon and is mad. Why do you listen to Him?"
verses.textEnNlt: Some said, "He’s demon possessed and out of his mind. Why listen to a man like that?"
verses.textEnNasb: Many of them were saying, "He has a demon and is insane. Why do you listen to Him?"
verses.textEn: Many of them said, "He is demon-possessed and raving mad. Why listen to him?"

verses.textZh: 另外有人说："这话不是鬼附的人所说的。鬼怎能使瞎子的眼睛开了呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 另外有人说："这话不是鬼附的人所说的。鬼怎能使瞎子的眼睛开了呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有人说：「这不是鬼附之人所说的话。鬼岂能叫瞎子的眼睛开了呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But others said, "These are not the sayings of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"
verses.textEnEsv: Others said, "These are not the words of one who is oppressed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Others said, "These are not the words of one who has a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"
verses.textEnNlt: Others said, "This doesn’t sound like a man possessed by a demon! Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"
verses.textEnNasb: Others were saying, "These are not the words of one who is demon-possessed. A demon cannot open the eyes of those who are blind, can it?"
verses.textEn: But others said, "These are not the sayings of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"

verses.textZh: 在耶路撒冷，献殿节到了，那时是冬天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶路撒冷，献殿节到了，那时是冬天。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶路撒冷有修殿节，是冬天的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: Then came the Festival of Dedication at Jerusalem. It was winter,
verses.textEnEsv: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place at Jerusalem. It was winter,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was the Feast of Dedication in Jerusalem, and it was winter.
verses.textEnNlt: It was now winter, and Jesus was in Jerusalem at the time of Hanukkah, the Festival of Dedication.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time the Feast of the Dedication took place in Jerusalem;
verses.textEn: Then came the Festival of Dedication at Jerusalem. It was winter,

verses.textZh: 耶稣在殿的所罗门廊上走过，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣在殿的所罗门廊上走过，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣在殿里所罗门的廊下行走。
verses.textEnNiv: and Jesus was in the temple courts walking in Solomon’s Colonnade.
verses.textEnEsv: and Jesus was walking in the temple, in the colonnade of Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus walked in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
verses.textEnNlt: He was in the Temple, walking through the section known as Solomon’s Colonnade.
verses.textEnNasb: it was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple area, in the portico of Solomon.
verses.textEn: and Jesus was in the temple courts walking in Solomon’s Colonnade.

verses.textZh: 犹太人围着他，对他说："你使我们心里悬疑不定，要到几时呢？如果你是基督，就公开地告诉我们吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人围着他，对他说："你使我们心里悬疑不定，要到几时呢？如果你是基督，就公开地告诉我们吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人围着他，说：「你叫我们犹疑不定到几时呢？你若是基督，就明明地告诉我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Jews who were there gathered around him, saying, "How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly."
verses.textEnEsv: So the Jews gathered around him and said to him, "How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Jews surrounded Him and said to Him, "How long do You keep us in doubt? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly."
verses.textEnNlt: The people surrounded him and asked, "How long are you going to keep us in suspense? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly."
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews then surrounded Him and began saying to Him, "How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly."
verses.textEn: The Jews who were there gathered around him, saying, "How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly."

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>我已经告诉你们，你们却不相信；我奉我父的名所作的事，可以为我作证。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>我已经告诉你们，你们却不相信；我奉我父的名所作的事，可以为我作证。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「我已经告诉你们，你们不信。我奉我父之名所行的事可以为我作见证；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“I did tell you, but you do not believe. The works I do in my Father’s name testify about me,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "I told you, and you do not believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name bear witness about me,
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered them, "I told you, and you do not believe. The works that I do in My Father’s name, they bear witness of Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "I have already told you, and you don’t believe me. The proof is the work I do in my Father’s name.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered them, "I told you, and you do not believe; the works that I do in My Father’s name, these testify of Me.
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“I did tell you, but you do not believe. The works I do in my Father’s name testify about me,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>只是你们不信，因为你们不是我的羊。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>只是你们不信，因为你们不是我的羊。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是你们不信，因为你们不是我的羊。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>but you do not believe because you are not my sheep.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but you do not believe because you are not among my sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you do not believe, because you are not of My sheep, as I said to you.
verses.textEnNlt: But you don’t believe me because you are not my sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: But you do not believe, because you are not of My sheep.
verses.textEn: <red>but you do not believe because you are not my sheep.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我的羊听我的声音，我也认识他们，他们也跟随我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我的羊听我的声音，我也认识他们，他们也跟随我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我的羊听我的声音，我也认识他们，他们也跟着我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
verses.textEnNkjv: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.
verses.textEnNlt: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.
verses.textEnNasb: My sheep listen to My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me;
verses.textEn: <red>My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我赐给他们永生，他们永不灭亡，谁也不能把他们从我手里夺去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我赐给他们永生，他们永不灭亡，谁也不能把他们从我手里夺去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我又赐给他们永生；他们永不灭亡，谁也不能从我手里把他们夺去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; neither shall anyone snatch them out of My hand.
verses.textEnNlt: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them away from me,
verses.textEnNasb: and I give them eternal life, and they will never perish; and no one will snatch them out of My hand.
verses.textEn: <red>I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那位把羊群赐给我的父比一切都大，也没有人能把他们从我父的手里夺去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那位把羊群赐给我的父比一切都大，也没有人能把他们从我父的手里夺去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我父把羊赐给我，他比万有都大，谁也不能从我父手里把他们夺去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all; no one can snatch them out of my Father’s hand.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all, and no one is able to snatch them out of the Father’s hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: My Father, who has given them to Me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
verses.textEnNlt: for my Father has given them to me, and he is more powerful than anyone else. No one can snatch them from the Father’s hand.
verses.textEnNasb: My Father, who has given them to Me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch them out of the Father’s hand.
verses.textEn: <red>My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all; no one can snatch them out of my Father’s hand.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我与父原为一。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我与父原为一。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我与父原为一。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I and the Father are one.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I and the Father are one."
verses.textEnNkjv: I and My Father are one."
verses.textEnNlt: The Father and I are one."
verses.textEnNasb: I and the Father are one."
verses.textEn: <red>I and the Father are one.”</red>

verses.textZh: 犹太人又拿起石头要打他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人又拿起石头要打他。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人又拿起石头来要打他。
verses.textEnNiv: Again his Jewish opponents picked up stones to stone him,
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews picked up stones again to stone him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Once again the people picked up stones to kill him.
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews picked up stones again to stone Him.
verses.textEn: Again his Jewish opponents picked up stones to stone him,

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>我把许多从父那里来的善事显给你们看，你们因哪一件要用石头打我呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>我把许多从父那里来的善事显给你们看，你们因哪一件要用石头打我呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>我从父显出许多善事给你们看，你们是为哪一件拿石头打我呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: but Jesus said to them, <red>“I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone me?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "I have shown you many good works from the Father; for which of them are you going to stone me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered them, "Many good works I have shown you from My Father. For which of those works do you stone Me?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said, "At my Father’s direction I have done many good works. For which one are you going to stone me?"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus replied to them, "I showed you many good works from the Father; for which of them are you stoning Me?"
verses.textEn: but Jesus said to them, <red>“I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone me?”</red>

verses.textZh: 犹太人对他说："我们不是因为善事用石头打你，而是因为你说了僭妄的话；又因为你是个人，竟然把自己当作神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人对他说："我们不是因为善事用石头打你，而是因为你说了僭妄的话；又因为你是个人，竟然把自己当作神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人回答说：「我们不是为善事拿石头打你，是为你说僭妄的话；又为你是个人，反将自己当作神。」
verses.textEnNiv: "We are not stoning you for any good work," they replied, "but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, claim to be God."
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews answered him, "It is not for a good work that we are going to stone you but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Jews answered Him, saying, "For a good work we do not stone You, but for blasphemy, and because You, being a Man, make Yourself God."
verses.textEnNlt: They replied, "We’re stoning you not for any good work, but for blasphemy! You, a mere man, claim to be God."
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews answered Him, "We are not stoning You for a good work, but for blasphemy; and because You, being a man, make Yourself out to be God."
verses.textEn: "We are not stoning you for any good work," they replied, "but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, claim to be God."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>你们的律法上不是写着‘我说你们是神’吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>你们的律法上不是写着‘我说你们是神’吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「你们的律法上岂不是写着『我曾说你们是神』吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered them, <red>“Is it not written in your Law, ‘I have said you are “gods” ’?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "Is it not written in your Law, ‘I said, you are gods’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered them, "Is it not written in your law, ‘I said, "You are gods" ’?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "It is written in your own Scriptures that God said to certain leaders of the people, ‘I say, you are gods!’
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered them, "Has it not been written in your Law: ‘I said, you are gods’?
verses.textEn: Jesus answered them, <red>“Is it not written in your Law, ‘I have said you are “gods” ’?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>圣经是不能废除的，如果那些承受神的道的人，神尚且称他们是神，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>圣经是不能废除的，如果那些承受神的道的人，神尚且称他们是神，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>经上的话是不能废的；若那些承受神道的人尚且称为神，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If he called them ‘gods,’ to whom the word of God came—and Scripture cannot be set aside—</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came—and Scripture cannot be broken—
verses.textEnNkjv: If He called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture cannot be broken),
verses.textEnNlt: And you know that the Scriptures cannot be altered. So if those people who received God’s message were called ‘gods,’
verses.textEnNasb: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture cannot be nullified),
verses.textEn: <red>If he called them ‘gods,’ to whom the word of God came—and Scripture cannot be set aside—</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那么父所分别为圣又差到世上来的，他自称是神的儿子，你们就说他说了僭妄神的话吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那么父所分别为圣又差到世上来的，他自称是神的儿子，你们就说他说了僭妄神的话吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>父所分别为圣、又差到世间来的，他自称是神的儿子，你们还向他说『你说僭妄的话』吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>what about the one whom the Father set apart as his very own and sent into the world? Why then do you accuse me of blasphemy because I said, ‘I am God’s Son’?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: do you say of him whom the Father consecrated and sent into the world, ‘You are blaspheming,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
verses.textEnNkjv: do you say of Him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You are blaspheming,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
verses.textEnNlt: why do you call it blasphemy when I say, ‘I am the Son of God’? After all, the Father set me apart and sent me into the world.
verses.textEnNasb: are you saying of Him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You are blaspheming,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
verses.textEn: <red>what about the one whom the Father set apart as his very own and sent into the world? Why then do you accuse me of blasphemy because I said, ‘I am God’s Son’?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我若不作我父的事，你们就不必信我；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我若不作我父的事，你们就不必信我；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若不行我父的事，你们就不必信我；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Do not believe me unless I do the works of my Father.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If I am not doing the works of my Father, then do not believe me;
verses.textEnNkjv: If I do not do the works of My Father, do not believe Me;
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t believe me unless I carry out my Father’s work.
verses.textEnNasb: If I do not do the works of My Father, do not believe Me;
verses.textEn: <red>Do not believe me unless I do the works of my Father.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我若作了，你们纵然不信我，也应当信这些事，好使你们确实知道，我父是在我里面，我也在父里面。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我若作了，你们纵然不信我，也应当信这些事，好使你们确实知道，我父是在我里面，我也在父里面。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若行了，你们纵然不信我，也当信这些事，叫你们又知道又明白父在我里面，我也在父里面。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father."
verses.textEnNkjv: but if I do, though you do not believe Me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in Me, and I in Him."
verses.textEnNlt: But if I do his work, believe in the evidence of the miraculous works I have done, even if you don’t believe me. Then you will know and understand that the Father is in me, and I am in the Father."
verses.textEnNasb: but if I do them, even though you do not believe Me, believe the works, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I in the Father."
verses.textEn: <red>But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们又要逮捕耶稣，他却从他们的手中逃脱了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又要逮捕耶稣，他却从他们的手中逃脱了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又要拿他，他却逃出他们的手走了。
verses.textEnNiv: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.
verses.textEnEsv: Again they sought to arrest him, but he escaped from their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they sought again to seize Him, but He escaped out of their hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Once again they tried to arrest him, but he got away and left them.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore they were seeking again to arrest Him, and He eluded their grasp.
verses.textEn: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.

verses.textZh: 耶稣又往约旦河东去，到约翰从前施洗的地方，住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又往约旦河东去，到约翰从前施洗的地方，住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又往约旦河外去，到了约翰起初施洗的地方，就住在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing in the early days. There he stayed,
verses.textEnEsv: He went away again across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing at first, and there he remained.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He went away again beyond the Jordan to the place where John was baptizing at first, and there He stayed.
verses.textEnNlt: He went beyond the Jordan River near the place where John was first baptizing and stayed there awhile.
verses.textEnNasb: And He went away again beyond the Jordan to the place where John was first baptizing, and He stayed there.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing in the early days. There he stayed,

verses.textZh: 许多人到他那里去，说："约翰没有行过一件神迹，但约翰指着这人所说的一切话，都是真实的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 许多人到他那里去，说："约翰没有行过一件神迹，但约翰指着这人所说的一切话，都是真实的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多人来到他那里。他们说：「约翰一件神迹没有行过，但约翰指着这人所说的一切话都是真的。」
verses.textEnNiv: and many people came to him. They said, "Though John never performed a sign, all that John said about this man was true."
verses.textEnEsv: And many came to him. And they said, "John did no sign, but everything that John said about this man was true."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then many came to Him and said, "John performed no sign, but all the things that John spoke about this Man were true."
verses.textEnNlt: And many followed him. "John didn’t perform miraculous signs," they remarked to one another, "but everything he said about this man has come true."
verses.textEnNasb: Many came to Him and were saying, "While John performed no sign, yet everything John said about this Man was true."
verses.textEn: and many people came to him. They said, "Though John never performed a sign, all that John said about this man was true."

verses.textZh: 在那里就有许多人信了耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里就有许多人信了耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里，信耶稣的人就多了。
verses.textEnNiv: And in that place many believed in Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And many believed in him there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And many believed in Him there.
verses.textEnNlt: And many who were there believed in Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And many believed in Him there.
verses.textEn: And in that place many believed in Jesus.

verses.textZh: 有一个患病的人，名叫拉撒路，住在伯大尼，就是马利亚和她姊姊马大的村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个患病的人，名叫拉撒路，住在伯大尼，就是马利亚和她姊姊马大的村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个患病的人，名叫拉撒路，住在伯大尼，就是马利亚和她姊姊马大的村庄。
verses.textEnNiv: Now a man named Lazarus was sick. He was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.textEnEsv: Now a certain man was ill, Lazarus of Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.textEnNlt: A man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bethany with his sisters, Mary and Martha.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a certain man was sick: Lazarus of Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.textEn: Now a man named Lazarus was sick. He was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

verses.textZh: 这马利亚就是后来用香膏抹主，并且用头发把主的脚擦干的那人；患病的拉撒路是她的兄弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这马利亚就是后来用香膏抹主，并且用头发把主的脚擦干的那人；患病的拉撒路是她的兄弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 这马利亚就是那用香膏抹主，又用头发擦他脚的；患病的拉撒路是她的兄弟。
verses.textEnNiv: (This Mary, whose brother Lazarus now lay sick, was the same one who poured perfume on the Lord and wiped his feet with her hair.)
verses.textEnEsv: It was Mary who anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was ill.
verses.textEnNkjv: It was that Mary who anointed the Lord with fragrant oil and wiped His feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the Mary who later poured the expensive perfume on the Lord’s feet and wiped them with her hair. Her brother, Lazarus, was sick.
verses.textEnNasb: And it was the Mary who anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped His feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
verses.textEn: (This Mary, whose brother Lazarus now lay sick, was the same one who poured perfume on the Lord and wiped his feet with her hair.)

verses.textZh: 姊妹二人派人到耶稣那里去，说："主啊，你所爱的人病了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 姊妹二人派人到耶稣那里去，说："主啊，你所爱的人病了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她姊妹两个就打发人去见耶稣，说：「主啊，你所爱的人病了。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, "Lord, the one you love is sick."
verses.textEnEsv: So the sisters sent to him, saying, "Lord, he whom you love is ill."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the sisters sent to Him, saying, "Lord, behold, he whom You love is sick."
verses.textEnNlt: So the two sisters sent a message to Jesus telling him, "Lord, your dear friend is very sick."
verses.textEnNasb: So the sisters sent word to Him, saying, "Lord, behold, he whom You love is sick."
verses.textEn: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, "Lord, the one you love is sick."

verses.textZh: 耶稣听见，就说："<red>这病不至于死，而是为了神的荣耀，使神的儿子因此得到荣耀。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣听见，就说："<red>这病不至于死，而是为了神的荣耀，使神的儿子因此得到荣耀。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣听见，就说：「<red>这病不至于死，乃是为神的荣耀，叫神的儿子因此得荣耀。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When he heard this, Jesus said, <red>“This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for God’s glory so that God’s Son may be glorified through it.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But when Jesus heard it he said, "This illness does not lead to death. It is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus heard that, He said, "This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God may be glorified through it."
verses.textEnNlt: But when Jesus heard about it he said, "Lazarus’s sickness will not end in death. No, it happened for the glory of God so that the Son of God will receive glory from this."
verses.textEnNasb: But when Jesus heard this, He said, "This sickness is not meant for death, but is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified by it."
verses.textEn: When he heard this, Jesus said, <red>“This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for God’s glory so that God’s Son may be glorified through it.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣向来爱马大和她的妹妹马利亚，以及拉撒路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣向来爱马大和她的妹妹马利亚，以及拉撒路。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣素来爱马大和她妹子并拉撒路。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
verses.textEnNlt: So although Jesus loved Martha, Mary, and Lazarus,
verses.textEnNasb: (Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister, and Lazarus.)
verses.textEn: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

verses.textZh: 他听说拉撒路病了，仍然在原来的地方住了两天，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他听说拉撒路病了，仍然在原来的地方住了两天，
verses.textZhCuv: 听见拉撒路病了，就在所居之地仍住了两天。
verses.textEnNiv: So when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days,
verses.textEnEsv: So, when he heard that Lazarus was ill, he stayed two days longer in the place where he was.
verses.textEnNkjv: So, when He heard that he was sick, He stayed two more days in the place where He was.
verses.textEnNlt: he stayed where he was for the next two days.
verses.textEnNasb: So when He heard that he was sick, He then stayed two days longer in the place where He was.
verses.textEn: So when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days,

verses.textZh: 然后对门徒说："<red>我们再到犹太去吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后对门徒说："<red>我们再到犹太去吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 然后对门徒说：「<red>我们再往犹太去吧。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: and then he said to his disciples, <red>“Let us go back to Judea.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then after this he said to the disciples, "Let us go to Judea again."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then after this He said to the disciples, "Let us go to Judea again."
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, he said to his disciples, "Let’s go back to Judea."
verses.textEnNasb: Then after this He *said to the disciples, "Let’s go to Judea again."
verses.textEn: and then he said to his disciples, <red>“Let us go back to Judea.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒对他说："拉比，近来犹太人要拿石头打你，你还到那里去吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒对他说："拉比，近来犹太人要拿石头打你，你还到那里去吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒说：「拉比，犹太人近来要拿石头打你，你还往那里去吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "But Rabbi," they said, "a short while ago the Jews there tried to stone you, and yet you are going back?"
verses.textEnEsv: The disciples said to him, "Rabbi, the Jews were just now seeking to stone you, and are you going there again?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The disciples said to Him, "Rabbi, lately the Jews sought to stone You, and are You going there again?"
verses.textEnNlt: But his disciples objected. "Rabbi," they said, "only a few days ago the people in Judea were trying to stone you. Are you going there again?"
verses.textEnNasb: The disciples *said to Him, "Rabbi, the Jews were just now seeking to stone You, and yet You are going there again?"
verses.textEn: "But Rabbi," they said, "a short while ago the Jews there tried to stone you, and yet you are going back?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>白昼不是有十二小时吗？人若在白昼行走，就不会跌倒，因为他看见这世上的光；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>白昼不是有十二小时吗？人若在白昼行走，就不会跌倒，因为他看见这世上的光；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「白日不是有十二小时吗？人在白日走路，就不至跌倒，因为看见这世上的光。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“Are there not twelve hours of daylight? Anyone who walks in the daytime will not stumble, for they see by this world’s light.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "Are there not twelve hours in the day? If anyone walks in the day, he does not stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered, "Are there not twelve hours in the day? If anyone walks in the day, he does not stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "There are twelve hours of daylight every day. During the day people can walk safely. They can see because they have the light of this world.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus replied, "Are there not twelve hours in the day? If anyone walks during the day, he does not stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“Are there not twelve hours of daylight? Anyone who walks in the daytime will not stumble, for they see by this world’s light.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人若在夜间行走，就会跌倒，因为他没有光。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人若在夜间行走，就会跌倒，因为他没有光。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若在黑夜走路，就必跌倒，因为他没有光。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It is when a person walks at night that they stumble, for they have no light.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But if anyone walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light is not in him."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if one walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light is not in him."
verses.textEnNlt: But at night there is danger of stumbling because they have no light."
verses.textEnNasb: But if anyone walks during the night, he stumbles, because the light is not in him."
verses.textEn: <red>It is when a person walks at night that they stumble, for they have no light.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说完了这些话，跟着又对他们说："<red>我们的朋友拉撒路睡了，我要去唤醒他。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说完了这些话，跟着又对他们说："<red>我们的朋友拉撒路睡了，我要去唤醒他。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说了这话，随后对他们说：「<red>我们的朋友拉撒路睡了，我去叫醒他。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: After he had said this, he went on to tell them, <red>“Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going there to wake him up.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: After saying these things, he said to them, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I go to awaken him."
verses.textEnNkjv: These things He said, and after that He said to them, "Our friend Lazarus sleeps, but I go that I may wake him up."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but now I will go and wake him up."
verses.textEnNasb: This He said, and after this He *said to them, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going so that I may awaken him from sleep."
verses.textEn: After he had said this, he went on to tell them, <red>“Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going there to wake him up.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒说："主啊，如果他睡了，就会好过来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒说："主啊，如果他睡了，就会好过来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒说：「主啊，他若睡了，就必好了。」
verses.textEnNiv: His disciples replied, "Lord, if he sleeps, he will get better."
verses.textEnEsv: The disciples said to him, "Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then His disciples said, "Lord, if he sleeps he will get well."
verses.textEnNlt: The disciples said, "Lord, if he is sleeping, he will soon get better!"
verses.textEnNasb: The disciples then said to Him, "Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will come out of it."
verses.textEn: His disciples replied, "Lord, if he sleeps, he will get better."

verses.textZh: 其实耶稣是指着拉撒路的死说的，门徒却以为他是指正常的睡眠说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实耶稣是指着拉撒路的死说的，门徒却以为他是指正常的睡眠说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣这话是指着他死说的，他们却以为是说照常睡了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus had been speaking of his death, but his disciples thought he meant natural sleep.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he meant taking rest in sleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, Jesus spoke of his death, but they thought that He was speaking about taking rest in sleep.
verses.textEnNlt: They thought Jesus meant Lazarus was simply sleeping, but Jesus meant Lazarus had died.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that He was speaking about actual sleep.
verses.textEn: Jesus had been speaking of his death, but his disciples thought he meant natural sleep.

verses.textZh: 于是，耶稣公开地告诉他们："拉撒路死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，耶稣公开地告诉他们："拉撒路死了。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣就明明地告诉他们说：「拉撒路死了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: So then he told them plainly, <red>“Lazarus is dead,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus told them plainly, "Lazarus has died,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them plainly, "Lazarus is dead.
verses.textEnNlt: So he told them plainly, "Lazarus is dead.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus then said to them plainly, "Lazarus died,
verses.textEn: So then he told them plainly, <red>“Lazarus is dead,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我为你们欢喜，因为我不在那里，是要使你们相信。现在我们到他那里去吧。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我为你们欢喜，因为我不在那里，是要使你们相信。现在我们到他那里去吧。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我没有在那里就欢喜，这是为你们的缘故，好叫你们相信。如今我们可以往他那里去吧。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and for your sake I am glad that I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, that you may believe. Nevertheless let us go to him."
verses.textEnNlt: And for your sakes, I’m glad I wasn’t there, for now you will really believe. Come, let’s go see him."
verses.textEnNasb: and I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe; but let’s go to him."
verses.textEn: <red>and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那称为"双生子" 的多马，对其他的门徒说："我们也去跟他一同死吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那称为"双生子" 的多马，对其他的门徒说："我们也去跟他一同死吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 多马，又称为低土马，就对那同作门徒的说：「我们也去和他同死吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Thomas (also known as Didymus ) said to the rest of the disciples, "Let us also go, that we may die with him."
verses.textEnEsv: So Thomas, called the Twin, said to his fellow disciples, "Let us also go, that we may die with him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Thomas, who is called the Twin, said to his fellow disciples, "Let us also go, that we may die with Him."
verses.textEnNlt: Thomas, nicknamed the Twin, said to his fellow disciples, "Let’s go, too—and die with Jesus."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Thomas, who was called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, "Let’s also go, so that we may die with Him!"
verses.textEn: Then Thomas (also known as Didymus ) said to the rest of the disciples, "Let us also go, that we may die with him."

verses.textZh: 耶稣到了，知道拉撒路在坟墓里已经四天了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣到了，知道拉撒路在坟墓里已经四天了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣到了，就知道拉撒路在坟墓里已经四天了。
verses.textEnNiv: On his arrival, Jesus found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Jesus came, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Jesus came, He found that he had already been in the tomb four days.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus arrived at Bethany, he was told that Lazarus had already been in his grave for four days.
verses.textEnNasb: So when Jesus came, He found that he had already been in the tomb four days.
verses.textEn: On his arrival, Jesus found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.

verses.textZh: 伯大尼靠近耶路撒冷，相距约有三公里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伯大尼靠近耶路撒冷，相距约有三公里。
verses.textZhCuv: 伯大尼离耶路撒冷不远，约有六里路。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Bethany was less than two miles from Jerusalem,
verses.textEnEsv: Bethany was near Jerusalem, about two miles off,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about two miles away.
verses.textEnNlt: Bethany was only a few miles down the road from Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away;
verses.textEn: Now Bethany was less than two miles from Jerusalem,

verses.textZh: 有许多犹太人来到马大和马利亚那里，为了拉撒路的死来安慰她们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多犹太人来到马大和马利亚那里，为了拉撒路的死来安慰她们。
verses.textZhCuv: 有好些犹太人来看马大和马利亚，要为她们的兄弟安慰她们。
verses.textEnNiv: and many Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them in the loss of their brother.
verses.textEnEsv: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to console them concerning their brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: And many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
verses.textEnNlt: and many of the people had come to console Martha and Mary in their loss.
verses.textEnNasb: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary, to console them about their brother.
verses.textEn: and many Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them in the loss of their brother.

verses.textZh: 马大听见耶稣来了，就去迎接他，马利亚却仍然坐在家里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 马大听见耶稣来了，就去迎接他，马利亚却仍然坐在家里。
verses.textZhCuv: 马大听见耶稣来了，就出去迎接他；马利亚却仍然坐在家里。
verses.textEnNiv: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed at home.
verses.textEnEsv: So when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary remained seated in the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met Him, but Mary was sitting in the house.
verses.textEnNlt: When Martha got word that Jesus was coming, she went to meet him. But Mary stayed in the house.
verses.textEnNasb: So then Martha, when she heard that Jesus was coming, went to meet Him, but Mary stayed in the house.
verses.textEn: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed at home.

verses.textZh: 马大对耶稣说："主啊，如果你早在这里，我的兄弟就不会死了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 马大对耶稣说："主啊，如果你早在这里，我的兄弟就不会死了！
verses.textZhCuv: 马大对耶稣说：「主啊，你若早在这里，我兄弟必不死。
verses.textEnNiv: "Lord," Martha said to Jesus, "if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
verses.textEnEsv: Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
verses.textEnNlt: Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, if only you had been here, my brother would not have died.
verses.textEnNasb: Martha then said to Jesus, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
verses.textEn: "Lord," Martha said to Jesus, "if you had been here, my brother would not have died.

verses.textZh: 就是现在，我也知道无论你向神求甚么，神必赐给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是现在，我也知道无论你向神求甚么，神必赐给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就是现在，我也知道，你无论向神求什么，神也必赐给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask."
verses.textEnEsv: But even now I know that whatever you ask from God, God will give you."
verses.textEnNkjv: But even now I know that whatever You ask of God, God will give You."
verses.textEnNlt: But even now I know that God will give you whatever you ask."
verses.textEnNasb: Even now I know that whatever You ask of God, God will give You."
verses.textEn: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask."

verses.textZh: 耶稣对她说："<red>你的兄弟必会复活。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对她说："<red>你的兄弟必会复活。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你兄弟必然复活。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to her, <red>“Your brother will rise again.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to her, "Your brother will rise again."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to her, "Your brother will rise again."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told her, "Your brother will rise again."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to her, "Your brother will rise from the dead."
verses.textEn: Jesus said to her, <red>“Your brother will rise again.”</red>

verses.textZh: 马大说："我知道在末日复活的时候，他必会复活。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 马大说："我知道在末日复活的时候，他必会复活。"
verses.textZhCuv: 马大说：「我知道在末日复活的时候，他必复活。」
verses.textEnNiv: Martha answered, "I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day."
verses.textEnEsv: Martha said to him, "I know that he will rise again in the resurrection on the last day."
verses.textEnNkjv: Martha said to Him, "I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day."
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," Martha said, "he will rise when everyone else rises, at the last day."
verses.textEnNasb: Martha *said to Him, "I know that he will rise in the resurrection on the last day."
verses.textEn: Martha answered, "I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>我就是复活和生命；信我的人，虽然死了，也要活着。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>我就是复活和生命；信我的人，虽然死了，也要活着。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对她说：「复活在我，生命也在我。信我的人虽然死了，也必复活；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to her, <red>“I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die;</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, though he die, yet shall he live,
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in Me, though he may die, he shall live.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told her, "I am the resurrection and the life. Anyone who believes in me will live, even after dying.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life; the one who believes in Me will live, even if he dies,
verses.textEn: Jesus said to her, <red>“I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die;</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所有活着又信我的人，必定永远不死，你信这话吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所有活着又信我的人，必定永远不死，你信这话吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡活着信我的人必永远不死。你信这话吗？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and whoever lives by believing in me will never die. Do you believe this?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and everyone who lives and believes in me shall never die. Do you believe this?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever lives and believes in Me shall never die. Do you believe this?"
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone who lives in me and believes in me will never ever die. Do you believe this, Martha?"
verses.textEnNasb: and everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?"
verses.textEn: <red>and whoever lives by believing in me will never die. Do you believe this?”</red>

verses.textZh: 她说："主啊，我信；我已经信了，你是基督，是神的儿子，是那要到世上来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她说："主啊，我信；我已经信了，你是基督，是神的儿子，是那要到世上来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 马大说：「主啊，是的，我信你是基督，是神的儿子，就是那要临到世界的。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Yes, Lord," she replied, "I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who is to come into the world."
verses.textEnEsv: She said to him, "Yes, Lord; I believe that you are the Christ, the Son of God, who is coming into the world."
verses.textEnNkjv: She said to Him, "Yes, Lord, I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who is to come into the world."
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, Lord," she told him. "I have always believed you are the Messiah, the Son of God, the one who has come into the world from God."
verses.textEnNasb: She *said to Him, "Yes, Lord; I have come to believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, and He who comes into the world."
verses.textEn: "Yes, Lord," she replied, "I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who is to come into the world."

verses.textZh: 马大说了这些话，就回去叫她妹妹马利亚，暗暗地说："老师来了，他叫你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 马大说了这些话，就回去叫她妹妹马利亚，暗暗地说："老师来了，他叫你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 马大说了这话，就回去暗暗地叫她妹子马利亚，说：「夫子来了，叫你。」
verses.textEnNiv: After she had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside. "The Teacher is here," she said, "and is asking for you."
verses.textEnEsv: When she had said this, she went and called her sister Mary, saying in private, "The Teacher is here and is calling for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when she had said these things, she went her way and secretly called Mary her sister, saying, "The Teacher has come and is calling for you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then she returned to Mary. She called Mary aside from the mourners and told her, "The Teacher is here and wants to see you."
verses.textEnNasb: When she had said this, she left and called Mary her sister, saying secretly, "The Teacher is here and is calling for you."
verses.textEn: After she had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside. "The Teacher is here," she said, "and is asking for you."

verses.textZh: 马利亚一听见，就急忙起来，到耶稣那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 马利亚一听见，就急忙起来，到耶稣那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 马利亚听见了，就急忙起来，到耶稣那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when she heard it, she rose quickly and went to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly and came to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Mary immediately went to him.
verses.textEnNasb: And when she heard this, she *got up quickly and came to Him.
verses.textEn: When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to him.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶稣还没有进入村子，仍然在马大迎接他的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶稣还没有进入村子，仍然在马大迎接他的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶稣还没有进村子，仍在马大迎接他的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was still in the place where Martha had met him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jesus had not yet come into the town, but was in the place where Martha met Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus had stayed outside the village, at the place where Martha met him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was still at the place where Martha met Him.
verses.textEn: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met him.

verses.textZh: 那些在房子里和马利亚在一起安慰她的犹太人，见她匆忙地起来出去，就跟着她，以为她要到坟墓那里去哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些在房子里和马利亚在一起安慰她的犹太人，见她匆忙地起来出去，就跟着她，以为她要到坟墓那里去哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些同马利亚在家里安慰她的犹太人，见她急忙起来出去，就跟着她，以为她要往坟墓那里去哭。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Jews who had been with Mary in the house, comforting her, noticed how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Jews who were with her in the house, consoling her, saw Mary rise quickly and go out, they followed her, supposing that she was going to the tomb to weep there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, and comforting her, when they saw that Mary rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, "She is going to the tomb to weep there."
verses.textEnNlt: When the people who were at the house consoling Mary saw her leave so hastily, they assumed she was going to Lazarus’s grave to weep. So they followed her there.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw that Mary had gotten up quickly and left, they followed her, thinking that she was going to the tomb to weep there.
verses.textEn: When the Jews who had been with Mary in the house, comforting her, noticed how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.

verses.textZh: 马利亚来到耶稣那里，一看见他，就俯伏在他脚前，说："主啊，如果你早在这里，我的兄弟就不会死了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 马利亚来到耶稣那里，一看见他，就俯伏在他脚前，说："主啊，如果你早在这里，我的兄弟就不会死了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 马利亚到了耶稣那里，看见他，就俯伏在他脚前，说：「主啊，你若早在这里，我兄弟必不死。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Mary reached the place where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said, "Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died."
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet, saying to him, "Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, when Mary came where Jesus was, and saw Him, she fell down at His feet, saying to Him, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died."
verses.textEnNlt: When Mary arrived and saw Jesus, she fell at his feet and said, "Lord, if only you had been here, my brother would not have died."
verses.textEnNasb: So when Mary came to the place where Jesus was, she saw Him and fell at His feet, saying to Him, "Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died."
verses.textEn: When Mary reached the place where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said, "Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died."

verses.textZh: 耶稣看见她在哭，和她一同来的犹太人也在哭，就心里激动，难过起来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看见她在哭，和她一同来的犹太人也在哭，就心里激动，难过起来，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣看见她哭，并看见与她同来的犹太人也哭，就心里悲叹，又甚忧愁，
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come along with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in his spirit and greatly troubled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who came with her weeping, He groaned in the spirit and was troubled.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus saw her weeping and saw the other people wailing with her, a deep anger welled up within him, and he was deeply troubled.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore when Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who came with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and was troubled,
verses.textEn: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come along with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

verses.textZh: <red>说："你们把他安放在哪里？"他们说："主啊，请来看。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>说："你们把他安放在哪里？"他们说："主啊，请来看。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 便说：「<red>你们把他安放在哪里？</red>」他们回答说：「<red>请主来看。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Where have you laid him?”</red> he asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Where have you laid him?" They said to him, "Lord, come and see."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Where have you laid him?" They said to Him, "Lord, come and see."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where have you put him?" he asked them. They told him, "Lord, come and see."
verses.textEnNasb: and He said, "Where have you laid him?" They *said to Him, "Lord, come and see."
verses.textEn: <red>“Where have you laid him?”</red> he asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they replied.

verses.textZh: 耶稣哭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣哭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣哭了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus wept.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus wept.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus wept.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus wept.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus wept.
verses.textEn: Jesus wept.

verses.textZh: 于是犹太人说："你看，他多么爱这个人！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是犹太人说："你看，他多么爱这个人！"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人就说：「你看他爱这人是何等恳切。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Jews said, "See how he loved him!"
verses.textEnEsv: So the Jews said, "See how he loved him!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Jews said, "See how He loved him!"
verses.textEnNlt: The people who were standing nearby said, "See how much he loved him!"
verses.textEnNasb: So the Jews were saying, "See how He loved him!"
verses.textEn: Then the Jews said, "See how he loved him!"

verses.textZh: 他们中间有人说："他既然开了瞎子的眼睛，难道不能使这个人不死吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中间有人说："他既然开了瞎子的眼睛，难道不能使这个人不死吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 其中有人说：「他既然开了瞎子的眼睛，岂不能叫这人不死吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But some of them said, "Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?"
verses.textEnEsv: But some of them said, "Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man also have kept this man from dying?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And some of them said, "Could not this Man, who opened the eyes of the blind, also have kept this man from dying?"
verses.textEnNlt: But some said, "This man healed a blind man. Couldn’t he have kept Lazarus from dying?"
verses.textEnNasb: But some of them said, "Could this Man, who opened the eyes of the man who was blind, not have also kept this man from dying?"
verses.textEn: But some of them said, "Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣又再心里激动，来到坟墓前面。那坟墓是一个洞穴，洞口有块石头堵住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又再心里激动，来到坟墓前面。那坟墓是一个洞穴，洞口有块石头堵住。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又心里悲叹，来到坟墓前；那坟墓是个洞，有一块石头挡着。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus, once more deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus, deeply moved again, came to the tomb. It was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus, again groaning in Himself, came to the tomb. It was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus was still angry as he arrived at the tomb, a cave with a stone rolled across its entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus, again being deeply moved within, *came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone was lying against it.
verses.textEn: Jesus, once more deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："把这块石头挪开！"死者的姊姊马大对他说："主啊，已经四天了，他必定臭了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："把这块石头挪开！"死者的姊姊马大对他说："主啊，已经四天了，他必定臭了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们把石头挪开。</red>」那死人的姊姊马大对他说：「<red>主啊，他现在必是臭了，因为他死了已经四天了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Take away the stone,”</red> he said. “But, Lord,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man, “by this time there is a bad odor, for he has been there four days.”
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said, "Take away the stone." Martha, the sister of the dead man, said to him, "Lord, by this time there will be an odor, for he has been dead four days."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said, "Take away the stone." Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to Him, "Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days."
verses.textEnNlt: "Roll the stone aside," Jesus told them. But Martha, the dead man’s sister, protested, "Lord, he has been dead for four days. The smell will be terrible."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said, "Remove the stone." Martha, the sister of the deceased, *said to Him, "Lord, by this time there will be a stench, for he has been dead four days."
verses.textEn: <red>“Take away the stone,”</red> he said. “But, Lord,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man, “by this time there is a bad odor, for he has been there four days.”

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>我不是对你说过‘如果你信，就必定看见神的荣耀’吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>我不是对你说过‘如果你信，就必定看见神的荣耀’吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我不是对你说过，你若信，就必看见神的荣耀吗？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said, <red>“Did I not tell you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to her, "Did I not tell you that if you believed you would see the glory of God?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to her, "Did I not say to you that if you would believe you would see the glory of God?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus responded, "Didn’t I tell you that you would see God’s glory if you believe?"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to her, "Did I not say to you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?"
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said, <red>“Did I not tell you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他们把石头挪开。耶稣举目向天，说："<red>父啊，我感谢你，因为你垂听了我，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们把石头挪开。耶稣举目向天，说："<red>父啊，我感谢你，因为你垂听了我，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他们就把石头挪开。耶稣举目望天，说：「父啊，我感谢你，因为你已经听我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus looked up and said, <red>“Father, I thank you that you have heard me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So they took away the stone. And Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, "Father, I thank you that you have heard me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they took away the stone fromtheplace where the dead man was lying. And Jesus lifted up His eyes and said, "Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.
verses.textEnNlt: So they rolled the stone aside. Then Jesus looked up to heaven and said, "Father, thank you for hearing me.
verses.textEnNasb: So they removed the stone. And Jesus raised His eyes, and said, "Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.
verses.textEn: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus looked up and said, <red>“Father, I thank you that you have heard me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我知道你常常听我，但我说这话，是为了周围站着的群众，叫他们信是你差了我来。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我知道你常常听我，但我说这话，是为了周围站着的群众，叫他们信是你差了我来。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我也知道你常听我，但我说这话是为周围站着的众人，叫他们信是你差了我来。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I knew that you always hear me, but I said this for the benefit of the people standing here, that they may believe that you sent me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I knew that you always hear me, but I said this on account of the people standing around, that they may believe that you sent me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I know that You always hear Me, but because of the people who are standing by I said this, that they may believe that You sent Me."
verses.textEnNlt: You always hear me, but I said it out loud for the sake of all these people standing here, so that they will believe you sent me."
verses.textEnNasb: But I knew that You always hear Me; nevertheless, because of the people standing around I said it, so that they may believe that You sent Me."
verses.textEn: <red>I knew that you always hear me, but I said this for the benefit of the people standing here, that they may believe that you sent me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 说了这话，就大声呼喊："<red>拉撒路，出来！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说了这话，就大声呼喊："<red>拉撒路，出来！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 说了这话，就大声呼叫说：「<red>拉撒路出来！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When he had said this, Jesus called in a loud voice, <red>“Lazarus, come out!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When he had said these things, he cried out with a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He had said these things, He cried with a loud voice, "Lazarus, come forth!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus shouted, "Lazarus, come out!"
verses.textEnNasb: And when He had said these things, He cried out with a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"
verses.textEn: When he had said this, Jesus called in a loud voice, <red>“Lazarus, come out!”</red>

verses.textZh: 那死了的人就出来，他的手脚都缠着布，脸上裹着巾。耶稣说："<red>解开他，让他走！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那死了的人就出来，他的手脚都缠着布，脸上裹着巾。耶稣说："<red>解开他，让他走！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 那死人就出来了，手脚裹着布，脸上包着手巾。耶稣对他们说：「<red>解开，叫他走！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: The dead man came out, his hands and feet wrapped with strips of linen, and a cloth around his face. Jesus said to them, <red>“Take off the grave clothes and let him go.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The man who had died came out, his hands and feet bound with linen strips, and his face wrapped with a cloth. Jesus said to them, "Unbind him, and let him go."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he who had died came out bound hand and foot with graveclothes, and his face was wrapped with a cloth. Jesus said to them, "Loose him, and let him go."
verses.textEnNlt: And the dead man came out, his hands and feet bound in graveclothes, his face wrapped in a headcloth. Jesus told them, "Unwrap him and let him go!"
verses.textEnNasb: Out came the man who had died, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus *said to them, "Unbind him, and let him go."
verses.textEn: The dead man came out, his hands and feet wrapped with strips of linen, and a cloth around his face. Jesus said to them, <red>“Take off the grave clothes and let him go.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有许多到马利亚那里去的犹太人，看见了耶稣所作的事，就信了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多到马利亚那里去的犹太人，看见了耶稣所作的事，就信了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些来看马利亚的犹太人见了耶稣所做的事，就多有信他的；
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to visit Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in him.
verses.textEnEsv: Many of the Jews therefore, who had come with Mary and had seen what he did, believed in him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then many of the Jews who had come to Mary, and had seen the things Jesus did, believed in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Many of the people who were with Mary believed in Jesus when they saw this happen.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary, and saw what He had done, believed in Him.
verses.textEn: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to visit Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in him.

verses.textZh: 但他们中间有些人到法利赛人那里去，把耶稣所作的事都告诉他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们中间有些人到法利赛人那里去，把耶稣所作的事都告诉他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 但其中也有去见法利赛人的，将耶稣所做的事告诉他们。
verses.textEnNiv: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
verses.textEnEsv: but some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things Jesus did.
verses.textEnNlt: But some went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
verses.textEnNasb: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.
verses.textEn: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

verses.textZh: 于是祭司长和法利赛人召开公议会，说："这个人行了许多神迹，我们怎么办呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是祭司长和法利赛人召开公议会，说："这个人行了许多神迹，我们怎么办呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长和法利赛人聚集公会，说：「这人行好些神迹，我们怎么办呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called a meeting of the Sanhedrin. "What are we accomplishing?" they asked. "Here is this man performing many signs.
verses.textEnEsv: So the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered the council and said, "What are we to do? For this man performs many signs.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered a council and said, "What shall we do? For this Man works many signs.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the leading priests and Pharisees called the high council together. "What are we going to do?" they asked each other. "This man certainly performs many miraculous signs.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the chief priests and the Pharisees convened a council meeting, and they were saying, "What are we doing in regard to the fact that this Man is performing many signs?
verses.textEn: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called a meeting of the Sanhedrin. "What are we accomplishing?" they asked. "Here is this man performing many signs.

verses.textZh: 我们若让他这样，所有的人都会信他，罗马人就会来，夺取我们的圣地，除灭我们的民族。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若让他这样，所有的人都会信他，罗马人就会来，夺取我们的圣地，除灭我们的民族。"
verses.textZhCuv: 若这样由着他，人人都要信他，罗马人也要来夺我们的地土和我们的百姓。」
verses.textEnNiv: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our temple and our nation."
verses.textEnEsv: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation."
verses.textEnNkjv: If we let Him alone like this, everyone will believe in Him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and nation."
verses.textEnNlt: If we allow him to go on like this, soon everyone will believe in him. Then the Roman army will come and destroy both our Temple and our nation."
verses.textEnNasb: If we let Him go on like this, all the people will believe in Him, and the Romans will come and take over both our place and our nation."
verses.textEn: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our temple and our nation."

verses.textZh: 他们当中有一位该亚法，是那年作大祭司的，对他们说："你们甚么都不知道，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们当中有一位该亚法，是那年作大祭司的，对他们说："你们甚么都不知道，
verses.textZhCuv: 内中有一个人，名叫该亚法，本年作大祭司，对他们说：「你们不知道什么。
verses.textEnNiv: Then one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, spoke up, "You know nothing at all!
verses.textEnEsv: But one of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, "You know nothing at all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, "You know nothing at all,
verses.textEnNlt: Caiaphas, who was high priest at that time, said, "You don’t know what you’re talking about!
verses.textEnNasb: But one of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, "You know nothing at all,
verses.textEn: Then one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, spoke up, "You know nothing at all!

verses.textZh: 也不去想想，一个人代替人民死，免得整个民族灭亡，这对你们是有益的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不去想想，一个人代替人民死，免得整个民族灭亡，这对你们是有益的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 独不想一个人替百姓死，免得通国灭亡，就是你们的益处。」
verses.textEnNiv: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish."
verses.textEnEsv: Nor do you understand that it is better for you that one man should die for the people, not that the whole nation should perish."
verses.textEnNkjv: nor do you consider that it is expedient for us that one man should die for the people, and not that the whole nation should perish."
verses.textEnNlt: You don’t realize that it’s better for you that one man should die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed."
verses.textEnNasb: nor are you taking into account that it is in your best interest that one man die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish instead."
verses.textEn: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish."

verses.textZh: 他说这话不是由于自己，而是因为他是那年的大祭司，所以预言耶稣要替犹太民族死；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说这话不是由于自己，而是因为他是那年的大祭司，所以预言耶稣要替犹太民族死；
verses.textZhCuv: 他这话不是出于自己，是因他本年作大祭司，所以预言耶稣将要替这一国死；
verses.textEnNiv: He did not say this on his own, but as high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the Jewish nation,
verses.textEnEsv: He did not say this of his own accord, but being high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this he did not say on his own authority; but being high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
verses.textEnNlt: He did not say this on his own; as high priest at that time he was led to prophesy that Jesus would die for the entire nation.
verses.textEnNasb: Now he did not say this on his own, but as he was high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus was going to die for the nation;
verses.textEn: He did not say this on his own, but as high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the Jewish nation,

verses.textZh: 不但替犹太民族死，也要把散居各地的神的儿女招聚成为一体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不但替犹太民族死，也要把散居各地的神的儿女招聚成为一体。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不但替这一国死，并要将神四散的子民都聚集归一。
verses.textEnNiv: and not only for that nation but also for the scattered children of God, to bring them together and make them one.
verses.textEnEsv: and not for the nation only, but also to gather into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
verses.textEnNkjv: and not for that nation only, but also that He would gather together in one the children of God who were scattered abroad.
verses.textEnNlt: And not only for that nation, but to bring together and unite all the children of God scattered around the world.
verses.textEnNasb: and not for the nation only, but in order that He might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
verses.textEn: and not only for that nation but also for the scattered children of God, to bring them together and make them one.

verses.textZh: 从那天起，他们就想杀害耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那天起，他们就想杀害耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 从那日起，他们就商议要杀耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: So from that day on they plotted to take his life.
verses.textEnEsv: So from that day on they made plans to put him to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, from that day on, they plotted to put Him to death.
verses.textEnNlt: So from that time on, the Jewish leaders began to plot Jesus’ death.
verses.textEnNasb: So from that day on they planned together to kill Him.
verses.textEn: So from that day on they plotted to take his life.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶稣不再在犹太人中间公开活动，却离开那里，到旷野附近的地方去；到了一座名叫以法莲的城，就和门徒住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶稣不再在犹太人中间公开活动，却离开那里，到旷野附近的地方去；到了一座名叫以法莲的城，就和门徒住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶稣不再显然行在犹太人中间，就离开那里往靠近旷野的地方去，到了一座城，名叫以法莲，就在那里和门徒同住。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore Jesus no longer moved about publicly among the people of Judea. Instead he withdrew to a region near the wilderness, to a village called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus therefore no longer walked openly among the Jews, but went from there to the region near the wilderness, to a town called Ephraim, and there he stayed with the disciples.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Jesus no longer walked openly among the Jews, but went from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim, and there remained with His disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: As a result, Jesus stopped his public ministry among the people and left Jerusalem. He went to a place near the wilderness, to the village of Ephraim, and stayed there with his disciples.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Jesus no longer continued to walk publicly among the Jews, but went away from there to the region near the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim; and there He stayed with the disciples.
verses.textEn: Therefore Jesus no longer moved about publicly among the people of Judea. Instead he withdrew to a region near the wilderness, to a village called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.

verses.textZh: 犹太人的逾越节快到了，有许多人在过节前从各乡上耶路撒冷去，要在那里洁净自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人的逾越节快到了，有许多人在过节前从各乡上耶路撒冷去，要在那里洁净自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人的逾越节近了，有许多人从乡下上耶路撒冷去，要在节前洁净自己。
verses.textEnNiv: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, many went up from the country to Jerusalem for their ceremonial cleansing before the Passover.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand, and many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover to purify themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Passover of the Jews was near, and many went from the country up to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: It was now almost time for the Jewish Passover celebration, and many people from all over the country arrived in Jerusalem several days early so they could go through the purification ceremony before Passover began.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Passover of the Jews was near, and many went up to Jerusalem from the country prior to the Passover, in order to purify themselves.
verses.textEn: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, many went up from the country to Jerusalem for their ceremonial cleansing before the Passover.

verses.textZh: 他们到处寻找耶稣，站在圣殿里的时候，彼此说："你们认为怎样？他不会来过节吧？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到处寻找耶稣，站在圣殿里的时候，彼此说："你们认为怎样？他不会来过节吧？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就寻找耶稣，站在殿里彼此说：「你们的意思如何，他不来过节吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: They kept looking for Jesus, and as they stood in the temple courts they asked one another, "What do you think? Isn’t he coming to the festival at all?"
verses.textEnEsv: They were looking for Jesus and saying to one another as they stood in the temple, "What do you think? That he will not come to the feast at all?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they sought Jesus, and spoke among themselves as they stood in the temple, "What do you think—that He will not come to the feast?"
