verses.textEnNlt: They kept looking for Jesus, but as they stood around in the Temple, they said to each other, "What do you think? He won’t come for Passover, will he?"
verses.textEnNasb: So they were looking for Jesus, and saying to one another as they stood in the temple area, "What do you think; that He will not come to the feast at all?"
verses.textEn: They kept looking for Jesus, and as they stood in the temple courts they asked one another, "What do you think? Isn’t he coming to the festival at all?"

verses.textZh: 祭司长和法利赛人早已下了命令：如果有人知道耶稣在哪里，就要前来报告，好去逮捕他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长和法利赛人早已下了命令：如果有人知道耶稣在哪里，就要前来报告，好去逮捕他。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，祭司长和法利赛人早已吩咐说，若有人知道耶稣在哪里，就要报明，好去拿他。
verses.textEnNiv: But the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that anyone who found out where Jesus was should report it so that they might arrest him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone knew where he was, he should let them know, so that they might arrest him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a command, that if anyone knew where He was, he should report it, that they might seize Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the leading priests and Pharisees had publicly ordered that anyone seeing Jesus must report it immediately so they could arrest him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone knew where He was, he was to report it, so that they might arrest Him.
verses.textEn: But the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that anyone who found out where Jesus was should report it so that they might arrest him.

verses.textZh: 逾越节前六天，耶稣到了伯大尼，就是拉撒路所住的地方；耶稣曾经使这拉撒路从死人中复活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 逾越节前六天，耶稣到了伯大尼，就是拉撒路所住的地方；耶稣曾经使这拉撒路从死人中复活。
verses.textZhCuv: 逾越节前六日，耶稣来到伯大尼，就是他叫拉撒路从死里复活之处。
verses.textEnNiv: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus lived, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: Six days before the Passover, Jesus therefore came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was who had been dead, whom He had raised from the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: Six days before the Passover celebration began, Jesus arrived in Bethany, the home of Lazarus—the man he had raised from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany where Lazarus was, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.
verses.textEn: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus lived, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.

verses.textZh: 有人在那里为耶稣预备了筵席。马大在那里侍候，拉撒路也和一些人与耶稣一同吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人在那里为耶稣预备了筵席。马大在那里侍候，拉撒路也和一些人与耶稣一同吃饭。

verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus answered them, saying, "The hour has come that the Son of Man should be glorified.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Now the time has come for the Son of Man to enter into his glory.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus *answered them by saying, "The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，一粒麦子若不落在地里死了，仍旧是一粒；如果死了，就结出许多果实来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，一粒麦子若不落在地里死了，仍旧是一粒；如果死了，就结出许多果实来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实实在在地告诉你们，一粒麦子不落在地里死了，仍旧是一粒，若是死了，就结出许多子粒来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Very truly I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a single seed. But if it dies, it produces many seeds.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, truly, I say to you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains alone; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the ground and dies, it remains alone; but if it dies, it produces much grain.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, unless a kernel of wheat is planted in the soil and dies, it remains alone. But its death will produce many new kernels—a plentiful harvest of new lives.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, truly I say to you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains alone; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.
verses.textEn: <red>Very truly I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a single seed. But if it dies, it produces many seeds.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>爱惜自己生命的，就丧掉生命；在这世上恨恶自己生命的，必会保全生命到永远。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>爱惜自己生命的，就丧掉生命；在这世上恨恶自己生命的，必会保全生命到永远。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>爱惜自己生命的，就失丧生命；在这世上恨恶自己生命的，就要保守生命到永生。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Anyone who loves their life will lose it, while anyone who hates their life in this world will keep it for eternal life.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever loves his life loses it, and whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who loves his life will lose it, and he who hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who love their life in this world will lose it. Those who care nothing for their life in this world will keep it for eternity.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who loves his life loses it, and the one who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
verses.textEn: <red>Anyone who loves their life will lose it, while anyone who hates their life in this world will keep it for eternal life.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果有人服事我，就应当跟从我；我在哪里，服事我的人也会在哪里；如果有人服事我，我父必尊重他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果有人服事我，就应当跟从我；我在哪里，服事我的人也会在哪里；如果有人服事我，我父必尊重他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若有人服事我，就当跟从我；我在哪里，服事我的人也要在那里；若有人服事我，我父必尊重他。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever serves me must follow me; and where I am, my servant also will be. My Father will honor the one who serves me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone serves me, he must follow me; and where I am, there will my servant be also. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone serves Me, let him follow Me; and where I am, there My servant will be also. If anyone serves Me, him My Father will honor.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who wants to serve me must follow me, because my servants must be where I am. And the Father will honor anyone who serves me.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, there My servant will be also; if anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever serves me must follow me; and where I am, my servant also will be. My Father will honor the one who serves me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我现在心里烦乱，我应该说甚么呢？说‘父啊，救我脱离这时刻’吗？然而我正是为了这个缘故来的，要面对这时刻。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我现在心里烦乱，我应该说甚么呢？说‘父啊，救我脱离这时刻’吗？然而我正是为了这个缘故来的，要面对这时刻。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我现在心里忧愁，我说什么才好呢？父啊，救我脱离这时候；但我原是为这时候来的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Now my soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this hour’? No, it was for this very reason I came to this hour.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Now is my soul troubled. And what shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this hour’? But for this purpose I have come to this hour.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? But for this purpose I came to this hour.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now my soul is deeply troubled. Should I pray, ‘Father, save me from this hour’? But this is the very reason I came!
verses.textEnNasb: "Now My soul has become troubled; and what am I to say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? But for this purpose I came to this hour.
verses.textEn: <red>“Now my soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this hour’? No, it was for this very reason I came to this hour.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父啊，愿你荣耀你的名！"当时有声音从天上来，说："我已经荣耀了我的名，还要再荣耀。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父啊，愿你荣耀你的名！"当时有声音从天上来，说："我已经荣耀了我的名，还要再荣耀。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 父啊，愿你荣耀你的名！」当时就有声音从天上来，说：「<red>我已经荣耀了我的名，还要再荣耀。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Father, glorify your name!”</red> Then a voice came from heaven, “I have glorified it, and will glorify it again.”
verses.textEnEsv: Father, glorify your name." Then a voice came from heaven: "I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again."
verses.textEnNkjv: Father, glorify Your name." Then a voice came from heaven, saying, "I have both glorified it and will glorify it again."
verses.textEnNlt: Father, bring glory to your name." Then a voice spoke from heaven, saying, "I have already brought glory to my name, and I will do so again."
verses.textEnNasb: Father, glorify Your name." Then a voice came out of heaven: "I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again."
verses.textEn: <red>Father, glorify your name!”</red> Then a voice came from heaven, “I have glorified it, and will glorify it again.”

verses.textZh: 站在旁边的群众听见了，就说："打雷了。"另外有人说："有天使对他说话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 站在旁边的群众听见了，就说："打雷了。"另外有人说："有天使对他说话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 站在旁边的众人听见，就说：「打雷了。」还有人说：「有天使对他说话。」
verses.textEnNiv: The crowd that was there and heard it said it had thundered; others said an angel had spoken to him.
verses.textEnEsv: The crowd that stood there and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, "An angel has spoken to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the people who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, "An angel has spoken to Him."
verses.textEnNlt: When the crowd heard the voice, some thought it was thunder, while others declared an angel had spoken to him.
verses.textEnNasb: So the crowd who stood by and heard it were saying that it had thundered; others were saying, "An angel has spoken to Him!"
verses.textEn: The crowd that was there and heard it said it had thundered; others said an angel had spoken to him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>这声音不是为了我，而是为了你们发出的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>这声音不是为了我，而是为了你们发出的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「这声音不是为我，是为你们来的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, <red>“This voice was for your benefit, not mine.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "This voice has come for your sake, not mine.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said, "This voice did not come because of Me, but for your sake.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus told them, "The voice was for your benefit, not mine.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus responded and said, "This voice has not come for My sake, but for yours.
verses.textEn: Jesus said, <red>“This voice was for your benefit, not mine.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>现在是这世界受审判的时候了，现在这世界的王要被赶出去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>现在是这世界受审判的时候了，现在这世界的王要被赶出去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>现在这世界受审判，这世界的王要被赶出去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Now is the time for judgment on this world; now the prince of this world will be driven out.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Now is the judgment of this world; now will the ruler of this world be cast out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now is the judgment of this world; now the ruler of this world will be cast out.
verses.textEnNlt: The time for judging this world has come, when Satan, the ruler of this world, will be cast out.
verses.textEnNasb: Now judgment is upon this world; now the ruler of this world will be cast out.
verses.textEn: <red>Now is the time for judgment on this world; now the prince of this world will be driven out.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我若从地上被举起来，就要吸引万人归向我。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我若从地上被举起来，就要吸引万人归向我。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若从地上被举起来，就要吸引万人来归我。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all peoples to Myself."
verses.textEnNlt: And when I am lifted up from the earth, I will draw everyone to myself."
verses.textEnNasb: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to Myself."
verses.textEn: <red>And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他说这话，是指着自己将要怎样死说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说这话，是指着自己将要怎样死说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣这话原是指着自己将要怎样死说的。
verses.textEnNiv: He said this to show the kind of death he was going to die.
verses.textEnEsv: He said this to show by what kind of death he was going to die.
verses.textEnNkjv: This He said, signifying by what death He would die.
verses.textEnNlt: He said this to indicate how he was going to die.
verses.textEnNasb: Now He was saying this to indicate what kind of death He was going to die.
verses.textEn: He said this to show the kind of death he was going to die.

verses.textZh: 于是群众对他说："<red>我们从律法上知道基督是永远常存的，你怎么说‘人子必须被举起来’呢？这人子是谁呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是群众对他说："<red>我们从律法上知道基督是永远常存的，你怎么说‘人子必须被举起来’呢？这人子是谁呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人回答说：「<red>我们听见律法上有话说，基督是永存的，你怎么说『人子必须被举起来』呢？这人子是谁呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: The crowd spoke up, “We have heard from the Law that the Messiah will remain forever, so how can you say, <red>‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’?</red> Who is this ‘Son of Man’?”
verses.textEnEsv: So the crowd answered him, "We have heard from the Law that the Christ remains forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The people answered Him, "We have heard from the law that the Christ remains forever; and how can You say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?"
verses.textEnNlt: The crowd responded, "We understood from Scripture that the Messiah would live forever. How can you say the Son of Man will die? Just who is this Son of Man, anyway?"
verses.textEnNasb: The crowd then answered Him, "We have heard from the Law that the Christ is to remain forever; and how is it that You say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?"
verses.textEn: The crowd spoke up, “We have heard from the Law that the Messiah will remain forever, so how can you say, <red>‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’?</red> Who is this ‘Son of Man’?”

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>光在你们中间的时间不多了。你们应当趁着有光的时候行走，免得黑暗追上你们。在黑暗中行走的人，不知道往哪里去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>光在你们中间的时间不多了。你们应当趁着有光的时候行走，免得黑暗追上你们。在黑暗中行走的人，不知道往哪里去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「光在你们中间还有不多的时候，应当趁着有光行走，免得黑暗临到你们；那在黑暗里行走的，不知道往何处去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus told them, <red>“You are going to have the light just a little while longer. Walk while you have the light, before darkness overtakes you. Whoever walks in the dark does not know where they are going.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus said to them, "The light is among you for a little while longer. Walk while you have the light, lest darkness overtake you. The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "A little while longer the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, lest darkness overtake you; he who walks in darkness does not know where he is going.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "My light will shine for you just a little longer. Walk in the light while you can, so the darkness will not overtake you. Those who walk in the darkness cannot see where they are going.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus said to them, "For a little while longer the Light is among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you; also, the one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus told them, <red>“You are going to have the light just a little while longer. Walk while you have the light, before darkness overtakes you. Whoever walks in the dark does not know where they are going.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们应当趁着有光的时候信从这光，使你们成为光明的儿女。" 耶稣说完了这些话，就离开他们隐藏起来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们应当趁着有光的时候信从这光，使你们成为光明的儿女。" 耶稣说完了这些话，就离开他们隐藏起来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们应当趁着有光，信从这光，使你们成为光明之子。」 耶稣说了这话，就离开他们隐藏了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Believe in the light while you have the light, so that you may become children of light.”</red> When he had finished speaking, Jesus left and hid himself from them.
verses.textEnEsv: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become sons of light." When Jesus had said these things, he departed and hid himself from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become sons of light." These things Jesus spoke, and departed, and was hidden from them.
verses.textEnNlt: Put your trust in the light while there is still time; then you will become children of the light." After saying these things, Jesus went away and was hidden from them.
verses.textEnNasb: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of Light." These things Jesus proclaimed, and He went away and hid Himself from them.
verses.textEn: <red>Believe in the light while you have the light, so that you may become children of light.”</red> When he had finished speaking, Jesus left and hid himself from them.

verses.textZh: 耶稣在他们面前行了许多神迹，但是他们仍然不信他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣在他们面前行了许多神迹，但是他们仍然不信他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他虽然在他们面前行了许多神迹，他们还是不信他。
verses.textEnNiv: Even after Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still would not believe in him.
verses.textEnEsv: Though he had done so many signs before them, they still did not believe in him,
verses.textEnNkjv: But although He had done so many signs before them, they did not believe in Him,
verses.textEnNlt: But despite all the miraculous signs Jesus had done, most of the people still did not believe in him.
verses.textEnNasb: But though He had performed so many signs in their sight, they still were not believing in Him.
verses.textEn: Even after Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still would not believe in him.

verses.textZh: 这是要应验以赛亚先知所说的话： "主啊，我们所传的，有谁信呢？ 主的膀臂向谁显露呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是要应验以赛亚先知所说的话： "主啊，我们所传的，有谁信呢？ 主的膀臂向谁显露呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说： 主啊，我们所传的有谁信呢？ 主的膀臂向谁显露呢？
verses.textEnNiv: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: "Lord, who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"
verses.textEnEsv: so that the word spoken by the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled: "Lord, who has believed what he heard from us, and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"
verses.textEnNkjv: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: "Lord, who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"
verses.textEnNlt: This is exactly what Isaiah the prophet had predicted: " Lord , who has believed our message? To whom has the Lord revealed his powerful arm?"
verses.textEnNasb: This happened so that the word of Isaiah the prophet which he spoke would be fulfilled: "Lord, who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"
verses.textEn: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: "Lord, who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"

verses.textZh: 他们不能相信，因为以赛亚又说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不能相信，因为以赛亚又说：
verses.textZhCuv: 他们所以不能信，因为以赛亚又说：
verses.textEnNiv: For this reason they could not believe, because, as Isaiah says elsewhere:
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore they could not believe. For again Isaiah said,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they could not believe, because Isaiah said again:
verses.textEnNlt: But the people couldn’t believe, for as Isaiah also said,
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason they could not believe, for Isaiah said again,
verses.textEn: For this reason they could not believe, because, as Isaiah says elsewhere:

verses.textZh: "神使他们瞎了眼，硬了心， 免得他们眼睛看见， 心里明白而回转过来； 我就医好他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "神使他们瞎了眼，硬了心， 免得他们眼睛看见， 心里明白而回转过来； 我就医好他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 主叫他们瞎了眼， 硬了心， 免得他们眼睛看见， 心里明白，回转过来， 我就医治他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so they can neither see with their eyes, nor understand with their hearts, nor turn—and I would heal them."
verses.textEnEsv: "He has blinded their eyes and hardened their heart, lest they see with their eyes, and understand with their heart, and turn, and I would heal them."
verses.textEnNkjv: "He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, Lest they should see with their eyes, Lest they should understand with their hearts and turn, So that I should heal them."
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts— so that their eyes cannot see, and their hearts cannot understand, and they cannot turn to me and have me heal them."
verses.textEnNasb: "He has blinded their eyes and He hardened their heart, so that they will not see with their eyes and understand with their heart, and be converted, and so I will not heal them."
verses.textEn: "He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so they can neither see with their eyes, nor understand with their hearts, nor turn—and I would heal them."

verses.textZh: 以赛亚说这些话，是因为看见了他的荣耀，就指着他说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚说这些话，是因为看见了他的荣耀，就指着他说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚因为看见他的荣耀，就指着他说这话。
verses.textEnNiv: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about him.
verses.textEnEsv: Isaiah said these things because he saw his glory and spoke of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things Isaiah said when he saw His glory and spoke of Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Isaiah was referring to Jesus when he said this, because he saw the future and spoke of the Messiah’s glory.
verses.textEnNasb: These things Isaiah said because he saw His glory, and he spoke about Him.
verses.textEn: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about him.

verses.textZh: 虽然这样，官长当中也有许多人信了耶稣。但是因为法利赛人的缘故，他们不敢公开承认，免得被赶出会堂；
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然这样，官长当中也有许多人信了耶稣。但是因为法利赛人的缘故，他们不敢公开承认，免得被赶出会堂；
verses.textZhCuv: 虽然如此，官长中却有好些信他的，只因法利赛人的缘故，就不承认，恐怕被赶出会堂。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet at the same time many even among the leaders believed in him. But because of the Pharisees they would not openly acknowledge their faith for fear they would be put out of the synagogue;
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, many even of the authorities believed in him, but for fear of the Pharisees they did not confess it, so that they would not be put out of the synagogue;
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless even among the rulers many believed in Him, but because of the Pharisees they did not confess Him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue;
verses.textEnNlt: Many people did believe in him, however, including some of the Jewish leaders. But they wouldn’t admit it for fear that the Pharisees would expel them from the synagogue.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless many, even of the rulers, believed in Him, but because of the Pharisees they were not confessing Him, so that they would not be excommunicated from the synagogue;
verses.textEn: Yet at the same time many even among the leaders believed in him. But because of the Pharisees they would not openly acknowledge their faith for fear they would be put out of the synagogue;

verses.textZh: 因为他们爱来自人的荣耀，过于爱来自神的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们爱来自人的荣耀，过于爱来自神的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是因他们爱人的荣耀过于爱神的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: for they loved human praise more than praise from God.
verses.textEnEsv: for they loved the glory that comes from man more than the glory that comes from God.
verses.textEnNkjv: for they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
verses.textEnNlt: For they loved human praise more than the praise of God.
verses.textEnNasb: for they loved the approval of people rather than the approval of God.
verses.textEn: for they loved human praise more than praise from God.

verses.textZh: 耶稣大声说："<red>信我的，不单是信我，也是信那差我来的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣大声说："<red>信我的，不单是信我，也是信那差我来的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣大声说：「信我的，不是信我，乃是信那差我来的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus cried out, <red>“Whoever believes in me does not believe in me only, but in the one who sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus cried out and said, "Whoever believes in me, believes not in me but in him who sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus cried out and said, "He who believes in Me, believes not in Me but in Him who sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus shouted to the crowds, "If you trust me, you are trusting not only me, but also God who sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jesus cried out and said, "The one who believes in Me, does not believe only in Me, but also in Him who sent Me.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus cried out, <red>“Whoever believes in me does not believe in me only, but in the one who sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>看见我的，就是看见那差我来的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>看见我的，就是看见那差我来的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人看见我，就是看见那差我来的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The one who looks at me is seeing the one who sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever sees me sees him who sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he who sees Me sees Him who sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: For when you see me, you are seeing the one who sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: And the one who sees Me sees Him who sent Me.
verses.textEn: <red>The one who looks at me is seeing the one who sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我是光，我到世上来，叫所有信我的不住在黑暗里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我是光，我到世上来，叫所有信我的不住在黑暗里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我到世上来，乃是光，叫凡信我的，不住在黑暗里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in me should stay in darkness.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I have come into the world as light, so that whoever believes in me may not remain in darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in Me should not abide in darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: I have come as a light to shine in this dark world, so that all who put their trust in me will no longer remain in the dark.
verses.textEnNasb: I have come as Light into the world, so that no one who believes in Me will remain in darkness.
verses.textEn: <red>I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in me should stay in darkness.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人若听见我的话却不遵守的，我不审判他，因为我来不是要审判世人，而是要拯救世人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人若听见我的话却不遵守的，我不审判他，因为我来不是要审判世人，而是要拯救世人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若有人听见我的话不遵守，我不审判他。我来本不是要审判世界，乃是要拯救世界。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“If anyone hears my words but does not keep them, I do not judge that person. For I did not come to judge the world, but to save the world.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone hears my words and does not keep them, I do not judge him; for I did not come to judge the world but to save the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if anyone hears My words and does not believe, I do not judge him; for I did not come to judge the world but to save the world.
verses.textEnNlt: I will not judge those who hear me but don’t obey me, for I have come to save the world and not to judge it.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone hears My teachings and does not keep them, I do not judge him; for I did not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.textEn: <red>“If anyone hears my words but does not keep them, I do not judge that person. For I did not come to judge the world, but to save the world.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>弃绝我又不接受我的话的人，自有审判他的。我所讲的道在末日要定他的罪；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>弃绝我又不接受我的话的人，自有审判他的。我所讲的道在末日要定他的罪；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>弃绝我、不领受我话的人，有审判他的－就是我所讲的道在末日要审判他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>There is a judge for the one who rejects me and does not accept my words; the very words I have spoken will condemn them at the last day.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The one who rejects me and does not receive my words has a judge; the word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who rejects Me, and does not receive My words, has that which judges him— the word that I have spoken will judge him in the last day.
verses.textEnNlt: But all who reject me and my message will be judged on the day of judgment by the truth I have spoken.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who rejects Me and does not accept My teachings has one who judges him: the word which I spoke. That will judge him on the last day.
verses.textEn: <red>There is a judge for the one who rejects me and does not accept my words; the very words I have spoken will condemn them at the last day.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为我没有凭着自己说话，而是差我来的父给了我命令，要我说甚么，讲甚么。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为我没有凭着自己说话，而是差我来的父给了我命令，要我说甚么，讲甚么。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为我没有凭着自己讲，惟有差我来的父已经给我命令，叫我说什么，讲什么。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For I did not speak on my own, but the Father who sent me commanded me to say all that I have spoken.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I have not spoken on my own authority, but the Father who sent me has himself given me a commandment—what to say and what to speak.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have not spoken on My own authority; but the Father who sent Me gave Me a command, what I should say and what I should speak.
verses.textEnNlt: I don’t speak on my own authority. The Father who sent me has commanded me what to say and how to say it.
verses.textEnNasb: For I did not speak on My own, but the Father Himself who sent Me has given Me a commandment as to what to say and what to speak.
verses.textEn: <red>For I did not speak on my own, but the Father who sent me commanded me to say all that I have spoken.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我知道他的命令就是永生。所以，我所讲的，正是父吩咐我要我讲的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我知道他的命令就是永生。所以，我所讲的，正是父吩咐我要我讲的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我也知道他的命令就是永生。故此，我所讲的话正是照着父对我所说的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I know that his command leads to eternal life. So whatever I say is just what the Father has told me to say.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I know that his commandment is eternal life. What I say, therefore, I say as the Father has told me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I know that His command is everlasting life. Therefore, whatever I speak, just as the Father has told Me, so I speak."
verses.textEnNlt: And I know his commands lead to eternal life; so I say whatever the Father tells me to say."
verses.textEnNasb: And I know that His commandment is eternal life; therefore the things I speak, I speak just as the Father has told Me."
verses.textEn: <red>I know that his command leads to eternal life. So whatever I say is just what the Father has told me to say.”</red>

verses.textZh: 逾越节以前，耶稣知道自己离开这世界回到父那里去的时候到了。他既然爱世上属于自己的人，就爱他们到底。
verses.textZhCnvs: 逾越节以前，耶稣知道自己离开这世界回到父那里去的时候到了。他既然爱世上属于自己的人，就爱他们到底。
verses.textZhCuv: 逾越节以前，耶稣知道自己离世归父的时候到了。他既然爱世间属自己的人，就爱他们到底。
verses.textEnNiv: It was just before the Passover Festival. Jesus knew that the hour had come for him to leave this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
verses.textEnEsv: Now before the Feast of the Passover, when Jesus knew that his hour had come to depart out of this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now before the Feast of the Passover, when Jesus knew that His hour had come that He should depart from this world to the Father, having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the end.
verses.textEnNlt: Before the Passover celebration, Jesus knew that his hour had come to leave this world and return to his Father. He had loved his disciples during his ministry on earth, and now he loved them to the very end.
verses.textEnNasb: Now before the Feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that His hour had come that He would depart from this world to the Father, having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the end.
verses.textEn: It was just before the Passover Festival. Jesus knew that the hour had come for him to leave this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

verses.textZh: 吃晚饭的时候 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃晚饭的时候 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 吃晚饭的时候，魔鬼已将卖耶稣的意思放在西门的儿子加略人犹大心里。
verses.textEnNiv: The evening meal was in progress, and the devil had already prompted Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: During supper, when the devil had already put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
verses.textEnNkjv: And supper being ended, the devil having already put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray Him,
verses.textEnNlt: It was time for supper, and the devil had already prompted Judas, son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And during supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon, to betray Him,
verses.textEn: The evening meal was in progress, and the devil had already prompted Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.

verses.textZh: 耶稣知道父已经把万有交在他手中，并且知道自己从神而来，又要回到神那里去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣知道父已经把万有交在他手中，并且知道自己从神而来，又要回到神那里去，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣知道父已将万有交在他手里，且知道自己是从神出来的，又要归到神那里去，
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus knew that the Father had put all things under his power, and that he had come from God and was returning to God;
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he had come from God and was going back to God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was going to God,
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus knew that the Father had given him authority over everything and that he had come from God and would return to God.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus, knowing that the Father had handed all things over to Him, and that He had come forth from God and was going back to God,
verses.textEn: Jesus knew that the Father had put all things under his power, and that he had come from God and was returning to God;

verses.textZh: 就起身离席，脱去外衣，拿一条手巾束腰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就起身离席，脱去外衣，拿一条手巾束腰。
verses.textZhCuv: 就离席站起来，脱了衣服，拿一条手巾束腰，
verses.textEnNiv: so he got up from the meal, took off his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
verses.textEnEsv: rose from supper. He laid aside his outer garments, and taking a towel, tied it around his waist.
verses.textEnNkjv: rose from supper and laid aside His garments, took a towel and girded Himself.
verses.textEnNlt: So he got up from the table, took off his robe, wrapped a towel around his waist,
verses.textEnNasb: *got up from supper and *laid His outer garments aside; and He took a towel and tied it around Himself.
verses.textEn: so he got up from the meal, took off his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

verses.textZh: 然后他倒了一盆水，洗门徒的脚，并且用束腰的手巾擦干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后他倒了一盆水，洗门徒的脚，并且用束腰的手巾擦干。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后把水倒在盆里，就洗门徒的脚，并用自己所束的手巾擦干。
verses.textEnNiv: After that, he poured water into a basin and began to wash his disciples’ feet, drying them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
verses.textEnNkjv: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel with which He was girded.
verses.textEnNlt: and poured water into a basin. Then he began to wash the disciples’ feet, drying them with the towel he had around him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He *poured water into the basin, and began washing the disciples’ feet and wiping them with the towel which He had tied around Himself.
verses.textEn: After that, he poured water into a basin and began to wash his disciples’ feet, drying them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

verses.textZh: 轮到西门．彼得，彼得就说："主啊，你要洗我的脚吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 轮到西门．彼得，彼得就说："主啊，你要洗我的脚吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 挨到西门‧彼得，彼得对他说：「主啊，你洗我的脚吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, "Lord, are you going to wash my feet?"
verses.textEnEsv: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, "Lord, do you wash my feet?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He came to Simon Peter. And Peter said to Him, "Lord, are You washing my feet?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus came to Simon Peter, Peter said to him, "Lord, are you going to wash my feet?"
verses.textEnNasb: So He *came to Simon Peter. He *said to Him, "Lord, You are washing my feet?"
verses.textEn: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, "Lord, are you going to wash my feet?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>我所作的，你现在不知道，以后就会明白。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>我所作的，你现在不知道，以后就会明白。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>我所做的，你如今不知道，后来必明白。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered him, "What I am doing you do not understand now, but afterward you will understand."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "What I am doing you do not understand now, but you will know after this."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "You don’t understand now what I am doing, but someday you will."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered and said to him, "What I am doing, you do not realize right now, but you will understand later."
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得说："<red>不行，你千万不可洗我的脚！</red>"耶稣说："<red>如果我不洗你，你就与我没有关系了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得说："<red>不行，你千万不可洗我的脚！</red>"耶稣说："<red>如果我不洗你，你就与我没有关系了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「<red>你永不可洗我的脚！</red>」耶稣说：「<red>我若不洗你，你就与我无分了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: “No,” said Peter, “you shall never wash my feet.” Jesus answered, <red>“Unless I wash you, you have no part with me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Peter said to him, "You shall never wash my feet." Jesus answered him, "If I do not wash you, you have no share with me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Peter said to Him, "You shall never wash my feet!" Jesus answered him, "If I do not wash you, you have no part with Me."
verses.textEnNlt: "No," Peter protested, "you will never ever wash my feet!" Jesus replied, "Unless I wash you, you won’t belong to me."
verses.textEnNasb: Peter *said to Him, "Never shall You wash my feet!" Jesus answered him, "If I do not wash you, you have no place with Me."
verses.textEn: “No,” said Peter, “you shall never wash my feet.” Jesus answered, <red>“Unless I wash you, you have no part with me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得说："主啊，那就不单洗我的脚，连我的手和头都洗吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得说："主啊，那就不单洗我的脚，连我的手和头都洗吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得说：「主啊，不但我的脚，连手和头也要洗。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Then, Lord," Simon Peter replied, "not just my feet but my hands and my head as well!"
verses.textEnEsv: Simon Peter said to him, "Lord, not my feet only but also my hands and my head!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Simon Peter said to Him, "Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!"
verses.textEnNlt: Simon Peter exclaimed, "Then wash my hands and head as well, Lord, not just my feet!"
verses.textEnNasb: Simon Peter *said to Him, "Lord, then wash not only my feet, but also my hands and my head!"
verses.textEn: "Then, Lord," Simon Peter replied, "not just my feet but my hands and my head as well!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>洗过澡的人，全身都洁净，只需要洗脚就可以了。你们是洁净的，但不是人人都是这样。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>洗过澡的人，全身都洁净，只需要洗脚就可以了。你们是洁净的，但不是人人都是这样。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>凡洗过澡的人，只要把脚一洗，全身就干净了。你们是干净的，然而不都是干净的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“Those who have had a bath need only to wash their feet; their whole body is clean. And you are clean, though not every one of you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "The one who has bathed does not need to wash, except for his feet, but is completely clean. And you are clean, but not every one of you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "He who is bathed needs only to wash his feet, but is completely clean; and you are clean, but not all of you."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "A person who has bathed all over does not need to wash, except for the feet, to be entirely clean. And you disciples are clean, but not all of you."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to him, "He who has bathed needs only to wash his feet; otherwise he is completely clean. And you are clean—but not all of you."
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“Those who have had a bath need only to wash their feet; their whole body is clean. And you are clean, though not every one of you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 原来耶稣知道谁要出卖他，所以他说"你们不是人人都是洁净的"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来耶稣知道谁要出卖他，所以他说"你们不是人人都是洁净的"。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣原知道要卖他的是谁，所以说：「你们不都是干净的。」
verses.textEnNiv: For he knew who was going to betray him, and that was why he said not every one was clean.
verses.textEnEsv: For he knew who was to betray him; that was why he said, "Not all of you are clean."
verses.textEnNkjv: For He knew who would betray Him; therefore He said, "You are not all clean."
verses.textEnNlt: For Jesus knew who would betray him. That is what he meant when he said, "Not all of you are clean."
verses.textEnNasb: For He knew the one who was betraying Him; it was for this reason that He said, "Not all of you are clean."
verses.textEn: For he knew who was going to betray him, and that was why he said not every one was clean.

verses.textZh: 耶稣洗完了门徒的脚，就穿上外衣，再坐下来，对他们说："<red>我给你们作的，你们明白吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣洗完了门徒的脚，就穿上外衣，再坐下来，对他们说："<red>我给你们作的，你们明白吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣洗完了他们的脚，就穿上衣服，又坐下，对他们说：「我向你们所做的，你们明白吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: When he had finished washing their feet, he put on his clothes and returned to his place. <red>“Do you understand what I have done for you?”</red> he asked them.
verses.textEnEsv: When he had washed their feet and put on his outer garments and resumed his place, he said to them, "Do you understand what I have done to you?
verses.textEnNkjv: So when He had washed their feet, taken His garments, and sat down again, He said to them, "Do you know what I have done to you?
verses.textEnNlt: After washing their feet, he put on his robe again and sat down and asked, "Do you understand what I was doing?
verses.textEnNasb: Then, when He had washed their feet, and taken His garments and reclined at the table again, He said to them, "Do you know what I have done for you?
verses.textEn: When he had finished washing their feet, he put on his clothes and returned to his place. <red>“Do you understand what I have done for you?”</red> he asked them.

verses.textZh: <red>你们称呼我‘老师，主’，你们说得对，我本来就是。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们称呼我‘老师，主’，你们说得对，我本来就是。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们称呼我夫子，称呼我主，你们说的不错，我本来是。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and rightly so, for that is what I am.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You call me Teacher and Lord, and you are right, for so I am.
verses.textEnNkjv: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and you say well, for so I am.
verses.textEnNlt: You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and you are right, because that’s what I am.
verses.textEnNasb: You call Me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord’; and you are correct, for so I am.
verses.textEn: <red>“You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and rightly so, for that is what I am.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我是主，是老师，尚且洗你们的脚，你们也应当彼此洗脚。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我是主，是老师，尚且洗你们的脚，你们也应当彼此洗脚。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我是你们的主，你们的夫子，尚且洗你们的脚，你们也当彼此洗脚。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Now that I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If I then, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I then, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.textEnNlt: And since I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you ought to wash each other’s feet.
verses.textEnNasb: So if I, the Lord and the Teacher, washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.textEn: <red>Now that I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我作了你们的榜样，是要你们也照着我所作的去行。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我作了你们的榜样，是要你们也照着我所作的去行。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我给你们作了榜样，叫你们照着我向你们所做的去做。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I have given you an example, that you also should do just as I have done to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have given you an example, that you should do as I have done to you.
verses.textEnNlt: I have given you an example to follow. Do as I have done to you.
verses.textEnNasb: For I gave you an example, so that you also would do just as I did for you.
verses.textEn: <red>I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，仆人不能大过主人，奉差遣的也不能大过差他的人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，仆人不能大过主人，奉差遣的也不能大过差他的人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实实在在地告诉你们，仆人不能大于主人，差人也不能大于差他的人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Very truly I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, truly, I say to you, a servant is not greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, a servant is not greater than his master; nor is he who is sent greater than he who sent him.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, slaves are not greater than their master. Nor is the messenger more important than the one who sends the message.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, truly I say to you, a slave is not greater than his master, nor is one who is sent greater than the one who sent him.
verses.textEn: <red>Very truly I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们既然知道这些事，如果去实行，就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们既然知道这些事，如果去实行，就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们既知道这事，若是去行就有福了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
verses.textEnNlt: Now that you know these things, God will bless you for doing them.
verses.textEnNasb: If you know these things, you are blessed if you do them.
verses.textEn: <red>Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我这话不是指着你们全体说的；我认识我所拣选的人，但是经上的话：‘那吃我饭的，用他的脚踢我’，必须应验。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我这话不是指着你们全体说的；我认识我所拣选的人，但是经上的话：‘那吃我饭的，用他的脚踢我’，必须应验。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我这话不是指着你们众人说的，我知道我所拣选的是谁。现在要应验经上的话，说：『同我吃饭的人用脚踢我。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I am not referring to all of you; I know those I have chosen. But this is to fulfill this passage of Scripture: ‘He who shared my bread has turned against me.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am not speaking of all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But the Scripture will be fulfilled, ‘He who ate my bread has lifted his heel against me.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "I do not speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with Mehas lifted up his heel against Me.’
verses.textEnNlt: "I am not saying these things to all of you; I know the ones I have chosen. But this fulfills the Scripture that says, ‘The one who eats my food has turned against me.’
verses.textEnNasb: I am not speaking about all of you. I know the ones whom I have chosen; but this is happening so that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’
verses.textEn: <red>“I am not referring to all of you; I know those I have chosen. But this is to fulfill this passage of Scripture: ‘He who shared my bread has turned against me.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>现在，事情还没有发生，我就告诉你们，使你们到时可以信我就是‘那一位’。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>现在，事情还没有发生，我就告诉你们，使你们到时可以信我就是‘那一位’。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>如今事情还没有成就，我要先告诉你们，叫你们到事情成就的时候可以信我是基督。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I am who I am.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am telling you this now, before it takes place, that when it does take place you may believe that I am he.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I tell you before it comes, that when it does come to pass, you may believe that I am He.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you this beforehand, so that when it happens you will believe that I Am the Messiah.
verses.textEnNasb: From now on I am telling you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you may believe that I am He.
verses.textEn: <red>“I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I am who I am.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，那接待我所差遣的，就是接待我；接待我的，就是接待那差我来的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，那接待我所差遣的，就是接待我；接待我的，就是接待那差我来的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实实在在地告诉你们，有人接待我所差遣的，就是接待我；接待我，就是接待那差遣我的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Very truly I tell you, whoever accepts anyone I send accepts me; and whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever receives the one I send receives me, and whoever receives me receives the one who sent me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, he who receives whomever I send receives Me; and he who receives Me receives Him who sent Me."
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, anyone who welcomes my messenger is welcoming me, and anyone who welcomes me is welcoming the Father who sent me."
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, truly I say to you, the one who receives anyone I send, receives Me; and the one who receives Me receives Him who sent Me."
verses.textEn: <red>Very truly I tell you, whoever accepts anyone I send accepts me; and whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说了这话，心里很难过，就明明地说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，你们中间有一个人要出卖我。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说了这话，心里很难过，就明明地说："<red>我实实在在告诉你们，你们中间有一个人要出卖我。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说了这话，心里忧愁，就明说：「<red>我实实在在地告诉你们，你们中间有一个人要卖我了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: After he had said this, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified, <red>“Very truly I tell you, one of you is going to betray me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: After saying these things, Jesus was troubled in his spirit, and testified, "Truly, truly, I say to you, one of you will betray me."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus had said these things, He was troubled in spirit, and testified and said, "Most assuredly, I say to you, one of you will betray Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Now Jesus was deeply troubled, and he exclaimed, "I tell you the truth, one of you will betray me!"
verses.textEnNasb: When Jesus had said these things, He became troubled in spirit, and testified and said, "Truly, truly I say to you that one of you will betray Me."
verses.textEn: After he had said this, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified, <red>“Very truly I tell you, one of you is going to betray me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒面面相觑，不知道他是指着谁说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒面面相觑，不知道他是指着谁说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒彼此对看，猜不透所说的是谁。
verses.textEnNiv: His disciples stared at one another, at a loss to know which of them he meant.
verses.textEnEsv: The disciples looked at one another, uncertain of whom he spoke.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom He spoke.
verses.textEnNlt: The disciples looked at each other, wondering whom he could mean.
verses.textEnNasb: The disciples began looking at one another, at a loss to know of which one He was speaking.
verses.textEn: His disciples stared at one another, at a loss to know which of them he meant.

verses.textZh: 门徒中有一个人，是耶稣所爱的，侧身挨近耶稣 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒中有一个人，是耶稣所爱的，侧身挨近耶稣 。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个门徒，是耶稣所爱的，侧身挨近耶稣的怀里。
verses.textEnNiv: One of them, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining next to him.
verses.textEnEsv: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was reclining at table at Jesus’ side,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of His disciples, whom Jesus loved.
verses.textEnNlt: The disciple Jesus loved was sitting next to Jesus at the table.
verses.textEnNasb: Lying back on Jesus’ chest was one of His disciples, whom Jesus loved.
verses.textEn: One of them, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining next to him.

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得向他示意，叫他问耶稣是指着谁说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得向他示意，叫他问耶稣是指着谁说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得点头对他说：「你告诉我们，主是指着谁说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Simon Peter motioned to this disciple and said, "Ask him which one he means."
verses.textEnEsv: so Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus of whom he was speaking.
verses.textEnNkjv: Simon Peter therefore motioned to him to ask who it was of whom He spoke.
verses.textEnNlt: Simon Peter motioned to him to ask, "Who’s he talking about?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Simon Peter *nodded to this disciple and *said to him, "Tell us who it is of whom He is speaking."
verses.textEn: Simon Peter motioned to this disciple and said, "Ask him which one he means."

verses.textZh: 于是那个门徒贴近耶稣的胸怀，问他："主啊，是谁呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是那个门徒贴近耶稣的胸怀，问他："主啊，是谁呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那门徒便就势靠着耶稣的胸膛，问他说：「主啊，是谁呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked him, "Lord, who is it?"
verses.textEnEsv: So that disciple, leaning back against Jesus, said to him, "Lord, who is it?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, leaning back on Jesus’ breast, he said to Him, "Lord, who is it?"
verses.textEnNlt: So that disciple leaned over to Jesus and asked, "Lord, who is it?"
verses.textEnNasb: He then simply leaned back on Jesus’ chest and *said to Him, "Lord, who is it?"
verses.textEn: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked him, "Lord, who is it?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>我蘸一小块饼给谁，谁就是了。</red>"于是他蘸了一小块饼，递给加略人西门的儿子犹大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>我蘸一小块饼给谁，谁就是了。</red>"于是他蘸了一小块饼，递给加略人西门的儿子犹大。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>我蘸一点饼给谁，就是谁。</red>」耶稣就蘸了一点饼，递给加略人西门的儿子犹大。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“It is the one to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it in the dish.”</red> Then, dipping the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "It is he to whom I will give this morsel of bread when I have dipped it." So when he had dipped the morsel, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered, "It is he to whom I shall give a piece of bread when I have dipped it." And having dipped the bread, He gave it to Judas Iscariot, theson of Simon.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus responded, "It is the one to whom I give the bread I dip in the bowl." And when he had dipped it, he gave it to Judas, son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus then *answered, "That man is the one for whom I shall dip the piece of bread and give it to him." So when He had dipped the piece of bread, He *took and *gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“It is the one to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it in the dish.”</red> Then, dipping the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

verses.textZh: 犹大接过饼以后，撒但就进入他的心。耶稣对他说："<red>你要作的，快去作吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大接过饼以后，撒但就进入他的心。耶稣对他说："<red>你要作的，快去作吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他吃了以后，撒但就入了他的心。耶稣便对他说：「<red>你所做的，快做吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. So Jesus told him, <red>“What you are about to do, do quickly.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then after he had taken the morsel, Satan entered into him. Jesus said to him, "What you are going to do, do quickly."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after the piece of bread, Satan entered him. Then Jesus said to him, "What you do, do quickly."
verses.textEnNlt: When Judas had eaten the bread, Satan entered into him. Then Jesus told him, "Hurry and do what you’re going to do."
verses.textEnNasb: After this, Satan then entered him. Therefore Jesus *said to him, "What you are doing, do it quickly."
verses.textEn: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. So Jesus told him, <red>“What you are about to do, do quickly.”</red>

verses.textZh: 在座的人，没有一个知道耶稣为甚么对犹大说这话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在座的人，没有一个知道耶稣为甚么对犹大说这话。
verses.textZhCuv: 同席的人没有一个知道是为什么对他说这话。
verses.textEnNiv: But no one at the meal understood why Jesus said this to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now no one at the table knew why he said this to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But no one at the table knew for what reason He said this to him.
verses.textEnNlt: None of the others at the table knew what Jesus meant.
verses.textEnNasb: Now none of those reclining at the table knew for what purpose He had said this to him.
verses.textEn: But no one at the meal understood why Jesus said this to him.

verses.textZh: 犹大是管钱的，所以有人以为耶稣叫他去买过节用的东西，或是吩咐他拿点东西去赒济穷人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大是管钱的，所以有人以为耶稣叫他去买过节用的东西，或是吩咐他拿点东西去赒济穷人。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人因犹大带着钱囊，以为耶稣是对他说：「你去买我们过节所应用的东西」，或是叫他拿什么周济穷人。
verses.textEnNiv: Since Judas had charge of the money, some thought Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the festival, or to give something to the poor.
verses.textEnEsv: Some thought that, because Judas had the moneybag, Jesus was telling him, "Buy what we need for the feast," or that he should give something to the poor.
verses.textEnNkjv: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus had said to him, "Buy thosethings we need for the feast," or that he should give something to the poor.
verses.textEnNlt: Since Judas was their treasurer, some thought Jesus was telling him to go and pay for the food or to give some money to the poor.
verses.textEnNasb: For some were assuming, since Judas kept the money box, that Jesus was saying to him, "Buy the things we need for the feast"; or else, that he was to give something to the poor.
verses.textEn: Since Judas had charge of the money, some thought Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the festival, or to give something to the poor.

verses.textZh: 犹大吃了饼，立刻就出去；那时是黑夜了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大吃了饼，立刻就出去；那时是黑夜了。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大受了那点饼，立刻就出去。那时候是夜间了。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as Judas had taken the bread, he went out. And it was night.
verses.textEnEsv: So, after receiving the morsel of bread, he immediately went out. And it was night.
verses.textEnNkjv: Having received the piece of bread, he then went out immediately. And it was night.
verses.textEnNlt: So Judas left at once, going out into the night.
verses.textEnNasb: So after receiving the piece of bread, he left immediately; and it was night.
verses.textEn: As soon as Judas had taken the bread, he went out. And it was night.

verses.textZh: 他出去以后，耶稣就说："<red>现在人子得了荣耀，神也在人子身上得了荣耀，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他出去以后，耶稣就说："<red>现在人子得了荣耀，神也在人子身上得了荣耀，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他既出去，耶稣就说：「如今人子得了荣耀，神在人子身上也得了荣耀。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: When he was gone, Jesus said, <red>“Now the Son of Man is glorified and God is glorified in him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When he had gone out, Jesus said, "Now is the Son of Man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So, when he had gone out, Jesus said, "Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as Judas left the room, Jesus said, "The time has come for the Son of Man to enter into his glory, and God will be glorified because of him.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore when he had left, Jesus *said, "Now is the Son of Man glorified, and God is glorified in Him;
verses.textEn: When he was gone, Jesus said, <red>“Now the Son of Man is glorified and God is glorified in him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>也要在自己身上荣耀人子，并且要立刻荣耀他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>也要在自己身上荣耀人子，并且要立刻荣耀他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>神要因自己荣耀人子，并且要快快地荣耀他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If God is glorified in him, God will glorify the Son in himself, and will glorify him at once.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If God is glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and glorify him at once.
verses.textEnNkjv: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify Him in Himself, and glorify Him immediately.
verses.textEnNlt: And since God receives glory because of the Son, he will give his own glory to the Son, and he will do so at once.
verses.textEnNasb: if God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify Him in Himself, and will glorify Him immediately.
verses.textEn: <red>If God is glorified in him, God will glorify the Son in himself, and will glorify him at once.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>孩子们啊，我跟你们在一起的时候不多了。你们要寻找我，但是我对犹太人说过，现在也照样对你们说：‘我去的地方，是你们不能去的。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>孩子们啊，我跟你们在一起的时候不多了。你们要寻找我，但是我对犹太人说过，现在也照样对你们说：‘我去的地方，是你们不能去的。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>小子们，我还有不多的时候与你们同在；后来你们要找我，但我所去的地方你们不能到。这话我曾对犹太人说过，如今也照样对你们说。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“My children, I will be with you only a little longer. You will look for me, and just as I told the Jews, so I tell you now: Where I am going, you cannot come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. You will seek me, and just as I said to the Jews, so now I also say to you, ‘Where I am going you cannot come.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Little children, I shall be with you a little while longer. You will seek Me; and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come,’ so now I say to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear children, I will be with you only a little longer. And as I told the Jewish leaders, you will search for me, but you can’t come where I am going.
verses.textEnNasb: Little children, I am still with you a little longer. You will look for Me; and just as I said to the Jews, now I also say to you: ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’
verses.textEn: <red>“My children, I will be with you only a little longer. You will look for me, and just as I told the Jews, so I tell you now: Where I am going, you cannot come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我给你们一条新命令，就是要你们彼此相爱；我怎样爱你们，你们也要怎样彼此相爱。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我给你们一条新命令，就是要你们彼此相爱；我怎样爱你们，你们也要怎样彼此相爱。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我赐给你们一条新命令，乃是叫你们彼此相爱；我怎样爱你们，你们也要怎样相爱。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Ap new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another: just as I have loved you, you also are to love one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another.
verses.textEnNlt: So now I am giving you a new commandment: Love each other. Just as I have loved you, you should love each other.
verses.textEnNasb: I am giving you a new commandment, that you love one another; just as I have loved you, that you also love one another.
verses.textEn: <red>“Ap new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们彼此相爱，众人就会认出你们是我的门徒了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们彼此相爱，众人就会认出你们是我的门徒了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若有彼此相爱的心，众人因此就认出你们是我的门徒了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: By this all people will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another."
verses.textEnNkjv: By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another."
verses.textEnNlt: Your love for one another will prove to the world that you are my disciples."
verses.textEnNasb: By this all people will know that you are My disciples: if you have love for one another."
verses.textEn: <red>By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.”</red>

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得对耶稣说："<red>主啊，你往哪里去？</red>"耶稣回答："我去的地方，你现在不能跟着我去，但后来却要跟着我去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得对耶稣说："<red>主啊，你往哪里去？</red>"耶稣回答："我去的地方，你现在不能跟着我去，但后来却要跟着我去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得问耶稣说：「<red>主往哪里去？</red>」耶稣回答说：「<red>我所去的地方，你现在不能跟我去，后来却要跟我去。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Simon Peter asked him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus replied, <red>“Where I am going, you cannot follow now, but you will follow later.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Simon Peter said to him, "Lord, where are you going?" Jesus answered him, "Where I am going you cannot follow me now, but you will follow afterward."
verses.textEnNkjv: Simon Peter said to Him, "Lord, where are You going?" Jesus answered him, "Where I am going you cannot follow Me now, but you shall follow Me afterward."
verses.textEnNlt: Simon Peter asked, "Lord, where are you going?" And Jesus replied, "You can’t go with me now, but you will follow me later."
verses.textEnNasb: Simon Peter *said to Him, "Lord, where are You going?" Jesus answered, "Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now; but you will follow later."
verses.textEn: Simon Peter asked him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus replied, <red>“Where I am going, you cannot follow now, but you will follow later.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得说："主啊，为甚么我现在不能跟着你去？为了你，我舍命也愿意！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得说："主啊，为甚么我现在不能跟着你去？为了你，我舍命也愿意！"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「主啊，我为什么现在不能跟你去？我愿意为你舍命！」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter asked, "Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you."
verses.textEnEsv: Peter said to him, "Lord, why can I not follow you now? I will lay down my life for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Peter said to Him, "Lord, why can I not follow You now? I will lay down my life for Your sake."
verses.textEnNlt: "But why can’t I come now, Lord?" he asked. "I’m ready to die for you."
verses.textEnNasb: Peter *said to Him, "Lord, why can I not follow You right now? I will lay down my life for You."
verses.textEn: Peter asked, "Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>你愿意为我舍命吗？我实实在在告诉你，鸡叫之前，你必定三次不认我。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>你愿意为我舍命吗？我实实在在告诉你，鸡叫之前，你必定三次不认我。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你愿意为我舍命吗？我实实在在地告诉你，鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus answered, <red>“Will you really lay down your life for me? Very truly I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "Will you lay down your life for me? Truly, truly, I say to you, the rooster will not crow till you have denied me three times.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered him, "Will you lay down your life for My sake? Most assuredly, I say to you, the rooster shall not crow till you have denied Me three times.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus answered, "Die for me? I tell you the truth, Peter—before the rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will deny three times that you even know me.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *replied, "Will you lay down your life for Me? Truly, truly I say to you, a rooster will not crow until you deny Me three times.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus answered, <red>“Will you really lay down your life for me? Very truly I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们心里不要难过，你们应当信神，也应当信我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们心里不要难过，你们应当信神，也应当信我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们心里不要忧愁；你们信神，也当信我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Dop not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe also in me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Let not your hearts be troubled. Believe in God; believe also in me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Let not your heart be troubled; you believe in God, believe also in Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t let your hearts be troubled. Trust in God, and trust also in me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not let your heart be troubled; believe in God, believe also in Me.
verses.textEn: <red>“Dop not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe also in me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在我父的家里，有许多住的地方；如果没有，我怎么会告诉你们我去是要为你们预备地方呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在我父的家里，有许多住的地方；如果没有，我怎么会告诉你们我去是要为你们预备地方呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>在我父的家里有许多住处；若是没有，我就早已告诉你们了。我去原是为你们预备地方去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>My Father’s house has many rooms; if that were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: In my Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I go to prepare a place for you?
verses.textEnNkjv: In My Father’s house are many mansions; if it were not so,I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.textEnNlt: There is more than enough room in my Father’s home. If this were not so, would I have told you that I am going to prepare a place for you?
verses.textEnNasb: In My Father’s house are many rooms; if that were not so, I would have told you, because I am going there to prepare a place for you.
verses.textEn: <red>My Father’s house has many rooms; if that were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我若去为你们预备地方，就必再来接你们到我那里去，好使我在哪里，你们也在哪里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我若去为你们预备地方，就必再来接你们到我那里去，好使我在哪里，你们也在哪里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若去为你们预备了地方，就必再来接你们到我那里去，我在哪里，叫你们也在那里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to be with me that you also may be where I am.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will take you to myself, that where I am you may be also.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and receive you to Myself; that where I am, there you may be also.
verses.textEnNlt: When everything is ready, I will come and get you, so that you will always be with me where I am.
verses.textEnNasb: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I am coming again and will take you to Myself, so that where I am, there you also will be.
verses.textEn: <red>And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to be with me that you also may be where I am.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我去的地方，你们知道那条路。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我去的地方，你们知道那条路。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我往哪里去，你们知道；那条路，你们也知道 。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You know the way to the place where I am going.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And you know the way to where I am going."
verses.textEnNkjv: And where I go you know, and the way you know."
verses.textEnNlt: And you know the way to where I am going."
verses.textEnNasb: And you know the way where I am going."
verses.textEn: <red>You know the way to the place where I am going.”</red>

verses.textZh: 多马说："主啊，我们不知道你去的地方，怎能知道那条路呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 多马说："主啊，我们不知道你去的地方，怎能知道那条路呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 多马对他说：「主啊，我们不知道你往哪里去，怎么知道那条路呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Thomas said to him, "Lord, we don’t know where you are going, so how can we know the way?"
verses.textEnEsv: Thomas said to him, "Lord, we do not know where you are going. How can we know the way?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Thomas said to Him, "Lord, we do not know where You are going, and how can we know the way?"
verses.textEnNlt: "No, we don’t know, Lord," Thomas said. "We have no idea where you are going, so how can we know the way?"
verses.textEnNasb: Thomas *said to Him, "Lord, we do not know where You are going; how do we know the way?"
verses.textEn: Thomas said to him, "Lord, we don’t know where you are going, so how can we know the way?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："<red>我就是道路、真理、生命，如果不是借着我，没有人能到父那里去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："<red>我就是道路、真理、生命，如果不是借着我，没有人能到父那里去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉着我，没有人能到父那里去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told him, "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one can come to the Father except through me.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to him, "I am the way, and the truth, and the life; no one comes to the Father except through Me.
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们认识我，就必认识我的父；从今以后，你们认识他，并且看见了他。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们认识我，就必认识我的父；从今以后，你们认识他，并且看见了他。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若认识我，也就认识我的父。从今以后，你们认识他，并且已经看见他。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you really know me, you will know my Father as well. From now on, you do know him and have seen him.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on you do know him and have seen him."
verses.textEnNkjv: "If you had known Me, you would have known My Father also; and from now on you know Him and have seen Him."
verses.textEnNlt: If you had really known me, you would know who my Father is. From now on, you do know him and have seen him!"
verses.textEnNasb: If you had known Me, you would have known My Father also; from now on you know Him, and have seen Him."
verses.textEn: <red>If you really know me, you will know my Father as well. From now on, you do know him and have seen him.”</red>

verses.textZh: 腓力说："主啊，请把父显示给我们，我们就满足了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 腓力说："主啊，请把父显示给我们，我们就满足了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 腓力对他说：「求主将父显给我们看，我们就知足了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Philip said, "Lord, show us the Father and that will be enough for us."
verses.textEnEsv: Philip said to him, "Lord, show us the Father, and it is enough for us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Philip said to Him, "Lord, show us the Father, and it is sufficient for us."
verses.textEnNlt: Philip said, "Lord, show us the Father, and we will be satisfied."
verses.textEnNasb: Philip *said to Him, "Lord, show us the Father, and it is enough for us."
verses.textEn: Philip said, "Lord, show us the Father and that will be enough for us."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>腓力，我跟你们在一起这么久了，你还不认识我吗？那看见了我的就是看见了父，你怎么还说‘把父显示给我们’呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>腓力，我跟你们在一起这么久了，你还不认识我吗？那看见了我的就是看见了父，你怎么还说‘把父显示给我们’呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他说：「腓力，我与你们同在这样长久，你还不认识我吗？人看见了我，就是看见了父；你怎么说『将父显给我们看』呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered: <red>“Don’t you know me, Philip, even after I have been among you such a long time? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "Have I been with you so long, and you still do not know me, Philip? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "Have I been with you so long, and yet you have not known Me, Philip? He who has seen Me has seen the Father; so how can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Have I been with you all this time, Philip, and yet you still don’t know who I am? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father! So why are you asking me to show him to you?
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to him, "Have I been with you for so long a time, and yet you have not come to know Me, Philip? The one who has seen Me has seen the Father; how can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
verses.textEn: Jesus answered: <red>“Don’t you know me, Philip, even after I have been among you such a long time? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你不信我是在父里面，父是在我里面吗？我对你们说的话，不是凭着自己说的，而是住在我里面的父作他自己的事。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你不信我是在父里面，父是在我里面吗？我对你们说的话，不是凭着自己说的，而是住在我里面的父作他自己的事。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我在父里面，父在我里面，你不信吗？我对你们所说的话，不是凭着自己说的，乃是住在我里面的父做他自己的事。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and that the Father is in me? The words I say to you I do not speak on my own authority. Rather, it is the Father, living in me, who is doing his work.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words that I say to you I do not speak on my own authority, but the Father who dwells in me does his works.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in Me? The words that I speak to you I do not speak on My own authority; but the Father who dwells in Me does the works.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words I speak are not my own, but my Father who lives in me does his work through me.
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not believe that I am in the Father, and the Father is in Me? The words that I say to you I do not speak on My own, but the Father, as He remains in Me, does His works.
verses.textEn: <red>Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and that the Father is in me? The words I say to you I do not speak on my own authority. Rather, it is the Father, living in me, who is doing his work.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们应当信我是在父里面，父是在我里面；不然，也要因我所作的而相信。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们应当信我是在父里面，父是在我里面；不然，也要因我所作的而相信。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们当信我，我在父里面，父在我里面；即或不信，也当因我所做的事信我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the works themselves.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Believe me that I am in the Father and the Father is in me, or else believe on account of the works themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father in Me, or else believe Me for the sake of the works themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: Just believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me. Or at least believe because of the work you have seen me do.
verses.textEnNasb: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me; otherwise believe because of the works themselves.
verses.textEn: <red>Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the works themselves.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，我所作的事，信我的人也要作，并且要作比这些更大的，因为我往父那里去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，我所作的事，信我的人也要作，并且要作比这些更大的，因为我往父那里去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实实在在地告诉你们，我所做的事，信我的人也要做，并且要做比这更大的事，因为我往父那里去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Very truly I tell you, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever believes in me will also do the works that I do; and greater works than these will he do, because I am going to the Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Most assuredly, I say to you, he who believes in Me, the works that I do he will do also; and greater works than these he will do, because I go to My Father.
verses.textEnNlt: "I tell you the truth, anyone who believes in me will do the same works I have done, and even greater works, because I am going to be with the Father.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, truly I say to you, the one who believes in Me, the works that I do, he will do also; and greater works than these he will do; because I am going to the Father.
verses.textEn: <red>Very truly I tell you, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们奉我的名无论求甚么，我必定成全，使父在子的身上得着荣耀。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们奉我的名无论求甚么，我必定成全，使父在子的身上得着荣耀。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们奉我的名无论求什么，我必成就，叫父因儿子得荣耀。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whatever you ask in my name, this I will do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whatever you ask in My name, that I will do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.textEnNlt: You can ask for anything in my name, and I will do it, so that the Son can bring glory to the Father.
verses.textEnNasb: And whatever you ask in My name, this I will do, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.textEn: <red>And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们若奉我的名向我求甚么，我必定成全。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们若奉我的名向我求甚么，我必定成全。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若奉我的名求什么，我必成就。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You may ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If you ask me anything in my name, I will do it.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you ask anything in My name, I will do it.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it!
verses.textEnNasb: If you ask Me anything in My name, I will do it.
verses.textEn: <red>You may ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"如果你们爱我，就要遵守我的命令。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"如果你们爱我，就要遵守我的命令。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们若爱我，就必遵守我的命令。</red>
