verses.textEnNiv: <red>“If you love me, keep my commands.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "If you love me, you will keep my commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If you love Me, keep My commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you love me, obey my commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: "If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
verses.textEn: <red>“If you love me, keep my commands.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我要请求父，他就会赐给你们另一位保惠师，使他跟你们永远在一起。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我要请求父，他就会赐给你们另一位保惠师，使他跟你们永远在一起。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我要求父，父就另外赐给你们一位保惠师 ，叫他永远与你们同在，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another advocate to help you and be with you forever—</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Helper, to be with you forever,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will pray the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may abide with you forever—
verses.textEnNlt: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Advocate, who will never leave you.
verses.textEnNasb: I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper, so that He may be with you forever;
verses.textEn: <red>And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another advocate to help you and be with you forever—</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这保惠师就是真理的灵，世人不能接受他，因为看不见他，也不认识他。你们却认识他，因为他跟你们住在一起，也要在你们里面。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这保惠师就是真理的灵，世人不能接受他，因为看不见他，也不认识他。你们却认识他，因为他跟你们住在一起，也要在你们里面。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就是真理的圣灵，乃世人不能接受的；因为不见他，也不认识他。你们却认识他，因他常与你们同在，也要在你们里面。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>the Spirit of truth. The world cannot accept him, because it neither sees him nor knows him. But you know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: even the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees him nor knows him. You know him, for he dwells with you and will be in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him; but you know Him, for He dwells with you and will be in you.
verses.textEnNlt: He is the Holy Spirit, who leads into all truth. The world cannot receive him, because it isn’t looking for him and doesn’t recognize him. But you know him, because he lives with you now and later will be in you.
verses.textEnNasb: the Helper is the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it does not see Him or know Him; but you know Him because He remains with you and will be in you.
verses.textEn: <red>the Spirit of truth. The world cannot accept him, because it neither sees him nor knows him. But you know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我不会撇下你们为孤儿，我要回到你们这里来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我不会撇下你们为孤儿，我要回到你们这里来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我不撇下你们为孤儿，我必到你们这里来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will not leave you orphans; I will come to you.
verses.textEnNlt: No, I will not abandon you as orphans—I will come to you.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will not leave you as orphans; I am coming to you.
verses.textEn: <red>I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不久以后，世人不再看见我，你们却要看见我，因为我活着，你们也要活着。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不久以后，世人不再看见我，你们却要看见我，因为我活着，你们也要活着。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>还有不多的时候，世人不再看见我，你们却看见我；因为我活着，你们也要活着。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Before long, the world will not see me anymore, but you will see me. Because I live, you also will live.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Yet a little while and the world will see me no more, but you will see me. Because I live, you also will live.
verses.textEnNkjv: "A little while longer and the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you will live also.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon the world will no longer see me, but you will see me. Since I live, you also will live.
verses.textEnNasb: After a little while, the world no longer is going to see Me, but you are going to see Me; because I live, you also will live.
verses.textEn: <red>Before long, the world will not see me anymore, but you will see me. Because I live, you also will live.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>到那日，你们就知道我是在我父里面，你们是在我里面，我也在你们里面。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>到那日，你们就知道我是在我父里面，你们是在我里面，我也在你们里面。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>到那日，你们就知道我在父里面，你们在我里面，我也在你们里面。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>On that day you will realize that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you in Me, and I in you.
verses.textEnNlt: When I am raised to life again, you will know that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I in you.
verses.textEn: <red>On that day you will realize that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那领受我的命令，并且遵守的，就是爱我的；爱我的，我父必定爱他，我也要爱他，并且要亲自向他显现。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那领受我的命令，并且遵守的，就是爱我的；爱我的，我父必定爱他，我也要爱他，并且要亲自向他显现。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有了我的命令又遵守的，这人就是爱我的；爱我的必蒙我父爱他，我也要爱他，并且要向他显现。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me. The one who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I too will love them and show myself to them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever has my commandments and keeps them, he it is who loves me. And he who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him and manifest myself to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has My commandments and keeps them, it is he who loves Me. And he who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and manifest Myself to him."
verses.textEnNlt: Those who accept my commandments and obey them are the ones who love me. And because they love me, my Father will love them. And I will love them and reveal myself to each of them."
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me; and the one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and will reveal Myself to him."
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me. The one who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I too will love them and show myself to them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 犹大 对耶稣说："主啊，你为甚么要亲自向我们显现，不向世人显现呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大 对耶稣说："主啊，你为甚么要亲自向我们显现，不向世人显现呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大（不是加略人犹大）问耶稣说：「主啊，为什么要向我们显现，不向世人显现呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Judas (not Judas Iscariot) said, "But, Lord, why do you intend to show yourself to us and not to the world?"
verses.textEnEsv: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, "Lord, how is it that you will manifest yourself to us, and not to the world?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Judas (not Iscariot) said to Him, "Lord, how is it that You will manifest Yourself to us, and not to the world?"
verses.textEnNlt: Judas (not Judas Iscariot, but the other disciple with that name) said to him, "Lord, why are you going to reveal yourself only to us and not to the world at large?"
verses.textEnNasb: Judas (not Iscariot) *said to Him, "Lord, what has happened that You are going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?"
verses.textEn: Then Judas (not Judas Iscariot) said, "But, Lord, why do you intend to show yourself to us and not to the world?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："人若爱我，就要遵守我的话，我父必定爱他，并且我们要到他那里去，跟他住在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："人若爱我，就要遵守我的话，我父必定爱他，并且我们要到他那里去，跟他住在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「人若爱我，就必遵守我的道；我父也必爱他，并且我们要到他那里去，与他同住。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Anyone who loves me will obey my teaching. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered him, "If anyone loves me, he will keep my word, and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to him, "If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "All who love me will do what I say. My Father will love them, and we will come and make our home with each of them.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered and said to him, "If anyone loves Me, he will follow My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our dwelling with him.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Anyone who loves me will obey my teaching. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不爱我的，就不会遵守我的话。你们所听见的道，不是我的，而是那差我来的父的道。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不爱我的，就不会遵守我的话。你们所听见的道，不是我的，而是那差我来的父的道。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不爱我的人就不遵守我的道。你们所听见的道不是我的，乃是差我来之父的道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Anyone who does not love me will not obey my teaching. These words you hear are not my own; they belong to the Father who sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever does not love me does not keep my words. And the word that you hear is not mine but the Father’s who sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who does not love Me does not keep My words; and the word which you hear is not Mine but the Father’s who sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who doesn’t love me will not obey me. And remember, my words are not my own. What I am telling you is from the Father who sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who does not love Me does not follow My words; and the word which you hear is not Mine, but the Father’s who sent Me.
verses.textEn: <red>Anyone who does not love me will not obey my teaching. These words you hear are not my own; they belong to the Father who sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我还跟你们在一起的时候，就对你们讲了这些事。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我还跟你们在一起的时候，就对你们讲了这些事。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我还与你们同住的时候，已将这些话对你们说了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“All this I have spoken while still with you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "These things I have spoken to you while I am still with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "These things I have spoken to you while being present with you.
verses.textEnNlt: I am telling you these things now while I am still with you.
verses.textEnNasb: "These things I have spoken to you while remaining with you.
verses.textEn: <red>“All this I have spoken while still with you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但保惠师，就是父因我的名要差来的圣灵，他要把一切事教导你们，也要使你们想起我对你们所说过的一切话。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但保惠师，就是父因我的名要差来的圣灵，他要把一切事教导你们，也要使你们想起我对你们所说过的一切话。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但保惠师，就是父因我的名所要差来的圣灵，他要将一切的事指教你们，并且要叫你们想起我对你们所说的一切话。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have said to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things and bring to your remembrance all that I have said to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all things that I said to you.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the Father sends the Advocate as my representative—that is, the Holy Spirit—he will teach you everything and will remind you of everything I have told you.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things, and remind you of all that I said to you.
verses.textEn: <red>But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have said to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我留下平安给你们，我把自己的平安赐给你们；我给你们的，不像世界所给的。你们心里不要难过，也不要恐惧。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我留下平安给你们，我把自己的平安赐给你们；我给你们的，不像世界所给的。你们心里不要难过，也不要恐惧。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我留下平安给你们；我将我的平安赐给你们。我所赐的，不像世人所赐的。你们心里不要忧愁，也不要胆怯。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Peace I leave with you, My peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am leaving you with a gift—peace of mind and heart. And the peace I give is a gift the world cannot give. So don’t be troubled or afraid.
verses.textEnNasb: Peace I leave you, My peace I give you; not as the world gives, do I give to you. Do not let your hearts be troubled, nor fearful.
verses.textEn: <red>Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们听见我对你们说过：‘我去，但还要回到你们这里来。’你们若爱我，就要喜乐，因为我到父那里去，又因为父是比我大的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们听见我对你们说过：‘我去，但还要回到你们这里来。’你们若爱我，就要喜乐，因为我到父那里去，又因为父是比我大的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们听见我对你们说了，我去还要到你们这里来。你们若爱我，因我到父那里去，就必喜乐，因为父是比我大的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp heard me say, ‘I am going away and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved me, you would be glad that I am going to the Father, for the Father is greater than I.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You heard me say to you, ‘I am going away, and I will come to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I am going to the Father, for the Father is greater than I.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have heard Me say to you, ‘I am going away and coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice because I said, ‘I am going to the Father,’ for My Father is greater than I.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember what I told you: I am going away, but I will come back to you again. If you really loved me, you would be happy that I am going to the Father, who is greater than I am.
verses.textEnNasb: You heard that I said to you, ‘I am going away, and I am coming to you.’ If you loved Me, you would have rejoiced because I am going to the Father, for the Father is greater than I.
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp heard me say, ‘I am going away and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved me, you would be glad that I am going to the Father, for the Father is greater than I.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>现在事情还没有发生，我就已经告诉你们，使你们在事情发生的时候可以相信。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>现在事情还没有发生，我就已经告诉你们，使你们在事情发生的时候可以相信。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>现在事情还没有成就，我预先告诉你们，叫你们到事情成就的时候就可以信。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have told you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And now I have told you before it takes place, so that when it does take place you may believe.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And now I have told you before it comes, that when it does come to pass, you may believe.
verses.textEnNlt: I have told you these things before they happen so that when they do happen, you will believe.
verses.textEnNasb: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it happens, you may believe.
verses.textEn: <red>I have told you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我不会再跟你们讲很多的事，因为这世界的统治者将到；他在我身上毫无作用，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我不会再跟你们讲很多的事，因为这世界的统治者将到；他在我身上毫无作用，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>以后我不再和你们多说话，因为这世界的王将到。他在我里面是毫无所有；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I will not say much more to you, for the prince of this world is coming. He has no hold over me,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I will no longer talk much with you, for the ruler of this world is coming. He has no claim on me,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will no longer talk much with you, for the ruler of this world is coming, and he has nothing in Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "I don’t have much more time to talk to you, because the ruler of this world approaches. He has no power over me,
verses.textEnNasb: I will not speak much more with you, for the ruler of the world is coming, and he has nothing in regard to Me,
verses.textEn: <red>I will not say much more to you, for the prince of this world is coming. He has no hold over me,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但这些事是要使世人知道我爱父，并且知道父怎样吩咐了我，我就怎样作。起来，我们走吧！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但这些事是要使世人知道我爱父，并且知道父怎样吩咐了我，我就怎样作。起来，我们走吧！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但要叫世人知道我爱父，并且父怎样吩咐我，我就怎样行。起来，我们走吧！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>but he comes so that the world may learn that I love the Father and do exactly what my Father has commanded me. “Come now; let us leave.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but I do as the Father has commanded me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Rise, let us go from here.
verses.textEnNkjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father gave Me commandment, so I do. Arise, let us go from here.
verses.textEnNlt: but I will do what the Father requires of me, so that the world will know that I love the Father. Come, let’s be going.
verses.textEnNasb: but so that the world may know that I love the Father, I do exactly as the Father commanded Me. Get up, let’s go from here.
verses.textEn: <red>but he comes so that the world may learn that I love the Father and do exactly what my Father has commanded me. “Come now; let us leave.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我是真葡萄树，我父是培植的人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我是真葡萄树，我父是培植的人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我是真葡萄树，我父是栽培的人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I am the true vine, and my Father is the vinedresser.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I am the true vine, and My Father is the vinedresser.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am the true grapevine, and my Father is the gardener.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am the true vine, and My Father is the vinedresser.
verses.textEn: <red>“I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所有属我而不结果子的枝子，他就剪去；所有结果子的，他就修剪干净，让它结更多的果子。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所有属我而不结果子的枝子，他就剪去；所有结果子的，他就修剪干净，让它结更多的果子。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡属我不结果子的枝子，他就剪去；凡结果子的，他就修理干净，使枝子结果子更多。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He cuts off every branch in me that bears no fruit, while every branch that does bear fruit he prunes so that it will be even more fruitful.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Every branch in me that does not bear fruit he takes away, and every branch that does bear fruit he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit He takes away; and every branch that bears fruit He prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: He cuts off every branch of mine that doesn’t produce fruit, and he prunes the branches that do bear fruit so they will produce even more.
verses.textEnNasb: Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit, He takes away; and every branch that bears fruit, He prunes it so that it may bear more fruit.
verses.textEn: <red>He cuts off every branch in me that bears no fruit, while every branch that does bear fruit he prunes so that it will be even more fruitful.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>现在你们因着我对你们所讲的道，已经干净了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>现在你们因着我对你们所讲的道，已经干净了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>现在你们因我讲给你们的道，已经干净了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Already you are clean because of the word that I have spoken to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are already clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
verses.textEnNlt: You have already been pruned and purified by the message I have given you.
verses.textEnNasb: You are already clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
verses.textEn: <red>You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要住在我里面，我也就住在你们里面。枝子若不连在葡萄树上，自己就不能结果子；你们若不住在我里面，也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要住在我里面，我也就住在你们里面。枝子若不连在葡萄树上，自己就不能结果子；你们若不住在我里面，也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要常在我里面，我也常在你们里面。枝子若不常在葡萄树上，自己就不能结果子；你们若不常在我里面，也是这样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Remain in me, as I also remain in you. No branch can bear fruit by itself; it must remain in the vine. Neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit by itself, unless it abides in the vine, neither can you, unless you abide in me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Abide in Me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, unless it abides in the vine, neither can you, unless you abide in Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Remain in me, and I will remain in you. For a branch cannot produce fruit if it is severed from the vine, and you cannot be fruitful unless you remain in me.
verses.textEnNasb: Remain in Me, and I in you. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit of itself but must remain in the vine, so neither can you unless you remain in Me.
verses.textEn: <red>Remain in me, as I also remain in you. No branch can bear fruit by itself; it must remain in the vine. Neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我是葡萄树，你们是枝子。住在我里面的，我也住在他里面，他就结出很多果子；因为离开了我，你们就不能作甚么。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我是葡萄树，你们是枝子。住在我里面的，我也住在他里面，他就结出很多果子；因为离开了我，你们就不能作甚么。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我是葡萄树，你们是枝子。常在我里面的，我也常在他里面，这人就多结果子；因为离了我，你们就不能做什么。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever abides in me and I in him, he it is that bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I am the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, I am the vine; you are the branches. Those who remain in me, and I in them, will produce much fruit. For apart from me you can do nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: I am the vine, you are the branches; the one who remains in Me, and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from Me you can do nothing.
verses.textEn: <red>“I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人若不住在我里面，就像枝子丢在外面枯干了，人把它们拾起来，丢在火里烧掉了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人若不住在我里面，就像枝子丢在外面枯干了，人把它们拾起来，丢在火里烧掉了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人若不常在我里面，就像枝子丢在外面枯干，人拾起来，扔在火里烧了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you do not remain in me, you are like a branch that is thrown away and withers; such branches are picked up, thrown into the fire and burned.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone does not abide in me, he is thrown away like a branch and withers; and the branches are gathered, thrown into the fire, and burned.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone does not abide in Me, he is cast out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them and throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who does not remain in me is thrown away like a useless branch and withers. Such branches are gathered into a pile to be burned.
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is thrown away like a branch and dries up; and they gather them and throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.textEn: <red>If you do not remain in me, you are like a branch that is thrown away and withers; such branches are picked up, thrown into the fire and burned.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们若住在我里面，我的话也留在你们里面；无论你们想要甚么，祈求，就给你们成就。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们若住在我里面，我的话也留在你们里面；无论你们想要甚么，祈求，就给你们成就。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若常在我里面，我的话也常在你们里面，凡你们所愿意的，祈求，就给你们成就。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If you abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you abide in Me, and My words abide in you, you will ask what you desire, and it shall be done for you.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you remain in me and my words remain in you, you may ask for anything you want, and it will be granted!
verses.textEnNasb: If you remain in Me, and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
verses.textEn: <red>If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这样，你们结出很多果子，我父就因此得荣耀，你们也就是我的门徒了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这样，你们结出很多果子，我父就因此得荣耀，你们也就是我的门徒了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们多结果子，我父就因此得荣耀，你们也就是我的门徒了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>This is to my Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: By this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit and so prove to be my disciples.
verses.textEnNkjv: By this My Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; so you will be My disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: When you produce much fruit, you are my true disciples. This brings great glory to my Father.
verses.textEnNasb: My Father is glorified by this, that you bear much fruit, and so prove to be My disciples.
verses.textEn: <red>This is to my Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父怎样爱我，我也怎样爱你们；你们要住在我的爱里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父怎样爱我，我也怎样爱你们；你们要住在我的爱里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我爱你们，正如父爱我一样；你们要常在我的爱里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Asp the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Abide in my love.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As the Father loved Me, I also have loved you; abide in My love.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have loved you even as the Father has loved me. Remain in my love.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as the Father has loved Me, I also have loved you; remain in My love.
verses.textEn: <red>“Asp the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们遵守我的命令，就必定住在我的爱里，正像我遵守了我父的命令，住在他的爱里一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们遵守我的命令，就必定住在我的爱里，正像我遵守了我父的命令，住在他的爱里一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若遵守我的命令，就常在我的爱里，正如我遵守了我父的命令，常在他的爱里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you keep my commands, you will remain in my love, just as I have kept my Father’s commands and remain in his love.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If you keep my commandments, you will abide in my love, just as I have kept my Father’s commandments and abide in his love.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you keep My commandments, you will abide in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and abide in His love.
verses.textEnNlt: When you obey my commandments, you remain in my love, just as I obey my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
verses.textEnNasb: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love; just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.
verses.textEn: <red>If you keep my commands, you will remain in my love, just as I have kept my Father’s commands and remain in his love.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我把这些事告诉了你们，好让我的喜乐存在你们心里，并且使你们的喜乐满溢。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我把这些事告诉了你们，好让我的喜乐存在你们心里，并且使你们的喜乐满溢。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「这些事我已经对你们说了，是要叫我的喜乐存在你们心里，并叫你们的喜乐可以满足。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: These things I have spoken to you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be full.
verses.textEnNkjv: "These things I have spoken to you, that My joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be full.
verses.textEnNlt: I have told you these things so that you will be filled with my joy. Yes, your joy will overflow!
verses.textEnNasb: These things I have spoken to you so that My joy may be in you, and that your joy may be made full.
verses.textEn: <red>I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要彼此相爱，像我爱你们一样，这就是我的命令。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要彼此相爱，像我爱你们一样，这就是我的命令。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要彼此相爱，像我爱你们一样；这就是我的命令。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "This is my commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
verses.textEnNlt: This is my commandment: Love each other in the same way I have loved you.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is My commandment, that you love one another, just as I have loved you.
verses.textEn: <red>My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人为朋友舍命，人间的爱没有比这个更大的了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人为朋友舍命，人间的爱没有比这个更大的了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人为朋友舍命，人的爱心没有比这个大的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greater love has no one than this, than to lay down one’s life for his friends.
verses.textEnNlt: There is no greater love than to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.
verses.textEnNasb: Greater love has no one than this, that a person will lay down his life for his friends.
verses.textEn: <red>Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们若行我所吩咐你们的，就是我的朋友了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们若行我所吩咐你们的，就是我的朋友了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若遵行我所吩咐的，就是我的朋友了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You are my friends if you do what I command.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You are my friends if you do what I command you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are My friends if you do whatever I command you.
verses.textEnNlt: You are my friends if you do what I command.
verses.textEnNasb: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
verses.textEn: <red>You are my friends if you do what I command.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我不再称你们为仆人，因为仆人不知道主人所作的事；我已经称你们为朋友了，因为我从我父那里听见的一切，都已经告诉你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我不再称你们为仆人，因为仆人不知道主人所作的事；我已经称你们为朋友了，因为我从我父那里听见的一切，都已经告诉你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>以后我不再称你们为仆人，因仆人不知道主人所做的事。我乃称你们为朋友；因我从我父所听见的，已经都告诉你们了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master’s business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, for all that I have heard from my Father I have made known to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, for all things that I heard from My Father I have made known to you.
verses.textEnNlt: I no longer call you slaves, because a master doesn’t confide in his slaves. Now you are my friends, since I have told you everything the Father told me.
verses.textEnNasb: No longer do I call you slaves, for the slave does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, because all things that I have heard from My Father I have made known to you.
verses.textEn: <red>I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master’s business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不是你们拣选了我，而是我拣选了你们，并且分派你们去结果子，就是结常存的果子，使你们奉我的名，无论向父求甚么，他必定赐给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不是你们拣选了我，而是我拣选了你们，并且分派你们去结果子，就是结常存的果子，使你们奉我的名，无论向父求甚么，他必定赐给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不是你们拣选了我，是我拣选了你们，并且分派你们去结果子，叫你们的果子常存，使你们奉我的名，无论向父求什么，他就赐给你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit—fruit that will last—and so that whatever you ask in my name the Father will give you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you that you should go and bear fruit and that your fruit should abide, so that whatever you ask the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You did not choose Me, but I chose you and appointed you that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain, that whatever you ask the Father in My name He may give you.
verses.textEnNlt: You didn’t choose me. I chose you. I appointed you to go and produce lasting fruit, so that the Father will give you whatever you ask for, using my name.
verses.textEnNasb: You did not choose Me but I chose you, and appointed you that you would go and bear fruit, and that your fruit would remain, so that whatever you ask of the Father in My name He may give to you.
verses.textEn: <red>You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit—fruit that will last—and so that whatever you ask in my name the Father will give you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我把这些事吩咐你们，是要你们彼此相爱。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我把这些事吩咐你们，是要你们彼此相爱。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我这样吩咐你们，是要叫你们彼此相爱。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>This is my command: Love each other.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: These things I command you, so that you will love one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things I command you, that you love one another.
verses.textEnNlt: This is my command: Love each other.
verses.textEnNasb: This I command you, that you love one another.
verses.textEn: <red>This is my command: Love each other.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"如果世人恨你们，你们要知道他们在恨你们以先，已经恨我了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"如果世人恨你们，你们要知道他们在恨你们以先，已经恨我了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「世人若恨你们，你们知道 ，恨你们以先已经恨我了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "If the world hates you, know that it has hated me before it hated you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If the world hates you, you know that it hated Me before it hated you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If the world hates you, remember that it hated me first.
verses.textEnNasb: "If the world hates you, you know that it has hated Me before it hated you.
verses.textEn: <red>“If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们若属于这世界，世人必定爱属自己的；但因为你们不属于世界，而是我从世界中拣选了你们，所以世人就恨你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们若属于这世界，世人必定爱属自己的；但因为你们不属于世界，而是我从世界中拣选了你们，所以世人就恨你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若属世界，世界必爱属自己的；只因你们不属世界，乃是我从世界中拣选了你们，所以世界就恨你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you belonged to the world, it would love you as its own. As it is, you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world. That is why the world hates you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If you were of the world, the world would love you as its own; but because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. Yet because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
verses.textEnNlt: The world would love you as one of its own if you belonged to it, but you are no longer part of the world. I chose you to come out of the world, so it hates you.
verses.textEnNasb: If you were of the world, the world would love you as its own; but because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, because of this the world hates you.
verses.textEn: <red>If you belonged to the world, it would love you as its own. As it is, you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world. That is why the world hates you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要记住我对你们说过的话：‘仆人不能大过主人。’他们若迫害我，也必定迫害你们；他们若遵守我的话，也必定遵守你们的话。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要记住我对你们说过的话：‘仆人不能大过主人。’他们若迫害我，也必定迫害你们；他们若遵守我的话，也必定遵守你们的话。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要记念我从前对你们所说的话：『仆人不能大于主人。』他们若逼迫了我，也要逼迫你们；若遵守了我的话，也要遵守你们的话。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Remember what I told you: ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will persecute you also. If they obeyed my teaching, they will obey yours also.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember the word that I said to you, ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will also persecute you. If they kept My word, they will keep yours also.
verses.textEnNlt: Do you remember what I told you? ‘A slave is not greater than the master.’ Since they persecuted me, naturally they will persecute you. And if they had listened to me, they would listen to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember the word that I said to you, ‘A slave is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they followed My word, they will follow yours also.
verses.textEn: <red>Remember what I told you: ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will persecute you also. If they obeyed my teaching, they will obey yours also.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但他们因着我的名，要向你们行这一切，因为他们不认识那差我来的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但他们因着我的名，要向你们行这一切，因为他们不认识那差我来的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但他们因我的名要向你们行这一切的事，因为他们不认识那差我来的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>They will treat you this way because of my name, for they do not know the one who sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But all these things they will do to you on account of my name, because they do not know him who sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: But all these things they will do to you for My name’s sake, because they do not know Him who sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: They will do all this to you because of me, for they have rejected the one who sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: But all these things they will do to you on account of My name, because they do not know the One who sent Me.
verses.textEn: <red>They will treat you this way because of my name, for they do not know the one who sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果我没有来，也没有对他们讲过甚么，他们就没有罪；但现在他们的罪是无可推诿的了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果我没有来，也没有对他们讲过甚么，他们就没有罪；但现在他们的罪是无可推诿的了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若没有来教训他们，他们就没有罪；但如今他们的罪无可推诿了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have been guilty of sin, but now they have no excuse for their sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would have no sin, but now they have no excuse for their sin.
verses.textEnNlt: They would not be guilty if I had not come and spoken to them. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
verses.textEnNasb: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
verses.textEn: <red>If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>恨我的，也恨我的父。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>恨我的，也恨我的父。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>恨我的，也恨我的父。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever hates me hates my Father as well.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever hates me hates my Father also.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who hates Me hates My Father also.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who hates me also hates my Father.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who hates Me hates My Father also.
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever hates me hates my Father as well.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果我没有在他们中间作过别人没有作过的事，他们就没有罪；但现在我和我的父，他们都看见了，也都恨恶。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果我没有在他们中间作过别人没有作过的事，他们就没有罪；但现在我和我的父，他们都看见了，也都恨恶。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若没有在他们中间行过别人未曾行的事，他们就没有罪；但如今连我与我的父，他们也看见也恨恶了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If I had not done among them the works no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin. As it is, they have seen, and yet they have hated both me and my Father.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin, but now they have seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I had not done among them the works which no one else did, they would have no sin; but now they have seen and also hated both Me and My Father.
verses.textEnNlt: If I hadn’t done such miraculous signs among them that no one else could do, they would not be guilty. But as it is, they have seen everything I did, yet they still hate me and my Father.
verses.textEnNasb: If I had not done among them the works which no one else did, they would not have sin; but now they have both seen and hated Me and My Father as well.
verses.textEn: <red>If I had not done among them the works no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin. As it is, they have seen, and yet they have hated both me and my Father.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这就应验了他们律法上所写的话：‘他们无故地恨我。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这就应验了他们律法上所写的话：‘他们无故地恨我。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这要应验他们律法上所写的话，说：『他们无故地恨我。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated me without reason.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the word that is written in their Law must be fulfilled: ‘They hated me without a cause.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But this happened that the word might be fulfilled which is written in their law, ‘They hated Me without a cause.’
verses.textEnNlt: This fulfills what is written in their Scriptures : ‘They hated me without cause.’
verses.textEnNasb: But this has happened so that the word that is written in their Law will be fulfilled: ‘They hated Me for no reason.’
verses.textEn: <red>But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated me without reason.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我从父那里要差来给你们的保惠师，就是从父那里出来的真理的灵，他来到的时候，要为我作见证。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我从父那里要差来给你们的保惠师，就是从父那里出来的真理的灵，他来到的时候，要为我作见证。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但我要从父那里差保惠师来，就是从父出来真理的圣灵；他来了，就要为我作见证。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who goes out from the Father—he will testify about me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But when the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will bear witness about me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But when the Helper comes, whom I shall send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father, He will testify of Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I will send you the Advocate —the Spirit of truth. He will come to you from the Father and will testify all about me.
verses.textEnNasb: "When the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, namely, the Spirit of truth who comes from the Father, He will testify about Me,
verses.textEn: <red>“When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who goes out from the Father—he will testify about me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们也要作见证，因为从开始你们就是跟我在一起的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们也要作见证，因为从开始你们就是跟我在一起的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们也要作见证，因为你们从起头就与我同在。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And you also must testify, for you have been with me from the beginning.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And you also will bear witness, because you have been with me from the beginning.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you also will bear witness, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
verses.textEnNlt: And you must also testify about me because you have been with me from the beginning of my ministry.
verses.textEnNasb: and you are testifying as well, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
verses.textEn: <red>And you also must testify, for you have been with me from the beginning.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我把这些事告诉了你们，使你们不致后退。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我把这些事告诉了你们，使你们不致后退。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我已将这些事告诉你们，使你们不至于跌倒。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“All this I have told you so that you will not fall away.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I have said all these things to you to keep you from falling away.
verses.textEnNkjv: "These things I have spoken to you, that you should not be made to stumble.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have told you these things so that you won’t abandon your faith.
verses.textEnNasb: "These things I have spoken to you so that you will not be led into sin.
verses.textEn: <red>“All this I have told you so that you will not fall away.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人要把你们赶出会堂；并且时候要到，所有要杀害你们的人，以为这样就是事奉神。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人要把你们赶出会堂；并且时候要到，所有要杀害你们的人，以为这样就是事奉神。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人要把你们赶出会堂，并且时候将到，凡杀你们的就以为是事奉神。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>They will put you out of the synagogue; in fact, the time is coming when anyone who kills you will think they are offering a service to God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They will put you out of the synagogues. Indeed, the hour is coming when whoever kills you will think he is offering service to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will put you out of the synagogues; yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers God service.
verses.textEnNlt: For you will be expelled from the synagogues, and the time is coming when those who kill you will think they are doing a holy service for God.
verses.textEnNasb: They will ban you from the synagogue, yet an hour is coming for everyone who kills you to think that he is offering a service to God.
verses.textEn: <red>They will put you out of the synagogue; in fact, the time is coming when anyone who kills you will think they are offering a service to God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们要作这些事，因为他们不认识父，也不认识我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们要作这些事，因为他们不认识父，也不认识我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他们这样行，是因未曾认识父，也未曾认识我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>They will do such things because they have not known the Father or me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these things they will do to you because they have not known the Father nor Me.
verses.textEnNlt: This is because they have never known the Father or me.
verses.textEnNasb: These things they will do because they have not known the Father nor Me.
verses.textEn: <red>They will do such things because they have not known the Father or me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我把这些事告诉了你们，让你们到了那个时候，可以想起我告诉过你们了。 "我起初没有把这些事告诉你们，因为我跟你们在一起。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我把这些事告诉了你们，让你们到了那个时候，可以想起我告诉过你们了。 "我起初没有把这些事告诉你们，因为我跟你们在一起。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我将这事告诉你们，是叫你们到了时候可以想起我对你们说过了。」 「我起先没有将这事告诉你们，因为我与你们同在。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have told you this, so that when their time comes you will remember that I warned you about them. I did not tell you this from the beginning because I was with you,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I have said these things to you, that when their hour comes you may remember that I told them to you. "I did not say these things to you from the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But these things I have told you, that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you of them. And these things I did not say to you at the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I’m telling you these things now, so that when they happen, you will remember my warning. I didn’t tell you earlier because I was going to be with you for a while longer.
verses.textEnNasb: But these things I have spoken to you, so that when their hour comes, you may remember that I told you of them. However, I did not say these things to you at the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.textEn: <red>I have told you this, so that when their time comes you will remember that I warned you about them. I did not tell you this from the beginning because I was with you,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>现在我要到那差我来的那里去，你们中间并没有人问：‘你到哪里去？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>现在我要到那差我来的那里去，你们中间并没有人问：‘你到哪里去？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>现今我往差我来的父那里去，你们中间并没有人问我：『你往哪里去？』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>but now I am going to him who sent me. None of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "But now I go away to Him who sent Me, and none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’
verses.textEnNlt: "But now I am going away to the one who sent me, and not one of you is asking where I am going.
verses.textEnNasb: "But now I am going to Him who sent Me; and none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’
verses.textEn: <red>but now I am going to him who sent me. None of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而因为我把这些事告诉了你们，你们心里就充满忧愁。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而因为我把这些事告诉了你们，你们心里就充满忧愁。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只因我将这事告诉你们，你们就满心忧愁。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Rather, you are filled with grief because I have said these things.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But because I have said these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: But because I have said these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, you grieve because of what I’ve told you.
verses.textEnNasb: But because I have said these things to you, grief has filled your heart.
verses.textEn: <red>Rather, you are filled with grief because I have said these things.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但我要把实情告诉你们，我去是对你们有益的。如果我不去，保惠师就不会到你们这里来；我若去了，就会差他到你们这里来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但我要把实情告诉你们，我去是对你们有益的。如果我不去，保惠师就不会到你们这里来；我若去了，就会差他到你们这里来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然而，我将真情告诉你们，我去是与你们有益的；我若不去，保惠师就不到你们这里来；我若去，就差他来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But very truly I tell you, it is for your good that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, I tell you the truth: it is to your advantage that I go away, for if I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth. It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you; but if I depart, I will send Him to you.
verses.textEnNlt: But in fact, it is best for you that I go away, because if I don’t, the Advocate won’t come. If I do go away, then I will send him to you.
verses.textEnNasb: But I tell you the truth: it is to your advantage that I am leaving; for if I do not leave, the Helper will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.
verses.textEn: <red>But very truly I tell you, it is for your good that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他来了，就要在罪、在义、在审判各方面指证世人的罪。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他来了，就要在罪、在义、在审判各方面指证世人的罪。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他既来了，就要叫世人为罪、为义、为审判，自己责备自己。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When he comes, he will prove the world to be in the wrong about sin and righteousness and judgment:</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when he comes, he will convict the world concerning sin and righteousness and judgment:
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He has come, He will convict the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
verses.textEnNlt: And when he comes, he will convict the world of its sin, and of God’s righteousness, and of the coming judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: And He, when He comes, will convict the world regarding sin, and righteousness, and judgment:
verses.textEn: <red>When he comes, he will prove the world to be in the wrong about sin and righteousness and judgment:</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在罪方面，是因为他们不信我；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在罪方面，是因为他们不信我；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>为罪，是因他们不信我；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>about sin, because people do not believe in me;</red>
verses.textEnEsv: concerning sin, because they do not believe in me;
verses.textEnNkjv: of sin, because they do not believe in Me;
verses.textEnNlt: The world’s sin is that it refuses to believe in me.
verses.textEnNasb: regarding sin, because they do not believe in Me;
verses.textEn: <red>about sin, because people do not believe in me;</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在义方面，是因为我到父那里去，你们就再看不见我；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在义方面，是因为我到父那里去，你们就再看不见我；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>为义，是因我往父那里去，你们就不再见我；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>about righteousness, because I am going to the Father, where you can see me no longer;</red>
verses.textEnEsv: concerning righteousness, because I go to the Father, and you will see me no longer;
verses.textEnNkjv: of righteousness, because I go to My Father and you see Me no more;
verses.textEnNlt: Righteousness is available because I go to the Father, and you will see me no more.
verses.textEnNasb: and regarding righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you no longer are going to see Me;
verses.textEn: <red>about righteousness, because I am going to the Father, where you can see me no longer;</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在审判方面，是因为这世界的统治者已经受了审判。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在审判方面，是因为这世界的统治者已经受了审判。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>为审判，是因这世界的王受了审判。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and about judgment, because the prince of this world now stands condemned.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: concerning judgment, because the ruler of this world is judged.
verses.textEnNkjv: of judgment, because the ruler of this world is judged.
verses.textEnNlt: Judgment will come because the ruler of this world has already been judged.
verses.textEnNasb: and regarding judgment, because the ruler of this world has been judged.
verses.textEn: <red>and about judgment, because the prince of this world now stands condemned.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我还有许多事要告诉你们，可是你们现在担当不了；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我还有许多事要告诉你们，可是你们现在担当不了；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我还有好些事要告诉你们，但你们现在担当不了 。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I have much more to say to you, more than you can now bear.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I still have many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them now.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I still have many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them now.
verses.textEnNlt: "There is so much more I want to tell you, but you can’t bear it now.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have many more things to say to you, but you cannot bear them at the present time.
verses.textEn: <red>“I have much more to say to you, more than you can now bear.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>只等真理的灵来了，他要引导你们进入一切真理。他不是凭着自己说话，而是把他听见的都说出来，并且要把将来的事告诉你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>只等真理的灵来了，他要引导你们进入一切真理。他不是凭着自己说话，而是把他听见的都说出来，并且要把将来的事告诉你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只等真理的圣灵来了，他要引导你们明白 一切的真理；因为他不是凭自己说的，乃是把他所听见的都说出来，并要把将来的事告诉你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all the truth. He will not speak on his own; he will speak only what he hears, and he will tell you what is yet to come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth, for he will not speak on his own authority, but whatever he hears he will speak, and he will declare to you the things that are to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, when He, the Spirit of truth, has come, He will guide you into all truth; for He will not speak on His own authority, but whatever He hears He will speak; and He will tell you things to come.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all truth. He will not speak on his own but will tell you what he has heard. He will tell you about the future.
verses.textEnNasb: But when He, the Spirit of truth, comes, He will guide you into all the truth; for He will not speak on His own, but whatever He hears, He will speak; and He will disclose to you what is to come.
verses.textEn: <red>But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all the truth. He will not speak on his own; he will speak only what he hears, and he will tell you what is yet to come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他要荣耀我，因为他要把从我那里所领受的告诉你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他要荣耀我，因为他要把从我那里所领受的告诉你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他要荣耀我，因为他要将受于我的告诉你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He will glorify me because it is from me that he will receive what he will make known to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He will glorify me, for he will take what is mine and declare it to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will glorify Me, for He will take of what is Mine and declare it to you.
verses.textEnNlt: He will bring me glory by telling you whatever he receives from me.
verses.textEnNasb: He will glorify Me, for He will take from Mine and will disclose it to you.
verses.textEn: <red>He will glorify me because it is from me that he will receive what he will make known to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父所有的一切，都是我的；所以我说，他要把从我那里所领受的告诉你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父所有的一切，都是我的；所以我说，他要把从我那里所领受的告诉你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡父所有的，都是我的；所以我说，他要将受于我的告诉你们。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>All that belongs to the Father is mine. That is why I said the Spirit will receive from me what he will make known to you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: All that the Father has is mine; therefore I said that he will take what is mine and declare it to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: All things that the Father has are Mine. Therefore I said that He will take of Mine and declare it to you.
verses.textEnNlt: All that belongs to the Father is mine; this is why I said, ‘The Spirit will tell you whatever he receives from me.’
verses.textEnNasb: All things that the Father has are Mine; this is why I said that He takes from Mine and will disclose it to you.
verses.textEn: <red>All that belongs to the Father is mine. That is why I said the Spirit will receive from me what he will make known to you.”</red>

verses.textZh: "<red>不久，你们不会再看见我；再过不久，你们还要看见我。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: "<red>不久，你们不会再看见我；再过不久，你们还要看见我。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>等不多时，你们就不得见我；再等不多时，你们还要见我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus went on to say, <red>“In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "A little while, and you will see me no longer; and again a little while, and you will see me."
verses.textEnNkjv: "A little while, and you will not see Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me, because I go to the Father."
verses.textEnNlt: "In a little while you won’t see me anymore. But a little while after that, you will see me again."
verses.textEnNasb: "A little while, and you no longer are going to see Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me."
verses.textEn: Jesus went on to say, <red>“In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他的门徒中有几个彼此说："<red>他对我们说：‘不久，你们不会看见我；再过不久，你们还要看见我。’又说：‘因为我到父那里去。’这是甚么意思呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他的门徒中有几个彼此说："<red>他对我们说：‘不久，你们不会看见我；再过不久，你们还要看见我。’又说：‘因为我到父那里去。’这是甚么意思呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 有几个门徒就彼此说：「<red>他对我们说：『等不多时，你们就不得见我；再等不多时，你们还要见我』；又说：『因我往父那里去。』这是什么意思呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: At this, some of his disciples said to one another, “What does he mean by saying, <red>‘In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me,’</red> and <red>‘Because I am going to the Father’?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So some of his disciples said to one another, "What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you will not see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’; and, ‘because I am going to the Father’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some of His disciples said among themselves, "What is this that He says to us, ‘A little while, and you will not see Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me’; and, ‘because I go to the Father’?"
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the disciples asked each other, "What does he mean when he says, ‘In a little while you won’t see me, but then you will see me,’ and ‘I am going to the Father’?
verses.textEnNasb: So some of His disciples said to one another, "What is this that He is telling us, ‘A little while, and you are not going to see Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me’; and, ‘because I am going to the Father’?"
verses.textEn: At this, some of his disciples said to one another, “What does he mean by saying, <red>‘In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me,’</red> and <red>‘Because I am going to the Father’?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们又说："<red>他所说的‘不久’，是甚么意思呢？我们不晓得他在讲甚么。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又说："<red>他所说的‘不久’，是甚么意思呢？我们不晓得他在讲甚么。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒彼此说：「<red>他说『等不多时』到底是什么意思呢？我们不明白他所说的话。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: They kept asking, “What does he mean by <red>‘a little while’?</red> We don’t understand what he is saying.”
verses.textEnEsv: So they were saying, "What does he mean by ‘a little while’? We do not know what he is talking about."
verses.textEnNkjv: They said therefore, "What is this that He says, ‘A little while’? We do not know what He is saying."
verses.textEnNlt: And what does he mean by ‘a little while’? We don’t understand."
verses.textEnNasb: So they were saying, "What is this that He says, ‘A little while’? We do not know what He is talking about."
verses.textEn: They kept asking, “What does he mean by <red>‘a little while’?</red> We don’t understand what he is saying.”

verses.textZh: 耶稣知道他们想问他，就说："<red>我所说的‘不久，你们不会看见我；再过不久，你们还要看见我’，你们为了这话彼此议论吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣知道他们想问他，就说："<red>我所说的‘不久，你们不会看见我；再过不久，你们还要看见我’，你们为了这话彼此议论吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣看出他们要问他，就说：「我说『等不多时，你们就不得见我；再等不多时，你们还要见我』，你们为这话彼此相问吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus saw that they wanted to ask him about this, so he said to them, <red>“Are you asking one another what I meant when I said, ‘In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me’?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus knew that they wanted to ask him, so he said to them, "Is this what you are asking yourselves, what I meant by saying, ‘A little while and you will not see me, and again a little while and you will see me’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jesus knew that they desired to ask Him, and He said to them, "Are you inquiring among yourselves about what I said, ‘A little while, and you will not see Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me’?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus realized they wanted to ask him about it, so he said, "Are you asking yourselves what I meant? I said in a little while you won’t see me, but a little while after that you will see me again.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus knew that they wanted to question Him, and He said to them, "Are you deliberating together about this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you are not going to see Me, and again a little while, and you will see Me’?
verses.textEn: Jesus saw that they wanted to ask him about this, so he said to them, <red>“Are you asking one another what I meant when I said, ‘In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me’?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，你们要痛哭哀号，世人却要欢喜；你们要忧愁，但你们的忧愁要变为喜乐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实实在在告诉你们，你们要痛哭哀号，世人却要欢喜；你们要忧愁，但你们的忧愁要变为喜乐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实实在在地告诉你们，你们将要痛哭、哀号，世人倒要喜乐；你们将要忧愁，然而你们的忧愁要变为喜乐。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Very truly I tell you, you will weep and mourn while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, truly, I say to you, you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will turn into joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice; and you will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, you will weep and mourn over what is going to happen to me, but the world will rejoice. You will grieve, but your grief will suddenly turn to wonderful joy.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, truly I say to you that you will weep and mourn, but the world will rejoice; you will grieve, but your grief will be turned into joy!
verses.textEn: <red>Very truly I tell you, you will weep and mourn while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>妇人生产的时候会有忧愁，因为她的时候到了；但生了孩子以后，就不再记住那痛苦了，因为欢喜有一个人生到世上来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>妇人生产的时候会有忧愁，因为她的时候到了；但生了孩子以后，就不再记住那痛苦了，因为欢喜有一个人生到世上来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>妇人生产的时候就忧愁，因为她的时候到了；既生了孩子，就不再记念那苦楚，因为欢喜世上生了一个人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>A woman giving birth to a child has pain because her time has come; but when her baby is born she forgets the anguish because of her joy that a child is born into the world.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When a woman is giving birth, she has sorrow because her hour has come, but when she has delivered the baby, she no longer remembers the anguish, for joy that a human being has been born into the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: A woman, when she is in labor, has sorrow because her hour has come; but as soon as she has given birth to the child, she no longer remembers the anguish, for joy that a human being has been born into the world.
verses.textEnNlt: It will be like a woman suffering the pains of labor. When her child is born, her anguish gives way to joy because she has brought a new baby into the world.
verses.textEnNasb: Whenever a woman is in labor she has pain, because her hour has come; but when she gives birth to the child, she no longer remembers the anguish because of the joy that a child has been born into the world.
verses.textEn: <red>A woman giving birth to a child has pain because her time has come; but when her baby is born she forgets the anguish because of her joy that a child is born into the world.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>现在你们也有忧愁；但我要再见你们，你们的心就会喜乐，你们的喜乐是没有人能够夺去的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>现在你们也有忧愁；但我要再见你们，你们的心就会喜乐，你们的喜乐是没有人能够夺去的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们现在也是忧愁，但我要再见你们，你们的心就喜乐了；这喜乐也没有人能夺去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So with you: Now is your time of grief, but I will see you again and you will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again, and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take your joy from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you now have sorrow; but I will see you again and your heart will rejoice, and your joy no one will take from you.
verses.textEnNlt: So you have sorrow now, but I will see you again; then you will rejoice, and no one can rob you of that joy.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore you too have grief now; but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one is going to take your joy away from you.
verses.textEn: <red>So with you: Now is your time of grief, but I will see you again and you will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>到了那天，你们甚么也不会问我了。我实实在在告诉你们，你们奉我的名无论向父求甚么，他必定赐给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>到了那天，你们甚么也不会问我了。我实实在在告诉你们，你们奉我的名无论向父求甚么，他必定赐给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>到那日，你们什么也就不问我了。我实实在在地告诉你们，你们若向父求什么，他必因我的名赐给你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In that day you will no longer ask me anything. Very truly I tell you, my Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: In that day you will ask nothing of me. Truly, truly, I say to you, whatever you ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And in that day you will ask Me nothing. Most assuredly, I say to you, whatever you ask the Father in My name He will give you.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time you won’t need to ask me for anything. I tell you the truth, you will ask the Father directly, and he will grant your request because you use my name.
verses.textEnNasb: And on that day you will not question Me about anything. Truly, truly I say to you, if you ask the Father for anything in My name, He will give it to you.
verses.textEn: <red>In that day you will no longer ask me anything. Very truly I tell you, my Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们向来没有奉我的名求甚么；现在你们祈求，就必定得着，让你们的喜乐满溢。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们向来没有奉我的名求甚么；现在你们祈求，就必定得着，让你们的喜乐满溢。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>向来你们没有奉我的名求什么，如今你们求，就必得着，叫你们的喜乐可以满足。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Until now you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be full.
verses.textEnNkjv: Until now you have asked nothing in My name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be full.
verses.textEnNlt: You haven’t done this before. Ask, using my name, and you will receive, and you will have abundant joy.
verses.textEnNasb: Until now you have asked for nothing in My name; ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be made full.
verses.textEn: <red>Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我用譬喻对你们说了这些事，时候要到，我不再用譬喻对你们说了，而是把关于父的事明明白白告诉你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我用譬喻对你们说了这些事，时候要到，我不再用譬喻对你们说了，而是把关于父的事明明白白告诉你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「这些事，我是用比喻对你们说的；时候将到，我不再用比喻对你们说，乃要将父明明地告诉你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Though I have been speaking figuratively, a time is coming when I will no longer use this kind of language but will tell you plainly about my Father.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I have said these things to you in figures of speech. The hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you in figures of speech but will tell you plainly about the Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: "These things I have spoken to you in figurative language; but the time is coming when I will no longer speak to you in figurative language, but I will tell you plainly about the Father.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have spoken of these matters in figures of speech, but soon I will stop speaking figuratively and will tell you plainly all about the Father.
verses.textEnNasb: "These things I have spoken to you in figures of speech; an hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
verses.textEn: <red>“Though I have been speaking figuratively, a time is coming when I will no longer use this kind of language but will tell you plainly about my Father.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>到了那天，你们要奉我的名祈求，我不是说我要为你们请求父；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>到了那天，你们要奉我的名祈求，我不是说我要为你们请求父；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>到那日，你们要奉我的名祈求；我并不对你们说，我要为你们求父。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In that day you will ask in my name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: In that day you will ask in my name, and I do not say to you that I will ask the Father on your behalf;
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day you will ask in My name, and I do not say to you that I shall pray the Father for you;
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will ask in my name. I’m not saying I will ask the Father on your behalf,
verses.textEnNasb: On that day you will ask in My name, and I am not saying to you that I will request of the Father on your behalf;
verses.textEn: <red>In that day you will ask in my name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父自己爱你们，因为你们已经爱我，并且信我是从神那里来的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父自己爱你们，因为你们已经爱我，并且信我是从神那里来的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>父自己爱你们；因为你们已经爱我，又信我是从父出来的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>No, the Father himself loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.
verses.textEnNkjv: for the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me, and have believed that I came forth from God.
verses.textEnNlt: for the Father himself loves you dearly because you love me and believe that I came from God.
verses.textEnNasb: for the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came forth from the Father.
verses.textEn: <red>No, the Father himself loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我从父那里来，到了这世界；我又离开这世界，到父那里去。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我从父那里来，到了这世界；我又离开这世界，到父那里去。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我从父出来，到了世界；我又离开世界，往父那里去。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I came from the Father and entered the world; now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I came from the Father and have come into the world, and now I am leaving the world and going to the Father."
verses.textEnNkjv: I came forth from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I came from the Father into the world, and now I will leave the world and return to the Father."
verses.textEnNasb: I came forth from the Father and have come into the world; again, I am leaving the world and going to the Father."
verses.textEn: <red>I came from the Father and entered the world; now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒说："你看，现在你是明说，不是用譬喻说了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒说："你看，现在你是明说，不是用譬喻说了。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒说：「如今你是明说，并不用比喻了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus’ disciples said, "Now you are speaking clearly and without figures of speech.
verses.textEnEsv: His disciples said, "Ah, now you are speaking plainly and not using figurative speech!
verses.textEnNkjv: His disciples said to Him, "See, now You are speaking plainly, and using no figure of speech!
verses.textEnNlt: Then his disciples said, "At last you are speaking plainly and not figuratively.
verses.textEnNasb: His disciples *said, "See, now You are speaking plainly and are not using any figure of speech.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus’ disciples said, "Now you are speaking clearly and without figures of speech.

verses.textZh: 现在我们知道你是无所不知的，不需要人向你发问。因此，我们信你是从神那里来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我们知道你是无所不知的，不需要人向你发问。因此，我们信你是从神那里来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我们晓得你凡事都知道，也不用人问你，因此我们信你是从神出来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now we can see that you know all things and that you do not even need to have anyone ask you questions. This makes us believe that you came from God."
verses.textEnEsv: Now we know that you know all things and do not need anyone to question you; this is why we believe that you came from God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now we are sure that You know all things, and have no need that anyone should question You. By this we believe that You came forth from God."
verses.textEnNlt: Now we understand that you know everything, and there’s no need to question you. From this we believe that you came from God."
verses.textEnNasb: Now we know that You know all things, and that You have no need for anyone to question You; this is why we believe that You came forth from God."
verses.textEn: Now we can see that you know all things and that you do not even need to have anyone ask you questions. This makes us believe that you came from God."

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他们说："现在你们信吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他们说："现在你们信吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「现在你们信吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Dop you now believe?”</red> Jesus replied.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered them, "Do you now believe?
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered them, "Do you now believe?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus asked, "Do you finally believe?
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus replied to them, "Do you now believe?
verses.textEn: <red>“Dop you now believe?”</red> Jesus replied.

verses.textZh: <red>看哪，时候要到，而且已经到了，你们要分散，各人到自己的地方去，只留下我独自一个人。其实我不是独自一个人，因为有父与我同在。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>看哪，时候要到，而且已经到了，你们要分散，各人到自己的地方去，只留下我独自一个人。其实我不是独自一个人，因为有父与我同在。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>看哪，时候将到，且是已经到了，你们要分散，各归自己的地方去，留下我独自一人；其实我不是独自一人，因为有父与我同在。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“A time is coming and in fact has come when you will be scattered, each to your own home. You will leave me all alone. Yet I am not alone, for my Father is with me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the hour is coming, indeed it has come, when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, for the Father is with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed the hour is coming, yes, has now come, that you will be scattered, each to his own, and will leave Me alone. And yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
verses.textEnNlt: But the time is coming—indeed it’s here now—when you will be scattered, each one going his own way, leaving me alone. Yet I am not alone because the Father is with me.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, an hour is coming, and has already come, for you to be scattered, each to his own home, and to leave Me alone; and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
verses.textEn: <red>“A time is coming and in fact has come when you will be scattered, each to your own home. You will leave me all alone. Yet I am not alone, for my Father is with me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我把这些事告诉你们，是要使你们在我里面有平安。在世上你们有患难，但你们放心，我已经胜了这世界。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我把这些事告诉你们，是要使你们在我里面有平安。在世上你们有患难，但你们放心，我已经胜了这世界。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我将这些事告诉你们，是要叫你们在我里面有平安。在世上，你们有苦难；但你们可以放心，我已经胜了世界。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I have said these things to you, that in me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take heart; I have overcome the world."
verses.textEnNkjv: These things I have spoken to you, that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation; but be of good cheer, I have overcome the world."
verses.textEnNlt: I have told you all this so that you may have peace in me. Here on earth you will have many trials and sorrows. But take heart, because I have overcome the world."
verses.textEnNasb: These things I have spoken to you so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you have tribulation, but take courage; I have overcome the world."
verses.textEn: <red>“I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣讲完了这些话，就举目望天，说："<red>父啊，时候到了，求你荣耀你的儿子，让儿子也荣耀你，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣讲完了这些话，就举目望天，说："<red>父啊，时候到了，求你荣耀你的儿子，让儿子也荣耀你，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说了这话，就举目望天，说：「父啊，时候到了，愿你荣耀你的儿子，使儿子也荣耀你；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: After Jesus said this, he looked toward heaven and prayed: <red>“Father, the hour has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may glorify you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, "Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son that the Son may glorify you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus spoke these words, lifted up His eyes to heaven, and said: "Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son also may glorify You,
verses.textEnNlt: After saying all these things, Jesus looked up to heaven and said, "Father, the hour has come. Glorify your Son so he can give glory back to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus spoke these things; and raising His eyes to heaven, He said, "Father, the hour has come; glorify Your Son, so that the Son may glorify You,
verses.textEn: After Jesus said this, he looked toward heaven and prayed: <red>“Father, the hour has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may glorify you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>正如你把管理全人类的权柄给了他，使他赐永生给你所赐给他的人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>正如你把管理全人类的权柄给了他，使他赐永生给你所赐给他的人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>正如你曾赐给他权柄管理凡有血气的，叫他将永生赐给你所赐给他的人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For you granted him authority over all people that he might give eternal life to all those you have given him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: since you have given him authority over all flesh, to give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
verses.textEnNkjv: as You have given Him authority over all flesh, that He should give eternal life to as many as You have given Him.
verses.textEnNlt: For you have given him authority over everyone. He gives eternal life to each one you have given him.
verses.textEnNasb: just as You gave Him authority over all mankind, so that to all whom You have given Him, He may give eternal life.
verses.textEn: <red>For you granted him authority over all people that he might give eternal life to all those you have given him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>认识你是独一的真神，并且认识你所差来的耶稣基督，这就是永生。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>认识你是独一的真神，并且认识你所差来的耶稣基督，这就是永生。</red>
