verses.textZhCuv: <red>认识你－独一的真神，并且认识你所差来的耶稣基督，这就是永生。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Now this is eternal life: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And this is eternal life, that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.
verses.textEnNlt: And this is the way to have eternal life—to know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, the one you sent to earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.
verses.textEn: <red>Now this is eternal life: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我在地上已经荣耀了你，你交给我要作的工，我已经完成了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我在地上已经荣耀了你，你交给我要作的工，我已经完成了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我在地上已经荣耀你，你所托付我的事，我已成全了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have brought you glory on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I glorified you on earth, having accomplished the work that you gave me to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have glorified You on the earth. I have finished the work which You have given Me to do.
verses.textEnNlt: I brought glory to you here on earth by completing the work you gave me to do.
verses.textEnNasb: I glorified You on the earth by accomplishing the work which You have given Me to do.
verses.textEn: <red>I have brought you glory on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父啊，现在让我在你自己面前得着荣耀，就是在创世以前我与你同享的荣耀。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父啊，现在让我在你自己面前得着荣耀，就是在创世以前我与你同享的荣耀。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>父啊，现在求你使我同你享荣耀，就是未有世界以先，我同你所有的荣耀。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I had with you before the world began.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And now, Father, glorify me in your own presence with the glory that I had with you before the world existed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, O Father, glorify Me together with Yourself, with the glory which I had with You before the world was.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, Father, bring me into the glory we shared before the world began.
verses.textEnNasb: And now You, Father, glorify Me together with Yourself, with the glory which I had with You before the world existed.
verses.textEn: <red>And now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I had with you before the world began.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你从世上分别出来赐给我的人，我已经把你的名显明给他们了。他们是你的，你把他们赐给了我，他们也遵守了你的道。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你从世上分别出来赐给我的人，我已经把你的名显明给他们了。他们是你的，你把他们赐给了我，他们也遵守了你的道。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你从世上赐给我的人，我已将你的名显明与他们。他们本是你的，你将他们赐给我，他们也遵守了你的道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I have revealed you to those whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours; you gave them to me and they have obeyed your word.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I have manifested your name to the people whom you gave me out of the world. Yours they were, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have manifested Your name to the men whom You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours, You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have revealed you to the ones you gave me from this world. They were always yours. You gave them to me, and they have kept your word.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have revealed Your name to the men whom You gave Me out of the world; they were Yours and You gave them to Me, and they have followed Your word.
verses.textEn: <red>“I have revealed you to those whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours; you gave them to me and they have obeyed your word.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>现在他们知道，你所给我的，无论是甚么，都是从你那里来的；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>现在他们知道，你所给我的，无论是甚么，都是从你那里来的；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>如今他们知道，凡你所赐给我的，都是从你那里来的；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Now they know that everything that you have given me is from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now they have known that all things which You have given Me are from You.
verses.textEnNlt: Now they know that everything I have is a gift from you,
verses.textEnNasb: Now they have come to know that everything which You have given Me is from You;
verses.textEn: <red>Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为你赐给我的话，我已经给了他们，他们也领受了，又确实知道我是从你那里来的，并且信你差了我来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为你赐给我的话，我已经给了他们，他们也领受了，又确实知道我是从你那里来的，并且信你差了我来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为你所赐给我的道，我已经赐给他们，他们也领受了，又确实知道，我是从你出来的，并且信你差了我来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For I gave them the words you gave me and they accepted them. They knew with certainty that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I have given them the words that you gave me, and they have received them and have come to know in truth that I came from you; and they have believed that you sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have given to them the words which You have given Me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came forth from You; and they have believed that You sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: for I have passed on to them the message you gave me. They accepted it and know that I came from you, and they believe you sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: for the words which You gave Me I have given to them; and they received them and truly understood that I came forth from You, and they believed that You sent Me.
verses.textEn: <red>For I gave them the words you gave me and they accepted them. They knew with certainty that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我为他们求；我不为世人求，而是为你赐给我的人求，因为他们是你的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我为他们求；我不为世人求，而是为你赐给我的人求，因为他们是你的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我为他们祈求，不为世人祈求，却为你所赐给我的人祈求，因他们本是你的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I pray for them. I am not praying for the world, but for those you have given me, for they are yours.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am praying for them. I am not praying for the world but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I pray for them. I do not pray for the world but for those whom You have given Me, for they are Yours.
verses.textEnNlt: "My prayer is not for the world, but for those you have given me, because they belong to you.
verses.textEnNasb: I ask on their behalf; I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on the behalf of those whom You have given Me, because they are Yours;
verses.textEn: <red>I pray for them. I am not praying for the world, but for those you have given me, for they are yours.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我的一切都是你的，你的一切也是我的，并且我因着他们得了荣耀。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我的一切都是你的，你的一切也是我的，并且我因着他们得了荣耀。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡是我的，都是你的；你的也是我的，并且我因他们得了荣耀。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And glory has come to me through them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: All mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all Mine are Yours, and Yours are Mine, and I am glorified in them.
verses.textEnNlt: All who are mine belong to you, and you have given them to me, so they bring me glory.
verses.textEnNasb: and all things that are Mine are Yours, and Yours are Mine; and I have been glorified in them.
verses.textEn: <red>All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And glory has come to me through them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我不再在这世上，他们却在这世上，我要到你那里去。圣父啊，求你因你赐给我的名，保守他们，使他们合而为一，好象我们一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我不再在这世上，他们却在这世上，我要到你那里去。圣父啊，求你因你赐给我的名，保守他们，使他们合而为一，好象我们一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>从今以后，我不在世上，他们却在世上；我往你那里去。圣父啊，求你因你所赐给我的名保守他们，叫他们合而为一像我们一样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I will remain in the world no longer, but they are still in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, protect them by the power of your name, the name you gave me, so that they may be one as we are one.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I am no longer in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them in your name, which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are one.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I am no longer in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to You. Holy Father, keep through Your name those whom You have given Me, that they may be one as We are.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I am departing from the world; they are staying in this world, but I am coming to you. Holy Father, you have given me your name; now protect them by the power of your name so that they will be united just as we are.
verses.textEnNasb: I am no longer going to be in the world; and yet they themselves are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, keep them in Your name, the name which You have given Me, so that they may be one just as We are.
verses.textEn: <red>I will remain in the world no longer, but they are still in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, protect them by the power of your name, the name you gave me, so that they may be one as we are one.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我跟他们在一起的时候，因你赐给我的名，我保守了他们，也护卫了他们；他们中间除了那灭亡的人以外，没有一个是灭亡的，这就应验了经上的话。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我跟他们在一起的时候，因你赐给我的名，我保守了他们，也护卫了他们；他们中间除了那灭亡的人以外，没有一个是灭亡的，这就应验了经上的话。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我与他们同在的时候，因你所赐给我的名保守了他们，我也护卫了他们；其中除了那灭亡之子，没有一个灭亡的，好叫经上的话得应验。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>While I was with them, I protected them and kept them safe by that name you gave me. None has been lost except the one doomed to destruction so that Scripture would be fulfilled.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: While I was with them, I kept them in your name, which you have given me. I have guarded them, and not one of them has been lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.textEnNkjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in Your name. Those whom You gave Me I have kept; and none of them is lost except the son of perdition, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.textEnNlt: During my time here, I protected them by the power of the name you gave me. I guarded them so that not one was lost, except the one headed for destruction, as the Scriptures foretold.
verses.textEnNasb: While I was with them, I was keeping them in Your name, which You have given Me; and I guarded them, and not one of them perished except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
verses.textEn: <red>While I was with them, I protected them and kept them safe by that name you gave me. None has been lost except the one doomed to destruction so that Scripture would be fulfilled.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>现在我到你那里去，我在世上说这些话，是要他们心里充满我的喜乐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>现在我到你那里去，我在世上说这些话，是要他们心里充满我的喜乐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>现在我往你那里去，我还在世上说这话，是叫他们心里充满我的喜乐。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I am coming to you now, but I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have the full measure of my joy within them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But now I am coming to you, and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now I come to You, and these things I speak in the world, that they may have My joy fulfilled in themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now I am coming to you. I told them many things while I was with them in this world so they would be filled with my joy.
verses.textEnNasb: But now I am coming to You; and these things I speak in the world so that they may have My joy made full in themselves.
verses.textEn: <red>“I am coming to you now, but I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have the full measure of my joy within them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我把你的道赐给了他们；世人恨他们，因为他们不属于这世界，像我不属于这世界一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我把你的道赐给了他们；世人恨他们，因为他们不属于这世界，像我不属于这世界一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我已将你的道赐给他们。世界又恨他们；因为他们不属世界，正如我不属世界一样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have given them your word and the world has hated them, for they are not of the world any more than I am of the world.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I have given them your word, and the world has hated them because they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have given them Your word; and the world has hated them because they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
verses.textEnNlt: I have given them your word. And the world hates them because they do not belong to the world, just as I do not belong to the world.
verses.textEnNasb: I have given them Your word; and the world has hated them because they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
verses.textEn: <red>I have given them your word and the world has hated them, for they are not of the world any more than I am of the world.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我不求你使他们离开世界，只求你保守他们脱离那恶者。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我不求你使他们离开世界，只求你保守他们脱离那恶者。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我不求你叫他们离开世界，只求你保守他们脱离那恶者 。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>My prayer is not that you take them out of the world but that you protect them from the evil one.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I do not ask that you take them out of the world, but that you keep them from the evil one.
verses.textEnNkjv: I do not pray that You should take them out of the world, but that You should keep them from the evil one.
verses.textEnNlt: I’m not asking you to take them out of the world, but to keep them safe from the evil one.
verses.textEnNasb: I am not asking You to take them out of the world, but to keep them away from the evil one.
verses.textEn: <red>My prayer is not that you take them out of the world but that you protect them from the evil one.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们不属于这世界，像我不属于这世界一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们不属于这世界，像我不属于这世界一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他们不属世界，正如我不属世界一样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>They are not of the world, even as I am not of it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
verses.textEnNlt: They do not belong to this world any more than I do.
verses.textEnNasb: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
verses.textEn: <red>They are not of the world, even as I am not of it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>求你用真理使他们成圣；你的道就是真理。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>求你用真理使他们成圣；你的道就是真理。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>求你用真理使他们成圣；你的道就是真理。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Sanctify them by the truth; your word is truth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Sanctify them in the truth; your word is truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sanctify them by Your truth. Your word is truth.
verses.textEnNlt: Make them holy by your truth; teach them your word, which is truth.
verses.textEnNasb: Sanctify them in the truth; Your word is truth.
verses.textEn: <red>Sanctify them by the truth; your word is truth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你怎样差我到世上来，我也怎样差他们到世上去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你怎样差我到世上来，我也怎样差他们到世上去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你怎样差我到世上，我也照样差他们到世上。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>As you sent me into the world, I have sent them into the world.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As you sent me into the world, so I have sent them into the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: As You sent Me into the world, I also have sent them into the world.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as you sent me into the world, I am sending them into the world.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as You sent Me into the world, I also sent them into the world.
verses.textEn: <red>As you sent me into the world, I have sent them into the world.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我为了他们的缘故，自己分别为圣，使他们也因着真理成圣。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我为了他们的缘故，自己分别为圣，使他们也因着真理成圣。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我为他们的缘故，自己分别为圣，叫他们也因真理成圣。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For them I sanctify myself, that they too may be truly sanctified.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And for their sake I consecrate myself, that they also may be sanctified in truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And for their sakes I sanctify Myself, that they also may be sanctified by the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: And I give myself as a holy sacrifice for them so they can be made holy by your truth.
verses.textEnNasb: And for their sakes I sanctify Myself, so that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
verses.textEn: <red>For them I sanctify myself, that they too may be truly sanctified.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我不但为他们求，也为那些因他们的话而信我的人求，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我不但为他们求，也为那些因他们的话而信我的人求，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我不但为这些人祈求，也为那些因他们的话信我的人祈求，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“My prayer is not for them alone. I pray also for those who will believe in me through their message,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I do not ask for these only, but also for those who will believe in me through their word,
verses.textEnNkjv: "I do not pray for these alone, but also for those who will believe in Me through their word;
verses.textEnNlt: "I am praying not only for these disciples but also for all who will ever believe in me through their message.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am not asking on behalf of these alone, but also for those who believe in Me through their word,
verses.textEn: <red>“My prayer is not for them alone. I pray also for those who will believe in me through their message,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>使他们都合而为一，像父你在我里面，我在你里面一样；使他们也在我们里面，让世人相信你差了我来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>使他们都合而为一，像父你在我里面，我在你里面一样；使他们也在我们里面，让世人相信你差了我来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>使他们都合而为一。正如你父在我里面，我在你里面，使他们也在我们里面，叫世人可以信你差了我来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>that all of them may be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. May they also be in us so that the world may believe that you have sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: that they may all be one, just as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: that they all may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I in You; that they also may be one in Us, that the world may believe that You sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: I pray that they will all be one, just as you and I are one—as you are in me, Father, and I am in you. And may they be in us so that the world will believe you sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: that they may all be one; just as You, Father, are in Me and I in You, that they also may be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
verses.textEn: <red>that all of them may be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. May they also be in us so that the world may believe that you have sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你赐给我的荣耀，我已经赐给了他们，使他们合而为一，像我们合而为一。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你赐给我的荣耀，我已经赐给了他们，使他们合而为一，像我们合而为一。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你所赐给我的荣耀，我已赐给他们，使他们合而为一，像我们合而为一。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have given them the glory that you gave me, that they may be one as we are one—</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The glory that you have given me I have given to them, that they may be one even as we are one,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the glory which You gave Me I have given them, that they may be one just as We are one:
verses.textEnNlt: "I have given them the glory you gave me, so they may be one as we are one.
verses.textEnNasb: The glory which You have given Me I also have given to them, so that they may be one, just as We are one;
verses.textEn: <red>I have given them the glory that you gave me, that they may be one as we are one—</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我在他们里面，你在我里面，使他们完完全全合而为一，让世人知道你差了我来，并且知道你爱他们，好象爱我一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我在他们里面，你在我里面，使他们完完全全合而为一，让世人知道你差了我来，并且知道你爱他们，好象爱我一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我在他们里面，你在我里面，使他们完完全全地合而为一，叫世人知道你差了我来，也知道你爱他们如同爱我一样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I in them and you in me—so that they may be brought to complete unity. Then the world will know that you sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I in them and you in me, that they may become perfectly one, so that the world may know that you sent me and loved them even as you loved me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I in them, and You in Me; that they may be made perfect in one, and that the world may know that You have sent Me, and have loved them as You have loved Me.
verses.textEnNlt: I am in them and you are in me. May they experience such perfect unity that the world will know that you sent me and that you love them as much as you love me.
verses.textEnNasb: I in them and You in Me, that they may be perfected in unity, so that the world may know that You sent Me, and You loved them, just as You loved Me.
verses.textEn: <red>I in them and you in me—so that they may be brought to complete unity. Then the world will know that you sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父啊，我在哪里，愿你赐给我的人也和我同在哪里，让他们看见你赐给我的荣耀，因为在创立世界以前，你已经爱我了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父啊，我在哪里，愿你赐给我的人也和我同在哪里，让他们看见你赐给我的荣耀，因为在创立世界以前，你已经爱我了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>父啊，我在哪里，愿你所赐给我的人也同我在那里，叫他们看见你所赐给我的荣耀；因为创立世界以前，你已经爱我了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Father, I want those you have given me to be with me where I am, and to see my glory, the glory you have given me because you loved me before the creation of the world.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Father, I desire that they also, whom you have given me, may be with me where I am, to see my glory that you have given me because you loved me before the foundation of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Father, I desire that they also whom You gave Me may be with Me where I am, that they may behold My glory which You have given Me; for You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
verses.textEnNlt: Father, I want these whom you have given me to be with me where I am. Then they can see all the glory you gave me because you loved me even before the world began!
verses.textEnNasb: Father, I desire that they also, whom You have given Me, be with Me where I am, so that they may see My glory which You have given Me, for You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
verses.textEn: <red>“Father, I want those you have given me to be with me where I am, and to see my glory, the glory you have given me because you loved me before the creation of the world.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>公义的父啊，世人虽然不认识你，我却认识你，这些人也知道你差了我来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>公义的父啊，世人虽然不认识你，我却认识你，这些人也知道你差了我来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>公义的父啊，世人未曾认识你，我却认识你；这些人也知道你差了我来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Righteous Father, though the world does not know you, I know you, and they know that you have sent me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: O righteous Father, even though the world does not know you, I know you, and these know that you have sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: O righteous Father! The world has not known You, but I have known You; and these have known that You sent Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "O righteous Father, the world doesn’t know you, but I do; and these disciples know you sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, yet I have known You; and these have known that You sent Me;
verses.textEn: <red>“Righteous Father, though the world does not know you, I know you, and they know that you have sent me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我已经把你的名指示他们，还要再指示，使你爱我的爱在他们里面，我也在他们里面。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我已经把你的名指示他们，还要再指示，使你爱我的爱在他们里面，我也在他们里面。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我已将你的名指示他们，还要指示他们，使你所爱我的爱在他们里面，我也在他们里面。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have made you known to them, and will continue to make you known in order that the love you have for me may be in them and that I myself may be in them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I made known to them your name, and I will continue to make it known, that the love with which you have loved me may be in them, and I in them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have declared to them Your name, and will declare it, that the love with which You loved Me may be in them, and I in them."
verses.textEnNlt: I have revealed you to them, and I will continue to do so. Then your love for me will be in them, and I will be in them."
verses.textEnNasb: and I have made Your name known to them, and will make it known, so that the love with which You loved Me may be in them, and I in them."
verses.textEn: <red>I have made you known to them, and will continue to make you known in order that the love you have for me may be in them and that I myself may be in them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说完了这些话，就和门徒出去，过了汲沦溪。在那里有一个园子，耶稣和门徒进去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说完了这些话，就和门徒出去，过了汲沦溪。在那里有一个园子，耶稣和门徒进去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说了这话，就同门徒出去，过了汲沦溪。在那里有一个园子，他和门徒进去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When he had finished praying, Jesus left with his disciples and crossed the Kidron Valley. On the other side there was a garden, and he and his disciples went into it.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples across the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, which he and his disciples entered.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples over the Brook Kidron, where there was a garden, which He and His disciples entered.
verses.textEnNlt: After saying these things, Jesus crossed the Kidron Valley with his disciples and entered a grove of olive trees.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jesus had spoken these words, He went away with His disciples across the ravine of the Kidron, where there was a garden which He entered with His disciples.
verses.textEn: When he had finished praying, Jesus left with his disciples and crossed the Kidron Valley. On the other side there was a garden, and he and his disciples went into it.

verses.textZh: 出卖耶稣的犹大也知道那地方，因为耶稣和门徒常常在那里聚集。
verses.textZhCnvs: 出卖耶稣的犹大也知道那地方，因为耶稣和门徒常常在那里聚集。
verses.textZhCuv: 卖耶稣的犹大也知道那地方，因为耶稣和门徒屡次上那里去聚集。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Judas, who betrayed him, knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with his disciples.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Judas, who betrayed Him, also knew the place; for Jesus often met there with His disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: Judas, the betrayer, knew this place, because Jesus had often gone there with his disciples.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Judas, who was betraying Him, also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.
verses.textEn: Now Judas, who betrayed him, knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with his disciples.

verses.textZh: 那时，犹大带着一队兵，还有祭司长和法利赛人的差役，拿着灯笼、火把、武器，来到园子里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，犹大带着一队兵，还有祭司长和法利赛人的差役，拿着灯笼、火把、武器，来到园子里。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大领了一队兵，和祭司长并法利赛人的差役，拿着灯笼、火把、兵器，就来到园里。
verses.textEnNiv: So Judas came to the garden, guiding a detachment of soldiers and some officials from the chief priests and the Pharisees. They were carrying torches, lanterns and weapons.
verses.textEnEsv: So Judas, having procured a band of soldiers and some officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, went there with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judas, having received a detachment oftroops, and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
verses.textEnNlt: The leading priests and Pharisees had given Judas a contingent of Roman soldiers and Temple guards to accompany him. Now with blazing torches, lanterns, and weapons, they arrived at the olive grove.
verses.textEnNasb: So Judas, having obtained the Roman cohort and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, *came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
verses.textEn: So Judas came to the garden, guiding a detachment of soldiers and some officials from the chief priests and the Pharisees. They were carrying torches, lanterns and weapons.

verses.textZh: 耶稣知道快要临到他身上的一切事，就出来对他们说："<red>你们找谁？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣知道快要临到他身上的一切事，就出来对他们说："<red>你们找谁？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣知道将要临到自己的一切事，就出来对他们说：「<red>你们找谁？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus, knowing all that was going to happen to him, went out and asked them, <red>“Who is it you want?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus, knowing all that would happen to him, came forward and said to them, "Whom do you seek?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that would come upon Him, went forward and said to them, "Whom are you seeking?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus fully realized all that was going to happen to him, so he stepped forward to meet them. "Who are you looking for?" he asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were coming upon Him, came out into the open and *said to them, "Whom are you seeking?"
verses.textEn: Jesus, knowing all that was going to happen to him, went out and asked them, <red>“Who is it you want?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们回答："拿撒勒人耶稣！"耶稣说："<red>我就是。</red>"出卖耶稣的犹大和他们站在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："拿撒勒人耶稣！"耶稣说："<red>我就是。</red>"出卖耶稣的犹大和他们站在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答说：「<red>找拿撒勒人耶稣。</red>」耶稣说：「<red>我就是！</red>」卖他的犹大也同他们站在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they replied. <red>“I am he,”</red> Jesus said. (And Judas the traitor was standing there with them.)
verses.textEnEsv: They answered him, "Jesus of Nazareth." Jesus said to them, "I am he." Judas, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They answered Him, "Jesus of Nazareth." Jesus said to them, "I am He." And Judas, who betrayed Him, also stood with them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Jesus the Nazarene," they replied. " I Am he," Jesus said. (Judas, who betrayed him, was standing with them.)
verses.textEnNasb: They answered Him, "Jesus the Nazarene." He *said to them, "I am He." And Judas also, who was betraying Him, was standing with them.
verses.textEn: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they replied. <red>“I am he,”</red> Jesus said. (And Judas the traitor was standing there with them.)

verses.textZh: 耶稣一说"<red>我就是</red>"，他们就往后退，倒在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣一说"<red>我就是</red>"，他们就往后退，倒在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣一说「<red>我就是</red>」，他们就退后倒在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus said, <red>“I am he,”</red> they drew back and fell to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus said to them, "I am he," they drew back and fell to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He said to them, "I am He," they drew back and fell to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus said " I Am he," they all drew back and fell to the ground!
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, when He said to them, "I am He," they drew back and fell to the ground.
verses.textEn: When Jesus said, <red>“I am he,”</red> they drew back and fell to the ground.

verses.textZh: 他再问他们："你们找谁？"他们说："<red>拿撒勒人耶稣！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他再问他们："你们找谁？"他们说："<red>拿撒勒人耶稣！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他又问他们说：「<red>你们找谁？</red>」他们说：「<red>找拿撒勒人耶稣。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Again he asked them, <red>“Who is it you want?”</red> “Jesus of Nazareth,” they said.
verses.textEnEsv: So he asked them again, "Whom do you seek?" And they said, "Jesus of Nazareth."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He asked them again, "Whom are you seeking?" And they said, "Jesus of Nazareth."
verses.textEnNlt: Once more he asked them, "Who are you looking for?" And again they replied, "Jesus the Nazarene."
verses.textEnNasb: He then asked them again, "Whom are you seeking?" And they said, "Jesus the Nazarene."
verses.textEn: Again he asked them, <red>“Who is it you want?”</red> “Jesus of Nazareth,” they said.

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>我已经告诉你们，我就是了。如果你们来找我，就让这些人走吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>我已经告诉你们，我就是了。如果你们来找我，就让这些人走吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我已经告诉你们，我就是。你们若找我，就让这些人去吧。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“I told you that I am he. If you are looking for me, then let these men go.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "I told you that I am he. So, if you seek me, let these men go."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered, "I have told you that I am He. Therefore, if you seek Me, let these go their way,"
verses.textEnNlt: "I told you that I Am he," Jesus said. "And since I am the one you want, let these others go."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered, "I told you that I am He; so if you are seeking Me, let these men go on their way."
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“I told you that I am he. If you are looking for me, then let these men go.”</red>

verses.textZh: 这应验了耶稣说过的话："<red>你赐给我的人，我一个也没有失落。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这应验了耶稣说过的话："<red>你赐给我的人，我一个也没有失落。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 这要应验耶稣从前的话，说：「<red>你所赐给我的人，我没有失落一个。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: This happened so that the words he had spoken would be fulfilled: <red>“I have not lost one of those you gave me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: This was to fulfill the word that he had spoken: "Of those whom you gave me I have lost not one."
verses.textEnNkjv: that the saying might be fulfilled which He spoke, "Of those whom You gave Me I have lost none."
verses.textEnNlt: He did this to fulfill his own statement: "I did not lose a single one of those you have given me."
verses.textEnNasb: This took place so that the word which He spoke would be fulfilled: "Of those whom You have given Me I lost not one."
verses.textEn: This happened so that the words he had spoken would be fulfilled: <red>“I have not lost one of those you gave me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得带着一把刀，就拔出来，向大祭司的仆人马勒古砍去，削掉他的右耳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得带着一把刀，就拔出来，向大祭司的仆人马勒古砍去，削掉他的右耳。
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得带着一把刀，就拔出来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉他的右耳；那仆人名叫马勒古。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s servant, cutting off his right ear. (The servant’s name was Malchus.)
verses.textEnEsv: Then Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s servant and cut off his right ear. (The servant’s name was Malchus.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Simon Peter drew a sword and slashed off the right ear of Malchus, the high priest’s slave.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Simon Peter, since he had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s slave, and cut off his right ear; and the slave’s name was Malchus.
verses.textEn: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s servant, cutting off his right ear. (The servant’s name was Malchus.)

verses.textZh: 耶稣对彼得说："<red>把刀收入鞘里去！父给我的杯，我怎能不喝呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对彼得说："<red>把刀收入鞘里去！父给我的杯，我怎能不喝呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就对彼得说：「<red>收刀入鞘吧，我父所给我的那杯，我岂可不喝呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus commanded Peter, <red>“Put your sword away! Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given me?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus said to Peter, "Put your sword into its sheath; shall I not drink the cup that the Father has given me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus said to Peter, "Put your sword into the sheath. Shall I not drink the cup which My Father has given Me?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said to Peter, "Put your sword back into its sheath. Shall I not drink from the cup of suffering the Father has given me?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus said to Peter, "Put the sword into the sheath; the cup which the Father has given Me, am I not to drink it?"
verses.textEn: Jesus commanded Peter, <red>“Put your sword away! Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given me?”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是那一队兵和千夫长，以及犹太人的差役拿住耶稣，把他绑起来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是那一队兵和千夫长，以及犹太人的差役拿住耶稣，把他绑起来，
verses.textZhCuv: 那队兵和千夫长，并犹太人的差役就拿住耶稣，把他捆绑了，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the detachment of soldiers with its commander and the Jewish officials arrested Jesus. They bound him
verses.textEnEsv: So the band of soldiers and their captain and the officers of the Jews arrested Jesus and bound him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the detachment oftroops and the captain and the officers of the Jews arrested Jesus and bound Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So the soldiers, their commanding officer, and the Temple guards arrested Jesus and tied him up.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Roman cohort, the commander, and the officers of the Jews arrested Jesus and bound Him,
verses.textEn: Then the detachment of soldiers with its commander and the Jewish officials arrested Jesus. They bound him

verses.textZh: 先带到亚那面前。亚那是当年的大祭司该亚法的岳父。
verses.textZhCnvs: 先带到亚那面前。亚那是当年的大祭司该亚法的岳父。
verses.textZhCuv: 先带到亚那面前，因为亚那是本年作大祭司该亚法的岳父。
verses.textEnNiv: and brought him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
verses.textEnEsv: First they led him to Annas, for he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they led Him away to Annas first, for he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas who was high priest that year.
verses.textEnNlt: First they took him to Annas, since he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest at that time.
verses.textEnNasb: and brought Him to Annas first; for he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
verses.textEn: and brought him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.

verses.textZh: 该亚法就是从前向犹太人提议说"一个人代替人民死，这是有益的"那个人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 该亚法就是从前向犹太人提议说"一个人代替人民死，这是有益的"那个人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这该亚法就是从前向犹太人发议论说「一个人替百姓死是有益的」那位。
verses.textEnNiv: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jewish leaders that it would be good if one man died for the people.
verses.textEnEsv: It was Caiaphas who had advised the Jews that it would be expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Caiaphas was the one who had told the other Jewish leaders, "It’s better that one man should die for the people."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it was in their best interest for one man to die in behalf of the people.
verses.textEn: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jewish leaders that it would be good if one man died for the people.

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得和另一个门徒跟着耶稣；那门徒是大祭司认识的。他跟耶稣一起进了大祭司的院子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得和另一个门徒跟着耶稣；那门徒是大祭司认识的。他跟耶稣一起进了大祭司的院子，
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得跟着耶稣，还有一个门徒跟着。那门徒是大祭司所认识的，他就同耶稣进了大祭司的院子。
verses.textEnNiv: Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Because this disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the high priest’s courtyard,
verses.textEnEsv: Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple. Since that disciple was known to the high priest, he entered with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.
verses.textEnNlt: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another of the disciples. That other disciple was acquainted with the high priest, so he was allowed to enter the high priest’s courtyard with Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Simon Peter was following Jesus, and so was another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and he entered with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest,
verses.textEn: Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Because this disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the high priest’s courtyard,

verses.textZh: 彼得却站在门外。大祭司所认识的那门徒出来，对看门的婢女说了一声，就带了彼得进去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得却站在门外。大祭司所认识的那门徒出来，对看门的婢女说了一声，就带了彼得进去。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得却站在门外。大祭司所认识的那个门徒出来，和看门的使女说了一声，就领彼得进去。
verses.textEnNiv: but Peter had to wait outside at the door. The other disciple, who was known to the high priest, came back, spoke to the servant girl on duty there and brought Peter in.
verses.textEnEsv: but Peter stood outside at the door. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to the servant girl who kept watch at the door, and brought Peter in.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter stood at the door outside. Then the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought Peter in.
verses.textEnNlt: Peter had to stay outside the gate. Then the disciple who knew the high priest spoke to the woman watching at the gate, and she let Peter in.
verses.textEnNasb: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.
verses.textEn: but Peter had to wait outside at the door. The other disciple, who was known to the high priest, came back, spoke to the servant girl on duty there and brought Peter in.

verses.textZh: 那看门的婢女对彼得说："你不也是这个人的门徒吗？"他说："我不是。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那看门的婢女对彼得说："你不也是这个人的门徒吗？"他说："我不是。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那看门的使女对彼得说：「你不也是这人的门徒吗？」他说：「我不是。」
verses.textEnNiv: "You aren’t one of this man’s disciples too, are you?" she asked Peter. He replied, "I am not."
verses.textEnEsv: The servant girl at the door said to Peter, "You also are not one of this man’s disciples, are you?" He said, "I am not."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the servant girl who kept the door said to Peter, "You are not also one of this Man’s disciples, are you?" He said, "I am not."
verses.textEnNlt: The woman asked Peter, "You’re not one of that man’s disciples, are you?" "No," he said, "I am not."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the slave woman who was the doorkeeper *said to Peter, "You are not also one of this Man’s disciples, are you?" He *said, "I am not."
verses.textEn: "You aren’t one of this man’s disciples too, are you?" she asked Peter. He replied, "I am not."

verses.textZh: 因为天气寒冷，仆人和差役就生了炭火，站着取暖；彼得也和他们站在一起取暖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为天气寒冷，仆人和差役就生了炭火，站着取暖；彼得也和他们站在一起取暖。
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人和差役因为天冷，就生了炭火，站在那里烤火；彼得也同他们站着烤火。
verses.textEnNiv: It was cold, and the servants and officials stood around a fire they had made to keep warm. Peter also was standing with them, warming himself.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the servants and officers had made a charcoal fire, because it was cold, and they were standing and warming themselves. Peter also was with them, standing and warming himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the servants and officers who had made a fire of coals stood there, for it was cold, and they warmed themselves. And Peter stood with them and warmed himself.
verses.textEnNlt: Because it was cold, the household servants and the guards had made a charcoal fire. They stood around it, warming themselves, and Peter stood with them, warming himself.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the slaves and the officers were standing there, having made a charcoal fire, for it was cold and they were warming themselves; and Peter was also with them, standing and warming himself.
verses.textEn: It was cold, and the servants and officials stood around a fire they had made to keep warm. Peter also was standing with them, warming himself.

verses.textZh: 那时，大祭司查问耶稣有关他的门徒和他的教训的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，大祭司查问耶稣有关他的门徒和他的教训的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 大祭司就以耶稣的门徒和他的教训盘问他。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
verses.textEnEsv: The high priest then questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: The high priest then asked Jesus about His disciples and His doctrine.
verses.textEnNlt: Inside, the high priest began asking Jesus about his followers and what he had been teaching them.
verses.textEnNasb: The high priest then questioned Jesus about His disciples, and about His teaching.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对大祭司说："我向来对世人讲话都是公开的，我常常在会堂和圣殿里，就是在所有犹太人聚集的地方教导人，暗地里我并没有讲甚么。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对大祭司说："我向来对世人讲话都是公开的，我常常在会堂和圣殿里，就是在所有犹太人聚集的地方教导人，暗地里我并没有讲甚么。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「我从来是明明地对世人说话。我常在会堂和殿里，就是犹太人聚集的地方教训人；我在暗地里并没有说什么。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I have spoken openly to the world,”</red> Jesus replied. <red>“I always taught in synagogues or at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered him, "I have spoken openly to the world. I have always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where all Jews come together. I have said nothing in secret.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered him, "I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet, and in secret I have said nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Everyone knows what I teach. I have preached regularly in the synagogues and the Temple, where the people gather. I have not spoken in secret.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered him, "I have spoken openly to the world; I always taught in synagogues and in the temple area, where all the Jews congregate; and I said nothing in secret.
verses.textEn: <red>“I have spoken openly to the world,”</red> Jesus replied. <red>“I always taught in synagogues or at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你为甚么查问我呢？问问那些听过我讲话的人吧，他们知道我讲过甚么。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你为甚么查问我呢？问问那些听过我讲话的人吧，他们知道我讲过甚么。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你为什么问我呢？可以问那听见的人，我对他们说的是什么；我所说的，他们都知道。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Why question me? Ask those who heard me. Surely they know what I said.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them; they know what I said."
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you ask Me? Ask those who have heard Me what I said to them. Indeed they know what I said."
verses.textEnNlt: Why are you asking me this question? Ask those who heard me. They know what I said."
verses.textEnNasb: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who have heard what I spoke to them. Look: these people know what I said."
verses.textEn: <red>Why question me? Ask those who heard me. Surely they know what I said.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说了这些话，站在旁边的一个差役，就打他一巴掌，说："你竟敢这样回答大祭司吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说了这些话，站在旁边的一个差役，就打他一巴掌，说："你竟敢这样回答大祭司吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说了这话，旁边站着的一个差役用手掌打他，说：「你这样回答大祭司吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus said this, one of the officials nearby slapped him in the face. "Is this the way you answer the high priest?" he demanded.
verses.textEnEsv: When he had said these things, one of the officers standing by struck Jesus with his hand, saying, "Is that how you answer the high priest?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had said these things, one of the officers who stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, "Do You answer the high priest like that?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then one of the Temple guards standing nearby slapped Jesus across the face. "Is that the way to answer the high priest?" he demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: But when He said this, one of the officers, who was standing nearby, struck Jesus, saying, "Is that the way You answer the high priest?"
verses.textEn: When Jesus said this, one of the officials nearby slapped him in the face. "Is this the way you answer the high priest?" he demanded.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他说："如果我讲错了，你可以指证错在哪里；如果我讲对了，你为甚么打我呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他说："如果我讲错了，你可以指证错在哪里；如果我讲对了，你为甚么打我呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我若说的不是，你可以指证那不是；我若说的是，你为什么打我呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“If I said something wrong,”</red> Jesus replied, <red>“testify as to what is wrong. But if I spoke the truth, why did you strike me?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered him, "If what I said is wrong, bear witness about the wrong; but if what I said is right, why do you strike me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered him, "If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil; but if well, why do you strike Me?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "If I said anything wrong, you must prove it. But if I’m speaking the truth, why are you beating me?"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered him, "If I have spoken wrongly, testify of the wrong; but if rightly, why do you strike Me?"
verses.textEn: <red>“If I said something wrong,”</red> Jesus replied, <red>“testify as to what is wrong. But if I spoke the truth, why did you strike me?”</red>

verses.textZh: 亚那仍然绑着耶稣，把他押到大祭司该亚法那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚那仍然绑着耶稣，把他押到大祭司该亚法那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚那就把耶稣解到大祭司该亚法那里，仍是捆着解去的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.textEnEsv: Annas then sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Annas sent Him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Annas bound Jesus and sent him to Caiaphas, the high priest.
verses.textEnNasb: So Annas sent Him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.textEn: Then Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得仍然站在火旁取暖。有人对他说："你不也是他的门徒吗？"彼得否认说："我不是。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得仍然站在火旁取暖。有人对他说："你不也是他的门徒吗？"彼得否认说："我不是。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得正站着烤火，有人对他说：「你不也是他的门徒吗？」彼得不承认，说：「我不是。」
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, Simon Peter was still standing there warming himself. So they asked him, "You aren’t one of his disciples too, are you?" He denied it, saying, "I am not."
verses.textEnEsv: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. So they said to him, "You also are not one of his disciples, are you?" He denied it and said, "I am not."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. Therefore they said to him, "You are not also one of His disciples, are you?" He denied it and said, "I am not!"
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, as Simon Peter was standing by the fire warming himself, they asked him again, "You’re not one of his disciples, are you?" He denied it, saying, "No, I am not."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they said to him, "You are not one of His disciples as well, are you?" He denied it, and said, "I am not."
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, Simon Peter was still standing there warming himself. So they asked him, "You aren’t one of his disciples too, are you?" He denied it, saying, "I am not."

verses.textZh: 有一个大祭司的仆人，就是彼得削掉耳朵的那个人的亲戚，说："我不是看见你跟他在园子里吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个大祭司的仆人，就是彼得削掉耳朵的那个人的亲戚，说："我不是看见你跟他在园子里吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 有大祭司的一个仆人，是彼得削掉耳朵那人的亲属，说：「我不是看见你同他在园子里吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, challenged him, "Didn’t I see you with him in the garden?"
verses.textEnEsv: One of the servants of the high priest, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, "Did I not see you in the garden with him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: One of the servants of the high priest, a relative ofhim whose ear Peter cut off, said, "Did I not see you in the garden with Him?"
verses.textEnNlt: But one of the household slaves of the high priest, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, "Didn’t I see you out there in the olive grove with Jesus?"
verses.textEnNasb: One of the slaves of the high priest, who was related to the one whose ear Peter cut off, *said, "Did I not see you in the garden with Him?"
verses.textEn: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, challenged him, "Didn’t I see you with him in the garden?"

verses.textZh: 彼得又否认，立刻鸡就叫了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得又否认，立刻鸡就叫了。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得又不承认。立时鸡就叫了。
verses.textEnNiv: Again Peter denied it, and at that moment a rooster began to crow.
verses.textEnEsv: Peter again denied it, and at once a rooster crowed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Peter then denied again; and immediately a rooster crowed.
verses.textEnNlt: Again Peter denied it. And immediately a rooster crowed.
verses.textEnNasb: Peter then denied it again, and immediately a rooster crowed.
verses.textEn: Again Peter denied it, and at that moment a rooster began to crow.

verses.textZh: 清早的时候，犹太人把耶稣从该亚法那里押往总督的官邸。他们自己没有进到官邸里去，恐怕沾染了污秽，不能吃逾越节的晚餐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 清早的时候，犹太人把耶稣从该亚法那里押往总督的官邸。他们自己没有进到官邸里去，恐怕沾染了污秽，不能吃逾越节的晚餐。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人将耶稣从该亚法那里往衙门内解去，那时天还早。他们自己却不进衙门，恐怕染了污秽，不能吃逾越节的筵席。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Jewish leaders took Jesus from Caiaphas to the palace of the Roman governor. By now it was early morning, and to avoid ceremonial uncleanness they did not enter the palace, because they wanted to be able to eat the Passover.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they led Jesus from the house of Caiaphas to the governor’s headquarters. It was early morning. They themselves did not enter the governor’s headquarters, so that they would not be defiled, but could eat the Passover.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas to the Praetorium, and it was early morning. But they themselves did not go into the Praetorium, lest they should be defiled, but that they might eat the Passover.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus’ trial before Caiaphas ended in the early hours of the morning. Then he was taken to the headquarters of the Roman governor. His accusers didn’t go inside because it would defile them, and they wouldn’t be allowed to celebrate the Passover.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they *brought Jesus from Caiaphas into the Praetorium, and it was early; and they themselves did not enter the Praetorium, so that they would not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
verses.textEn: Then the Jewish leaders took Jesus from Caiaphas to the palace of the Roman governor. By now it was early morning, and to avoid ceremonial uncleanness they did not enter the palace, because they wanted to be able to eat the Passover.

verses.textZh: 于是彼拉多走到外面见他们，说："你们控告这个人甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是彼拉多走到外面见他们，说："你们控告这个人甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多就出来，到他们那里，说：「你们告这人是为什么事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So Pilate came out to them and asked, "What charges are you bringing against this man?"
verses.textEnEsv: So Pilate went outside to them and said, "What accusation do you bring against this man?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Pilate then went out to them and said, "What accusation do you bring against this Man?"
verses.textEnNlt: So Pilate, the governor, went out to them and asked, "What is your charge against this man?"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Pilate came out to them and *said, "What accusation are you bringing against this Man?"
verses.textEn: So Pilate came out to them and asked, "What charges are you bringing against this man?"

verses.textZh: 他们回答："如果这个人没有作恶，我们就不会把他交给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："如果这个人没有作恶，我们就不会把他交给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答说：「这人若不是作恶的，我们就不把他交给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: "If he were not a criminal," they replied, "we would not have handed him over to you."
verses.textEnEsv: They answered him, "If this man were not doing evil, we would not have delivered him over to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: They answered and said to him, "If He were not an evildoer, we would not have delivered Him up to you."
verses.textEnNlt: "We wouldn’t have handed him over to you if he weren’t a criminal!" they retorted.
verses.textEnNasb: They answered and said to him, "If this Man were not a criminal, we would not have handed Him over to you."
verses.textEn: "If he were not a criminal," they replied, "we would not have handed him over to you."

verses.textZh: 彼拉多对他们说："你们自己把他带去，按着你们的律法审问他吧。"犹太人说："我们没有权去判人死罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多对他们说："你们自己把他带去，按着你们的律法审问他吧。"犹太人说："我们没有权去判人死罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多说：「你们自己带他去，按着你们的律法审问他吧。」犹太人说：「我们没有杀人的权柄。」
verses.textEnNiv: Pilate said, "Take him yourselves and judge him by your own law." "But we have no right to execute anyone," they objected.
verses.textEnEsv: Pilate said to them, "Take him yourselves and judge him by your own law." The Jews said to him, "It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pilate said to them, "You take Him and judge Him according to your law." Therefore the Jews said to him, "It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death,"
verses.textEnNlt: "Then take him away and judge him by your own law," Pilate told them. "Only the Romans are permitted to execute someone," the Jewish leaders replied.
verses.textEnNasb: So Pilate said to them, "Take Him yourselves, and judge Him according to your law." The Jews said to him, "We are not permitted to put anyone to death."
verses.textEn: Pilate said, "Take him yourselves and judge him by your own law." "But we have no right to execute anyone," they objected.

verses.textZh: 这就应验了耶稣预先说到自己将要怎样死的那句话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就应验了耶稣预先说到自己将要怎样死的那句话。
verses.textZhCuv: 这要应验耶稣所说自己将要怎样死的话了。
verses.textEnNiv: This took place to fulfill what Jesus had said about the kind of death he was going to die.
verses.textEnEsv: This was to fulfill the word that Jesus had spoken to show by what kind of death he was going to die.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled which He spoke, signifying by what death He would die.
verses.textEnNlt: (This fulfilled Jesus’ prediction about the way he would die. )
verses.textEnNasb: This happened so that the word of Jesus which He said, indicating what kind of death He was going to die, would be fulfilled.
verses.textEn: This took place to fulfill what Jesus had said about the kind of death he was going to die.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多又进了官邸，把耶稣叫来，问他说："你是犹太人的王吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多又进了官邸，把耶稣叫来，问他说："你是犹太人的王吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多又进了衙门，叫耶稣来，对他说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Pilate then went back inside the palace, summoned Jesus and asked him, "Are you the king of the Jews?"
verses.textEnEsv: So Pilate entered his headquarters again and called Jesus and said to him, "Are you the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pilate entered the Praetorium again, called Jesus, and said to Him, "Are You the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pilate went back into his headquarters and called for Jesus to be brought to him. "Are you the king of the Jews?" he asked him.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Pilate entered the Praetorium again, and summoned Jesus and said to Him, "You are the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEn: Pilate then went back inside the palace, summoned Jesus and asked him, "Are you the king of the Jews?"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣回答："这话是你自己说的，还是别人对你说到我的呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣回答："这话是你自己说的，还是别人对你说到我的呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>这话是你自己说的，还是别人论我对你说的呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Is that your own idea,”</red> Jesus asked, <red>“or did others talk to you about me?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "Do you say this of your own accord, or did others say it to you about me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered him, "Are you speaking for yourself about this, or did others tell you this concerning Me?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Is this your own question, or did others tell you about me?"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered, "Are you saying this on your own, or did others tell you about Me?"
verses.textEn: <red>“Is that your own idea,”</red> Jesus asked, <red>“or did others talk to you about me?”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼拉多说："难道我是犹太人吗？你本国的人和祭司长把你交给我，你究竟作了甚么事？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多说："难道我是犹太人吗？你本国的人和祭司长把你交给我，你究竟作了甚么事？"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多说：「我岂是犹太人呢？你本国的人和祭司长把你交给我。你做了什么事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Am I a Jew?" Pilate replied. "Your own people and chief priests handed you over to me. What is it you have done?"
verses.textEnEsv: Pilate answered, "Am I a Jew? Your own nation and the chief priests have delivered you over to me. What have you done?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Pilate answered, "Am I a Jew? Your own nation and the chief priests have delivered You to me. What have You done?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Am I a Jew?" Pilate retorted. "Your own people and their leading priests brought you to me for trial. Why? What have you done?"
verses.textEnNasb: Pilate answered, "I am not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests handed You over to me; what have You done?"
verses.textEn: "Am I a Jew?" Pilate replied. "Your own people and chief priests handed you over to me. What is it you have done?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："<red>我的国不属于这世界；如果我的国属于这世界，我的臣仆就要作战，使我不至被交给犹太人。不过，我的国不是这世上的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："<red>我的国不属于这世界；如果我的国属于这世界，我的臣仆就要作战，使我不至被交给犹太人。不过，我的国不是这世上的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>我的国不属这世界；我的国若属这世界，我的臣仆必要争战，使我不至于被交给犹太人。只是我的国不属这世界。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, <red>“My kingdom is not of this world. If it were, my servants would fight to prevent my arrest by the Jewish leaders. But now my kingdom is from another place.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "My kingdom is not of this world. If my kingdom were of this world, my servants would have been fighting, that I might not be delivered over to the Jews. But my kingdom is not from the world."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered, "My kingdom is not of this world. If My kingdom were of this world, My servants would fight, so that I should not be delivered to the Jews; but now My kingdom is not from here."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus answered, "My Kingdom is not an earthly kingdom. If it were, my followers would fight to keep me from being handed over to the Jewish leaders. But my Kingdom is not of this world."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered, "My kingdom is not of this world. If My kingdom were of this world, My servants would be fighting so that I would not be handed over to the Jews; but as it is, My kingdom is not of this realm."
verses.textEn: Jesus said, <red>“My kingdom is not of this world. If it were, my servants would fight to prevent my arrest by the Jewish leaders. But now my kingdom is from another place.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是彼拉多问他："那么，你是王吗？"耶稣说："<red>我是王，你已经说了 。我要为真理作见证，我为此而生，也为此来到世上。凡是属于真理的人，都听我的声音。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是彼拉多问他："那么，你是王吗？"耶稣说："<red>我是王，你已经说了 。我要为真理作见证，我为此而生，也为此来到世上。凡是属于真理的人，都听我的声音。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多就对他说：「<red>这样，你是王吗？</red>」耶稣回答说：「<red>你说我是王。我为此而生，也为此来到世间，特为给真理作见证。凡属真理的人就听我的话。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: “You are a king, then!” said Pilate. Jesus answered, <red>“You say that I am a king. In fact, the reason I was born and came into the world is to testify to the truth. Everyone on the side of truth listens to me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pilate said to him, "So you are a king?" Jesus answered, "You say that I am a king. For this purpose I was born and for this purpose I have come into the world— to bear witness to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice."
verses.textEnNkjv: Pilate therefore said to Him, "Are You a king then?" Jesus answered, "You say rightly that I am a king. For this cause I was born, and for this cause I have come into the world, that I should bear witness to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth hears My voice."
verses.textEnNlt: Pilate said, "So you are a king?" Jesus responded, "You say I am a king. Actually, I was born and came into the world to testify to the truth. All who love the truth recognize that what I say is true."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Pilate said to Him, "So You are a king?" Jesus answered, "You say correctly that I am a king. For this purpose I have been born, and for this I have come into the world: to testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to My voice."
verses.textEn: “You are a king, then!” said Pilate. Jesus answered, <red>“You say that I am a king. In fact, the reason I was born and came into the world is to testify to the truth. Everyone on the side of truth listens to me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼拉多问他："真理是甚么？" 彼拉多说了这话，又出来见犹太人，对他们说："我查不出他有甚么罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多问他："真理是甚么？" 彼拉多说了这话，又出来见犹太人，对他们说："我查不出他有甚么罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多说：「真理是什么呢？」 说了这话，又出来到犹太人那里，对他们说：「我查不出他有什么罪来。
verses.textEnNiv: "What is truth?" retorted Pilate. With this he went out again to the Jews gathered there and said, "I find no basis for a charge against him.
verses.textEnEsv: Pilate said to him, "What is truth?" After he had said this, he went back outside to the Jews and told them, "I find no guilt in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pilate said to Him, "What is truth?" And when he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, "I find no fault in Him at all.
verses.textEnNlt: "What is truth?" Pilate asked. Then he went out again to the people and told them, "He is not guilty of any crime.
verses.textEnNasb: Pilate *said to Him, "What is truth?" And after saying this, he came out again to the Jews and *said to them, "I find no grounds at all for charges in His case.
verses.textEn: "What is truth?" retorted Pilate. With this he went out again to the Jews gathered there and said, "I find no basis for a charge against him.

verses.textZh: 你们有个惯例，每逢逾越节，要我给你们释放一个囚犯。你们愿意我给你们释放这个犹太人的王吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们有个惯例，每逢逾越节，要我给你们释放一个囚犯。你们愿意我给你们释放这个犹太人的王吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们有个规矩，在逾越节要我给你们释放一个人，你们要我给你们释放犹太人的王吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But it is your custom for me to release to you one prisoner at the time of the Passover. Do you want me to release ‘the king of the Jews’?"
verses.textEnEsv: But you have a custom that I should release one man for you at the Passover. So do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Do you therefore want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEnNlt: But you have a custom of asking me to release one prisoner each year at Passover. Would you like me to release this ‘King of the Jews’?"
verses.textEnNasb: However, you have a custom that I release one prisoner for you at the Passover; therefore do you wish that I release for you the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEn: But it is your custom for me to release to you one prisoner at the time of the Passover. Do you want me to release ‘the king of the Jews’?"

verses.textZh: 他们又喊叫说："不要他！要巴拉巴！"这巴拉巴是个强盗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又喊叫说："不要他！要巴拉巴！"这巴拉巴是个强盗。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又喊着说：「不要这人，要巴拉巴！」这巴拉巴是个强盗。
verses.textEnNiv: They shouted back, "No, not him! Give us Barabbas!" Now Barabbas had taken part in an uprising.
verses.textEnEsv: They cried out again, "Not this man, but Barabbas!" Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they all cried again, saying, "Not this Man, but Barabbas!" Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.textEnNlt: But they shouted back, "No! Not this man. We want Barabbas!" (Barabbas was a revolutionary.)
verses.textEnNasb: So they shouted again, saying, "Not this Man, but Barabbas." Now Barabbas was a rebel.
verses.textEn: They shouted back, "No, not him! Give us Barabbas!" Now Barabbas had taken part in an uprising.

verses.textZh: 那时，彼拉多吩咐人把耶稣拉去鞭打。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，彼拉多吩咐人把耶稣拉去鞭打。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下彼拉多将耶稣鞭打了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pilate took Jesus and flogged him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then Pilate took Jesus and scourged Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pilate had Jesus flogged with a lead-tipped whip.
verses.textEnNasb: So Pilate then took Jesus and had Him flogged.
verses.textEn: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.

verses.textZh: 士兵用荆棘编成冠冕，戴在他的头上，又给他披上紫色的外袍，
verses.textZhCnvs: 士兵用荆棘编成冠冕，戴在他的头上，又给他披上紫色的外袍，
verses.textZhCuv: 兵丁用荆棘编做冠冕戴在他头上，给他穿上紫袍，
verses.textEnNiv: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They clothed him in a purple robe
verses.textEnEsv: And the soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head and arrayed him in a purple robe.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the soldiers twisted a crown of thorns and put it on His head, and they put on Him a purple robe.
verses.textEnNlt: The soldiers wove a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and they put a purple robe on him.
verses.textEnNasb: And the soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and placed it on His head, and put a purple cloak on Him;
verses.textEn: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They clothed him in a purple robe

verses.textZh: 然后来到他面前，说："犹太人的王万岁！"并且用手掌打他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后来到他面前，说："犹太人的王万岁！"并且用手掌打他。
verses.textZhCuv: 又挨近他，说：「恭喜，犹太人的王啊！」他们就用手掌打他。
verses.textEnNiv: and went up to him again and again, saying, "Hail, king of the Jews!" And they slapped him in the face.
verses.textEnEsv: They came up to him, saying, "Hail, King of the Jews!" and struck him with their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said, "Hail, King of the Jews!" And they struck Him with their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: "Hail! King of the Jews!" they mocked, as they slapped him across the face.
verses.textEnNasb: and they repeatedly came up to Him and said, "Hail, King of the Jews!" and slapped Him in the face again and again.
verses.textEn: and went up to him again and again, saying, "Hail, king of the Jews!" And they slapped him in the face.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多再次出到外面，对犹太人说："看！我把他带出来给你们，让你们知道我查不出他有甚么罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多再次出到外面，对犹太人说："看！我把他带出来给你们，让你们知道我查不出他有甚么罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多又出来对众人说：「我带他出来见你们，叫你们知道我查不出他有什么罪来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Once more Pilate came out and said to the Jews gathered there, "Look, I am bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against him."
verses.textEnEsv: Pilate went out again and said to them, "See, I am bringing him out to you that you may know that I find no guilt in him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Pilate then went out again, and said to them, "Behold, I am bringing Him out to you, that you may know that I find no fault in Him."
verses.textEnNlt: Pilate went outside again and said to the people, "I am going to bring him out to you now, but understand clearly that I find him not guilty."
verses.textEnNasb: And then Pilate came out again and *said to them, "See, I am bringing Him out to you so that you will know that I find no grounds at all for charges in His case."
verses.textEn: Once more Pilate came out and said to the Jews gathered there, "Look, I am bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against him."

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣出来，戴着荆棘的冠冕，披着紫色的外袍。彼拉多对他们说："看，这个人！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣出来，戴着荆棘的冠冕，披着紫色的外袍。彼拉多对他们说："看，这个人！"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣出来，戴着荆棘冠冕，穿着紫袍。彼拉多对他们说：「你们看这个人！」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, "Here is the man!"
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said to them, "Behold the man!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And Pilate said to them, "Behold the Man!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And Pilate said, "Look, here is the man!"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus then came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple cloak. And Pilate *said to them, "Behold, the Man!"
verses.textEn: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, "Here is the man!"

verses.textZh: 祭司长和差役看见耶稣，就喊叫说："把他钉十字架！把他钉十字架！"彼拉多对他们说："你们自己把他带去钉十字架吧！我查不出他有甚么罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长和差役看见耶稣，就喊叫说："把他钉十字架！把他钉十字架！"彼拉多对他们说："你们自己把他带去钉十字架吧！我查不出他有甚么罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长和差役看见他，就喊着说：「钉他十字架！钉他十字架！」彼拉多说：「你们自己把他钉十字架吧！我查不出他有什么罪来。」
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as the chief priests and their officials saw him, they shouted, "Crucify! Crucify!" But Pilate answered, "You take him and crucify him. As for me, I find no basis for a charge against him."
verses.textEnEsv: When the chief priests and the officers saw him, they cried out, "Crucify him, crucify him!" Pilate said to them, "Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no guilt in him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when the chief priests and officers saw Him, they cried out, saying, "Crucify Him, crucify Him!" Pilate said to them, "You take Him and crucify Him, for I find no fault in Him."
verses.textEnNlt: When they saw him, the leading priests and Temple guards began shouting, "Crucify him! Crucify him!" "Take him yourselves and crucify him," Pilate said. "I find him not guilty."
verses.textEnNasb: So when the chief priests and the officers saw Him, they shouted, saying, "Crucify, crucify!" Pilate *said to them, "Take Him yourselves and crucify Him; for I find no grounds for charges in His case!"
verses.textEn: As soon as the chief priests and their officials saw him, they shouted, "Crucify! Crucify!" But Pilate answered, "You take him and crucify him. As for me, I find no basis for a charge against him."

verses.textZh: 犹太人回答："我们有律法，根据那律法，他是该死的，因为他自命为神的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人回答："我们有律法，根据那律法，他是该死的，因为他自命为神的儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人回答说：「我们有律法，按那律法，他是该死的，因他以自己为神的儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Jewish leaders insisted, "We have a law, and according to that law he must die, because he claimed to be the Son of God."
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews answered him, "We have a law, and according to that law he ought to die because he has made himself the Son of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Jews answered him, "We have a law, and according to our law He ought to die, because He made Himself the Son of God."
verses.textEnNlt: The Jewish leaders replied, "By our law he ought to die because he called himself the Son of God."
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews answered him, "We have a law, and by that law He ought to die, because He made Himself out to be the Son of God!"
verses.textEn: The Jewish leaders insisted, "We have a law, and according to that law he must die, because he claimed to be the Son of God."

verses.textZh: 彼拉多听见这话，就更加害怕，
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多听见这话，就更加害怕，
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多听见这话，越发害怕，
verses.textEnNiv: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,
verses.textEnEsv: When Pilate heard this statement, he was even more afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when Pilate heard that saying, he was the more afraid,
verses.textEnNlt: When Pilate heard this, he was more frightened than ever.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore when Pilate heard this statement, he was even more afraid;
verses.textEn: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,

verses.textZh: 又进了官邸，问耶稣："你究竟是从哪里来的？"耶稣却不回答他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又进了官邸，问耶稣："你究竟是从哪里来的？"耶稣却不回答他。
verses.textZhCuv: 又进衙门，对耶稣说：「你是哪里来的？」耶稣却不回答。
verses.textEnNiv: and he went back inside the palace. "Where do you come from?" he asked Jesus, but Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.textEnEsv: He entered his headquarters again and said to Jesus, "Where are you from?" But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.textEnNkjv: and went again into the Praetorium, and said to Jesus, "Where are You from?" But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.textEnNlt: He took Jesus back into the headquarters again and asked him, "Where are you from?" But Jesus gave no answer.
verses.textEnNasb: and he entered the Praetorium again and *said to Jesus, "Where are You from?" But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.textEn: and he went back inside the palace. "Where do you come from?" he asked Jesus, but Jesus gave him no answer.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多对他说："你不对我说话吗？你不知道我有权释放你，也有权把你钉十字架吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多对他说："你不对我说话吗？你不知道我有权释放你，也有权把你钉十字架吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多说：「你不对我说话吗？你岂不知我有权柄释放你，也有权柄把你钉十字架吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Do you refuse to speak to me?" Pilate said. "Don’t you realize I have power either to free you or to crucify you?"
verses.textEnEsv: So Pilate said to him, "You will not speak to me? Do you not know that I have authority to release you and authority to crucify you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pilate said to Him, "Are You not speaking to me? Do You not know that I have power to crucify You, and power to release You?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why don’t you talk to me?" Pilate demanded. "Don’t you realize that I have the power to release you or crucify you?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Pilate *said to Him, "Are you not speaking to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You, and I have authority to crucify You?"
verses.textEn: "Do you refuse to speak to me?" Pilate said. "Don’t you realize I have power either to free you or to crucify you?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>如果不是从天上给你权柄，你就无权办我；因此，把我交给你的那人，罪更重了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>如果不是从天上给你权柄，你就无权办我；因此，把我交给你的那人，罪更重了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>若不是从上头赐给你的，你就毫无权柄办我。所以，把我交给你的那人罪更重了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“You would have no power over me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of a greater sin.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered him, "You would have no authority over me at all unless it had been given you from above. Therefore he who delivered me over to you has the greater sin."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered, "You could have no power at all against Me unless it had been given you from above. Therefore the one who delivered Me to you has the greater sin."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said, "You would have no power over me at all unless it were given to you from above. So the one who handed me over to you has the greater sin."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered him, "You would have no authority over Me at all, if it had not been given to you from above; for this reason the one who handed Me over to you has the greater sin."
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“You would have no power over me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of a greater sin.”</red>

verses.textZh: 从那时起，彼拉多想释放耶稣；可是犹太人却喊叫说："如果你释放这个人，就不是凯撒的忠臣了。凡是自命为王的，就是与凯撒为敌。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那时起，彼拉多想释放耶稣；可是犹太人却喊叫说："如果你释放这个人，就不是凯撒的忠臣了。凡是自命为王的，就是与凯撒为敌。"
verses.textZhCuv: 从此，彼拉多想要释放耶稣，无奈犹太人喊着说：「你若释放这个人，就不是凯撒的忠臣 。凡以自己为王的，就是背叛凯撒了。」
verses.textEnNiv: From then on, Pilate tried to set Jesus free, but the Jewish leaders kept shouting, "If you let this man go, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who claims to be a king opposes Caesar."
verses.textEnEsv: From then on Pilate sought to release him, but the Jews cried out, "If you release this man, you are not Caesar’s friend. Everyone who makes himself a king opposes Caesar."
verses.textEnNkjv: From then on Pilate sought to release Him, but the Jews cried out, saying, "If you let this Man go, you are not Caesar’s friend. Whoever makes himself a king speaks against Caesar."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pilate tried to release him, but the Jewish leaders shouted, "If you release this man, you are no ‘friend of Caesar.’ Anyone who declares himself a king is a rebel against Caesar."
verses.textEnNasb: As a result of this, Pilate made efforts to release Him; but the Jews shouted, saying, "If you release this Man, you are not a friend of Caesar; everyone who makes himself out to be a king opposes Caesar!"
verses.textEn: From then on, Pilate tried to set Jesus free, but the Jewish leaders kept shouting, "If you let this man go, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who claims to be a king opposes Caesar."

verses.textZh: 彼拉多听了这些话，就把耶稣带到外面，到了一个名叫"铺石地" 的地方，就在那里开庭审问。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多听了这些话，就把耶稣带到外面，到了一个名叫"铺石地" 的地方，就在那里开庭审问。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多听见这话，就带耶稣出来，到了一个地方，名叫「铺华石处」，希伯来话叫厄巴大，就在那里坐堂。
verses.textEnNiv: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judge’s seat at a place known as the Stone Pavement (which in Aramaic is Gabbatha).
verses.textEnEsv: So when Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called The Stone Pavement, and in Aramaic Gabbatha.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus out and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called The Pavement, but in Hebrew, Gabbatha.
verses.textEnNlt: When they said this, Pilate brought Jesus out to them again. Then Pilate sat down on the judgment seat on the platform that is called the Stone Pavement (in Hebrew, Gabbatha).
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore when Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called The Pavement—but in Hebrew, Gabbatha.
verses.textEn: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judge’s seat at a place known as the Stone Pavement (which in Aramaic is Gabbatha).

verses.textZh: 那天是逾越节的预备日，约在正午的时候。彼拉多对犹太人说："看，你们的王！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天是逾越节的预备日，约在正午的时候。彼拉多对犹太人说："看，你们的王！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那日是预备逾越节的日子，约有午正。彼拉多对犹太人说：「看哪，这是你们的王！」
verses.textEnNiv: It was the day of Preparation of the Passover; it was about noon. "Here is your king," Pilate said to the Jews.
verses.textEnEsv: Now it was the day of Preparation of the Passover. It was about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, "Behold your King!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, and about the sixth hour. And he said to the Jews, "Behold your King!"
verses.textEnNlt: It was now about noon on the day of preparation for the Passover. And Pilate said to the people, "Look, here is your king!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was the day of preparation for the Passover; it was about the sixth hour. And he *said to the Jews, "Look, your King!"
verses.textEn: It was the day of Preparation of the Passover; it was about noon. "Here is your king," Pilate said to the Jews.
