verses.textZh: 他们就喊叫起来："除掉他！除掉他！把他钉十字架！"彼拉多问他们："我可以把你们的王钉十字架吗？"祭司长回答："除了凯撒，我们没有王！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就喊叫起来："除掉他！除掉他！把他钉十字架！"彼拉多问他们："我可以把你们的王钉十字架吗？"祭司长回答："除了凯撒，我们没有王！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们喊着说：「除掉他！除掉他！钉他在十字架上！」彼拉多说：「我可以把你们的王钉十字架吗？」祭司长回答说：「除了凯撒，我们没有王。」
verses.textEnNiv: But they shouted, "Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him!" "Shall I crucify your king?" Pilate asked. "We have no king but Caesar," the chief priests answered.
verses.textEnEsv: They cried out, "Away with him, away with him, crucify him!" Pilate said to them, "Shall I crucify your King?" The chief priests answered, "We have no king but Caesar."
verses.textEnNkjv: But they cried out, "Away with Him, away with Him! Crucify Him!" Pilate said to them, "Shall I crucify your King?" The chief priests answered, "We have no king but Caesar!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Away with him," they yelled. "Away with him! Crucify him!" "What? Crucify your king?" Pilate asked. "We have no king but Caesar," the leading priests shouted back.
verses.textEnNasb: So they shouted, "Away with Him, away with Him, crucify Him!" Pilate *said to them, "Shall I crucify your King?" The chief priests answered, "We have no king except Caesar."
verses.textEn: But they shouted, "Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him!" "Shall I crucify your king?" Pilate asked. "We have no king but Caesar," the chief priests answered.

verses.textZh: 于是彼拉多把耶稣交给他们去钉十字架。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是彼拉多把耶稣交给他们去钉十字架。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是彼拉多将耶稣交给他们去钉十字架。
verses.textEnNiv: Finally Pilate handed him over to them to be crucified. So the soldiers took charge of Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: So he delivered him over to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he delivered Him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led Him away.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pilate turned Jesus over to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus away.
verses.textEnNasb: So he then handed Him over to them to be crucified.
verses.textEn: Finally Pilate handed him over to them to be crucified. So the soldiers took charge of Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他们把耶稣带去了。耶稣自己背着十字架出来，到了一个名叫"髑髅"的地方，希伯来话叫各各他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把耶稣带去了。耶稣自己背着十字架出来，到了一个名叫"髑髅"的地方，希伯来话叫各各他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就把耶稣带了去。耶稣背着自己的十字架出来，到了一个地方，名叫「髑髅地」，希伯来话叫各各他。
verses.textEnNiv: Carrying his own cross, he went out to the place of the Skull (which in Aramaic is called Golgotha).
verses.textEnEsv: and he went out, bearing his own cross, to the place called The Place of a Skull, which in Aramaic is called Golgotha.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He, bearing His cross, went out to a place called thePlace of a Skull, which is called in Hebrew, Golgotha,
verses.textEnNlt: Carrying the cross by himself, he went to the place called Place of the Skull (in Hebrew, Golgotha).
verses.textEnNasb: They took Jesus, therefore, and He went out, carrying His own cross, to the place called the Place of a Skull, which in Hebrew is called, Golgotha.
verses.textEn: Carrying his own cross, he went out to the place of the Skull (which in Aramaic is called Golgotha).

verses.textZh: 他们就在那里把耶稣钉在十字架上；和他一同钉十字架的，还有两个人，一边一个，耶稣在中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就在那里把耶稣钉在十字架上；和他一同钉十字架的，还有两个人，一边一个，耶稣在中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就在那里钉他在十字架上，还有两个人和他一同钉着，一边一个，耶稣在中间。
verses.textEnNiv: There they crucified him, and with him two others—one on each side and Jesus in the middle.
verses.textEnEsv: There they crucified him, and with him two others, one on either side, and Jesus between them.
verses.textEnNkjv: where they crucified Him, and two others with Him, one on either side, and Jesus in the center.
verses.textEnNlt: There they nailed him to the cross. Two others were crucified with him, one on either side, with Jesus between them.
verses.textEnNasb: There they crucified Him, and with Him two other men, one on either side, and Jesus in between.
verses.textEn: There they crucified him, and with him two others—one on each side and Jesus in the middle.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多写了一个牌子，放在十字架上头，写的是："犹太人的王拿撒勒人耶稣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多写了一个牌子，放在十字架上头，写的是："犹太人的王拿撒勒人耶稣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多又用牌子写了一个名号，安在十字架上，写的是：「犹太人的王，拿撒勒人耶稣。」
verses.textEnNiv: Pilate had a notice prepared and fastened to the cross. It read: jesus of nazareth, the king of the jews.
verses.textEnEsv: Pilate also wrote an inscription and put it on the cross. It read, "Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Pilate wrote a title and put it on the cross. And the writing was: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.textEnNlt: And Pilate posted a sign on the cross that read, "Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Pilate also wrote an inscription and put it on the cross. It was written: "JESUS THE NAZARENE, THE KING OF THE JEWS."
verses.textEn: Pilate had a notice prepared and fastened to the cross. It read: jesus of nazareth, the king of the jews.

verses.textZh: 有许多犹太人念了这牌子上所写的，因为耶稣钉十字架的地方离城不远，而且那牌子是用希伯来文、拉丁文和希腊文写的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多犹太人念了这牌子上所写的，因为耶稣钉十字架的地方离城不远，而且那牌子是用希伯来文、拉丁文和希腊文写的。
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多犹太人念这名号；因为耶稣被钉十字架的地方与城相近，并且是用希伯来、罗马、希腊三样文字写的。
verses.textEnNiv: Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Aramaic, Latin and Greek.
verses.textEnEsv: Many of the Jews read this inscription, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Aramaic, in Latin, and in Greek.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, Greek, and Latin.
verses.textEnNlt: The place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek, so that many people could read it.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore many of the Jews read this inscription, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, Latin, and in Greek.
verses.textEn: Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Aramaic, Latin and Greek.

verses.textZh: 犹太人的祭司长对彼拉多说："不要写‘犹太人的王’，要写‘这个人自称：我是犹太人的王’。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人的祭司长对彼拉多说："不要写‘犹太人的王’，要写‘这个人自称：我是犹太人的王’。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人的祭司长就对彼拉多说：「不要写『犹太人的王』，要写『他自己说：我是犹太人的王』。」
verses.textEnNiv: The chief priests of the Jews protested to Pilate, "Do not write ‘The King of the Jews,’ but that this man claimed to be king of the Jews."
verses.textEnEsv: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, "Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but rather, ‘This man said, I am King of the Jews.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, "Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘He said, "I am the King of the Jews." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then the leading priests objected and said to Pilate, "Change it from ‘The King of the Jews’ to ‘He said, I am King of the Jews.’"
verses.textEnNasb: So the chief priests of the Jews were saying to Pilate, "Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews’; rather, write that He said, ‘I am King of the Jews.’ "
verses.textEn: The chief priests of the Jews protested to Pilate, "Do not write ‘The King of the Jews,’ but that this man claimed to be king of the Jews."

verses.textZh: 彼拉多说："我所写的，我已经写了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多说："我所写的，我已经写了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多说：「我所写的，我已经写上了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."
verses.textEnEsv: Pilate answered, "What I have written I have written."
verses.textEnNkjv: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."
verses.textEnNlt: Pilate replied, "No, what I have written, I have written."
verses.textEnNasb: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."
verses.textEn: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."

verses.textZh: 士兵把耶稣钉了十字架之后，就把他的衣服拿来，分成四分，每个兵一分。他们又拿他的内衣；这内衣是没有缝的，是从上到下整件织成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 士兵把耶稣钉了十字架之后，就把他的衣服拿来，分成四分，每个兵一分。他们又拿他的内衣；这内衣是没有缝的，是从上到下整件织成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 兵丁既然将耶稣钉在十字架上，就拿他的衣服分为四分，每兵一分；又拿他的里衣，这件里衣原来没有缝儿，是上下一片织成的。
verses.textEnNiv: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes, dividing them into four shares, one for each of them, with the undergarment remaining. This garment was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
verses.textEnEsv: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they took his garments and divided them into four parts, one part for each soldier; also his tunic. But the tunic was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took His garments and made four parts, to each soldier a part, and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top in one piece.
verses.textEnNlt: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they divided his clothes among the four of them. They also took his robe, but it was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took His outer garments and made four parts: a part to each soldier, and the tunic also; but the tunic was seamless, woven in one piece.
verses.textEn: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes, dividing them into four shares, one for each of them, with the undergarment remaining. This garment was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.

verses.textZh: 因此，他们彼此说："我们不要把它撕开，我们来抽签吧，看看是谁的。"这就应验了经上所说的： "他们分了我的外衣， 又为我的内衣抽签。" 士兵果然这样作了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，他们彼此说："我们不要把它撕开，我们来抽签吧，看看是谁的。"这就应验了经上所说的： "他们分了我的外衣， 又为我的内衣抽签。" 士兵果然这样作了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就彼此说：「我们不要撕开，只要拈阄，看谁得着。」这要应验经上的话说： 他们分了我的外衣， 为我的里衣拈阄。 兵丁果然做了这事。
verses.textEnNiv: "Let’s not tear it," they said to one another. "Let’s decide by lot who will get it." This happened that the scripture might be fulfilled that said, "They divided my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment." So this is what the soldiers did.
verses.textEnEsv: so they said to one another, "Let us not tear it, but cast lots for it to see whose it shall be." This was to fulfill the Scripture which says, "They divided my garments among them, and for my clothing they cast lots." So the soldiers did these things,
verses.textEnNkjv: They said therefore among themselves, "Let us not tear it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be," that the Scripture might be fulfilled which says: "They divided My garments among them, And for My clothing they cast lots." Therefore the soldiers did these things.
verses.textEnNlt: So they said, "Rather than tearing it apart, let’s throw dice for it." This fulfilled the Scripture that says, "They divided my garments among themselves and threw dice for my clothing." So that is what they did.
verses.textEnNasb: So they said to one another, "Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it, to decide whose it shall be." This happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: "They divided My garments among themselves, and they cast lots for My clothing." Therefore the soldiers did these things.
verses.textEn: "Let’s not tear it," they said to one another. "Let’s decide by lot who will get it." This happened that the scripture might be fulfilled that said, "They divided my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment." So this is what the soldiers did.

verses.textZh: 站在耶稣十字架旁边的，有他母亲和他母亲的姊妹，还有高罗巴的妻子马利亚，和抹大拉的马利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 站在耶稣十字架旁边的，有他母亲和他母亲的姊妹，还有高罗巴的妻子马利亚，和抹大拉的马利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 站在耶稣十字架旁边的，有他母亲与他母亲的姊妹，并革罗罢的妻子马利亚，和抹大拉的马利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: Near the cross of Jesus stood his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.textEnEsv: but standing by the cross of Jesus were his mother and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus His mother, and His mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.textEnNlt: Standing near the cross were Jesus’ mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary (the wife of Clopas), and Mary Magdalene.
verses.textEnNasb: Now beside the cross of Jesus stood His mother, His mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.textEn: Near the cross of Jesus stood his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

verses.textZh: 耶稣看见母亲，又看见他所爱的那门徒站在旁边，就对母亲说："<red>母亲 ，看！你的儿子。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看见母亲，又看见他所爱的那门徒站在旁边，就对母亲说："<red>母亲 ，看！你的儿子。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣见母亲和他所爱的那门徒站在旁边，就对他母亲说：「<red>母亲 ，看，你的儿子！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to her, <red>“Woman, here is your son,”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus saw his mother and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to his mother, "Woman, behold, your son!"
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus therefore saw His mother, and the disciple whom He loved standing by, He said to His mother, "Woman, behold your son!"
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus saw his mother standing there beside the disciple he loved, he said to her, "Dear woman, here is your son."
verses.textEnNasb: So when Jesus saw His mother, and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He *said to His mother, "Woman, behold, your son!"
verses.textEn: When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to her, <red>“Woman, here is your son,”</red>

verses.textZh: 然后他对那门徒说："<red>看！你的母亲。</red>"从那时起，那门徒就把她接到自己的家里去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后他对那门徒说："<red>看！你的母亲。</red>"从那时起，那门徒就把她接到自己的家里去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又对那门徒说：「<red>看，你的母亲！</red>」从此，那门徒就接她到自己家里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: and to the disciple, <red>“Here is your mother.”</red> From that time on, this disciple took her into his home.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to the disciple, "Behold, your mother!" And from that hour the disciple took her to his own home.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to the disciple, "Behold your mother!" And from that hour that disciple took her to his own home.
verses.textEnNlt: And he said to this disciple, "Here is your mother." And from then on this disciple took her into his home.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He *said to the disciple, "Behold, your mother!" And from that hour the disciple took her into his own household.
verses.textEn: and to the disciple, <red>“Here is your mother.”</red> From that time on, this disciple took her into his home.

verses.textZh: 这事以后，耶稣知道一切都已经成就了，为了要使经上的话应验，就说："<red>我渴了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，耶稣知道一切都已经成就了，为了要使经上的话应验，就说："<red>我渴了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，耶稣知道各样的事已经成了，为要使经上的话应验，就说：「<red>我渴了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Later, knowing that everything had now been finished, and so that Scripture would be fulfilled, Jesus said, <red>“I am thirsty.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: After this, Jesus, knowing that all was now finished, said ( to fulfill the Scripture), "I thirst."
verses.textEnNkjv: After this, Jesus, knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, "I thirst!"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus knew that his mission was now finished, and to fulfill Scripture he said, "I am thirsty."
verses.textEnNasb: After this, Jesus, knowing that all things had already been accomplished, in order that the Scripture would be fulfilled, *said, "I am thirsty."
verses.textEn: Later, knowing that everything had now been finished, and so that Scripture would be fulfilled, Jesus said, <red>“I am thirsty.”</red>

verses.textZh: 在那里有一个坛子，盛满了酸酒，他们就拿海绵浸了酸酒，绑在牛膝草上，送到他的口里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里有一个坛子，盛满了酸酒，他们就拿海绵浸了酸酒，绑在牛膝草上，送到他的口里。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个器皿盛满了醋，放在那里；他们就拿海绒蘸满了醋，绑在牛膝草上，送到他口。
verses.textEnNiv: A jar of wine vinegar was there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put the sponge on a stalk of the hyssop plant, and lifted it to Jesus’ lips.
verses.textEnEsv: A jar full of sour wine stood there, so they put a sponge full of the sour wine on a hyssop branch and held it to his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a vessel full of sour wine was sitting there; and they filled a sponge with sour wine, put it on hyssop, and put it to His mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: A jar of sour wine was sitting there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put it on a hyssop branch, and held it up to his lips.
verses.textEnNasb: A jar full of sour wine was standing there; so they put a sponge full of the sour wine on a branch of hyssop and brought it up to His mouth.
verses.textEn: A jar of wine vinegar was there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put the sponge on a stalk of the hyssop plant, and lifted it to Jesus’ lips.

verses.textZh: 耶稣尝了那酸酒，说："<red>成了！</red>"就低下头，断了气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣尝了那酸酒，说："<red>成了！</red>"就低下头，断了气。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣尝 了那醋，就说：「<red>成了！</red>」便低下头，将灵魂交付神了。
verses.textEnNiv: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, <red>“It is finished.”</red> With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus had received the sour wine, he said, "It is finished," and he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, "It is finished!" And bowing His head, He gave up His spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus had tasted it, he said, "It is finished!" Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore when Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, "It is finished!" And He bowed His head and gave up His spirit.
verses.textEn: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, <red>“It is finished.”</red> With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

verses.textZh: 因为那天是预备日，为了要避免尸体在安息日留在十字架上 ，犹太人就请求彼拉多打断那些被钉十字架的人的腿，把他们拿下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那天是预备日，为了要避免尸体在安息日留在十字架上 ，犹太人就请求彼拉多打断那些被钉十字架的人的腿，把他们拿下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人因这日是预备日，又因那安息日是个大日，就求彼拉多叫人打断他们的腿，把他们拿去，免得尸首当安息日留在十字架上。
verses.textEnNiv: Now it was the day of Preparation, and the next day was to be a special Sabbath. Because the Jewish leaders did not want the bodies left on the crosses during the Sabbath, they asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies taken down.
verses.textEnEsv: Since it was the day of Preparation, and so that the bodies would not remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a high day), the Jews asked Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, because it was the Preparation Day, that the bodies should not remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a high day), the Jews asked Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
verses.textEnNlt: It was the day of preparation, and the Jewish leaders didn’t want the bodies hanging there the next day, which was the Sabbath (and a very special Sabbath, because it was Passover week). So they asked Pilate to hasten their deaths by ordering that their legs be broken. Then their bodies could be taken down.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, since it was the day of preparation, to prevent the bodies from remaining on the cross on the Sabbath ( for that Sabbath was a high day), the Jews requested of Pilate that their legs be broken, and the bodies be taken away.
verses.textEn: Now it was the day of Preparation, and the next day was to be a special Sabbath. Because the Jewish leaders did not want the bodies left on the crosses during the Sabbath, they asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies taken down.

verses.textZh: 于是士兵来了，把和耶稣一同钉十字架的那两个人的腿都先后打断了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是士兵来了，把和耶稣一同钉十字架的那两个人的腿都先后打断了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是兵丁来，把头一个人的腿，并与耶稣同钉第二个人的腿，都打断了。
verses.textEnNiv: The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and then those of the other.
verses.textEnEsv: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who had been crucified with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the two men crucified with Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man, and of the other who was crucified with Him;
verses.textEn: The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and then those of the other.

verses.textZh: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见他已经死了，就没有打断他的腿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见他已经死了，就没有打断他的腿。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是来到耶稣那里，见他已经死了，就不打断他的腿。
verses.textEnNiv: But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
verses.textEnEsv: But when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.
verses.textEnNlt: But when they came to Jesus, they saw that he was already dead, so they didn’t break his legs.
verses.textEnNasb: but after they came to Jesus, when they saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.
verses.textEn: But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.

verses.textZh: 但是有一个士兵用枪刺他的肋旁，立刻有血和水流出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是有一个士兵用枪刺他的肋旁，立刻有血和水流出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有一个兵拿枪扎他的肋旁，随即有血和水流出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus’ side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.
verses.textEnEsv: But one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once there came out blood and water.
verses.textEnNkjv: But one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
verses.textEnNlt: One of the soldiers, however, pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
verses.textEn: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus’ side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.

verses.textZh: 那看见这事的人已经作证了，他的见证是真实的，他也知道自己所说的是实在的，使你们也相信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那看见这事的人已经作证了，他的见证是真实的，他也知道自己所说的是实在的，使你们也相信。
verses.textZhCuv: 看见这事的那人就作见证－他的见证也是真的，并且他知道自己所说的是真的－叫你们也可以信。
verses.textEnNiv: The man who saw it has given testimony, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, and he testifies so that you also may believe.
verses.textEnEsv: He who saw it has borne witness— his testimony is true, and he knows that he is telling the truth— that you also may believe.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true; and he knows that he is telling the truth, so that you may believe.
verses.textEnNlt: (This report is from an eyewitness giving an accurate account. He speaks the truth so that you also may continue to believe. )
verses.textEnNasb: And he who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true; and he knows that he is telling the truth, so that you also may believe.
verses.textEn: The man who saw it has given testimony, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, and he testifies so that you also may believe.

verses.textZh: 这些事的发生，是要应验经上所说的："他的骨头，一根也不可折断。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事的发生，是要应验经上所说的："他的骨头，一根也不可折断。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事成了，为要应验经上的话说：「他的骨头一根也不可折断。」
verses.textEnNiv: These things happened so that the scripture would be fulfilled: "Not one of his bones will be broken,"
verses.textEnEsv: For these things took place that the Scripture might be fulfilled: "Not one of his bones will be broken."
verses.textEnNkjv: For these things were done that the Scripture should be fulfilled, "Not one of His bones shall be broken."
verses.textEnNlt: These things happened in fulfillment of the Scriptures that say, "Not one of his bones will be broken,"
verses.textEnNasb: For these things took place so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: "Not a bone of Him shall be broken."
verses.textEn: These things happened so that the scripture would be fulfilled: "Not one of his bones will be broken,"

verses.textZh: 另有一处经文说："他们要仰望自己所刺的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 另有一处经文说："他们要仰望自己所刺的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 经上又有一句说：「他们要仰望自己所扎的人。」
verses.textEnNiv: and, as another scripture says, "They will look on the one they have pierced."
verses.textEnEsv: And again another Scripture says, "They will look on him whom they have pierced."
verses.textEnNkjv: And again another Scripture says, "They shall look on Him whom they pierced."
verses.textEnNlt: and "They will look on the one they pierced."
verses.textEnNasb: And again another Scripture says, "They will look at Him whom they pierced."
verses.textEn: and, as another scripture says, "They will look on the one they have pierced."

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，有一个亚利马太人约瑟来求彼拉多，要领耶稣的身体；他因为怕犹太人，就暗暗地作耶稣的门徒。彼拉多批准了，他便把耶稣的身体领去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，有一个亚利马太人约瑟来求彼拉多，要领耶稣的身体；他因为怕犹太人，就暗暗地作耶稣的门徒。彼拉多批准了，他便把耶稣的身体领去。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事以后，有亚利马太人约瑟，是耶稣的门徒，只因怕犹太人，就暗暗地作门徒。他来求彼拉多，要把耶稣的身体领去。彼拉多允准，他就把耶稣的身体领去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Later, Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus. Now Joseph was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly because he feared the Jewish leaders. With Pilate’s permission, he came and took the body away.
verses.textEnEsv: After these things Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus, and Pilate gave him permission. So he came and took away his body.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this, Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly, for fear of the Jews, asked Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus; and Pilate gave him permission. So he came and took the body of Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward Joseph of Arimathea, who had been a secret disciple of Jesus (because he feared the Jewish leaders), asked Pilate for permission to take down Jesus’ body. When Pilate gave permission, Joseph came and took the body away.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after these things Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but a secret one for fear of the Jews, requested of Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus; and Pilate granted permission. So he came and took away His body.
verses.textEn: Later, Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus. Now Joseph was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly because he feared the Jewish leaders. With Pilate’s permission, he came and took the body away.

verses.textZh: 从前夜间来见耶稣的尼哥德慕也来了，带着没药和沉香混合的香料，约有三十二公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前夜间来见耶稣的尼哥德慕也来了，带着没药和沉香混合的香料，约有三十二公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有尼哥德慕，就是先前夜里去见耶稣的，带着没药和沉香约有一百斤前来。
verses.textEnNiv: He was accompanied by Nicodemus, the man who earlier had visited Jesus at night. Nicodemus brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
verses.textEnEsv: Nicodemus also, who earlier had come to Jesus by night, came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds in weight.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came, bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds.
verses.textEnNlt: With him came Nicodemus, the man who had come to Jesus at night. He brought about seventy-five pounds of perfumed ointment made from myrrh and aloes.
verses.textEnNasb: Nicodemus, who had first come to Him by night, also came, bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred litras weight.
verses.textEn: He was accompanied by Nicodemus, the man who earlier had visited Jesus at night. Nicodemus brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.

verses.textZh: 他们领取了耶稣的身体，照着犹太人的葬礼的规例，用细麻布和香料把他裹好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们领取了耶稣的身体，照着犹太人的葬礼的规例，用细麻布和香料把他裹好。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就照犹太人殡葬的规矩，把耶稣的身体用细麻布加上香料裹好了。
verses.textEnNiv: Taking Jesus’ body, the two of them wrapped it, with the spices, in strips of linen. This was in accordance with Jewish burial customs.
verses.textEnEsv: So they took the body of Jesus and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as is the burial custom of the Jews.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they took the body of Jesus, and bound it in strips of linen with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
verses.textEnNlt: Following Jewish burial custom, they wrapped Jesus’ body with the spices in long sheets of linen cloth.
verses.textEnNasb: So they took the body of Jesus and bound it in linen wrappings with the spices, as is the burial custom of the Jews.
verses.textEn: Taking Jesus’ body, the two of them wrapped it, with the spices, in strips of linen. This was in accordance with Jewish burial customs.

verses.textZh: 在耶稣钉十字架的地方，有一个园子，园里有一个新的墓穴，是从来没有葬过人的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶稣钉十字架的地方，有一个园子，园里有一个新的墓穴，是从来没有葬过人的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶稣钉十字架的地方有一个园子，园子里有一座新坟墓，是从来没有葬过人的。
verses.textEnNiv: At the place where Jesus was crucified, there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had ever been laid.
verses.textEnEsv: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the place where He was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.
verses.textEnNlt: The place of crucifixion was near a garden, where there was a new tomb, never used before.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the place where He was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden was a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.
verses.textEn: At the place where Jesus was crucified, there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had ever been laid.

verses.textZh: 因为那天是犹太人的预备日，又因为那墓穴就在附近，他们就把耶稣葬在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那天是犹太人的预备日，又因为那墓穴就在附近，他们就把耶稣葬在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 只因是犹太人的预备日，又因那坟墓近，他们就把耶稣安放在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.
verses.textEnEsv: So because of the Jewish day of Preparation, since the tomb was close at hand, they laid Jesus there.
verses.textEnNkjv: So there they laid Jesus, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day, for the tomb was nearby.
verses.textEnNlt: And so, because it was the day of preparation for the Jewish Passover and since the tomb was close at hand, they laid Jesus there.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore because of the Jewish day of preparation, since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.
verses.textEn: Because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.

verses.textZh: 礼拜日清早，天还没有亮的时候，抹大拉的马利亚来到墓旁，看见石头已经从坟墓移开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 礼拜日清早，天还没有亮的时候，抹大拉的马利亚来到墓旁，看见石头已经从坟墓移开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 七日的第一日清早，天还黑的时候，抹大拉的马利亚来到坟墓那里，看见石头从坟墓挪开了，
verses.textEnNiv: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
verses.textEnEsv: Now on the first day of the week Mary Magdalene came to the tomb early, while it was still dark, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now on the first day of the week Mary Magdalene went to the tomb early, while it was still dark, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
verses.textEnNlt: Early on Sunday morning, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb and found that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the first day of the week Mary Magdalene *came early to the tomb, while it was still dark, and *saw the stone already removed from the tomb.
verses.textEn: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.

verses.textZh: 她就跑去见西门．彼得，和耶稣所爱的那个门徒，对他们说："有人把主从坟墓里搬走了，我们不知道他们把他放在哪里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她就跑去见西门．彼得，和耶稣所爱的那个门徒，对他们说："有人把主从坟墓里搬走了，我们不知道他们把他放在哪里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就跑来见西门‧彼得和耶稣所爱的那个门徒，对他们说：「有人把主从坟墓里挪了去，我们不知道放在哪里。」
verses.textEnNiv: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one Jesus loved, and said, "They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have put him!"
verses.textEnEsv: So she ran and went to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved, and said to them, "They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and said to them, "They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid Him."
verses.textEnNlt: She ran and found Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. She said, "They have taken the Lord’s body out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have put him!"
verses.textEnNasb: So she *ran and *came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and *said to them, "They have taken the Lord from the tomb, and we do not know where they have put Him."
verses.textEn: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one Jesus loved, and said, "They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have put him!"

verses.textZh: 彼得和那门徒就动身，到坟墓那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得和那门徒就动身，到坟墓那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得和那门徒就出来，往坟墓那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: So Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
verses.textEnEsv: So Peter went out with the other disciple, and they were going toward the tomb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Peter therefore went out, and the other disciple, and were going to the tomb.
verses.textEnNlt: Peter and the other disciple started out for the tomb.
verses.textEnNasb: So Peter and the other disciple left, and they were going to the tomb.
verses.textEn: So Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.

verses.textZh: 两个人一齐跑，那门徒比彼得跑得快，先到了坟墓，
verses.textZhCnvs: 两个人一齐跑，那门徒比彼得跑得快，先到了坟墓，
verses.textZhCuv: 两个人同跑，那门徒比彼得跑得更快，先到了坟墓，
verses.textEnNiv: Both were running, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
verses.textEnEsv: Both of them were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they both ran together, and the other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.
verses.textEnNlt: They were both running, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
verses.textEnNasb: The two were running together; and the other disciple ran ahead, faster than Peter, and came to the tomb first;
verses.textEn: Both were running, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.

verses.textZh: 屈身向里面观看，看见细麻布还在那里，但他却没有进去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 屈身向里面观看，看见细麻布还在那里，但他却没有进去。
verses.textZhCuv: 低头往里看，就见细麻布还放在那里，只是没有进去。
verses.textEnNiv: He bent over and looked in at the strips of linen lying there but did not go in.
verses.textEnEsv: And stooping to look in, he saw the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he, stooping down and looking in, saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he did not go in.
verses.textEnNlt: He stooped and looked in and saw the linen wrappings lying there, but he didn’t go in.
verses.textEnNasb: and he stooped to look in, and *saw the linen wrappings lying there; however he did not go in.
verses.textEn: He bent over and looked in at the strips of linen lying there but did not go in.

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得随后也到了；他进入坟墓，看见细麻布还放在那里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得随后也到了；他进入坟墓，看见细麻布还放在那里，
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得随后也到了，进坟墓里去，就看见细麻布还放在那里，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Simon Peter came along behind him and went straight into the tomb. He saw the strips of linen lying there,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and went into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying there,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and went into the tomb; and he saw the linen cloths lying there,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Simon Peter arrived and went inside. He also noticed the linen wrappings lying there,
verses.textEnNasb: So Simon Peter also *came, following him, and he entered the tomb; and he *looked at the linen wrappings lying there,
verses.textEn: Then Simon Peter came along behind him and went straight into the tomb. He saw the strips of linen lying there,

verses.textZh: 也看见耶稣的裹头巾，没有和细麻布放在一起，而是卷着放在一边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也看见耶稣的裹头巾，没有和细麻布放在一起，而是卷着放在一边。
verses.textZhCuv: 又看见耶稣的裹头巾没有和细麻布放在一处，是另在一处卷着。
verses.textEnNiv: as well as the cloth that had been wrapped around Jesus’ head. The cloth was still lying in its place, separate from the linen.
verses.textEnEsv: and the face cloth, which had been on Jesus’ head, not lying with the linen cloths but folded up in a place by itself.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the handkerchief that had been around His head, not lying with the linen cloths, but folded together in a place by itself.
verses.textEnNlt: while the cloth that had covered Jesus’ head was folded up and lying apart from the other wrappings.
verses.textEnNasb: and the face-cloth which had been on His head, not lying with the linen wrappings but folded up in a place by itself.
verses.textEn: as well as the cloth that had been wrapped around Jesus’ head. The cloth was still lying in its place, separate from the linen.

verses.textZh: 那时，先到坟墓的那门徒也进去，他看见，就信了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，先到坟墓的那门徒也进去，他看见，就信了。
verses.textZhCuv: 先到坟墓的那门徒也进去，看见就信了。（
verses.textEnNiv: Finally the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in, and he saw and believed;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the other disciple, who came to the tomb first, went in also; and he saw and believed.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the disciple who had reached the tomb first also went in, and he saw and believed—
verses.textEnNasb: So the other disciple who had first come to the tomb also entered then, and he saw and believed.
verses.textEn: Finally the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.

verses.textZh: 他们还不明白经上所说"他必须从死人中复活"这句话的意思。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们还不明白经上所说"他必须从死人中复活"这句话的意思。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们还不明白圣经的意思，就是耶稣必要从死里复活。）
verses.textEnNiv: (They still did not understand from Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.)
verses.textEnEsv: for as yet they did not understand the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as yet they did not know the Scripture, that He must rise again from the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: for until then they still hadn’t understood the Scriptures that said Jesus must rise from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: For they did not yet understand the Scripture, that He must rise from the dead.
verses.textEn: (They still did not understand from Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.)

verses.textZh: 于是两个门徒就回家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是两个门徒就回家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是两个门徒回自己的住处去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the disciples went back to where they were staying.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the disciples went back to their homes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the disciples went away again to their own homes.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they went home.
verses.textEnNasb: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.
verses.textEn: Then the disciples went back to where they were staying.

verses.textZh: 马利亚站在坟墓外面哭泣。她哭的时候，屈身往里面观看，
verses.textZhCnvs: 马利亚站在坟墓外面哭泣。她哭的时候，屈身往里面观看，
verses.textZhCuv: 马利亚却站在坟墓外面哭。哭的时候，低头往坟墓里看，
verses.textEnNiv: Now Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb
verses.textEnEsv: But Mary stood weeping outside the tomb, and as she wept she stooped to look into the tomb.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Mary stood outside by the tomb weeping, and as she wept she stooped down andlooked into the tomb.
verses.textEnNlt: Mary was standing outside the tomb crying, and as she wept, she stooped and looked in.
verses.textEnNasb: But Mary was standing outside the tomb, weeping; so as she wept, she stooped to look into the tomb;
verses.textEn: Now Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb

verses.textZh: 看见两个身穿白衣的天使，坐在安放耶稣身体的地方，一个在头那边，一个在脚那边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看见两个身穿白衣的天使，坐在安放耶稣身体的地方，一个在头那边，一个在脚那边。
verses.textZhCuv: 就见两个天使，穿着白衣，在安放耶稣身体的地方坐着，一个在头，一个在脚。
verses.textEnNiv: and saw two angels in white, seated where Jesus’ body had been, one at the head and the other at the foot.
verses.textEnEsv: And she saw two angels in white, sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and one at the feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.textEnNlt: She saw two white-robed angels, one sitting at the head and the other at the foot of the place where the body of Jesus had been lying.
verses.textEnNasb: and she *saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had been lying.
verses.textEn: and saw two angels in white, seated where Jesus’ body had been, one at the head and the other at the foot.

verses.textZh: 天使问她："妇人，你为甚么哭？"她说："有人把我的主搬走了，我不知道他们把他放在哪里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使问她："妇人，你为甚么哭？"她说："有人把我的主搬走了，我不知道他们把他放在哪里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 天使对她说：「妇人，你为什么哭？」她说：「因为有人把我主挪了去，我不知道放在哪里。」
verses.textEnNiv: They asked her, "Woman, why are you crying?" "They have taken my Lord away," she said, "and I don’t know where they have put him."
verses.textEnEsv: They said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping?" She said to them, "They have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping?" She said to them, "Because they have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid Him."
verses.textEnNlt: "Dear woman, why are you crying?" the angels asked her. "Because they have taken away my Lord," she replied, "and I don’t know where they have put him."
verses.textEnNasb: And they *said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping?" She *said to them, "Because they have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they put Him."
verses.textEn: They asked her, "Woman, why are you crying?" "They have taken my Lord away," she said, "and I don’t know where they have put him."

verses.textZh: 马利亚说了这话，就转过身来，看见耶稣站在那里，却不知道他就是耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 马利亚说了这话，就转过身来，看见耶稣站在那里，却不知道他就是耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 说了这话，就转过身来，看见耶稣站在那里，却不知道是耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: Having said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, but she did not know that it was Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, and did not know that it was Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: She turned to leave and saw someone standing there. It was Jesus, but she didn’t recognize him.
verses.textEnNasb: When she had said this, she turned around and *saw Jesus standing there, and yet she did not know that it was Jesus.
verses.textEn: At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对她说："<red>妇人，你为甚么哭？你找谁呢？</red>"马利亚以为耶稣是园丁，就对他说："<red>先生，如果是你把他挪去了，请告诉我你把他放在甚么地方，我好去搬回来。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对她说："<red>妇人，你为甚么哭？你找谁呢？</red>"马利亚以为耶稣是园丁，就对他说："<red>先生，如果是你把他挪去了，请告诉我你把他放在甚么地方，我好去搬回来。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣问她说：「<red>妇人，为什么哭？你找谁呢？</red>」马利亚以为是看园的，就对他说：「<red>先生，若是你把他移了去，请告诉我，你把他放在哪里，我便去取他。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He asked her, <red>“Woman, why are you crying? Who is it you are looking for?”</red> Thinking he was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will get him.”
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping? Whom are you seeking?" Supposing him to be the gardener, she said to him, "Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping? Whom are you seeking?" She, supposing Him to be the gardener, said to Him, "Sir, if You have carried Him away, tell me where You have laid Him, and I will take Him away."
verses.textEnNlt: "Dear woman, why are you crying?" Jesus asked her. "Who are you looking for?" She thought he was the gardener. "Sir," she said, "if you have taken him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will go and get him."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping? Whom are you seeking?" Thinking that He was the gardener, she *said to Him, "Sir, if you have carried Him away, tell me where you put Him, and I will take Him away."
verses.textEn: He asked her, <red>“Woman, why are you crying? Who is it you are looking for?”</red> Thinking he was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will get him.”

verses.textZh: 耶稣对她说："<red>马利亚！</red>"她转过身来，用希伯来话对他说："<red>拉波尼！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对她说："<red>马利亚！</red>"她转过身来，用希伯来话对他说："<red>拉波尼！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>马利亚。</red>」马利亚就转过来，用希伯来话对他说：「<red>拉波尼！</red>」（拉波尼就是夫子的意思。）
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to her, <red>“Mary.”</red> She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to her, "Mary." She turned and said to him in Aramaic, "Rabboni!" (which means Teacher).
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to her, "Mary!" She turned and said to Him, "Rabboni!" (which is to say, Teacher).
verses.textEnNlt: "Mary!" Jesus said. She turned to him and cried out, "Rabboni!" (which is Hebrew for "Teacher").
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to her, "Mary!" She turned and *said to Him in Hebrew, "Rabboni!" (which means, Teacher).
verses.textEn: Jesus said to her, <red>“Mary.”</red> She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>你不要拉住我，因为我还没有上去见父。你要到我的弟兄们那里去，告诉他们我要上去见我的父，也是你们的父；见我的神，也是你们的神。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>你不要拉住我，因为我还没有上去见父。你要到我的弟兄们那里去，告诉他们我要上去见我的父，也是你们的父；见我的神，也是你们的神。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>不要摸我，因我还没有升上去见我的父。你往我弟兄那里去，告诉他们说，我要升上去见我的父，也是你们的父，见我的神，也是你们的神。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, <red>“Do not hold on to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father. Go instead to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to her, "Do not cling to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father; but go to my brothers and say to them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to her, "Do not cling to Me, for I have not yet ascended to My Father; but go to My brethren and say to them, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, and to My God and your God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t cling to me," Jesus said, "for I haven’t yet ascended to the Father. But go find my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to her, "Stop clinging to Me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father; but go to My brothers and say to them, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, and My God and your God.’ "
verses.textEn: Jesus said, <red>“Do not hold on to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father. Go instead to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 抹大拉的马利亚就去，向门徒报信说："我已经看见主了！"她又把主对她所说的话告诉他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 抹大拉的马利亚就去，向门徒报信说："我已经看见主了！"她又把主对她所说的话告诉他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 抹大拉的马利亚就去告诉门徒说：「我已经看见了主。」她又将主对她说的这话告诉他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Mary Magdalene went to the disciples with the news: "I have seen the Lord!" And she told them that he had said these things to her.
verses.textEnEsv: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, "I have seen the Lord"—and that he had said these things to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that He had spoken these things to her.
verses.textEnNlt: Mary Magdalene found the disciples and told them, "I have seen the Lord!" Then she gave them his message.
verses.textEnNasb: Mary Magdalene *came and announced to the disciples, "I have seen the Lord," and that He had said these things to her.
verses.textEn: Mary Magdalene went to the disciples with the news: "I have seen the Lord!" And she told them that he had said these things to her.

verses.textZh: 礼拜日黄昏的时候，门徒聚在一起，因为怕犹太人，就把门户都关上。耶稣来了，站在他们中间，说："<red>愿你们平安。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 礼拜日黄昏的时候，门徒聚在一起，因为怕犹太人，就把门户都关上。耶稣来了，站在他们中间，说："<red>愿你们平安。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 那日（就是七日的第一日）晚上，门徒所在的地方，因怕犹太人，门都关了。耶稣来，站在当中，对他们说：「<red>愿你们平安！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: On the evening of that first day of the week, when the disciples were together, with the doors locked for fear of the Jewish leaders, Jesus came and stood among them and said, <red>“Peace be with you!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: On the evening of that day, the first day of the week, the doors being locked where the disciples were for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them and said to them, "Peace be with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and said to them, "Peace be with you."
verses.textEnNlt: That Sunday evening the disciples were meeting behind locked doors because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders. Suddenly, Jesus was standing there among them! "Peace be with you," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were shut where the disciples were together due to fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in their midst, and *said to them, "Peace be to you."
verses.textEn: On the evening of that first day of the week, when the disciples were together, with the doors locked for fear of the Jewish leaders, Jesus came and stood among them and said, <red>“Peace be with you!”</red>

verses.textZh: 说了这话，就把手和肋旁给他们看。门徒看见主，就欢喜了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说了这话，就把手和肋旁给他们看。门徒看见主，就欢喜了。
verses.textZhCuv: 说了这话，就把手和肋旁指给他们看。门徒看见主，就喜乐了。
verses.textEnNiv: After he said this, he showed them his hands and side. The disciples were overjoyed when they saw the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. Then the disciples were glad when they saw the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had said this, He showed them His hands and His side. Then the disciples were glad when they saw the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: As he spoke, he showed them the wounds in his hands and his side. They were filled with joy when they saw the Lord!
verses.textEnNasb: And when He had said this, He showed them both His hands and His side. The disciples then rejoiced when they saw the Lord.
verses.textEn: After he said this, he showed them his hands and side. The disciples were overjoyed when they saw the Lord.

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>愿你们平安。父怎样差遣了我，我也怎样差遣你们。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>愿你们平安。父怎样差遣了我，我也怎样差遣你们。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又对他们说：「<red>愿你们平安！父怎样差遣了我，我也照样差遣你们。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Again Jesus said, <red>“Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them again, "Peace be with you. As the Father has sent me, even so I am sending you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus said to them again, "Peace to you! As the Father has sent Me, I also send you."
verses.textEnNlt: Again he said, "Peace be with you. As the Father has sent me, so I am sending you."
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus said to them again, "Peace be to you; just as the Father has sent Me, I also send you."
verses.textEn: Again Jesus said, <red>“Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 说了这话，就向他们吹一口气，说："<red>你们领受圣灵吧！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 说了这话，就向他们吹一口气，说："<red>你们领受圣灵吧！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>说了这话，就向他们吹一口气，说：「你们受圣灵！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: And with that he breathed on them and said, <red>“Receive the Holy Spirit.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had said this, he breathed on them and said to them, "Receive the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had said this, He breathed on them, and said to them, "Receive the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: And when He had said this, He breathed on them and *said to them, "Receive the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: And with that he breathed on them and said, <red>“Receive the Holy Spirit.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们赦免谁的罪，谁的罪就得赦免；你们不赦免谁的罪，谁的罪就不得赦免。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们赦免谁的罪，谁的罪就得赦免；你们不赦免谁的罪，谁的罪就不得赦免。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们赦免谁的罪，谁的罪就赦免了；你们留下谁的罪，谁的罪就留下了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you forgive anyone’s sins, their sins are forgiven; if you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you withhold forgiveness from any, it is withheld."
verses.textEnNkjv: If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you retain the sins of any, they are retained."
verses.textEnNlt: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they are forgiven. If you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven."
verses.textEnNasb: If you forgive the sins of any, their sins have been forgiven them; if you retain the sins of any, they have been retained."
verses.textEn: <red>If you forgive anyone’s sins, their sins are forgiven; if you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven.”</red>

verses.textZh: 十二个门徒中，有一个称为"双生子" 的多马。耶稣来的时候，他没有和门徒在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 十二个门徒中，有一个称为"双生子" 的多马。耶稣来的时候，他没有和门徒在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 那十二个门徒中，有称为低土马的多马；耶稣来的时候，他没有和他们同在。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Thomas (also known as Didymus ), one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Thomas, one of the twelve, called the Twin, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Thomas, called the Twin, one of the twelve, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.textEnNlt: One of the twelve disciples, Thomas (nicknamed the Twin), was not with the others when Jesus came.
verses.textEnNasb: But Thomas, one of the twelve, who was called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.textEn: Now Thomas (also known as Didymus ), one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.

verses.textZh: 其他的门徒对他说："我们已经见过主了。"多马对他们说："除非我亲眼看见他手上的钉痕，用我的指头探入那钉痕，又用我的手探入他的肋旁，我决不相信。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 其他的门徒对他说："我们已经见过主了。"多马对他们说："除非我亲眼看见他手上的钉痕，用我的指头探入那钉痕，又用我的手探入他的肋旁，我决不相信。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那些门徒就对他说：「我们已经看见主了。」多马却说：「我非看见他手上的钉痕，用指头探入那钉痕，又用手探入他的肋旁，我总不信。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the other disciples told him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe."
verses.textEnEsv: So the other disciples told him, "We have seen the Lord." But he said to them, "Unless I see in his hands the mark of the nails, and place my finger into the mark of the nails, and place my hand into his side, I will never believe."
verses.textEnNkjv: The other disciples therefore said to him, "We have seen the Lord." So he said to them, "Unless I see in His hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into His side, I will not believe."
verses.textEnNlt: They told him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he replied, "I won’t believe it unless I see the nail wounds in his hands, put my fingers into them, and place my hand into the wound in his side."
verses.textEnNasb: So the other disciples were saying to him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "Unless I see in His hands the imprint of the nails, and put my finger into the place of the nails, and put my hand into His side, I will not believe."
verses.textEn: So the other disciples told him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe."

verses.textZh: 过了八天，门徒又在屋子里，多马也和他们在一起。门户都关上了。耶稣来了，站在他们中间，说："<red>愿你们平安。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了八天，门徒又在屋子里，多马也和他们在一起。门户都关上了。耶稣来了，站在他们中间，说："<red>愿你们平安。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 过了八日，门徒又在屋里，多马也和他们同在，门都关了。耶稣来，站在当中说：「<red>愿你们平安！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: A week later his disciples were in the house again, and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them and said, <red>“Peace be with you!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Eight days later, his disciples were inside again, and Thomas was with them. Although the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And after eight days His disciples were again inside, and Thomas with them. Jesus came, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, "Peace to you!"
verses.textEnNlt: Eight days later the disciples were together again, and this time Thomas was with them. The doors were locked; but suddenly, as before, Jesus was standing among them. "Peace be with you," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: Eight days later His disciples were again inside, and Thomas was with them. Jesus *came, the doors having been shut, and stood in their midst and said, "Peace be to you."
verses.textEn: A week later his disciples were in the house again, and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them and said, <red>“Peace be with you!”</red>

verses.textZh: 然后对多马说："<red>把你的指头放在这里，看看我的手吧！伸出你的手来，探探我的肋旁！不要疑惑，只要信！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后对多马说："<red>把你的指头放在这里，看看我的手吧！伸出你的手来，探探我的肋旁！不要疑惑，只要信！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 就对多马说：「<red>伸过你的指头来，摸 我的手；伸出你的手来，探入我的肋旁。不要疑惑，总要信！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to Thomas, <red>“Put your finger here; see my hands. Reach out your hand and put it into my side. Stop doubting and believe.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to Thomas, "Put your finger here, and see my hands; and put out your hand, and place it in my side. Do not disbelieve, but believe."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to Thomas, "Reach your finger here, and look at My hands; and reach your hand here, and put it into My side. Do not be unbelieving, but believing."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to Thomas, "Put your finger here, and look at my hands. Put your hand into the wound in my side. Don’t be faithless any longer. Believe!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then He *said to Thomas, "Place your finger here, and see My hands; and take your hand and put it into My side; and do not continue in disbelief, but be a believer."
verses.textEn: Then he said to Thomas, <red>“Put your finger here; see my hands. Reach out your hand and put it into my side. Stop doubting and believe.”</red>

verses.textZh: 多马对他说："我的主！我的神！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 多马对他说："我的主！我的神！"
verses.textZhCuv: 多马说：「我的主！我的神！」
verses.textEnNiv: Thomas said to him, "My Lord and my God!"
verses.textEnEsv: Thomas answered him, "My Lord and my God!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Thomas answered and said to Him, "My Lord and my God!"
verses.textEnNlt: "My Lord and my God!" Thomas exclaimed.
verses.textEnNasb: Thomas answered and said to Him, "My Lord and my God!"
verses.textEn: Thomas said to him, "My Lord and my God!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>你因为看见我才信吗？那些没有看见就信的人，是有福的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>你因为看见我才信吗？那些没有看见就信的人，是有福的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>你因看见了我才信；那没有看见就信的有福了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus told him, <red>“Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "Have you believed because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "Thomas, because you have seen Me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus told him, "You believe because you have seen me. Blessed are those who believe without seeing me."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to him, "Because you have seen Me, have you now believed? Blessed are they who did not see, and yet believed."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus told him, <red>“Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣在门徒面前还行了许多别的神迹，没有记在这书上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣在门徒面前还行了许多别的神迹，没有记在这书上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣在门徒面前另外行了许多神迹，没有记在这书上。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not recorded in this book.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jesus did many other signs in the presence of the disciples, which are not written in this book;
verses.textEnNkjv: And truly Jesus did many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book;
verses.textEnNlt: The disciples saw Jesus do many other miraculous signs in addition to the ones recorded in this book.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, many other signs Jesus also performed in the presence of the disciples, which are not written in this book;
verses.textEn: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not recorded in this book.

verses.textZh: 但把这些事记下来，是要你们信耶稣是基督，是神的儿子，并且使你们信了，可以因他的名得生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但把这些事记下来，是要你们信耶稣是基督，是神的儿子，并且使你们信了，可以因他的名得生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 但记这些事要叫你们信耶稣是基督，是神的儿子，并且叫你们信了他，就可以因他的名得生命。
verses.textEnNiv: But these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.
verses.textEnEsv: but these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.
verses.textEnNkjv: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in His name.
verses.textEnNlt: But these are written so that you may continue to believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing in him you will have life by the power of his name.
verses.textEnNasb: but these have been written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that by believing you may have life in His name.
verses.textEn: But these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，耶稣在提比里亚海边再次向门徒显现。他显现的经过是这样的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，耶稣在提比里亚海边再次向门徒显现。他显现的经过是这样的：
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事以后，耶稣在提比哩亚海边又向门徒显现。他怎样显现记在下面：
verses.textEnNiv: Afterward Jesus appeared again to his disciples, by the Sea of Galilee. It happened this way:
verses.textEnEsv: After this Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples by the Sea of Tiberias, and he revealed himself in this way.
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things Jesus showed Himself again to the disciples at the Sea of Tiberias, and in this way He showed Himself:
verses.textEnNlt: Later, Jesus appeared again to the disciples beside the Sea of Galilee. This is how it happened.
verses.textEnNasb: After these things Jesus revealed Himself again to the disciples at the Sea of Tiberias, and He revealed Himself in this way:
verses.textEn: Afterward Jesus appeared again to his disciples, by the Sea of Galilee. It happened this way:

verses.textZh: 当时西门．彼得、称为"双生子"的多马、加利利的迦拿人拿但业、西庇太的两个儿子，和另外两个门徒都聚在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时西门．彼得、称为"双生子"的多马、加利利的迦拿人拿但业、西庇太的两个儿子，和另外两个门徒都聚在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 有西门‧彼得和称为低土马的多马，并加利利的迦拿人拿但业，还有西庇太的两个儿子，又有两个门徒，都在一处。
verses.textEnNiv: Simon Peter, Thomas (also known as Didymus ), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
verses.textEnEsv: Simon Peter, Thomas (called the Twin), Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
verses.textEnNkjv: Simon Peter, Thomas called the Twin, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of His disciples were together.
verses.textEnNlt: Several of the disciples were there—Simon Peter, Thomas (nicknamed the Twin), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples.
verses.textEnNasb: Simon Peter, Thomas who was called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of His disciples were together.
verses.textEn: Simon Peter, Thomas (also known as Didymus ), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得对他们说："我要打鱼去。"他们说："我们也跟你一起去。"于是他们出去，上了船，可是那一夜他们并没有打到甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得对他们说："我要打鱼去。"他们说："我们也跟你一起去。"于是他们出去，上了船，可是那一夜他们并没有打到甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得对他们说：「我打鱼去。」他们说：「我们也和你同去。」他们就出去，上了船；那一夜并没有打着什么。
verses.textEnNiv: "I’m going out to fish," Simon Peter told them, and they said, "We’ll go with you." So they went out and got into the boat, but that night they caught nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: Simon Peter said to them, "I am going fishing." They said to him, "We will go with you." They went out and got into the boat, but that night they caught nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Simon Peter said to them, "I am going fishing." They said to him, "We are going with you also." They went out and immediately got into the boat, and that night they caught nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Simon Peter said, "I’m going fishing." "We’ll come, too," they all said. So they went out in the boat, but they caught nothing all night.
verses.textEnNasb: Simon Peter *said to them, "I am going fishing." They *said to him, "We are also coming with you." They went out and got into the boat; and that night they caught nothing.
verses.textEn: "I’m going out to fish," Simon Peter told them, and they said, "We’ll go with you." So they went out and got into the boat, but that night they caught nothing.

verses.textZh: 清早的时候，耶稣站在岸边；门徒却不知道他就是耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 清早的时候，耶稣站在岸边；门徒却不知道他就是耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 天将亮的时候，耶稣站在岸上，门徒却不知道是耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize that it was Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: Just as day was breaking, Jesus stood on the shore; yet the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the morning had now come, Jesus stood on the shore; yet the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: At dawn Jesus was standing on the beach, but the disciples couldn’t see who he was.
verses.textEnNasb: But when the day was now breaking, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.
verses.textEn: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize that it was Jesus.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>孩子们，打到鱼没有？</red>"他们回答："没有。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>孩子们，打到鱼没有？</red>"他们回答："没有。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就对他们说：「<red>小子！你们有吃的没有？</red>」他们回答说：「<red>没有。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He called out to them, <red>“Friends, haven’t you any fish?”</red> “No,” they answered.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "Children, do you have any fish?" They answered him, "No."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Children, have you any food?" They answered Him, "No."
verses.textEnNlt: He called out, "Fellows, have you caught any fish?" "No," they replied.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jesus *said to them, "Children, you do not have any fish to eat, do you?" They answered Him, "No."
verses.textEn: He called out to them, <red>“Friends, haven’t you any fish?”</red> “No,” they answered.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>把网撒在船的右边，就可以得着。</red>"他们就把网撒下去，可是拉不上来，因为鱼太多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>把网撒在船的右边，就可以得着。</red>"他们就把网撒下去，可是拉不上来，因为鱼太多。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们把网撒在船的右边，就必得着。</red>」他们便撒下网去，竟拉不上来了，因为鱼甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: He said, <red>“Throw your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some.”</red> When they did, they were unable to haul the net in because of the large number of fish.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some." So they cast it, and now they were not able to haul it in, because of the quantity of fish.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some." So they cast, and now they were not able to draw it in because of the multitude of fish.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "Throw out your net on the right-hand side of the boat, and you’ll get some!" So they did, and they couldn’t haul in the net because there were so many fish in it.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Cast the net on the right-hand side of the boat, and you will find the fish." So they cast it, and then they were not able to haul it in because of the great quantity of fish.
verses.textEn: He said, <red>“Throw your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some.”</red> When they did, they were unable to haul the net in because of the large number of fish.

verses.textZh: 耶稣所爱的那门徒对彼得说："是主！"西门．彼得一听见是主，就立刻束上外衣 ，纵身跳进海里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣所爱的那门徒对彼得说："是主！"西门．彼得一听见是主，就立刻束上外衣 ，纵身跳进海里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣所爱的那门徒对彼得说：「是主！」那时西门‧彼得赤着身子，一听见是主，就束上一件外衣，跳在海里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" As soon as Simon Peter heard him say, "It is the Lord," he wrapped his outer garment around him (for he had taken it off) and jumped into the water.
verses.textEnEsv: That disciple whom Jesus loved therefore said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" When Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment, for he was stripped for work, and threw himself into the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it), and plunged into the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the disciple Jesus loved said to Peter, "It’s the Lord!" When Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his tunic (for he had stripped for work), jumped into the water, and headed to shore.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved *said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he was stripped for work), and threw himself into the sea.
verses.textEn: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" As soon as Simon Peter heard him say, "It is the Lord," he wrapped his outer garment around him (for he had taken it off) and jumped into the water.

verses.textZh: 其他的门徒，因为离岸不远 ，就坐在小船上，把那网鱼拖过来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其他的门徒，因为离岸不远 ，就坐在小船上，把那网鱼拖过来。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的门徒离岸不远，约有二百肘 ，就在小船上把那网鱼拉过来。
verses.textEnNiv: The other disciples followed in the boat, towing the net full of fish, for they were not far from shore, about a hundred yards.
verses.textEnEsv: The other disciples came in the boat, dragging the net full of fish, for they were not far from the land, but about a hundred yards off.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from land, but about two hundred cubits), dragging the net with fish.
verses.textEnNlt: The others stayed with the boat and pulled the loaded net to the shore, for they were only about a hundred yards from shore.
verses.textEnNasb: But the other disciples came in the little boat, for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away, dragging the net full of fish.
verses.textEn: The other disciples followed in the boat, towing the net full of fish, for they were not far from shore, about a hundred yards.

verses.textZh: 他们上了岸，就看见那里有一堆炭火，上面有鱼有饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们上了岸，就看见那里有一堆炭火，上面有鱼有饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们上了岸，就看见那里有炭火，上面有鱼，又有饼。
verses.textEnNiv: When they landed, they saw a fire of burning coals there with fish on it, and some bread.
verses.textEnEsv: When they got out on land, they saw a charcoal fire in place, with fish laid out on it, and bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, as soon as they had come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.
verses.textEnNlt: When they got there, they found breakfast waiting for them—fish cooking over a charcoal fire, and some bread.
verses.textEnNasb: So when they got out on the land, they *saw a charcoal fire already made and fish placed on it, and bread.
verses.textEn: When they landed, they saw a fire of burning coals there with fish on it, and some bread.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>把你们刚才打的鱼拿几条来。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>把你们刚才打的鱼拿几条来。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>把刚才打的鱼拿几条来。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to them, <red>“Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "Bring some of the fish that you have just caught."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to them, "Bring some of the fish which you have just caught."
verses.textEnNlt: "Bring some of the fish you’ve just caught," Jesus said.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to them, "Bring some of the fish which you have now caught."
verses.textEn: Jesus said to them, <red>“Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”</red>

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得就上船，把网拉到岸上；那网满了大鱼，共有一百五十三条。鱼虽然这么多，网却没有破。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得就上船，把网拉到岸上；那网满了大鱼，共有一百五十三条。鱼虽然这么多，网却没有破。
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得就去 ，把网拉到岸上。那网满了大鱼，共一百五十三条；鱼虽这样多，网却没有破。
verses.textEnNiv: So Simon Peter climbed back into the boat and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many the net was not torn.
verses.textEnEsv: So Simon Peter went aboard and hauled the net ashore, full of large fish, 153 of them. And although there were so many, the net was not torn.
verses.textEnNkjv: Simon Peter went up and dragged the net to land, full of large fish, one hundred and fifty-three; and although there were so many, the net was not broken.
verses.textEnNlt: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net to the shore. There were 153 large fish, and yet the net hadn’t torn.
verses.textEnNasb: So Simon Peter went up and hauled the net to land, full of large fish, 153; and although there were so many, the net was not torn.
verses.textEn: So Simon Peter climbed back into the boat and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many the net was not torn.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>你们来，吃早饭吧。</red>"门徒中没有一个人敢问他："你是谁？"因为知道他是主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>你们来，吃早饭吧。</red>"门徒中没有一个人敢问他："你是谁？"因为知道他是主。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们来吃早饭。</red>」门徒中没有一个敢问他：「你是谁？」因为知道是主。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to them, <red>“Come and have breakfast.”</red> None of the disciples dared ask him, “Who are you?” They knew it was the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "Come and have breakfast." Now none of the disciples dared ask him, "Who are you?" They knew it was the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to them, "Come and eat breakfast." Yet none of the disciples dared ask Him, "Who are You?"—knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now come and have some breakfast!" Jesus said. None of the disciples dared to ask him, "Who are you?" They knew it was the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to them, "Come and have breakfast." None of the disciples ventured to inquire of Him, "Who are You?" knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.textEn: Jesus said to them, <red>“Come and have breakfast.”</red> None of the disciples dared ask him, “Who are you?” They knew it was the Lord.

verses.textZh: 耶稣走过来，拿饼递给他们，又照样拿鱼递给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣走过来，拿饼递给他们，又照样拿鱼递给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就来拿饼和鱼给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus came, took the bread and gave it to them, and did the same with the fish.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and so with the fish.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus then came and took the bread and gave it to them, and likewise the fish.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus served them the bread and the fish.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *came and *took the bread and *gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
verses.textEn: Jesus came, took the bread and gave it to them, and did the same with the fish.

verses.textZh: 这是耶稣从死人中复活之后，第三次向门徒显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是耶稣从死人中复活之后，第三次向门徒显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣从死里复活以后，向门徒显现，这是第三次。
verses.textEnNiv: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: This was now the third time that Jesus was revealed to the disciples after he was raised from the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is now the third time Jesus showed Himself to His disciples after He was raised from the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: This was the third time Jesus had appeared to his disciples since he had been raised from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: This was now the third time that Jesus revealed Himself to the disciples, after He was raised from the dead.
verses.textEn: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.

verses.textZh: 他们吃了早饭，耶稣问西门．彼得："约翰的儿子西门，你爱我比这些更深吗？"他回答："主啊，是的，你知道我爱你。"耶稣说："<red>你喂养我的小羊。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们吃了早饭，耶稣问西门．彼得："约翰的儿子西门，你爱我比这些更深吗？"他回答："主啊，是的，你知道我爱你。"耶稣说："<red>你喂养我的小羊。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们吃完了早饭，耶稣对西门‧彼得说：「<red>约翰 的儿子西门，你爱我比这些更深吗？</red>」彼得说：「<red>主啊，是的，你知道我爱你。</red>」耶稣对他说：「<red>你喂养我的小羊。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When they had finished eating, Jesus said to Simon Peter, <red>“Simon son of John, do you love me more than these?”</red> “Yes, Lord,” he said, “you know that I love you.” Jesus said, <red>“Feed my lambs.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When they had finished breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, "Simon, son of John, do you love me more than these?" He said to him, "Yes, Lord; you know that I love you." He said to him, "Feed my lambs."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they had eaten breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me more than these?" He said to Him, "Yes, Lord; You know that I love You." He said to him, "Feed My lambs."
verses.textEnNlt: After breakfast Jesus asked Simon Peter, "Simon son of John, do you love me more than these? " "Yes, Lord," Peter replied, "you know I love you." "Then feed my lambs," Jesus told him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they had finished breakfast, Jesus *said to Simon Peter, "Simon, son of John, do you love Me more than these?" He *said to Him, "Yes, Lord; You know that I love You." He *said to him, "Tend My lambs."
verses.textEn: When they had finished eating, Jesus said to Simon Peter, <red>“Simon son of John, do you love me more than these?”</red> “Yes, Lord,” he said, “you know that I love you.” Jesus said, <red>“Feed my lambs.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣第二次又问他："约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？"他回答："主啊，是的，你知道我爱你。"耶稣说："<red>你牧养我的羊。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣第二次又问他："约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？"他回答："主啊，是的，你知道我爱你。"耶稣说："<red>你牧养我的羊。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣第二次又对他说：「<red>约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？</red>」彼得说：「<red>主啊，是的，你知道我爱你。</red>」耶稣说：「<red>你牧养我的羊。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Again Jesus said, <red>“Simon son of John, do you love me?”</red> He answered, “Yes, Lord, you know that I love you.” Jesus said, <red>“Take care of my sheep.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to him a second time, "Simon, son of John, do you love me?" He said to him, "Yes, Lord; you know that I love you." He said to him, "Tend my sheep."
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to him again a second time, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me?" He said to Him, "Yes, Lord; You know that I love You." He said to him, "Tend My sheep."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus repeated the question: "Simon son of John, do you love me?" "Yes, Lord," Peter said, "you know I love you." "Then take care of my sheep," Jesus said.
verses.textEnNasb: He *said to him again, a second time, "Simon, son of John, do you love Me?" He *said to Him, "Yes, Lord; You know that I love You." He *said to him, "Shepherd My sheep."
verses.textEn: Again Jesus said, <red>“Simon son of John, do you love me?”</red> He answered, “Yes, Lord, you know that I love you.” Jesus said, <red>“Take care of my sheep.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣第三次问他："约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？"彼得因为耶稣第三次问他："你爱我吗？"就忧愁起来，对耶稣说："<red>主啊，你是无所不知的，你知道我爱你。</red>"耶稣说："<red>你喂养我的羊。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣第三次问他："约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？"彼得因为耶稣第三次问他："你爱我吗？"就忧愁起来，对耶稣说："<red>主啊，你是无所不知的，你知道我爱你。</red>"耶稣说："<red>你喂养我的羊。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 第三次对他说：「<red>约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？</red>」彼得因为耶稣第三次对他说「你爱我吗」，就忧愁，对耶稣说：「<red>主啊，你是无所不知的；你知道我爱你。</red>」耶稣说：「你喂养我的羊。
verses.textEnNiv: The third time he said to him, <red>“Simon son of John, do you love me?”</red> Peter was hurt because Jesus asked him the third time, <red>“Do you love me?”</red> He said, “Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you.” Jesus said, <red>“Feed my sheep.</red>
