verses.textEnEsv: He said to him the third time, "Simon, son of John, do you love me?" Peter was grieved because he said to him the third time, "Do you love me?" and he said to him, "Lord, you know everything; you know that I love you." Jesus said to him, "Feed my sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to him the third time, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me?" Peter was grieved because He said to him the third time, "Do you love Me?" And he said to Him, "Lord, You know all things; You know that I love You." Jesus said to him, "Feed My sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: A third time he asked him, "Simon son of John, do you love me?" Peter was hurt that Jesus asked the question a third time. He said, "Lord, you know everything. You know that I love you." Jesus said, "Then feed my sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: He *said to him the third time, "Simon, son of John, do you love Me?" Peter was hurt because He said to him the third time, "Do you love Me?" And he said to Him, "Lord, You know all things; You know that I love You." Jesus *said to him, "Tend My sheep.
verses.textEn: The third time he said to him, <red>“Simon son of John, do you love me?”</red> Peter was hurt because Jesus asked him the third time, <red>“Do you love me?”</red> He said, “Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you.” Jesus said, <red>“Feed my sheep.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实实在在告诉你，你年轻的时候，自己束上腰带，随意往来；但到了年老的时候，你要伸出手来，别人要把你绑着，带你到你不愿意去的地方。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实实在在告诉你，你年轻的时候，自己束上腰带，随意往来；但到了年老的时候，你要伸出手来，别人要把你绑着，带你到你不愿意去的地方。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实实在在地告诉你，你年少的时候，自己束上带子，随意往来；但年老的时候，你要伸出手来，别人要把你束上，带你到不愿意去的地方。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Very truly I tell you, when you were younger you dressed yourself and went where you wanted; but when you are old you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, truly, I say to you, when you were young, you used to dress yourself and walk wherever you wanted, but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you do not want to go."
verses.textEnNkjv: Most assuredly, I say to you, when you were younger, you girded yourself and walked where you wished; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will gird you and carry you where you do not wish."
verses.textEnNlt: "I tell you the truth, when you were young, you were able to do as you liked; you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and others will dress you and take you where you don’t want to go."
verses.textEnNasb: Truly, truly I tell you, when you were younger, you used to put on your belt and walk wherever you wanted; but when you grow old, you will stretch out your hands and someone else will put your belt on you, and bring you where you do not want to go."
verses.textEn: <red>Very truly I tell you, when you were younger you dressed yourself and went where you wanted; but when you are old you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说这话，是指明彼得将怎样死，来荣耀神。说了这话，就对彼得说："<red>你跟从我吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说这话，是指明彼得将怎样死，来荣耀神。说了这话，就对彼得说："<red>你跟从我吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: （耶稣说这话是指着彼得要怎样死，荣耀神。）说了这话，就对他说：「<red>你跟从我吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. Then he said to him, <red>“Follow me!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: (This he said to show by what kind of death he was to glorify God.) And after saying this he said to him, "Follow me."
verses.textEnNkjv: This He spoke, signifying by what death he would glorify God. And when He had spoken this, He said to him, "Follow Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said this to let him know by what kind of death he would glorify God. Then Jesus told him, "Follow me."
verses.textEnNasb: Now He said this, indicating by what kind of death he would glorify God. And when He had said this, He *said to him, "Follow Me!"
verses.textEn: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. Then he said to him, <red>“Follow me!”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得转过身来，看见耶稣所爱的那门徒跟着，就是在晚饭的时候，靠着耶稣的胸膛，问"主啊，出卖你的是谁？"的那个人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得转过身来，看见耶稣所爱的那门徒跟着，就是在晚饭的时候，靠着耶稣的胸膛，问"主啊，出卖你的是谁？"的那个人。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得转过来，看见耶稣所爱的那门徒跟着，（就是在晚饭的时候，靠着耶稣胸膛说：「主啊，卖你的是谁？」的那门徒。）
verses.textEnNiv: Peter turned and saw that the disciple whom Jesus loved was following them. (This was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper and had said, "Lord, who is going to betray you?")
verses.textEnEsv: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them, the one who also had leaned back against him during the supper and had said, "Lord, who is it that is going to betray you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter, turning around, saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following, who also had leaned on His breast at the supper, and said, "Lord, who is the one who betrays You?"
verses.textEnNlt: Peter turned around and saw behind them the disciple Jesus loved—the one who had leaned over to Jesus during supper and asked, "Lord, who will betray you?"
verses.textEnNasb: Peter turned around and *saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them—the one who also had leaned back on His chest at the supper and said, "Lord, who is the one who is betraying You?"
verses.textEn: Peter turned and saw that the disciple whom Jesus loved was following them. (This was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper and had said, "Lord, who is going to betray you?")

verses.textZh: 彼得看见他，就问耶稣："主啊，这个人将来怎么样？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得看见他，就问耶稣："主啊，这个人将来怎么样？"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得看见他，就问耶稣说：「主啊，这人将来如何？」
verses.textEnNiv: When Peter saw him, he asked, "Lord, what about him?"
verses.textEnEsv: When Peter saw him, he said to Jesus, "Lord, what about this man?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, "But Lord, what about this man?"
verses.textEnNlt: Peter asked Jesus, "What about him, Lord?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Peter, upon seeing him, *said to Jesus, "Lord, and what about this man?"
verses.textEn: When Peter saw him, he asked, "Lord, what about him?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答他："<red>如果我要他活到我来的时候，跟你有甚么关系呢？你只管跟从我吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答他："<red>如果我要他活到我来的时候，跟你有甚么关系呢？你只管跟从我吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>我若要他等到我来的时候，与你何干？你跟从我吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you? You must follow me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you? You follow me!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "If I will that he remain till I come, what is that to you? You follow Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you? As for you, follow me."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus *said to him, "If I want him to remain until I come, what is that to you? You follow Me!"
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you? You must follow me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是这话流传在弟兄中间，说那门徒不会死。其实耶稣并没有对他说他不会死，只是说："<red>如果我要他活到我来的时候，跟你有甚么关系呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是这话流传在弟兄中间，说那门徒不会死。其实耶稣并没有对他说他不会死，只是说："<red>如果我要他活到我来的时候，跟你有甚么关系呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是这话传在弟兄中间，说那门徒不死。其实，耶稣不是说他不死，乃是说：「<red>我若要他等到我来的时候，与你何干？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Because of this, the rumor spread among the believers that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say that he would not die; he only said, <red>“If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So the saying spread abroad among the brothers that this disciple was not to die; yet Jesus did not say to him that he was not to die, but, "If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then this saying went out among the brethren that this disciple would not die. Yet Jesus did not say to him that he would not die, but, "If I will that he remain till I come, what is that to you?"
verses.textEnNlt: So the rumor spread among the community of believers that this disciple wouldn’t die. But that isn’t what Jesus said at all. He only said, "If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you?"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this account went out among the brothers, that that disciple would not die; yet Jesus did not say to him that he would not die, but only,"If I want him to remain until I come, what is that to you?"
verses.textEn: Because of this, the rumor spread among the believers that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say that he would not die; he only said, <red>“If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you?”</red>

verses.textZh: 为这些事作证，并且记述这些事的，就是这门徒；我们知道他的见证是真实的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为这些事作证，并且记述这些事的，就是这门徒；我们知道他的见证是真实的。
verses.textZhCuv: 为这些事作见证，并且记载这些事的就是这门徒；我们也知道他的见证是真的。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who wrote them down. We know that his testimony is true.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the disciple who is bearing witness about these things, and who has written these things, and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the disciple who testifies of these things, and wrote these things; and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.textEnNlt: This disciple is the one who testifies to these events and has recorded them here. And we know that his account of these things is accurate.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the disciple who is testifying about these things and wrote these things, and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.textEn: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who wrote them down. We know that his testimony is true.

verses.textZh: 耶稣所行的，还有许多其他的事；如果都一一写下来，所要写成的书，我想就是这个世界也容不下了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣所行的，还有许多其他的事；如果都一一写下来，所要写成的书，我想就是这个世界也容不下了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣所行的事还有许多，若是一一地都写出来，我想，所写的书就是世界也容不下了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus did many other things as well. If every one of them were written down, I suppose that even the whole world would not have room for the books that would be written.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there are also many other things that Jesus did. Were every one of them to be written, I suppose that the world itself could not contain the books that would be written.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there are also many other things that Jesus did, which if they were written one by one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that would be written. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus also did many other things. If they were all written down, I suppose the whole world could not contain the books that would be written.
verses.textEnNasb: But there are also many other things which Jesus did, which, if they were written in detail, I expect that even the world itself would not contain the books that would be written.
verses.textEn: Jesus did many other things as well. If every one of them were written down, I suppose that even the whole world would not have room for the books that would be written.
